tei:div.tei:p: tsho — rngan ra sa sgrorna chu/khas zhu ཿcu mi 3 ཿrus rtsa ཿru tsho
༄༅/ /dpa' ris bsang brngon yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

r+shaswā sdutsha ṇa sbyaṣ+ṭha oṃ zakham / 9 8 gyu di —6 spang sa 4 sgo khuṣ+ṭha chosamatsho pogyi cho4)rtswa saXhā tshil sa ཿbo — lhaswā sbyitsha byu t+t+waṃ sdu 6ཿཿ ṭ+wāṃ ṭ+wāṃ momi caḥ / 27shā sdu lngas rgyu sta tshosdu gzha glu 6cir lta'i tshi nga ma mchinā kha lko
༄ga /dpa' ris bod rang skyong rdzong btsugs nas lo 'khor drug cu lon par legs skyes su phul pa'o/ /tshogalha tsho rda~Xdardorwashā sdu/ 260 sgo

gleng gzhi/lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'byung khungs bshad pa dang / de dag dang 'brel ba'i rig gnas kyi rin thang bshad pa gnyis las/dang bo/ lha srin sde brgyad du gtogs pa'i gzugs med kyi sems can dag gi ming dang rigs kyi dbye ba/ de dag mchod tshul gyi goms srol sogs gdod ma'i dus nas byung ba'i mi yi lta spyod 'tsho ba'i rig gnas shig yin par snang la/ goms srol de 'dzam gling shar phyogs rgya gar dang rgya nag nub phyogs rgya ser ku ru si dang rob ma sogs su gna' snga mo nas byung bar 'dugabod la yang lha gsol 'dre mchod kyi yul srol de bon gyi dus nas byung bar 'dug rgya gar du ches gna' snga mo nas de ba ste lha dang / pi shā tsi ste 'dre/ga rba ste dri za sogs kyi ming de yod par snang la/ lo stong phrag lnga'i sngo na nas byung ba'i rig byed kyi gzhung du mchod sbyin zhes lha mchod pa'i cho ga dang sbyin sreg byed tshul sogs yod/ mchod rdzas me la bsregs nas lha mchod tshul gyi sbyin sreg byed pa de bod kyi bsang gsur gyi gdod ma'i 'byung khungs yin par snang / de yang 'jig rten grags pa'i kun rdzob ma brlags shig ces gsungs pa ltar/rgya gar 'phags pa'i yulanas byung ba'i sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bka' bstan bcos nang du yang rgya gar gna' dus kyi lha chos mi chos kyi goms srol

ba/da sbyal mang bo zhig rig gnas kyi rgyun gyi tshul du 'dres yod pa smra mi da sa de /ba/zhin rgya nag tu dar ba'i sangs rgyas chos lugs la dge tshul slong gi gon rgyu dang za ma/ sangs rgyas byang sems gnas brtan sogs kyi cha byad snang brnyan tshang ma rgya dag gi yul srol dang bstun yod la/ dper na sku stod sgrib g.yogs med pa'i na chung mdzes ma'i nyams kyi rje btsun sgrol ma de rgya yul du zhal phyag ma gtogs lus yongs rdzogs bsgribs pa'i gna' dus kyi rgya mo'i nyams byas yod pa lta bus mtshon/ phyi'i cha lugs steng du rgya lugs byas yod par ma zad/ nang sems kyi lta ba la yang rgya'i rig gnas kyi shad zhugs mngon gsal tā / /rgyu/da nang bstan la yang bon po'i rig gnas kyi shan zhugs bsre slad mang ba de bzhin yin la/ dper na/ lha 'dre rten mchod/ lab tse bcigs pa/ bas nga mchod dang dkar gsur dmar gsur gtong ba/ gto mdos glud gsum gtong ba/ bon gyer zhes 'don chog rta dbyangs 'then pa/ rnga gshang rol mo brdung ba/ 'bag gyon bro 'cham byed pa/ rtsam phye gtor ma bzo stangs sogs tshang ma bod rang sa'i bon po'i lugs srol las byung ba sha stag red/lha srin sde brgyad ces pa'i ming yang rgya gar gyi sngon gyi rig gnas nang du yod pa sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi mdo rgyud sogs su bed spyod byas pa yin pa 'dra/ sde brgyad kyi grangs 'dren lugaX la mi 'dra ba du ma yod pa las/

dang bo/ shā ri'i bu'i mdo las byung ba/ de ba/(lha) nā ga(klu) yak+ṣa/(gnod sbyin) gsarba/ (dri za) a su ra/ (lha ma yin) ga ru ḍa/ (khyung)kim na ra/ (mi'am ci ste lus mi dang 'dra zhing mgo na rwa yod cing skad snyan pa'i sems can gyi rigs shig) ma ho ra ga (sto 'phye ste sbrul chen po)gnyis pa/byams zhus mdo 'grel (rgya 'gyur) las byung ba'i rgyal chen bzhi'i 'khor gyi sde brgyad ni/ garnyarba/ (dri za) pi sha tsi/ (mdangs za ba'i 'dre) kum+bhaṇ+ḍa/ (spul bum ste lto ba bum pa'i dbyibs can gyi 'dre rigs) bre ta/ (yi dwags) nā ga (klu) gu ta na/ (lus srul bo ste lus la dri ngan bro ba'i 'dre rigs) yak+ṣa/ (gnod sbyin) rāk+ṣa sna/ (srin po)gsum pa/ 1 dkar bo lha'i sde/ 2 dag po bdud kyi sde/ 3 dmar bo btsan gyi sde/ 4 sug po dmu'i sde/ 5 khra bo gza' yi sde/6 sha za srin po'i sde/ 7 dkor bdag rgyal po'i sde/ na nad bdag ma mo'i sde'o// bshad tshul gsum pa 'di bon po'i bshad tshul zhig yin pa 'dra/ de min pa'i phyi nang gsang ba'i sde brgyad sogs bshad tshul du ma yod/bod du dar ba'i lha 'dre'i skor gyi bshad tshul 'di dag gi khungs ni mdo rgyud bstan bcos nas byung ba dang /bon po'i rig gnas las byung ba bcas rigs gnyis yod/mdo rgyud bstan bcos las byung ba'i chos skyong skor la dge 'dun dkon mchog gi gral du the ba'i ye shes pa dang / der mi the ba'i 'jig rten pa ste rigs gnyis yod/ de yang 'jig /na las 'das pa'i mthong lam thob pa

ye shes pa dang / lam zhugs tshogs sbyor lam pa ba dang / lam ma zhugs pa'i lha 'dre'i rigs la 'jig rten pa zer ba yin/mdo rgyud kyi nang du byung ba'i phyogs skyong zhing skyong sogs la 'jig rten las 'das ma 'das rigs gnyis yod la/ 'jig rten las 'das kyang 'jig rten pa'i tshul bzung ba'ang yod/ bod rang yul nas byung ba'i bon dang sangs rgyas chos lugs kyi bstan srung yul lha gzhi bdag bon gyi yig tshang du byung ba dang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis dam la btags pa'i lo rgyus kyi khungs dang ldan pa phal cher 'jig rten pa'i khongs su gtogs/ de min lo rgyus kyi khungs med pa'i lha 'dre sangs rgyas byang sems kyi sprul ba sogs su ming 'dod du btags nas bsten mkhan yod kyang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ nga dang nga 'dra bas gang zag gi tshod gzung bar bya yi/ gang zag gis gang zag gi tshod bzung na nyams par gyur ta re/ zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/spyod pa min na kho rang sangs rgyas yin bsams nas/ lha 'dre che ge mo zhig sangs rgyas cig cig cig gi sprul ba red ces mi chos bla ma'i rdzun chos smra mkhan su zhig yod/ chos kyi gnas lugs shes pa zhig yin na lung rigs rnam bag gi khungs med pa dang / lha mthong 'dre mthong gi mngon shes smra ba sogs kyi la la brgyugs nas 'jig rten pa'i lha 'dre bsten cing skyabs su bzung na skyabs 'gro'i bslab bya dang 'gal ba yin pas/ de las bslus pa dang de las ngo tsha che ba'i bya spyod ci zhig yod/ de yang gzugs med kyi sems can de rigs

la lha dang 'dre'i khyad par nges can zhig 'byed dka'/mi rnams la gnod 'tshe mi byed cing phan bde sgrub pa la dkar phyogs pa dang lha zer zhing / gnod 'tshe byed mkhan la nag phyogs pa dang gdon dang 'dre zer ba yin/ lha 'dre nang gses kyi dbye ba'i rigs mang du yod/ 'jig rten pa'i lha srung spyi ldog tsam bshad na gzugs med 'dre'i khongs su gtogs shing / 'dre de la sems can la phan gnod kyi steng nas dkar phyogs pa dang dag phyogs pa gnyis su phye ba red/ dper na sum pa paṇ+ḍi ta'i gsung na bod mi 'dre mchod pa la dga' zhes pa de yul lha gzhi bdag mchod pa la ma rangs pa'i bka' bkyon gnang ba red/ mchog gsum bsten mchod mi byed par 'jig rten pa'i lha gal chen byas nas mchod na mkhas pas ma smad kyang rang nyid blun po yin par mtshon 'dug 'o na 'jig rten pa'i dgra lha yul lha gzhi bdag 'di'i rigs 'khor ba rigs drug gi dang gi rigs gang yin zer na/tshangs pa brgya byin nyi zla'i lha sogs lha'i rigs/ gza' sgra gcan sogs lha min gyi rigs/klu dang mkha' lding lto 'phye sogs dud 'gro'i rigs/ grul bum sha za srin po rgyal gdon 'gong bo the'u rang sogs yi dwags kyi rigs yin/ 'on kyang gzugs med kyi sems can de rigs las byung ba'i mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs sna tshogs yod pas dga' na phan grogs dang khros na gnod pa byed pas de dag gang la gang mthun gyi bza' btung longs spyod bstabs pa'i mchod 'bul gyi lam lugs shig 'jig rten stan tu gna' snga mo nas dar ba red/ de

dag gzugs med kyi sems can yin pas gzugs mthong ba'i spyir btang gis mig gis mi mthong yang / mi mthong ba'i rtags kyis med par sgrub mi nus te/ mig gis gzugs ma gtogs/ sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya gang yang mig gis mi rig pas/ sgra dri ro reg bya med par sgrub mi nus shing / gzugs yin kyang gzugs phra mo rdul phra rab mig gis mi rig cing / rdo khab len gyi nus pa sogs tshan rig gis ngos 'dzin byas pa'i gzugs dngos kyi nus pa gsum po gang yang mig gis rig mi thub cing / gna' nas da bar du shar nub kyi mi rigs gang gi nang na yang lha 'dre'i gtam mang du bshad rgyu yod pas spya thamaX cad thun dang rmongs dad kho na red ces thag gcod sus kyang dzod /rdo/ rte/na/ pa'i lha srin sde brgyad de rigs ji ltar byung ba'i khungs la dpyad na/ mi yi thog ma 'od gsal lha las mched pa'i bshad tshul yod la/bshad tshul de yang dpyad gzhi gal chen zhig tu snang la/ khungs med rdzun gtam kho na zhes thag gcod par dka' yang / gtso bo mi yi rigs kyi rgyal bo dang blon chen/ lo rgyus steng du byas rjes chen po yod pa'i dmag dpon dpa' bo dang / sa cha dang tsho sde so so'i tsho dpon sde dpon dang mes po byas rjes can sogs kyi rnam shes dag dgra lha dang yul lha gzhi bdag tu bkur zhing mchod pa'i srol las byung ba yin par shes byed kyi rtags mang du yod/ dper na/gna' dus gling gis sa bzung ba'i da/ga gi rgyal bo byas rjes can gling seng

chen khams phyogs su dgra lha byas nas bsten cing mchod pa dang / khri srong lde btsan gyi dmag gis bhan ta hor gyi sgom ga (su nan yu gur rdzong gi sa gnas shig) bcom nas gdan drangs pa'i bsam yas kyi dkor bdag pe har rgyal bo ni hor gur dkar rgyal bo'i rnam shes lha srin du gyur pa dang / hor gur dkar rgyal bo ni gling seng chen gyis hor 'dul skabs bgrongs pa'i stabs kyis pe har rgyal bo bsten sar gling seng chen mi mchod cing ge sar sgrung yang mi len pa dang / gling seng chen bsten sar pe har mi mchod pa'i lugs srol chags yod pa lta bu red/ yang rgya nag gong ma'i dbu bla rnams kyis bsten pa'i sprin ring rgyal bo zhes pa de ni rgya nag rgyal khab gsum du gyes pa'i dus kyi dmag dpon dpa' chen bkan yun khrang gi rnam shes yin pa dang / bsod nams grags pa'i sprul skur ngos bzung ba'i grwa ba grags pa rgyal mtshan nyid smon lam log pas shi 'dre gdug rtsub can du gyur pa rdo rje shugs ldan zhes par 'bod pa dang / de bzhin rma rgyal sbom ra yang rma chu'i stod rgyud kyi 'brog pa yongs kyi mes po bka' drin can zhig gi rnam shes gzhi bdag chen por bkur ba yin par gor ma chag go/gnyis pa/ bod kyi yul lha gzhi bdag bsten mchod byed pa'i goms srol gyi rig gnas kyi rin thang bshad pa/ de yang gangs ri rdza ri spang ri mang bor yul lha gzhi bdag gi lha ri gnas ri sogs su ming btags nas gus mchod byed srol de bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rig gnas gal chen zhig yin la/

bod ni dam pa'i chos la dad pa brtan po yod pa'i mi rigs shig yin pas/ ri bo gal chen sogs la yul lha gzhi bdag gi lha ri gnas rir ming btags nas gus mchod byed cing srung skyob byed pa dang / lab tse bstod pa/ gnas skor ri skor byed pa sogs la dgos phan du ma yod de/ dang bo/ rang byung gi khor yug srung skyob phyogs la phan pa chen po yod de/ lha la dad pa'i mi rigs rnams lha ri gnas ri rnams lha gang dang gang gi gnas yin bsam zhing / ri de'i mtha' skor gyi spang dang nags tshal/ sa 'og gi gter kha tshang ma gzhi bdag gi longs spyod dang / der gnas pa'i gcan gzan ri dwags 'dab chags tshang ma gzhi bdag de'i sgo phyugs yin pa'i 'du shes 'dzin cing / lha ri'i shing gcod pa dang / gter 'don gser rko sa slog rdo slog byed pa dang /'dab chags ri dwags gcan gzan gsod pa sogs byas na lha klu gnyan gsum mi dga' zhing / lha klu sogs kyis gnod bskyal nas mi la na tsha phyugs la god kha/ zhing la sad ser than pa/ 'thab rtsod mu ge chu log rlung 'tshub sogs ltas ngan sna tshogs 'byung zhes pa'i lta tshul dam por bzung nas/ khor yug srung skyob byed pa dang / lta ba des rang byung khor yug srung skyob kyi phyogs la phan 'bras rlabs chen byung nas/ da lta'i bar rang byung khor yug srung skyob phyogs la mdo dbus gtsang gsum la khor yug gtor brlag gi nyen kha ma byung ba'i 'dzam gling gi gtsang ma'i gnas nyag cig tu gyur to// gal te sngar nas bod rnams lha chos la mi dad pa'i mi rigaX shig tu gyur yod na bod yul gyi rang

sding shār sdug kyang h+phe gling ltar bye thang skam po zhig tu gyur yod med la the tshom rmu da mi su/// pa/ mda' mdung ral gri me mda' sogs kyis lab tse bstod srol de yang gdod ma'i dus su tsho sde ru sde phan tshun bar sa rtsod rgyu 'phrog gi 'thab 'khrug zhi nas lha srung dpang du bzhag ste 'thab 'khrug gi mtshon cha thams cad bsdus nas lha la 'bul zhing / phyin chad phan tshun 'thab 'khrug mi slong ba'i mna' bcad dam bzhag gi byed sgo zhig yin par 'dug mda' bstod lab bstod kyi skabs su tsho sde so so lhan du tshogs nas rta rgyug mda' 'phen/ chang 'thung glu len gar rtse'i ston mo byed pa sogs yul sde tsho sde'i mi rnams phan tshun 'brel 'dris mdza' mthun byed pa'i dgos pa 'grub pa sogs rig gnas kyi nang don mang du yod pa'i bya ba gal chen zhig yin par ma zad/lha ri gnas ri dang lab tse sogs mi rigs gang gi sa gnas yin pa'i rtags mtshan gal chen zhig kyang red/bzhi ba/ sa cha so so'i yul lha gzhi bdag gi sku mdog gzugs byad/gos rgyan khrab rmog skor gsum/ phyag gi mtshon cha/ 'og gi bzhon pa/ zhol yag pho mo sogs spyan gzigs/ sha mgron dkar mo lag g.yas/ zho 'o mar thud rtsam phye gtor ma 'bul ba/ gser g.yu'i bye ma btab pa'i chang gi gser skyems/ gsol mchod byed skabs kyi 'don rta bon po'i gyer dbyangs 'thenapa/ rnga gshang brdung ba/ bsang mchod rda ga yi ger bkod pa'i ri lung nags

tshal mtsho dang chu mig sogs snod bcud bkod pa'i yul ljongs kyi khyad par sogs lo rgyus dang spyi tshogs kyi khyad chos mang bo mtshon yod pa spyir btang gi 'o rgyus yig tshang nang du bkod med pa mang du yod/ gling sgrung nang du 'thab 'khrug dang chab srid kyi gnas tshul bkod yod la/ gna' mi'i bod kyi rgyan cha lugs 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul sogs yul lha gzhi bdag gi thang kha gzugs ris dang / bsang brngon cho ga las mang du go rgyu yod pas/ bsang bangon cho ga ni bod kyi gna' rabs lo rgyus dang spyi tshogs 'tsho ba'i gnas tshul la zhib 'jug byed pa'i yig tshang rin thang bla na med pa zhig yin par kho bos mgrin pa gzengs su bstod nas smras so//zhes spyi lo2009lo'i zla5ba'i nangadudapa' ris bsang brngon phyogs bsgrigs par /༷/ /nga gzhir dge rgan chen mo'i minga'adzin dor zhi gdong drug snyems blor 'bod

dkar chagalha rnams mnyes par byed pa/ /saX/ mju/ /dro shi/sa 'khyil ba/rgyal dbang lnga ba/(1)bsang mchod bkra shis g.yas 'khyil dung gi sgra dbyangs/ (16)lha bsang yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/'jam dbyangs ye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan/(18)bsang rnam dag ma/ bsod nams ye shes dbang bo/(20)rgyags brngan lha bsang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/(yo)bsang chung yid bzhin nor bu/ tshul khrims nor bu'i 'od zer/(61)mnol bsang lha chab sngon mo/ slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/(cha)mnol bsang dang grib bsang / chu bzang rin po che/(yo)bstan bsrung spyi'i 'phrin bcol/ lcang skya rol ba'i rdo je/(87)gzhi bdag spyi'i dkar gtor/ (89)sa bdag klu gnyan gyi bsang mchod/ rong bo blo bzang 'phrin las/(93)'go ba'i lha lnga rlung rta nor lug bsang gcan gzan kha chings bcas kyi bsang bsdus nor bu'i phreng ba/ chab mdo lcags ra sprul sku/(/4)

dgra lha bcu gsum bsdus pa/ rā ga a gye/(97)lam lha'i bsang bkra shis don grub/ mi pham rnam par rgyal ba/(98)glog sgron smon lam/ gung thung bstan pa'i dbang phyug(tsho)gnyis pa/ rlung rta/rlung rta'i bsang mchod/ paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan/(10))rlung rta'i bsang mchod 'bul tshul/ blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes/(101)rlung rta bskyed chog kun mkhyen 'jigs med dbang bo/(103)gsum pa/ 'ju lag chu rgyud kyi gzhi bdag gi bsang brngon/'ju lag mthon po bcu gsum gyi bsang brngon/stong 'khor bsod nams rgya mtsho/(105)yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum la bsang brngon gtong tshul dregs pa dgyes pa'i mchod sprin/ sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma/(108)ka drod kyi gsol kha bsdus pa/ thu'u bkan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma/(119)ka drod kyi bsang mchod byin rlabs gter mdzod/sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma/(121)ka drod kyi gsol kha dgos 'dod kun 'byung /stong 'khor bsod nams rgya mtsho/(123)ka drod gsol mchod mdor bsdus dngos grub char 'bebs/2 dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo/(125)

dkar phyogs skyong ba'i yul lhag ka drod la rgyags brngan gtong tshul lha srung mnyes pa'i rol dbyangs/ sman pa bsod nams tshe ring /(128)yul lha'i sde dpon chen po dge bsnyen khra leb kyi gsol mchod rgyas pa dregs pa dgyes pa'i dbyangs snyan/sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma/(141)yul lha'i rgyal po khra leb chen po'i bsang brngon 'bul tshul bde bskyed rta ljang dbang bo 'dren pa'i shing rta/ ngag dbang thub bstan dbang phyug(155)srid pa'i lha chen khra leb mthon po'i bsang mchod legs byas dpal ster/khrab le ba ba sa nga ba sdu sa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron me///sdu/// /// ༷ /da/ nor skyong sogs yul lha'i bsang ba rngo na / //sdu/rgyal chen stag btsan don grub kyi gsol mchod shin tu rgyas pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/ sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma/(170)stag btsan la gsol mchod bya tshul dgos 'dod sbrang rtsi'i char rgyun/ 'jam dpal rgya mtsho/(189)dmar mtho'i gsol mchod/ sman pa bsod nams tshe ring /(191)dmar mtho'i bsang bsdus 'dod don kun 'grub/sman pa bsod nams tshe ring /(19 2)rab bzang gi gsol kha/ stong skor ngag dbang bsod nams rgya mtsho/(1/3)

lha gnyan chen po rab bzang la gsol mchod kyi cho ga phan bde'i char 'bebs/sdo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma/(196)rab bzang gsol mchod mdor bsdus rin chen rdul brtsegs ma/dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo/(211)dmar mtho gtso ba'i yul lha spyi la bsang brngon 'bul tshul lha srung dgyes bskyed/ stod rgyud mkhan zur nor bu/(213)lhun po'i bsang sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma/(219)ra rgod gzhi bdag gi bsang brngon phan bde 'dod 'jo/sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma/(221)skya ka ri la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag dge bsnyen gtsug phud bzang la bsang brngon gtong tshul snyan pa'i 'brug sgra/phyug lung skya mtho'i gzhi bdag gi gsol khasdo/ kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma/(228)sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma/(237)mdo smad lha ri phyug rdzong mchod thabs/ blo bzang thub bstan rgya mtsho/(89)dgra lha'i rgyal po dge bsnyen dpa' 'bar gyi gsol mchod/sdo kho ngag dbang legs bshad tshul/(241)stobs ldan la bsang mchod 'bul tshul/ (243)stobs ldan la bsang brngon gyi cho ga 'dod don 'grub pa'i glu dbyangs/sngon kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma/(245)

skya ring /sngo ring sogs rang rtags phyogs kyi gzhi bdag gi bsang mchod gan/ /// ///sa pa dbang phyug gi gsol mchod rnam rgya la snya na pa 'i (2༅)'brug sgra/ sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma/(252)bya dkar bsang bsdus/ (2glu/drang srong chen po kurma bzang skyong gi gsol mchod 'phrin las bskul byed g.yas 'khyil dung gi rang sgra/rgya tig ngag dbang dkon mchog rgya mtsho/(261)gzhi bdag chen po yum cha kurma bzang skyong gi gsol mchod/bsam gtan don 'grub/(275)yul skyong kun bzang stobs rgyas kyi gsol mchod bya tshul dregs pa dgyes byed 'dod dgu'i dbyangs snyan/sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma/(279)dge 'phel gzhi bdag gi gsol kha/ ngag dbang bsod nams/(297)dge 'phel gnyan chen rnam rgyal rab brtan gyi gsol mchod bsam 'phel dbang rgyal/ rgya tig ngag dbang dkon mchog rgya mtsho/(30))dge legs rab brtan la bsang brngon 'bul tshul lha rgyal snyan pa'i gad rgyangs/ ma ṇi zhabs drung ngag dbang 'phrin las/(311)zu2ngab pa:) bsathang 6sgob/ (318)

bzhi ba/ jag rong gzhung chu'i gzhi bdag gi bsang brngon/gzhi bdag lha'i dge bsnyen gzi brjid 'phags kyi gsol mchod lha mchog dgyes pa'i rol mo thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma/(319)yul lha'i rgyal po lha yi dge bsnyen chen po'i gsol mchod bsdus pa/ (329)khra rab /ge leX ༷ba brtan la gnas ba'i gzhi bdag chen po'i gsol phyug // /shā bye ༷bye/ /na/ ba za nga da ga 'a ba skye da (41) thu'u bkwan bskal bzang dam chos nyi ma/(3 33)bkra shis dpal mtho'i bsang ma ṇi bla ma/(3 35)gnas bdag pad+ma baja9re bsang yig ( 3 37)bkra shis bom sngon gyi bsang mchod/ thu'u bkwan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma/( 339)bom sngon gsol mchod dge legs dpal ster/dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo/(341)bom sngon gyi bsang mchod bsdus pa/ sman pa bson nams tshe ring/(343)lnga ba/ stag lung zhwa dmar phyogs kyi gzhi bdag gi bsang brngon/'bri gung dgon pa'i mchod gzhi dang bcas pa'i gsol kha/thu'u bkwan blobazang chosakyi nyi ma/(344)yul lha kun dga' nor 'dzin gyi gsol mchod/ (347)36 ma35ga rma rgyal sbom ra:rno gsol maḥdzad/ (348)

rma chen gyi gsol mchod/ ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtsho/(34)yul lha rma rgyal sbom ra'i bsang mchod/ (34)rma chen bsang bsdus/ zhabs dkar pa tshogs drug rang grol/(359)dor zhi gnas bdag stobs ldan dbang phyug gi bsang mchod/dor zhi gdong drug snyems blo/(37)drug ba/ hor nags yangs kyi gzhi bdag gi bsang brngon/rgya yag dgon dge tshogs gling gi gzhi bdag gsol kha/thu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi ma/(363)dpa' stag la gsol mchod 'bul tshul lha chen dgyes pa'i mchod sprin rdzogs ldan gsar ba 'gugs pa'i kyo ba/ ki rti rnyarma sra nyi/(365)dpa' stag bsang mchod bsam dgu lhun grub ma/ a lags mdo ba/(372)shug bkra'i yul lha rnams mnyes par byed pa'i bsang mchod mu tig phreng ba/ dbyangs can rol ba'i rdo rje/(374)chu rul kha lung ba'i gzhi bdag gnyan chen sde bzhi la bsang mchod rnam /sdu /shāX /kha byams pa bub bstan rgya mtsho//sbyardo/bdun pa/ sum mdo dang 'khru gu'i bsang brngon/dge bsnyen seng mtho'i bsang mchod bsdus pa byin rlabs sprin phung /sa skya pa rje btsun kurma rol pa'i rdo rje/(3/5)

bal chan gsol kha bsdus pa/ bsod nams/(ma༅)phyug mo'i gsol mchod/ pad+ma 'phrin las 'gyur med rdo rje/(49)phyug mo'i gsol kha bde skyid kun 'byung / bsam gtan don 'grub/(391)klu mo dung skyong ma'i gsol kha/ (393)yul skyong zho lung mthon po'i bsang gsol yul lha dga' ba'i bzhad sgra/gnas bdag nor bu g.yul rgyal gyi bsang ma chod lha zlo / /bang 'phrin las/(48)brag dkar ga she ga sa ga to ra da byangaX/ / /dri /rdo gā rdo ṭ+wāṃ//////dge bsnyen brag dkar gyi bsang brngon bkra shis 'khyil ba/lha yi dge bsnyen chen po'i bskang gso pad+mo rgyasang shā ṭ+wāṃ rnyi/ byid grags rgya mtsho//////brgyad pa/ gser skyems/rgyal po sku lnga'i gser skye/sprus/ (428)dregs pa sde brgyad la gser skyesas gtong ba'i cho ga bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng thu'u bkan blo bzang chos kyi nyi ma/(432)dgra lha'i dbang bo lha gnyan dpa' stag la gser skyems 'bul tshul lha dgyes mchod sprin/ byams pa thub bstan rgya mtsho/(437)'ju lag mthon po bcu gsum dang gnas bdag byams pa dbang phyug gi 8 gser skyernas/ sngo kho ngas dbang legs bshad nyi ma/(440)

tshangs pa'i gser skyems dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags myu/sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi ma/(42)dgu ba/ g.yang 'bod/sgrol ma'i g.yang 'bod/ 'jigs med bsam gtan rgya mtsho/(mi )gang ser ma (45)klu thebs phan bde'i char 'bebs (47)mjug byang / (48)mjug byang(rgya yig) ( 7)

dang po/ spyi bsang /lha rnams mnyes par byed pa'i bsang mchod bkra shis 'khyil ba/༄ //phun tshogs dri ldan bsang mchod gaṅgā'i rgyun//mi gtsang nyes tshogs 'khrud pa'i cho ga mkhan//khungs ldan mes po'i thod las 'dren byed pa'i//sngon med skal ldan shing rta 'di sus bsgrun//rgyal kun ngo bo mtsho skyes gsang ba'i gsung //rdo rje'i tshig gi bdud rtsi phra mos kyang //rgud pa'i 'chi bdag 'joms nus de bor nas//yig hrul ngan skyugs 'thung las blun pa su//'on kyang kha ba'i ljongs 'dir rang snang ngor//cher rlom mtshan rgyu'i gnyis skyes mang bo yi rang bzo'i skad ngan bsgrags la tshangs dbyangs zhes//'jug rnams smig rgyur snyog pa'i ri dwags bzhin//de phyir bdag 'dra'i blo gros ba tshwa'i mtshor//shes rab dman pa'i skyogs kyis bcus pa'ichu//don gnyis mngar ba'i 'bras bur re ba dag /nam ma kha'i pad+mor lag pas reg min nam//de lta na yang don gnyer can 'ga' yis/ /nan tan tshig gi dbyug gus rab bskul bas/ /phun tshogs snyan 'gyur tshangs pa 'i rnga bo che//rnam dpyod mgrin pa 'i lam du dar dir sgrogs/ /lha rnams mnyes byed bsang mchod kyi//bcos kyi rim pa nyams bstar bar//sna

tshogs ljon shing sman sna dang //dkar gsum mngar gsum bye mar spos//rin chen 'bru sna sha mar chang / /mthun pa'i rdzas kun legs bshams nas//rang nyid bde ba'i stan 'dug ste//ma yengs ngang nas gyer bar bya// skyabs 'gro ni/rdu/ byin rlabs dngos grub char 'bebs bar chad sel/ /dpal ldan rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs la//bdag sogs 'gro ba ma lus dus 'di nas//byang chub snying bo'i bar du skyabs su mchi// sems bskyed pa ni/ rgyu/ pha mtha' yongs bral 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho cher//ma rig 'khrul ba'i klong du 'khyams pa'i 'gro//rig pa'i ngo bo rin chen gling mchog tu//bgrod phyir byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed do//tshogs zhing ni/ rgyu/ dag pa'i mkha' dbyings 'ja' zer 'khrigs pa'i klong //yid bzhin 'o mtshor 'khyil dbus pad sdong rtser/ /nyi zla'i gdan steng dus gsum rgyal ba'i gtso//pad+ma 'byung gnas khro chags zhi ba'i nyams//phyag g.yas rdo rje rtse lnga thugs kur 'dzin//g.yon pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i ka pā la//kha ṭaṃ rtse gsum sku yi g.yon phyogs brten//gnyen zhu rgod sgro me long dar snas mdzes//za ber gsang gos mthing kha snam sbyar brtsegs//zhabs gnyis mi byed rdo rje skyil mo krung //thabs shes zung 'jug bde stong phyag rgya'i gzugs/ /yid 'dzin mtsho rgyal gzung ma'i tshul gyis sgeg /skyabs gnas kun gyi thugs rje'i rol gar la sa//bzhin legs rnam par shar ba mtshan dpe'i gzugs//thogs med gshegs la rig 'dzin slob dpon che'i//steng 'og phyogs mtshams kun tu bzhugs su gsol//mi byed dang ba'i yid kyis phyag 'tshal zhing //'dzad

med kun tu bzang bo'i mchod sprin stobs//sdig snang nyes pa'i tshogs kun so sor bshags/ /dus gsum dge ba kun la rjes yi rangs//zab cing rgya che'i chos 'khor bskor bar skul/ /gzugs sku bskal brgyar mi g.yo gsol ba 'debs//dus gsum rnam par dkar ba'i dge ba'i las//kun bzang gdod ma'i go 'phang thob phyir bsngo/ bsang rdzas byin gyis rlabs pa ni/rgyu/ rang nyid rdor sems spyi bor rigs kyi bdag/ bla ma kun bzang mtshan dpe'i gar mkhan can//sbyong spel bsgyur thob tshim zhing dbang byed lha'i//thugs ke'i sa bon 'od zer 'phro 'du las//mi mthun nyes pa'i skyon tshogs rab sbyangs te//'dod pa'i re ba ma lus skong gyur cig /oṃ shudhe shudhe shodha na ye swā hā//oṃ badz+ra satwa rdu//oṃ su bhā wa shudha sarba dharmaḥsu bhā wa bi thu lhalha//oṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta skyo bi shā mu khe caḥsarba tak+ṣa.uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i me ga ga na khaṃ swā hā//oṃ badz+ra a skṛ ta ku li ha na ha na rdu phaṭa//na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te//oṃ saṃ bha ra sa ra rgyu//oṃ tshwa na a wa lo ki te//na mas sa man+ta sga ra ṇa rasmi bha wa ma hā ma ṇi du ru du ru hrī dā ya dz+wa la ni ga hā//na mas sa man+ta gusgyu rna gra gye shwa ri pra bhañdza na ma hā sa ma ya hūṃ phaṭaḥ ces brjod cingaphyag rgya rnams bya'o/gzhung dngos la 'jug pa'i bdagabaskyed ni/skye/ pad sdong nyi zla brtsegs steng bdag nyid ni//srid gsum zil gnon pad+ma thod phreng rtsal//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i 'khor gyis bskor ba'i dbus//'jigs med lhun chags brjid pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs//mgon thugs rje chen po'i 'od zer gyis//zhing dag pa rab 'byams pad+ma 'od//gnas zangs mdog dpal ri'i

pho brang na//rje rgyal ba kun 'dus pad+ma 'byung //sku mtshan dpe'i 'dzum 'od me re re//gsung tshangs pa'i dbyangs snyan di ri ri//thugs gsal stong 'dzin med hrigs se hrig /lha zhi khro'i 'gying bag shigs se shig /yab dpa' bo'i gar stabs khrabs se khrab/ /ma dpa' mo'i glu len sha ra ra/ /'gying pho nya'i bro brdungs chems se chem//mdangs 'ja' tshon 'od lnga khyugs se khyugakhyed thugs rje chen po'i byin rlabs kyis//gnas 'di ru byin chen char ltar phobs/ /rdzas bsang mchod kun la nus pa skyed//bdag 'dir tshogs rnams la dngos grub stsol/ oṃ sa / badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/mgron spyana'adrenapani/hūṃ/ thugs rje byin rlabs rtsa brgyud bla ma dang //dngos grub rtsa ba yi dam dkyil 'khor lha//'phrin las kun sgrub dam can chos skyong tshogs//mthun rkyen spel mdzad rigs brgyud 'go ba'i lha//srid gsum gnas pa'i sde brgyad gzhi bdag sogs//ma lus spyan 'dren thogs med 'dir gshegs la//rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la brtan par bzhugs//phyi nang mchod tshogs bsang gis mnyes gyur cig/ bsang gyer ba ni/hūṃ/ 'gyur med mkha' khyab chos sku spros bral la//gsang gsum mi zad rnam rol longs spyod rdzogs//thugs rjes 'gro la cir snang sprul ba'i sku/ /'gro ba'i dbang bor 'tsham pa'i sgyu dra'i gar//gzhom gzhig bral ba 'ja' lus rdo rje'i sku//'gag pa med pa'i sgra dbyangs nā ba'i gsung //shes bya kun mkhyen rang rtsal rig pa'i thugs//gdod nas rnam dag lhun grub kun tu bzang //ma rig 'khrul ngor 'khor ba'i chu nang du/ /phan gnong byed por btags pa'i 'jig

rten lha//zla ba gcig las shar ba'i 'bum phrag gzugs//ji bzhin rang gi sems kyi rol ba'i rtsal/ /dag dang dag bya dag byed yul bral yang //sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i 'phrul 'khor ji bzhin du/ /mi gtsang nyes pa'i tshogs kun sel ba dang //dngos grub stsol phyir bsang gi mchod pa 'bul/ chakun dga'i dpal ster dpyid kyi pho nya yis//legs drangs chu 'dzin gsar ba'i lang long can//lha lam 'gram pa'i ngos su 'khrigs pa dang //lhan cig dbyar gyi rnga gsang stong ldir zhing //mun sel dmar 'od glog gi zhags pa 'khyug /nam yang 'dzad pa med pa'i char rgyun gyis/ /gser ldan dga' ma'i bzhin ras yongs bkrus tshe/ /rtsi shing sman mchog skra yi lan bu g.yo/ /dri bzang ngad ldan rkang 'thung yal 'dab dang / /'bru mar rin chen rtsi bcud bsregs pa yi/ /dud pa'i sprin tshogs lha yi chu bo ltar//mi mthun nyes kun sel ba'i cho ga mkhan//de phyir rgyal dbang pad+ma sa was//gangs can bstan pa'i sgron me sbar ba'i tshe//bsang mchod 'phrin las grangs med rgyas btab ste//'jigs med sgom bur gsang ba'i gter tu sbas//mgon der mos ldan rdo rje'i mched lcam rnams/ /sngon rabs dam pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i blos//kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin la 'gran nus pa'i/ /gus pa'i lha bsang mchod pas sri zhur bgyi// cha gser gyi mdangs la 'khu ba'i lo 'dab tshogs//g.yur du za ba'i ljon shing stag pas bsang / /g.yu yi mdog can gnam sngon zhun ma dag /'khyil 'dra'i 'dab ma rab rgyas thug pas bsang / /rab dkar dung gi mdangs la 'gran bzod

pa'i//phang phung 'dab ma bzhad pa'i mkhan pas bsang //mchong gi mdog ltar rab dmar lo 'dab kyi//phang phung mdzes par rgod pa'i ba lus bsang //bzang drug sman dang spos dkar ma nu dang / /tsan dan dkar dmar a ga ru yis bsang //bdud rtsi can gyi ljon pa'i shing gi tshogs//phye mar zas phud 'bru sna'i rigs kyis bsang //dar dang za 'og rin chen rnam pa lnga//dkar gsum mngar gsum la sogs mthun pa'i rdzas//ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas//rang rang 'dod pa'i dngos por gyur pas bsang / 6tshe gcig sangs rgyas sgrub pa zab mo'i theg /smin byed dbang dang grol bar byed pa'i khrid/ /rgyab brten lung dang rgyud bshad man ngag dang / /bka' gtad gdams pa stsol pa'i byed pa po//khyab bdag thog ma'i mgon po nas bzung ste//drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar byon pa'i//rgya bod mkhas dang grub pa'i rig 'dzin tshogs/ /dngos brgyud rdo rje slob bapon thams cad bsang / /sde snod gsum dang sgra tshad bzo gso sogs//grangs med rig pa'i gnas rnams ston mkhas pa'i/ /'phags yul kha ba'i ljongs 'dir sngon byung dang //da ltar byon pa'i mkhas grub thams cad bsang / /khyad par chos kyi rgyal po mes dbon tshogs/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas ngo bo pad+ma 'byung //bstan pa'i rtsa lag mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ bka' drin mtshungs pa med pa rnam gsum bsang / /lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan jo bo yab sras dang //bstan pa'i mnga' bdag brtse chen snying bo'i zhabs/ /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa/ /phan dang bde ba'i 'byung

gnas rnam gsum bsang // kye: lhun grub dbang gzhu ltar bkra mtshan dpe'i gar//bde bar gshegs pa rigs lnga la sogs pa'i//bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis lha yi 'khor lo mchog /bcom ldan zhi ba'i lha tshogs thams cad bsang / /in+d+ra nī pa'i lhun po dus mtha'i mes//mngon par rab bklubs bdud bzhi las rgyal ba//lnga bcu rtsa brgyad 'jigs rung ho ru ka /khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha yi tshogs kun bsang //sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las can//bod gtong rig 'dzin mchod bstod drag sngags lha//bde gshegs rgyal ba ma lus rab 'dus pa'i/ /grangs med dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs bsang / /'jam rdor mi bskyod dgra gdong 'jigs gsum dang //bde kye dus 'khor la sogs rgyud sde bzhi'i/ /mtha' yas brjod par dka' ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /'khor lo'i bdag nyid lha yi tshogs kun bsang //dur khrod brgyad dang nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i yul/ /sum cu rtsa bdun gnas dang mkha' spyod sogs//bgrang yas ngo mtshar zhing na legs bzhugs pa'i/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs thams cad bsang //kyiḥ rgyal ba kun yum rdo rje dbyings phyug ma//gdul bya'i don du dbyangs can ngag gi lha//gdug pa 'dul phyir 'dod khams dbang phyug ma//bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs rnams bsang //dpal ldan ma hā kā la phyag bzhi drug /rnam mang thos sras las kyi gshin rje'i gshed//dur khrod bdag po legs ldan mched gsum dang //trathad zhang blon rdo rje bdud 'dul bsang //bstan srung rgya mtsho'i sde dpon rdo rje gur//gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo dud sol ma //

stobs 'phrog dbang bo lha chen gdong bzhi ba//pu tra ming sring peg gdong lcam dral bsang //ma ning e ka dza ṭi dpal lha mo//thang lha stag zhon gza' bdud bdud mgon dang //sprul ba'i chos rgyal btsan rgod rdo rje legs//bstan ma bcu gnyis tshe ring mched lnga bsang //ra sa 'phrul snang dpal gyi bsam yas dang //mtha' 'dul yang 'dul ru gnon gtsug lag khang / /dben gnas chos 'khor ma lus skyong ba dang / /chos dang gter gyi srung ma ma lus bsang //rje yi mgur lha 'bangs kyi srog lha dang //srid pa chags pa'i lha chen dgu la sogs//spur rgyal bod kyi rgyal khams skyong byed pa'i//gzhi bdag srung ma mthu chen ma lus bsang / /rgya gar li bal rgya nag hor gyi yul//mnga' ris bskor gsum dbus gtsang ru bzhi dang //mdo stod mdo smad la sogs 'dzam gling gi /yul gru kun gyi gzhi bdag srung ma bsang / /lha klu gnod sbyin ma bdud dmu btsan dang / /rgyal po gshin rje gza' dang rgyu skar sogs//mdor na snang zhing srid pa'i lha ma yin//sde brgyad bran g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa bsang / 6khyad par bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi//bsam pa'i don sgrub rigs dang rgyud rnams spel/ /mi 'dzad nor ster rgyab rten mgon skyabs mdzad/ /dpa' rtsal mthu stobs bskyed pa'i lha rnams bsang //dbang bo lnga yi so so'i byed las kyis//las rnams thogs med sgrub la dbang ba'i lha//mgyogs pa'i rta dang sra ba'i go cha'i tshogs//rnon po'i mtshon char gnas pa'i dgra lha bsang //mtho la zhu 'bul dma' la bka' bsgo zhing //sdunyam por gshags 'gyed phyogs su

don gnyer ba//tshong dang khe spogs dmag jag 'grul bzhud sogs//bya ba kun la dbang ba'i lha rnams bsang //'go ba'i lha lnga mi thub dgra lha gsum//khang khyim thab kha mkhar gyi rtse lha dang //zhing dang phyugs lhas sgo dang lam gyi lha//pha mes mi rabs brgyud kyi dgra lha bsang //mu rabs brgyud dang gtsug rabs brgyud kyi lha//slob dpon brgyud la 'go ba'i lha rnams dang / /'gro ba'i lam dang gzhis kyi srung ma'i tshogs/ /rgyan gos longs spyod grogs la gnas pa bsang //yar lha sham po gung rgyal sbom ra dang //brgya byin dkar nag khra gsum wer ma'i tshogs//srid pa'i lha lung rno mthong ston pa'i lha//bdud lha sum brgya drug cu la sogs bsang //yab lha rdal drug mo btsun rgyal mo mthing //'dod rigs sman pa bco brgyad ma chags stong //stong dang 'byung ba chags pa'i dgra lha dang / /a kur dkar gyi srung ma ma lus bsang / /sku lha gyer 'joms lha'u g.yang dkar dang //bod kyi mi'u gdung drug zo dor lha//thugs kur sum brgya drug cu la sogs pa'i//mdor na g.yung drung bon gyi lha rnams bsang //lo skor bcu gnyis spar kha rnam pa brgyad/ /sme ba dgu dang sa bdag rgyal blon 'bangs/ /spor thang brgyad cu skor gyi gtsug lag lha/ /gab rtse dgu la gnas pa'i lha rnams bsang //nyin srib ri dang nags tshal steng ka dang //lam chen bzhi mdo chu klung ljon pa'i shing //rang byung bcos ma'i me dang rlung sa sogs//so sor dbang ba'i phyogs 'di'i gzhi bdag bsang // nyamasagribabashags pani/hūṃ/ de ltar rtsa gsum chos srung sde brgya/ dang //yul lha gzhi bdag dgra lha la

sogs par/ /gtsang zhing gya rnam mang bor spel ba yi/ /dag byed bsang gi mchod pa 'di phul pas//gdod nas rnam dag gsal stong rig pa'i gshis//ma rig 'khrul bas bslad pa'i nad gdon bgegs//thag khra sbrul du mthong ba'i dngangs skrag bzhin//med kyang mngon sum snang ba'i skyon tshogs rnams//mkha' khyab don dam chos sku bde ba cher//chu la chu bzhag lta bur ro gcig kyang //kun rdzob rdzun ngor grub pa'i nyes pa kun//dag byed chu yis dri ma 'khrud ltar bshags//khyad par bdag cag rgyu sbyor sbyin bdag rnams//so thar byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang //rig 'dzin sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa'i grib//mnol dang dme yug ya bshan mdze grib dang //lha dang mi la 'khon dang rtsod pa'i grib//dkar dmar thab gzhob bya spyod mi mkhas pa'i//mi gtsang rigs rnams lag tu bstar zhing bcangs/ /zas su thos shing gos su gyon pa dang //gnas mal 'khor nor longs spyod bsten pa sogs//ljon shing mthun rdzas bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'dis/ /ma lus byang zhing rnam par dag gyur nas// gangs kyi ri bo lta bur gsal gyur cig/phun tshogs bkra shis dus bzang yar gyi ngor//gza' skar dus sbyor legs pa 'phrod kyi dge /mthun pa'i rkyen kun tshang ba'i gnas mchog 'dir//bsang gis mchod pa'i 'bras bu lhun grub shog/'phrinalasabacolab ni/ hūṃ/ bsang mchod mthun pa'i dam rdzas rgya chen po/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul te phul pa'i mthus//skyabs mchog ngo bo rtsa gsum lha tshogs kyis/ /mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char ltar phobs//srung

ma dam can sde brgyad tshogs rnams kyis//bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus thogs med sgrubs//yul lha gzhi bdag 'go ba'i lha rnams kyis//bar chad sel zhing bsam pa'i re ba skongs/ /mdor na mchod yul dam pa khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag cag mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la//seng ge glang chen smyon pa me sprul dang //lcags sgrog sha za rgya mtsho chom po ste/ /'jigs chen brgyad dang gdon bgegs nad rims dgra//dus min 'chi bdag gshin rje'i zhags pa dang //kha smras mi kha gleng gzhi 'thab rtsod sogs//bar chad mi mthun g.yul las rgyal bar mdzod//rgud pa'i mun stug rdzogs pa'i thun gsum mthar//shar ba'i legs byas skya rengs kyis drangs pa'i//phan bde'i nyin mor byed pa'i 'od zer gyis// zhi ba'i 'phrin las snang ba 'bar bar mdzod//bsod nams dus las yol med rlabs phreng can/ /tshe dpal 'byor ba mi zad chu bo'i gter/ /bsam pa'i re ba skong ba'i yid bzhin nor// rgyas pa'i 'phrin las rgyal mtshan rtser 'god mdzod//reg pas gdung sel yid dga'i mdza' na mo//'gugs byed lho phyogs rlung gi reg bya can//mthong na mi mthun med pa'i tsan dan shing //dbang gi 'phrin las dri bsung 'thul bar mdzod//'khu ba'i sems ldan lha min dga' ma'i mngal//drag sbyor rdo rje'i rtse brgya gdengs tsam gyis//bsod nams dpung dang lhan cig sang byed pa'i//drag po'i 'phrin las legs bris stobs ldan mdzod//sgrib gnyis sgo nga'i sbubs las rnam grol ba'i//tshogs gnyis 'dab ldan ka la piṅka'i bya//rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i mkha'

dbyings su//'phur nas chos kyi dbyangs snyan sgrog par mdzod//phan dang bde ba'i 'byung gnas thub pa'i bstan//bstan 'dzin skyes bu 'gro ba'i bde skyid kun//kun nas 'phel zhing rgyas pa dbyar gyi chu//chu gter chen po'i dpal la 'gran par mdzod/ /blo gros mchog mnga' bskal bzang 'gro ba'i mgon/ /mgon po 'jam dbyangs dngos gyur grags pa'i dpal/ /dpal ldan rgyal ba gnyis pa'i ring lugs gang //gang zhig srid mtha'i bar du rgyas par mdzod//bde skyid kun tshang kun nas dga' ba'i dpyid//gangs can yul gru yul gyi snying bo cher//phan bde ma lus ma smad 'byung ba dang //dga' skyid dbyangs snyan dbyangs su len par mdzod//dga' ba'i dpal ldan phun tshogs sde bzhi'i dngos/ /dngos por lhun grub spu 'dzin pho brang mchog /mchog tu rab brtan mnga' thang chab srid dag /dag byed gaṅgā'i rgyun la 'gran par mdzod/ /yangs pa'i sa chen chen po'i mdun sa na/ /chos bzhin skyong mdzad mdzad bzang dpa' rtul can//sa spyod mi dbang dbang phyug rgyal mnga' ba'i//sku tshe chab srid srid mthar rgyas par mdzod//dung dung snying nas mi phyed gsol 'debs shing / /yang yang mchod cing bstod na bdag sogs kun/ /'jigs 'jigs bar chad dgra las rnam rgyal zhing //'dzum 'dzum dgyes pa'i sgo nas dngos grub stsol/ /phywagayang 'gugs pani/ kyiḥ phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog 'dir//'dod pa'i mchog ster phywa dang g.yang gi tshogs//khab len rdo dang lcags kyi snang tshul bzhin//dga' ba'i gar dang bcas te thogs

med khug /gser mngal mgrin sngon 'khor lo'i lag pa can//grags pa'i mu khyud 'khor los bsgyur ba sogs//srid 'dir mngon par mtho ba'i tshogs rnams kyi//sgyu g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol//legs bris tshogs kyi 'chi med btung ba dang //klu dbang gtsug gi yid bzhin nor bu mchog/mi dbang sngon 'gro'i rgyal srid sna bdun gyi//phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol/ /rin chen gdugs dkar gser nya bum pa bzang //pad+ma dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dpal be'u dang //rgyal mtshan 'khor lo bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi//phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol//rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras pos bkra shis pa'i//dngos por byin rlabs dge legs 'byung ba'i sgo//rten 'brel lhun gyis grub pa'i rdzas brgyad kyi//phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol//tshe ring nad med 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub//stobs dang mnga' thang 'byor ba phun sum tshogs//bde zhing skyid pa'i dga' ston thams cad kyi//phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol//nongs pa bzong par gsol ba ni/skye/rmo ngas pa'i dbang gis 'phrin las 'khrul bar gyer//mchod pa'i dam rdzas ma tshang 'bags pa sogs//nyes pa'i tshogs kun snying nas bshags byed na//bzod par bzhes shig thugs rje che ldan rnams//gshegs su gsolab ni/r+ghaṃ/ chu las chu bur rdol ba ji bzhin du//rig pa'i rtsal gyis mgron du bsus pa rnams//ngo bo gdod nas skye ba med pa'i klong //rnam par rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs/ badz+ra muḥshisapa brjod pa ni/skye/yid bzhin nor dang

bum bzang 'dod 'jo'i ba//dpag bsam shing ltar 'dod pa'i re ba kun//'bad med stsol mdzad bla ma yi dam dngan/mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis shog/ gzhan yang shis brjod ci rigs pa bya'o/ smras pa/ khungs ldan bsang gzhung zla ba'i ma ma las//blo gros a za'i tshi gus blangs pa'i chu//rnam g.yeng skom tshad kyis gdung 'ga' zhig las//phan snyam snyim par thogs nas gar byed do//'ga' zhig tshig gi sbyor ba rab mkhas kyang //bsang rkyang rgyags rngan dbye ba ma byed cing //mjug tu bsgral ba'i mchod pa sbyar ba sogs/ /'khrul bar byed pa'i ring lugs kho nar nges//la la phyogs 'di'i brda la ma byang bar//rang bzor byas pa'i tshig gi phreng ba dag/rmongs pa'i go sar mdzes kyang tshul 'di nyid//shes pas mthong tshe khrel ba'i gad mo bro//kha cig grong ba'i cigasom dge'i gral rim ltar//bar bkab ste thug khrigs kyi yi ge dag/spos kyi nye ring 'phul ba'i g.yar khral las//yang dag don gyis stongs pa'i brag ca bzhin//spang rtogs yon tan pha mtha' gzhal dka' bas//ye shes lha yi tshad gzung ga la nus//gya gyu'i sems kyi rol ba mtha' klas pas//'jig rten lha 'dre'i grangs kyang gzhal nus su//de phyir ma tshang zlos dang 'gal ba sogs//skyon bral bdag blos bsgrun par mi nus kyang //mkhas grub dam pa'i phyag bzhes mthong rgyud las//gzhan gyi 'dod pa ji bzhin nyung ngur byas//de skad 'gro ba kun gyi gnyen gcig pu//'khon ston chos rje'i zhabs zung marnya ra//mi byed dad pa'i thod du legs 'ching ba'i//za hor rigs kyi byu su ku des snye

sbyar//zad byung rnam par dag pa'i dge tshogs chus//'gro kun dug gsum dri ma kun bkrus te/ /tshogs gnyis lang tsho dar ba'i mdzes sdug lus//kun mkhyen yeshes gos kyis bklub par shog /rgyal ba kun dngos pad+ma thod phreng rtsal gyi gsung las byung ba'i bsang yig rdo rje'i — tshig rnams byin rlabs kyi tshan ka che bzhin du bdag dang bdag 'dra'i g.yar khral du — bgyis pa'i rigs 'di 'dra la dgos pa mi 'dug na'ang bod sog gi skad gnyis dz+ra zhing mang du thos pa la dga' ba'i dpyod ldan/ mer rgan bka' bcu shes rab rgya mtsho dang che chen dpon po blobazang chos 'phel gnyis kyis nan du bsku ba dzobarten nas/ bsang gi yi ge bkra shis 'khyil ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/slob dpon chen pos mdzad pa'i bsang gzhung lho byang gi gter kha du ma las byung ba dzigazhi byas/ 'khyer bde ba'i phyir du bdag chen rinapo che rgya gar shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i yig cha dang 'ga' zhig cha mthun par byas rte/ za hor gyi rigs las ma wa nu gli ba'i btsun pa ngag dbang blobazang rgya mtshos chu 'go bkra shis 'khyil ba dang zung du 'brel ba'i lha rtse gzhung du sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni smon 'gro paṇa chen rna//

bsang mchod bkra shis g.yas 'khyil dung gi sgra dbyangs/༄༄ / /bsam pa tsam gyis mchog thun dngos grub kun//'bad med stsol mdzad mchog gsum yid bzhin nor//bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i tshogs rnams dang //mgon po lcam sring bstan srung rgya mtsho yi//dregs pa'i sde dpon chen po sum cu dang //sngags bdag bco brgyad dge bsnyen nyer gcig dang //mgur lha bcu gsum bstan ma bcu gnyis dang //srid pa chags pa'i lha chen dgu la sogs//'dzam gling zhing khams gnas chen sgrub gnas rnams//skyong ba'i gzhi bdag mthu chen tshogs rnams dang //dgra lha bcu gsum 'go ba'i lha lnga dang //lo zla zhag dus spar sme rlung rta'i lha//lha gnyan rma rgyal sbom ra 'khor bcas kyis//yul lha'i rgyal po dge bsnyen khra leb dang //lha yi dge bsnyen brag dkar rgyal blon dang //lha gnyan bya dkar la sogs yul gru 'dir//dbang mdzad 'ju lag mthon po bcu gsum dang / /gzhan yang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu bo che//lha yi dge bsnyen chen po rdor rdzong dang //ka drod seng mtho tsong kha'i skyes ri sogs//la rgyud ring mo phyogs mtshams khor yug la/ /gnas shing yul gru kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i/ /tsong kha'i lha gnyan chen po bcu gsum dang / /gzhan yang g.yas ri g.yon ri mdun ri dang //rgyab ri mtshor sa gnas mal 'di nyid la/ /gnas pa'i lha klu sde brgyad 'khor tshogs bcas/ /bsang mchod 6

mgron du spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/ /phyi dang mchod tshogs dpag med spro ba'i gzhi/ /bsang gi dud sprin nam mkha' yongs gang zhing / /dkar gsum mngar gsum ja chang gser skyems dang //dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod tshogs rgya mtsho 'bul//gnas la bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyis//mi 'dod nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi ba dang //tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang gong du 'phel/ /mthu stobs gzi brjid rlung rta yar la bskyed//khyad par yul 'di'i mi phyugs mtha' dag gi /sngon las 'phral rkyen ngan pa'i bskur ba las//sde brgyad 'byung bo'i gdug rtsub las byung ba'i/ /'go ba'i nad dang rims dang dal kha dang //phyugs kyi nad rigs glo tshad rgyu gol dang // gegs lhog la sogs mi phyugs nad rigs kun//myur du rgyun chad nad bdag 'dre gdon rnams//gdug rtsub bsam sbyor kun zhi byams sems ldan//byur dang god kha nam yang mi 'byung zhing //'gro kun nad med bde skyid ldan par mdzod/khyed rnams rtse gcig bsten mchod gsol btab mthus//dus kun srung skyob sba ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// bkra shis dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel bsod nams ni//ri ltar brtan cing snyan grags mkha' ltar khyab//rnam dkar legs tshogs nyi zla'i 'od bzhin 'bar//rnam kun bde skyid dpal la spyod gyur cig/bsang mchod bkra shisagayas 'khyil dung gi sgradabyangs zhes bya ba 'dini mi phyugs nad rimasasogs zhi ba'i ched du'abul lo//

lha bsang yid bzhin 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/༄snyo //bh+yoḥ/rab 'byams rgyal kun yum gcig dbyangs can ma//ma rung 'dul phyir khro gtum srin mo'i gar//srid gsum bdag mo dpal ldan re ma tis//bka' nyan mngag gzhug 'khor dang bcas pa rnams//mu le ding sogs gar bzhugs gnas mchog nas/ /chos 'khor skyong mdzad srung ma khyad par can//ma thogs dam tshig dbang gis 'dir byon la//dgyes pa'i 'dzum dkar spro bzhin brtan par bzhugs//zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin gyi//lha bsang 'dod pa'i yon tan kun tshang ba//dngos 'byor yid sprul sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin//'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod du byin brlabs pas//ma gcig 'dod pa'i khams kyi dbang phyug ma//dus bzhi'i lha mo tshe ring mched lnga dang//bod skyong bstan ma bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i//gdug pa'i 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho gsol zhing mchod//rnal 'byor dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyis/ /mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad kun zhi zhing //tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang snyan grags sogs//yar zla'i dpal bzhin 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod//khyad par rgyal kun yab gcig tsong kha pa'i//mdo sngags bshad sgrub bstan pa'i gdugs dkar po//srid zhi rgud pa'i tsha gdung skyob pa'i mchog/dus kyi mthar yang mi nyams rgyas gyur cig/ ཿ

ces srid gsum dbang bsgyur dpa la ldan dmag zor gyi rgyal mo la bsang mchod 'bul tshul 'di 'dra zhig dgos zhes/lung dang rtogs pa'i yon tan gyis mdzes pa bsod grags sprul pa'i sku nas/rje btsun sgrol ma'i sku khyad 'phags/lha dar tshe sku srid du ring ba bcas bskul ngor/'jam bzhad skyes sprug du 'bod pa shākya'i dge spyong blobazang 'jam dbyangasaye shes bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'o//༄byu / /dmigs med brtse ba'irigater chen spyan ras gzigs/ /dri rmed mkhyen pa'i dbang bo 'jam pa'i dbyangs//bdud dpung ma lus 'joms mdzad gsang ba'i bdag /gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan tsong kha pa /gi blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs/dmigs brtse ma'i gsol 'deXs/ ri

bsang rnam dag ma/ga //skyabs 'gro sems bskyed tshad med bzhi bsgom pa sngon du btang /rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/oṃ hrīḥjiḥbasangs/su bhā was sbyangs/bsang rdzas rnams mi dmigs pa stong ba nyid du gyur/stong ba'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mnyes par byed pa'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi spyan lam du 'bul zhing rgyas par gyur cig/oṃ sarba bid gru ra gu ra su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya ho/ badz+ra sga ra na khaṃ/ oṃ a āḥrgyu/ oṃ pār+ya āḥrgyu/oṃ buzhe lha'irdu/ oṃ sgrubo lha'ihūṃ/oṃ ā lo ge āḥ// oṃ garnye āḥ//oṃ rna li bye āḥ rgyu/ oṃ shasnya āḥ//oṃ rū ba lha'irdu/ oṃ sha snya āḥrdu/ oṃ garnye āḥzhe/oṃ ra sa lha'iskye/oṃ sbar+shalha'iskye/ oṃ su bhā wa bi thud dhe dharmaḥ te badz+ra sidarnyi hūṃ/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shā mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba tad khaṃ ud ga te sgar na gyi me ga ga na khaṃ swāhā/ oṃ ā skṛ ti rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ ā ka ro mu khaṃ sarba rtarmaḥ rna/ at+ya nuṅga na na tad/ na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/ oṃ ru ru spru ru dz+wa ༷0 tiṣ+ṭha sid rtsa lo tsa ni sarba arba sna bha ni

swā sum̐/ bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni//de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin stobs dang //chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis//don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun//de dag thams cad ci rigs par//thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig ma/ lhun grub bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas//dus gsum sangs rgyas pad+ma thod phreng rtsal//rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas//thogs med thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs su gsol//mdun gyi nam mkhar pad stong yangs pa'i steng / /seng khri pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan khri la/ /yid 'phrog 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim dbus//zhabs sen 'od chags brtan par bzhugs su gsol//phyi yi mchod pas sa dang bar snang gang //dang gi mchod pa zag med bdud rtsi'i mtsho//gsang ba bde chen smra bsam brjod las 'das//'gro ba'i don du dgyes bzhin bzhes su gsol// rgyu/ rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung //lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan mar me mdzad//rdo rje 'chang dbang blo bzang grags pa'i dpal//sna tshogs sprul pa'i gar mdzad de la 'dud/ /dpal ldan bstan skyong chen po 'khor bcas kyi/ /khyed kyi bka' dang dam tshig la gnas pa'i// 'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang //chos grwa chen po dar zhing rgyas par mdzod// kyeḥ rnam dag chos sku gzhal yas nas/ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong phrag dang / /khyad par longs sku rdo rje 'chang //sprul sku bcom ldan shākya thub//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//ston pa'i srol btod bstan pa 'dzin//rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po sogs//nye ba'i sras brgyad thams cad kyang / /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//yan lag 'byung la sogs pa yi/ /gnas brtan chen po bcu drug kyang //de ring mdun

gyi nam mkhar byon/ /'phags pa klu sgrub la sogs pa'i//'dzam gling mdzes pa'i rgyan drug kyang //de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//dpal ldan sa ra ha ba sogs//rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu yang /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar — byon//zangs mdog dpal ri'i rtse mo nas//rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma 'byung //dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang nas//dpal ldan mar me mdzad dpal dang //rgyal ba blo bzang grags pa'i dpal//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//dag pa mkha' spyod zhing khams nas/ /sgra sgyur mar pa lo tsā dang //dbang phyug mi la yab sras rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//phan bde'i lam bzang ston mdzad pa'i//'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas sogs//bka' gdams brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//sna ru chos dbang la sogs pa'i//rnying ma brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /zla 'od gzhon nu la sogs pa'i//bka' brgyud bla ma thams cad kyang //de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//sa chen kun snying la sogs pa'i/ /lam 'bras brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//rgyal tshab mkhas grub la sogs pa'i//lam rim brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//ma rig mun pa sel mdzad pa'i//rgyal blon byang chub sems dpa' dang / /sgra sgyur lo paṇa thams cad kyang //de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /thugs rje chen pos gzhan don mdzad/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang thams cad mkhyen/ /yab sras brgyud par bcas pa rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon// kyiḥ bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas/ /dpal ldan dus kyi 22

'khor lo dang //'khor lo sdom pa he ru ka/bcom ldan dgyes pa rdo rje dang / /snying bo ma hā ma ya dang //gsang 'dus mi bskyod lha tshogs dang //yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed sogs//bla med rgyud kyi lha tshogs rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /rdor dbyings kun rig la sogs pa'i//rnal 'byor rgyud kyi lha tshogs rnams/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//rnam snang mngon byang la sogs pa'i//spyod pa'i rgyud kyi lha tshogs rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//yid bzhin 'khor lo la sogs pa'i//bya ba'i rgyud kyi lha tshogs rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//dam tshig can gyi rnal 'byor la/ /dngos grub thams cad ster mdzad pa'i//yi dam lha tshogs thams cad kyangan/de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon// kyeḥ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas//ye shes mgon po phyag drug pa//bka' sdom dam can rgya mtsho rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//rnam par snang mdzad thugs ka nas//gur gyi mgon po 'khor bcas rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//phyi yi rgya mtsho'i 'gram shed nas//phyag bzhi mgon po 'khor bcas rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//ri rab lhun po'i byang phyogs nas//rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor bcas —rnams/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /lho phyogs gshin rje'i grong khyer nas//chos rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//byang shar thod pa'i sku mkhar nas// dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor bcas rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//ha ha rgod pa'i dur khrod nas//rdo rje nag po zhal bzhi ba//yum bzhi sprul ba 'khor bcas rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//'og min chos kyi pho brang nas//mgon po beng gi lha tshogs

rnams/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /dur khrod rol ba'i gzhal yas nas//dur khrod bdag po 'khor bcas rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon// ma du tse yi dur khrod nas/ /beg rtse lcam sring 'khor bcas rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//chos 'khor dpal gyi lha sa nas//dpal gyi lha mo 'khor bcas rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//'bri gung dpal gyi nags khrod nas//a phyi chos sgron 'khor bcas rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//bal bod gnyis kyi mtshams shed nas//jo mo tshe ring mched lnga rnams/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /rang rang so so'i gnas mchog nas//'dzam gling bstan ma bcu gnyis rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//be har gza' mchog rdor legs sogs//lha srin sde brgyad thams cad kyang / /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//lha rgyal rma chen sbom ra dang //jo bo skyogs chen gtong ra dang / /lha chen 'od de gung rgyal dang //yar lha sham po la sogs pa'i//srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu dang //rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum rnams/ /de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /khyad par gnyan chen thang lha dang //gnyan 'khor sum brgya drug cu rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//gzhan yang rnal 'byor dpon slob kyi//skyes lha yul lha dgra lha rnams//de ring mdunagyi nam mkhar byon/ /nyi ma zla ba la sogs pa'i//gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad kyang //de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//sa yi lha mo la sogs pa'i/ /sa bdag yul lha thams cad kyang //de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon//yul 'di'i gnas bdag gzhi bdag rnams//de ring mdun gyi nam mkhar byon/ /kyeḥ dgung sngon nam mkha' yangs pa la//rgya mtsho'i snying bo sprin dkar

'khrigs//sprin gyi snying bo sprang char 'bab//'dzam gling 'dzin ma'i sa gzhi la//sa yi snying bo rtsi shing skyes//rtsi bcud snying bo bsang gis mchod//bsang ngo rtsa brgyud bla ma bsang //ma dad log rtog 'byung ba sogs//dngos grub bgegs rnams dag gyur cig /yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bsang //dam tshig nyams chag thams cad kyang //bsang mchod 'di yis dag gyur cig/chos skyong srung ma thams cad bsang / /gtang rag dus gtor chag pa sogs/ /thugs dang 'gal ba dag gyur cig/yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad bsang //bya ba spyod pa mi mkhas pa'i//phog thug thams cad zhi gyur cig /bsang 'dis nyams sgrib dag gyur cig/ /kyeḥ dngos bshams yid kyi sprul ba yi//bsang mchod rgya che dam pa 'di//ting nge 'dzin gyis byin brlabs pas//dgyes pa thams cad bskyed gyur cig/gtsang ma chu yis bran pa las//yon chab mchod yon rgya mtshos mchod//bsang shing me tog rgyas pa las//me tog pad+mo'i tshal gyis mchod//bsang shing dud sprin 'khrigs pa las//bdug spos spos kyi dud pas mchod/ /bsang la sgron me sbar ba yi//snang gsal mar me 'bar bas mchod//bsang gi dri zhim 'thul ba yi//dri mchog dri yi mchod pas mchod//bsang gi phye mar la sogs pa'i//zhal zas ro brgya ldan pas mchod//gdangs snyan glu dbyangs len pa yi//snyan pa rol mo'i sgra yis mchod//gzugs mdzes mchod pas spyan la mchod//snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis snyan la mchod//dri zhim spos kyis shangs la mchod//ro brgya zas kyis ljags la mchod//lha rdzas gos kyis sku la mchod//rlung ltar mgyogs pa'i rta yis mchod//dri bral g.yang chags lug gis mchod//'phur lding mdzes pa bya yis mchod//yid 'ong zhol chen g.yag

gis mchod//'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin phyugs kyis mchod//gser g.yu mu tig byu ru sogs//rin chen sna tshogs dag gis mchod//rgyal srid rin chen bdun gyis mchod//bkra shis rtags brgyad dag gis mchod//sra zhing brtan pa'i go chas mchod//rno zhing ngar ba'i mtshon chas mchod//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams la//ye shes bdud rtsir bsgyur nas 'bul//yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la//bde ba chen por bskyed nas 'bul//chos skyong srung ma thams cad la//tshogs kyi gtor mar bsgyur nas 'bul//yul lha gzhi bdag tshogs rnams la//ci 'dod rdzas su bsgyur nas 'bul// kyeḥ ma lus dgyes pa bskyed byed cing //mchod pa'i sprin phung gcig bsdus pa'i//lha bsang dud sprin chen po 'dis//phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad bsang //byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bsang / /gnas brtan chen po bcu drug bsang //'dzam gling rgyan drug mchog gnyis bsang //rgya gar grub chen brgyad cu bsang //rnying ma brgyud pa'i bla ma bsang //bka' gdams brgyud pa'i bla ma bsang //bka' brgyud brgyud pa'i bla ma bsang //lam 'bras brgyud pa'i bla ma bsang //lam rim brgyud pa'i bla ma bsang / /rtsa ba'i bla ma thams cad bsang / /bla med rgyud kyi lha tshogs bsang / /rnam 'byor rgyud kyi lha tshogs bsang / /spyod pa'i rgyud kyi lha tshogs bsang //bya ba'i rgyud kyi lha tshogs bsang //myur mdzad mgon po 'khor bcas bsang //gur mgon lcam dral 'khor bcas bsang //phyag bzhi mgon po'i lha tshogs bsang //rgyal chen rnam sras 'khor bcas bsang //chos rgyal yab yum 'khor bcas bsang //dmag zor rgyal mo 'khor bcas bsang //rang byung rgyal mo 'khor bcas bsang //nam mkha'i gos can 'khor bcas bsang //

zhal bzhi yab yum 'khor bcas bsang //mgon po beng gi lha tshogs bsang //dur khror bdag po 'khor bcas bsang / /beg rtse lcam sring 'khor bcas bsang / /ma gcig dpal lha 'khor bcas bsang / /a phyi chos sgron 'khor bcas bsang //tshe ring mched lnga 'khor bcas bsang //'dzam gling bstan ma bcu gnyis bsang / /rdo rje g.yu sgron 'khor bcas bsang / /rdo rje grags rgyal 'khor bcas bsang //sprul ba'i chos rgyal 'khor bcas bsang//dam can rdor legs 'khor bcas bsang //lha srin sde brgyad 'khor bcas bsang / /lha rgyal rma chen sbom ra bsang //jo bo skyogs chen gtong ra bsang //lha chen 'od de gung rgyal dang / /yar lha sham po la sogs pa'i/ /srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu dang / /rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum bsang / / khyad par gnyan chen thang lha dang // gnyan 'khor sum brgya drug cu bsang //gzhan yang rnal 'byor dpon slob kyi//skyes lha yul lha dgra lha bsang //nyi ma zla ba la sogs pa'i//gza' dang rgyu skar thams cad bsang //sa yi lha mo la sogs pa'i//sa bdag yul lha thams cad bsang / /klu rgyal ma dros gzi chen dang / /klu chen brgyad po thams cad bsang / /gyes la 'gro ba'i lam lha bsang / /gzhi la sdod pa'i gzhi bdag bsang //thab la gnas pa'i me lha bsang //chu la gnas pa'ichu lha bsang //rlung la gnas pa'i rlung lha bsang //tshe dpal skyed pa'i lha rnams bsang //sdongs grogs byed pa'i lha rnams bsang / 7 gser skyems 'bul bar spro na 'diltar/ r+yārin chen las grub sdod yangs su//'bras chang rgun chang zang chang sogs//rtsa ba 'bras bu 'bru sna'i tshogs//brgya phrag las 'ongs bdud rtsi'i mtsho//sa le sbram dang bye mar bcas//sum rtsen a skṛ tar 'gran pa//zag med bdud rtsir

byin brlabs pa'i//'dod yon lnga ldan gser skyems 'di//drin can rtsa ba'i bla ma dang //rje btsun blo bzang grags pa sogs//bslu med dkon mchog gsum la 'bul// gser skyems dam pa 'di bzhes la//byin rlabs mchog gi bka' drin stsol//khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang chen dang //'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed la sogs//yi dam lha tshogs rnams la 'bul//gser skyems dam pa 'di bzhes la//dngos grub mchog gi bka' drin stsol//bcom ldan tshe dpag med mgon dang //bcom ldan shākya thub pa sogs//mgon po sras dang bcas la 'bul//gser skyems dam pa 'di bzhes la//ci bsam 'grub pa'i bka' drin stsol//myur mdzad mgon po chos kyi rgyal//dpal ldan dmag zor rgyal mo sogs//chos skyong srung ma rnams la 'bul//gser skyems dam pa 'di bzhes la//bar chad sel ba'i bka' drin stsol//tshe ring mched lnga bstan skyong bcas//yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad dang //khyad par rgyal po sku lnga sogs//lha srin sde brgyad rnams la 'bul//gser skyems dam pa 'di bzhes la//ma rung zhi ba'i bka' drin stsol//khyad par bdag cag 'khor bcas rnams//srung zhing skyob par byed pa dang //mgon skyabs dpung gnyen byed pa yi//dgra lha gnyan po rnams la 'bul//gser skyems dam pa 'di bzhes la//mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i bka' drin stsol//rigs drug sems can thams cad dang //khyad par gnon byed gdon bgegs dang / /lan chags gnyer ba rnams la 'bul/ /gser skyems dam pa 'di bzhes la//sdug bsngal lan chags dag gyur cig/ ༈gzhi bdagal gtor mgatong bar 'dodapas/ a skṛ tas bsangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las sgru las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ

'od du zhu las byung ba'i gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ ā rdu/ lan gsum brjod/namaḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/oṃ sa bha ra sa bha ra hūṃ/lan gsum mam bdun gyisabasngo/ de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rin chen mang la phyag 'tshal lo de bzhin gshegs pa gzugs mdzes dam pa la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin gshegs pa sku 'byams klas la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'jigs pa thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ phun tshogs 'dod yon lnga ldan pa'i/ /bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho gtor ma 'di/ /sa yi lha mo bstan ma sogs//stong gsum gzhi bdag tshogs rnams dang //tshe ring mched lnga bstan skyong bcas/ /gangs can gnas pa thams cad dang / /khyad par yul phyogs 'di nyid kyi/ /yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la 'bul//bzhes nas bdag cag yon mchod rnams//las dang bya ba ci byed kyang / /ko long phrag dog ma mdzad par/ /mthun rkyen yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni//de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin stobs dang / /chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis/ /de dag thams cad ci rigs par//thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig/7 bla ma yi dam srung ma yi//bsang mchod rgya che 'di bzhes la//rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas la//mi 'gyur mchog gi dngos grub stsol//bde ba chen po dngos grub stsol/ /bar chad zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol//nad gdon zhi ba'i dngos grub stsol//tshe dpal rgyas pa'i dngos grub stsol//khams gsum dbang sdud dngos grub stsol//drag po mthu yi dngos grub stsol//'chi med tshe yi dngos grub stsol//rma g.yang zas kyi dngos grub stsol/ /rta nor phyugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ / 29

gzugs mdzes lang tsho'i dngos grub stsol//snyan pa'i sgra yi dngos grub stsol//dri zhim spos kyi dngos grub stsol//ro brgya zas kyi dngos grub stsol//'jam mnyen gos kyi dngos grub stsol/ /dge ldan grogs kyi dngos grub stsol/ /nye 'khor 'khor gyi dngos grub stsol//rdzu 'phrul dpa' rtsal dngos grub stsol//sra btsan go cha'i dngos grub stsol//rno ngar mtshon gyi dngos grub stsol//ci 'dod dngos grub bstsal du gsol// /kyeḥ ye shes dbang rdzogs gzhal yas nas//dgra lha gnyan po dpang bstod do//dgung la nyi ma shar ba bzhin//dgra lha gnyan po dpang bstod do//nyi zlas mun pa 'joms pa bzhin//dgra lha gnyan po dpang bstod do//rtsa brgyud bla mas byin gyis rlobs//yi dam lha yis rgyab rten mdzod/ /chos skyong srung mas dgra lha mdzod//dgra lha gnyan po mchod tsa na//gnam dang nyi zla 'grogs pa bzhin//dgra lha mi dang ma 'bral cig /lus dang grib ma 'grogs pa bzhin//dgra lha mi dang ma 'bral cig/song ge gangs dang 'grogs pa bzhin//dgra lha mi dang ma 'bral cig /khyung dang gshog sgro 'grogs pa bzhin//dgra lha mi dang ma 'bral cig /'brug dang 'brug skad 'grogs pa bzhin//dgra lha mi dang ma 'bral cig/stag dang nags tshal 'grogs pa bzhin//dgra lha mi dang ma 'bral cig /nya mo chu dang 'grogs pa bzhin//dgra lha mi dang ma 'bral cig /gzhi lam gyes gsum thams cad du//bdag cag gar 'gro gar 'dug kyang //dgra lha gnyan pos sdongs grogs mdzod//kha 'dzin rgyab rten dpung gnyen mdzod//kai balhache'o lha rgyal lo/ ༈chadagung sngon mthon po'i dkyil shed nas//nyi ma zla ba'i gsal g.yang de//de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//steng phyogs lha yi pho brang nas//tshangs pa brgya byin la 30

sogs pa'i//lha yi phun tshogs g.yang chags de//de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//thog phyogs klu yi pho brang nas//dga' bo 'jog po la sogs pa'i//klu yi longs spyod g.yang chags de//de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//ri rab lhun po'i khong gseng nas/ /rnam thos sras la sogs pa yi/ /gnod sbyin mthu stobs g.yang chags de//de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//rgyal po'i rigs rgyud lhun chags de//de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//blon po'i bag yod dpa' rtsal de//de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//nor bu'i dgos 'dod kun stsol de//de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//mkhas pa'i shes rab thabs mkhas de//de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//btsun pa'i spyod lam mdzes pa de//de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//bzang po'i yon tan phun tshogs de//de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//dpa' bo'i dpa' rtsal yang rtsal de//de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//mang bo'i dpung tshogs grangs med de//de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//phyug po'i nor rdzas longs spyod de//de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//mgyogs shing thugs chen rta yi g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin nor gyi g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//bde zhing myur mgyogs lam gyi g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//spro zhing bag phebs gnas kyi g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//mdzes shing brjid chags gzugs kyi g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//snyan zhing lhun chags skad kyi g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//zhim mngar 'dzoms pa zas kyi g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//'jam mnyen 'dzoms pa gos kyi g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//ci 'dod sgrub pa 'khor gyi g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//yid 'ong nyer

mkho nor gyi g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//thu zhing skad bzang khyi yi g.yang / /de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon/ /stobs chen myur mgyogs khal ma'i g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//bkra shis phun tshogs g.yang chags rnams/ /de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon/ /g.yang chags mi 'gyur bkra shis shog/ /bh+yoḥ sangs rgyas bstan srung dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod//dge 'dun sde skyong rnal 'byor tshe dpal spel//snyan pa'i dar phyor grags pa'i dung bus la//'khor dang longs spyod rgyas pa nyid du mdzod//rgas med lang tsho ldan pa'i lus stobs rgyas//mig la ya mtshan ltad mo dga' ba dang //rna bar rtag tu snyan pa'i gtam thos shing //dri zhim ngad pa sna dang mi 'bral zhing //zas skom 'byor bas ro 'dzin tshim par mdzod//lus la reg bya'i bde ba kho nas 'tsho//yid la rnam par grol ba'i shes rab dang //zag med bde bas nam yang tshim par mdzod//khyod gsol khyod bsten khyod bsgrub khyod rbad na//mthu rtsal ma chung brtse gdung che bar mdzod/ /gzhi la bkra shis phun tshogs longs spyod spel//gyes su lam 'phrang chu las sgrol 'don mdzod//'jigs sar dgra jag chom thun 'tshe las skyobs/ /mdor na bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyis//bla med rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub pa la/ /'gal rkyen bar du gcod pa zhi ba dang //mthun rkyen bsam pa lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ /bcol ba'i 'phrin las ma lus 'grub par mdzod/ /kyeḥrtsa brgyud bla ma'i bkra shis shog /byin rlabs dngos grub bkra shis shog/yi dam lha tshogs bkra this shog /dngos grub stso la ba'i bkra shis shog /chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis shog /bar chad zhi ba'i bkra shis shog /yul lha gzhi bdag bkra

shis shog /mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i bkra shis shog /srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi//thub pa'i bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang //de 'dzin byed pa'i skyes bu dam pa rnams//dpal 'byor gyis skyong yun ring zhabs brtan shog /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi//tshe ring nad med longs spyod phun sum tshogs/ /don rnams thams cad yid bzhin 'grub pa dang / /'gro ba'i don la mthu dang ldan par shog /bstan pa'i dpal gyur bla ma'i zhabs pad brtan/ /bstan 'dzin skyes bu sa steng kun la khyab/ /bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang 'byor ba rgyas/ /bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog/ ces sprul skubasod nams ye shes dbang bos mdzad pa'i bsang rnam dag py-i trī // ༵ ṭ+wāṃ /// /sdo sna /// /// / ṭ+wāṃ // sa pa /gas 'ga' zhig slob dpon lcang dpar du nākā dī sdu /zlong ṭ+wāṃ /sdu trī //sapa'i 'khrungs gnas sku 'bum byams pa gling du

rgyags brngan lha bsangan༄ //gu ru pad+ma sirnyi hūṃ/ skyabs kun 'dus zhal o rgyan dus gsum mkhyen pa la phyag 'tshal lo/'dir byang gter rgyags brngan bsang gi cho ga ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/sbyor ba dngos gzhi mjug dang gsum/dang po sbyor ba la bca' sgrig dang sngon 'gro'i cho gar 'jug tshul gnyis las/dang po ni/'di nyid kyi gter gzhung las/ brngan gyi cho ga'i rim pa la/ shin tu gtsang ba'i sa phyogs su: dkar gsum mngar gsum brgyan pa dang ca dmar gtor sha chang brgyan pa dang: bsang bshos zas snas brgyan pa dang: phye mar ci 'byor snod khengs dang: dri bzang 'bru sna sman spos dang: rin chen me tog sna tshogs dang: khyad par rta glang ra dang lug: mdzo g.yag sbal sbrul la sogs dang:gzugs 'gros sna tshogs byas pa dang: sba smyug thug pa lcang ma dang: mkhan pa mtshe bang 'om bu dang:ba lu glang ma la sogs pa'i: rtsi shing sna tshogs mchod pa bshams: stag gzig dar zab la sogs pa: mda' mdung dar chen 'phyar ba dang: rnga dung la sogs rol mo'i sgra: spyan gzigs mchod pa sna tshogs bshams: zhes gsungs pa bzhin/ thog ma'i bca' gzhi sgrig tshul la dam pa'i phyag bzhes 'dra min sna tshogs shig mchis rung / 'dir ni rig 'dzin gsang sngags dga' tshul gyi mthong rgyud phyag len ji ltar bstar ba'i

tshul dgod par bya ste/ de yang gang du bya ba'i gnas ni ri rtse'am khang thog sogs shin tu gtsang ba'i yid mthun gyi gnas su/ ras dkar sogs dri ma med pa'i mchod gdan bting ba'i stegs bu'i khar/ man star sogs kyi gtor snod gtsang ma'i dbus su bzang drug rin chen sna lnga'i phye ma bdud rtsi ril bu'am mchod sman dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs rnal 'byor bla med nas bshad pa'i gtor rdzas ci 'byor bsres pa'i rtsam bye chang phud chu gtsang gis sprus pa'i zan leb gru bzhi rtsi dkar can bzhi bang rim gyi tshul du brtsegs pa'i 'og ma gsum dpangs mnyam dang / de gsum bsdoms pa'i dpangs dang mnyam pa'i bang rim bzhi ba'i steng du rtsa gsum spyi'i dpal gtor skum po bang 'dab bzhi ba rtsi dkar can/ bang 'dab rnams kyi bar bar du mtheb kyu rtsi dkar can sgor mo'i steng du zan ril bzhag pas bskor/ bang rim 'og ma gsum gyi zur bzhir bshos bu rked ris can rtsi dkar gyis byugs pa la shing rtser snying dngos sam zan gyi snying gzugs dmar bo re btsugs pa bsdoms bcu gnyis dang / ngos bzhir dmar gtor zur gsum re re bcas bsdoms bcu gnyis/ bang rim 'og ma'i mdun ngos dbus su g.yag mgos mtshan pa'i thang lha'i gtor ma zur gsum rtsi dkar can/ g.yas su lug mgos mtshan pa'i brtan ma'i gtor ma dbyibs rtsi gong 'dra/ g.yon dur mgos mtshan pa'i dam can gyi gtor ma dbyibs rtsi gong 'dra/ an tar gyi g.yas g.yon rnams su bkra shis rdzas rtags 'dod yon rin chen sna bdun bre dngul dong tse sogs

mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs dang sku glud pho gzugs mo gzugs rta drel ma dzo g.yag ra lug sogs mdor na 'phur dgu 'dzul dgu'i gzugs 'gros zan par gyi skum gtor bar stong rnams su gong gi gzugs 'gros rnams dpar ba'i zan leb nar mo chang phud mtheb kyu sogs kyis bkang / de'i g.yas g.yon gang 'os su dgra lha dang rang lugs sger gsol gyi mchod pa ci dgos mthong brgyud bzhin dang / phyi nang gi mchod pa/ shing sna sman spos shing 'bras zas sna dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs sbyar ba'i bsang bshos/phye mar chang phud 'o skyems rgya ja'i btung ba/ 'o ma dri bzang rin chen phye ma sman sogs sbyar ba'i bsang chu/dgra lha'i spyan gzigs go mtshon sogs dang /dar tshon sna lnga me long sogs kyis brgyan pa'i mda' dar/g.yang rten/phyogs bzhi'am gang 'os su 'phyar dar/ rang gi mdun du rnga rol sogs skabs kyi nyer mkho rnams 'tshogs par bya zhing / bsang g.yog dang bcas pa sta gon bya/ sbyor tshogs gnyis pa sngon 'gro'i rim pa ni gter gzhung las/rang nyid pad+ma'i nga rgyal gyis: mchod rdzas kun la spos chu gtor: thams cad ci 'dod 'byung ba yi:mchod sprin yid bzhin gter byung ba: sa gzhi bar snang gang bar bsam:shing sna me sbar bsang dung sbyar: rol mo'i sgra yis byin dbab bo: zhes gsungs pa ltar gyi cho gar 'jug pa'i rim pa la/thog mar bka' brgyad bde gshegs 'dus pa'i skyabs 'gro ni/ rol mo dbyangs dang bcas te 'di skad do/ hūṃ/ rang byung lhun gyis grub pa'i sdu: 'od gsal chen po'i dgongs pa

can: thugs rje'i dbang gis 'gro don mdzad: bla ma rnams la skyabs su mchi:rang la ye shes shar ba'i sku: mi 'bral rtse gcig dgongs pa can:byin gyis brlabs shing bar chad sel: yi dam lha la skyabs su mchi: dam tshig rnam par dag pa'i sku: brtse dung byams pa'i dgongs pa can: legs nyes stangs 'dzin dngos grub ster: mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la skyabs su mchi: zhes lanagasum gyis skyabasa'agro dang /sngon nas bsags pa'i rig sgrib bshags:'gro don sangs rgyas thob bya'i phyir: smon pas byang chub sems bskyed do:sems can yongs su smin bya'i phyir: gsang sngags spyod pa rlabs chen spyad:don dam spros bral byang chub sems:rang byung mtha' bral stong gsal bsgom:zhes lan gsum gyi sems bskyed bya/bla ma bde gshegs mkha' 'gro gnas 'dir gshegs:nyi zla pad gdan mdzes la dgyes par bzhugs: lus ngag yid gsum gus pas phyag 'tshal lo: phyi nang gsang gsum mchod sprin kun gyis mchod: sngon nas da bar mi dge bcu bsags bshags: dus gsum dge ba'i tshogs la rjes yi rangs: bdag gzhan yongs sgrol chos 'khor bskor du gsol:'gro mgon mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs gsol 'debs: sgo gsum dge spyad ma lus byang chub bsngo:mkha' mnyam 'gro rnams sku gsum mngon gyur shog: ces pasayan lagabadunapa 'bul/ skye/stong gsum kun tu dri mchog 'byung gyur pa'i: spos dang sman sbyar chu gtsang dag pa'i khrus: yid bzhin sprin phung mkha' la char 'bebs pas: mi gtsang dri ma'i tshogs kun dag gyur

cig:r+shazhu shu rwa rnya nayeswāhā zhes tshar gsum brjod cing gnas dang yo byad la chab gtor nas mdag pa sbyangs te byin gyis brlabs la/thog mar rang nyid skad cig gis pad+ma dkar bo 'dab ma drug pa'i stebar rang rig rgyu dkar po'i 'phro 'du las/dpal rdo rje — sems dpa'i skur thalagyis bskyed pa ni/rgyu/pad sdong 'dab drug khri 'phang bzhin:nyi ma zla ba'i gdan steng du:bdag nyid rdo rje sems dpa'i sku: dkar gsal zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa: rdo rje dril bu thugs skar 'dzin: dar dang rin chen du mas spras: spyi gtsug bla ma kun bzang mthing:mtshan dpes spras pa yum dang sbyor: sku yi gnas su zhi khro'i lha:chu nang zla ba lta bur gsal/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa rgyu: zhes lan bdun nam nyer gcig bzla/ 'dab drug shar gyi pad 'dab la: sbyong ba'i lha ni shāka thub ser: phyag gnyis sa gnon lhung bzed bsnams: mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par bzhugs: thal mo khong stong phyag rgya'i nang: a dkar 'od 'phros dngos 'dzin sbyangs: ma su bhā wa thu :sarba dha rmāḥ swā bhā wa bi shu rgyu: sngags 'di lan bdun brjod pa'i mthus:snad bcud dngos 'dzin dag gyur cig: de yi mtshams kyi pad 'dab la:spel ba'i lha ni rnam snang dkar: phyag gnyis 'khor lo dril bu bsnams:mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par bzhugs: thal mo tshigs bcag phyag rgya'i nang: rlu sngon 'od 'phros snod bcud spel: e na ma: sarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shā mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba ta smu u smu te sga ra ṇa i mi ga ga na khaṃ swāhā: sngags 'di lan bdun brjod pa'i mthus: snod bcuX legs tshogs spel gyur cig: de yi

mtshams kyi pad 'dab la: sgyur lha bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang: phyag mtshan rgya gram dril bu bsnams: mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par bzhugs: thal mo kha gyes phyag rgya'i nang: dza dmar 'od 'phros bdud rtsir bsgyur: i badz+ra a bla ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na k+shi phaṭa: sngags 'di lan bdun brjod pa'i mthu: snod bcud zag med bdud cir bsgyur: de yi mtshams kyi pad 'dab la: thob lha rin 'byung sku mdog ser: phyag na rin chen dril bu bsnams: mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par bzhugs:mchog sbyin phyag rgya tram̐ ser las: 'od 'phros kun gyis 'bad med thob: na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sa ra sa m+bha ra rgyu: sngags 'di lan bdun brjod pa'i mthus: mgron rnams kun gyis thob gyur cig: de yi mtshams kyi pad 'dab la: tshem lha don yod grub pa ljang: phyag mtshan ral gri dril bu bsnams: mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par bzhugs: bu tshur mchog sbyin phyag rgya'i nang: ha ljang 'od 'phros mgron mnyes gyur: o tshwan a wa lo ki te na mas sa man+ta sba ra khor smi bha wa sa ma ya mahā ma ṇi du ru du ru hri da ya dz+ra la ni swāhā: sngags 'di lan bdun brjod pa'i mthus: mgron kun dgyes shing tshim gyur cig: de yi mtshams kyi pad 'dab la: dbang chen phyag rdor ljang dmar ni: phyag mtshan rdo rje dril bu bsnams: mtshan dang dpe byad ldan par bzhugs: sor bsnol phyag rgya dza dmar las: 'od 'phros mgron bzhi'i mthu stobs bsdus: na ma sma man+ta bu ṭ+wāṃ gra he rwa ri bra bhañdza na mahā rdzu ma ya rdu phaṭa: sngags 'di lan

bdun brjod pa'i mthus:dbang sdud 'phrin las kun 'grub shog: ces byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pa dngos gzhil/gter gzhung las de nas dngos gzhi brngan pa niḥ rang nyid pad+ma'i nga rgyal gyis: mgron rnams spyan drangs bzhugs pa la: rim bzhin mchod cing brngan pa ni: mchod gtor gzugs 'gros bshams pa la: bsang chu phud chu 'thor phud dang: bye mar rin chen 'bru sna tshogs: me nang phul la 'di skad do:zhes gsungasapa bzhin rang nyid slob dpon chen po dam tshig par bskyed pa ni/pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng na//dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi//thugs las sprul pa'i rig 'dzin ni//pad+ma 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i sku//sku mdog dkar dmar skyil krung mdzad//gzhon nu lo brgyad lon pa'i tshul/ /sngags pa'i cha lugs mthing dag gos/ /rab byung cha lugs chos gos dmar/ /rgyal po'i cha byad zab ber gsol/ /phyag g.yas rdo rje thugs skar 'dzin//g.yon pa mnyam gzhag ka pā la//dbu la pad+ma'i gnyen zhu gsol//sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes//bkrag dang gzi mdangs ldan pa la//rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha//mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter bdag tshogs//ma lus 'khor gyis bskor bar gyur/ ye shesapa spyan 'dren pa ni/t+t+waṃ/ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams//pad+ma ge sar sdong bo la//ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes//pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags//'khor du mkha' 'gro mang bos bskor/ /khyed kyi rjes su bdag sgrub kyis//byin gyis brlabs phyir gshegs su gsol//gu ru pad+ma sirnyi r+ghaṃ/zhesadamalegacigatugyu/par bsams la/mchod pa 'bul ba ni/hūṃ/

me tog bdug spos mar me dang //lha bshos dri chab mchod par bshams//bla bre rgyal mtshan na bza' dang //ba dan gdugs dang rol mo'i tshogs//rin po che dang me tog dang //gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya dang //chos dang mdangs chen byang chub sems//mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa//rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang //yi dam zhi khro'i lha tshogs dang //chos bdag dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs//dam can chos skyong rnams la 'bul//sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsol/ mi ā: rgyu badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi rdu/zhes brgya rtsa sogs bzla/dang po brngan gyi 'byung khungs niḥ'adzam bu gling gi bod yul dbus: btsan po khri srong lde'u btsan gyis: bsam yas gtsug lag bzhengs pa'i dus: sa bdag klu gnyan khros gyur nas: lha khang nyin brtsigs mtshan mo bsgrol: ri rdo thams cad klungs su phab: klungs rdo thams cad ri la bskyal ca ji shing thams cad me la bsregs: nad dang gnod pa sna tshogs byung: rgyal po'i lha khang gshol la thug: de tshe rgyal blon bka' bgros mdzad: slob dpon pad+ma spyan drangs nas:brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas su slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis: rdo rje phur ba'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs: lha 'dre thams cad dam la btags: dkon mchog gsum la mchod pa phul: lha dang srung ma thams cad dang: sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad brngan: de yis bsam yas chos 'khor grub: rje 'bangs bde zhing bkra shis la: rgyal blon sku tshe ring ba dang: rtsi shing me tog thams cad smin: legs pa'i yon tan bsam mi
