khyab: brngan gyi byed las dgos pa ni: de yang phyi rabs rnal 'byor pas:gang 'dong 'phrin las sgrub pa dang: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang:sgrub la bar chad sel ba dang: 'khor bsrung rkyen bzlog grags pa spel: lha khang bzhengs dang mchod rten brtsigs: mi nad yams nad bcad pa dang:mkhar las byed dang bkra shis 'dod: thag ring mgron la 'gro ba dang: chu chen spu la 'gro ba dang:lam 'phrang bgrod dang dmag la 'gro: lho bal sbas yul 'gro ba dang: che hrag bya ba thams cad kyi: sngon du brngan 'di byas pas 'grub: ces bsang mchog 'di nyid gang du ma dzang pa'i gnas dang ma dzad lodang dgos pa dang byedalas ngang phan yon tedon lnga'i sgo nas phyi rabs rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis 'dod pa 'i donarnam sagegs med na gyis 'grub pa'i slad du cho ga 'dir 'jug par spyo ba bskyengade/de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/rdu/bstan pa 'di la ngo mtshar rmad byung ba'i: 'jig rten skyabs gyur pad+ma rgyal po ni: rigs ni za hor rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs: o rgyan yul du sgro 'dogs ma lus bcad:bsil ba tshal du dngos grub thams cad brnyes: la ba can du bstan pa dar bar mdzad:lho nub mtshams su srin po'i kha gnon mdzad: mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu: sku gsum che mchog badz+ra he ru ku: dus gsum mnyam nyid bla ma dus 'dir dran: bdag dang bla ma dbyer med nye ru ku: rgyal ba'i zhing khams ngag pa chen po 'dir:mi 'gyur lhun grub pad+ma rgyal po dang: bla ma yi bam mkha' 'gros byin gyis rlobs: sdo āḥ/ badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sid+dhi rgyu: mgron

spyan drangs pa ni/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang ca sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang: zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod lha: phyi nang srung ma'i tshogs rnams dang: gsang sngags rig sngags lha rnams dang: 'das dang ma byon da ltar gyi: lha dang srung ma dam tshig can: ma mo mkha' 'gro thugs 'gro dang:'jig rten gnas kyi mchog gyur pa: sgrub gnas byin chen thams cad dang:gzhan yang sa 'og sa steng gi: gnas bdag chen po thams cad dang:'khor du gtogs pa'i sde brgyad po: stong gsum khyab pa'i mthu rtsal can:che dgu gnyan dgu thams cad dang:gtsug lag khang dang sgrub gnas kyi: srung ma gnyan po thams cad dang:gzhan yang lha dang gnod sbyin dang: dri za grul bum mkha' 'gro sogs: brngan par 'os pa'i mgron rnams dang: sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad kun: sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung ba dang: sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs bya ba dang: dgon gnas bar chad sel ba dang: dgra dang bgegs rnams gzhom pa dang: nad gdon gnod pa la sogs pa: chag che nyam nga bzlog pa dang: 'dod pa thams cad bsgrub pa'i phyir: mgron rnams spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol: 'dir gshegs bshams pa'i mchod pa bzhes: bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzod: bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag gi: yid la re ba skong ba dang: kun kyang bshad pa'i chos la nyon:bsang gyer ba ni/ kyi: bsang gi rgyu byung gang nas byung: bsang gi rgyu byung gnam nas byung: pha gnam la 'brug /na lda ma ldir: ma sa la glog chen gya ma

gyu bu rta rgod gangs kyi thigs pa yin: rgya mtsho chu yi lu ba yin: ma pham g.yu mtsho'i kha zhag yin: bzang drug sman gyi nus pa yin: dri zhim spos kyi ngad pa yin: phye mar 'o skol gsur gyis mchod:shing bdud rtsi can gyi dud pa dang:gser lo 'bar ba'i stag pa dang ca g.yu lo 'bar ba'i shug pa dang:dung lo 'bar ba'i ba lu dang: mkhan pa spos dkar a ka ru: shing bdud rtsi can gyi dud pa dang: phye mar zas phud gser skyems kyis: lha 'dre thams cad bsang ba'i phyir: kye: skyabs mchog mgon gnas yon tan zhing: rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma bsang: nam dang skal bar ldan pa yi: yi dam lha tshogs thams cad bsang: snga rabs 'das dang da ltar bzhugs: slad nas 'byon dang dus gsum gyi: sangs rgyas nam mkhar gang ba bsang: rnam par snang mdzad la sogs pa'i:rigs lnga bde bar gshegs pa bsang: rigs gsum mgon po la sogs pa'i:byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bsang: ston pa bla med sangs rgyas bsang skyob pa bla med dam chos bsang: 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun bsang: bla med dkon mchog gsum po bsang: bu bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis bsang: khro bo med du byung ba bsang: khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad bsang:'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs bsang:bad ma gsung gi lha tshogs bsang: yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs bsang: che mchog yon tan lha tshogs bsang: phur ba 'phrin las lha tshogs bsang: bdud rtsi sman gyi lha tshogs bsang: ma mo bod gtong lha tshogs bsang: bla ma rig 'dzin lha tshogs

bsang: 'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs bsang: dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs bsang: dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa gnyis bsang: nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs bsang: bar snang gang ba'i gnyan rnams bsang: sa gzhi gang ba'i klu rnams bsang: sde brgyad dam la gnas pa bsang: lha min g.yul ngo bzlog pa bsang: lha dmag bye ba dung phyur bsang: dpal ldan lha mo nag mo bsang: lha mo bye ba 'khor bcas bsang: 'jig rten brtan ma bcu gnyis bsang: gsang sngags phyi dang bstan srung bsang: rig 'dzin brgyud kyi srung ma bsang: slob dpon brgyud kyi srung ma bsang: pha mes brgyud kyi srung ma bsang: dben gnas gnyan gyi srung ma bsang: phyi a dkar dkar gyi srung ma bsang: tshangs pa la sogs lha brgyad bsang: nyi ma la sogs gza' brgyad bsang: smin drug la sogs rgyu skar bsang: mtha' yas la sogs klu brgyad bsang: dzam lha la sogs nor lha bsang: dri za la sogs phyogs skyong bsang: phyi dang gsang ba'i chos skyong bsang: med pa yod ces dgra lha bsang: stong la chags pa'i dgra lha bsang: 'byung ba chags pa'i dgra lha bsang: srid pa'i lha lung dkar po bsang: 'dod rigs sman pa bco brgyad bsang: ma chags stong gi dgra lha bsang: ye nas srid pa'i dgra lha bsang:'dod dgu chags pa'i dgra lha bsang: mi thub dgra lha spun gsum bsang:pha mes brgyud kyi dgra lha bsang: mi rabs brgyud kyi dgra lha bsang: phyi rabs brgyud kyi dgra lha bsang: dmu rabs /rgyud kyi dgra lha bsang: gtsug rabs

brgyud kyi dgra lha bsang: mi'u gdung drug dgra lha bsang: smon pa'i rji lung 'phyo ba bsang: pha tshan yab lha gdal drug bsang: ma btsun rgyal mo mthing gi bsang: sman btsun de mo dbu dkar bsang rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum bsang: srid pa chags pa'i dgra lha bsang: ma gsang rdo rje legs pa bsang:btsan rgod 'bar ba spun bdun bsang: shar gyi rma chen sbom ra bsang: rma rigs sum brgya drug cu bsang: sto yi 'dzam bu gling chung bsang: klu 'khor sum brgya drug cu bsang: nub kyi gnyan chen thang lha bsang: lha 'khor sum brgya drug cu bsang: byang gi lha btsun bu le bsang: btsan 'khor sum brgya drug cu bsang: shar lho nub byang kun 'gro ba'i: dgra lha gnyan po thams cad bsang: sma ra mched dang lcam dral bsang: yar lha de ni sham po bsang:'o de de ni gung rgyal bsang: gnyan po sku lha gyer 'dzoms bsang:pho lha lha'u g.yang dkar bsang: lha gnyan tshogs lha gu ru bsang: khams gsum klu dang sa bdag bsang: pho lha dgra lha gnyan po bsang: yul gyi sa bdag gnyan po bsang:gzhis la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag bsang: mkhar la gnas pa'i rtse lha bsang jag yag cang se gnyan po bsang: thab la gnas pa'i thab lha bsang: lam la gnas pa'i lam lha bsang: dud pa gnam du song ba yis: nam mkha' gang ba'i lha tshogs bsang: me lce rab ca'abar ba yis: bar snang gang ba'i lha tshogs bsang: me gzhi sa gzhi'i steng du sbar:sa gzhi gang ba'i lha tshogs bsang: me /ga drag po'i thog rgod 'phro: gdug

pa'i dgra bgegs kho thag chod: thal ba chen po'i rlung la bskur: dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlogs: kye: phyi snod 'jig rten lha tshogs bsang:rtsi shing nags tshal lha tshogs bsang: nang bcud sems can lha tshogs bsang: pha ri g.yas la gnas pa bsang: tshur ri g.yon la gnas pa bsang:nyin dang srib la gnas pa bsang: phyi rabs brgyud kyi srung ma bsang: dmu rabs brgyud kyi srung ma bsang:gtsug rabs brgyud kyi srung ma bsang: stong gi stong lha mo chu bsang: sgra yi spra mo re khra bsang: 'bru yi 'bru mo khrom khrom bsang: sga yi sga mo le le bsang:dbang lha dgra lha tshal lhar bsang: rang la yod pa'i dgra lha bsang: grogs la 'go ba'i dgra lha bsang: dgra bsad grub pa'i dgra lha bsang: dar ma thob pa'i dgra lha bsang: che btsun smon pa'i dgra lha bsang: thugs dkar sum brgya drug cu bsang: 'bar ba nyis brgya lnga bcu bsang: wer ma brgya dang brgyad cu bsang: med pa yod srid dgra lha bsang: srid pa'i lha lung dkar bo bsang: gling bzhi dar ba'i dgra lha bsang: sku gsung thugs kyi dgra lha bsang: pha mes dar ba'i sras btsun bsang: ma phyi mnga' ba'i sman btsun bsang: gcod khams bzang ba'i zo dor bsang: tshe rabs brgyud kyi zo dor bsang: dmu rabs brgyud kyi zo dor bsang: gtsug rabs brgyud kyi tho dor bsang: mi'u gdung drug zo dor bsang: bod kyi mgur lha bcu gsum bsang: dge bsnyen sum brgya drug cu bsang: gnam gyi brgya byin dkar bo ༷sang: sa yi brgya byin nag po bsang:

bar snang brgya byin khra bo bsang: phyi btsan nang btsan dbus btsan bsang:lha khang btsan rgod 'khor bcas bsang: rigs ldan khro rgyal nub re bsang:mched 'khor sum brgya drug cu bsang: ri rab chen po'i sa bdag bsang:gser gyi ri la gnas pa bsang: rol mtsho bdun la gnas pa bsang:mnga' ris skor gsum gzhi bdag bsang:dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i gzhi bdag bsang: mdo khams sgang drug gzhi bdag bsang: ti se gangs kyi sa bdag bsang: phu drug gnas pa'i sa bdag bsang: mtho ba mkha' la gnas pa bsang: dma' ba sa la gnas pa bsang: sa bdag gtsang btsan 'khor bcas bsang: sa yi lha mo brtan ma bsang: sa 'dzin lag pa chen po bsang: lo skor bcu gnyis lha rnams bsang: gab tse dgu yi lha rnams bsang: sa bdag klu gnyan stong skor bsang: pho lha dgra lha gnyan po bsang:mo lha mo ji zhang lha bsang: dgra lha re mo gnyan po bsang: rno mthong ston pa'i rno lha bsang: bdud lha sum brgya drug cu bsang: za kha 'byed pa'i zhal lce bsang: wer ma sum brgya drug cu bsang: khas grags sum brgya drug cu bsang: spyan rnon sum brgya drug cu bsang: rdzi'u sum brgya drug cu bsang:nyin gyi grangs mkhan nyi ma bsang: mtshan gyi grangs mkhan zla ba bsang: sgra gcan la sogs gza' brgyad bsang jag la 'gro ba'i jag dpon bsang:/(1 /sdu/ 1(1 /nge//ste/ /ji/ /ste/dmag la 'a ba dmag da na bsang: sku lha 'a gas da bsang:sa gzhi 'di la gnas pa bsang: bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi:mgon

skyabs sdongs grogs rgyab rten mdzod: chos dang mthun pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod: mi mthun dgra bgegs med par mdzod: rgyal lo rgyal lo lha rgyal lo:zhesasmon lam btab phyag mchod ni sems can kun gyi mgon gyur pa'i rgyal ba shākya thub pa la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul:bcom ldan rgyal ba rigs lnga la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: yum lnga rin chen phreng ba la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: zhi khro dpal chen 'khor bcas la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: rigs gsum mgon po 'khor bcas la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: gdung ba sel ba la sogs pa'i: 'phags pa rang rgyal 'khor bcas la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul:'od srung chen po la sogs pa'i nyan thos chen po thams cad la:phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: bha ra d+dha dza la sogs pa'i: gnas brtan chen po bcu drug la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: nam mkha'i snying bo la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: chos sku kun bzang la sogs pa'i: rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna — tshogs 'bul: in+d+ra bo rnyi la sogs pa'i: grub chen brgyad po thams cad la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'asal: klu yi byang chub la sogs pa'i:

grub chen brgyad cu thams cad la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul:klu sgrub snying bo la sogs pa'i rgyan drug mchog gnyis thams cad la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: 'jam dpal sku dang pad+ma gsung: phur ba 'phrin las la sogs pa'i sgrub pa bka' brgyad lha rnams la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: nub phyogs tshergyan la sogs pa'i: dur khrod chen po brgyad rnams kyi: ma sring mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang yul: nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i mkha' 'gro dang: srung ma zhing skyong thams cad la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: khyad par 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu: o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul: 'dod dgu'i rob bskang du gsol:rgyags brngan gyi gzhung dngos di rgyu/ mchod yon me tog bdug spos dri: zhal zas rol mo gtor ma dang: sku glud bsang phud sna —tshogs kyis: 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i:srung ma gnyan po thams cad dang: lha klu gnod phyin dri za sogs: che dgu gnyan dgu thams cad brngan: shel sgong nag po spyi dkar dang: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma yis:ma hā ka la lcam dral dang :legs ldan nag po 'khor bcas brngan: rgya che'i mchod pa sna tshogs dang: bdud rtsi sha khrag gser skyems kyis: mkha' lding nag po gser mig dang: dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas brngan: phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod gtor dang: bya naX khyi spyang dom dred dang: bsang bud

spyan gzigs sna tshogs kyis: sngags bdag shan pa gza' mchog dang:dmar nag dam can la sogs pa: srung ma dam can 'khor bcas brngan: lha rnams me tog phreng bas brngan:klu rnams dkar gsum gtor mas brngan:gnyan rnams mngar gsum dar zab brngan: sa bdag gser dngul rin chen brngan: lha mo brtan ma bum pas brngan: dri za dri dang gsur gyis brngan: gshin rje sha yi gtor mas brngan: sto 'bye grul bum mi'am ci:mkha' lding mchod sbyin gtor mas brngan: gnod sbyin rlung lha drang srong rnams: gser g.yu sba dang sgyug mas brngan: dge bsnyen sha dang chang gis brngan: lha 'dre yid kyi gzugs can rnams: yid dang mthun pa'i gtor mas brngan: btsan rnams bya dang ri dwags brngan: klu bdud sbrul dang sbal bas brngan: lan chags mgron rnams gtor mas brngan: sde brgyad dam sri 'byung bo rnams: sku glud dar zab gtor mas brngan: rgya mtsho'i nang gi klu chen brgyad: klu rta rgyan dang bcas pas brngan: bar snang gnas pa'i gza' chen brgyad: nas nag ra nag snying gis brngan: rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang: blon po sum cu rtsa bdun rnams: rin chen gser dngul bye mas brngan: 'phrog ma ma bu lnga brgya'i tshogs: changs bu dag gi gtor mas brngan: rigs kyi srung ma thams cad la: so sor dgyes pa'i gtor mas brngan: sgo bzhi srung ma 'khor bcas rnams: rin chen dar zab dong tses brngan: lha srung gnyan po khyed rnam kyis: bdag cag yon mchod 'khor

bcas kyi: bsam don sgrub la re ba skongs: 'khor srung rkyen zlog bar chad sol: bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs mdzod: rgyu: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyis: byang chub thugs su chud pa'i sa: rdo rje gdan gyi sa bdag brngan: rgya gar shar nub ri bo che: ma mo mkha' 'gro 'du ba'i gnas: ri bo ta la'i sa bdag brngan: rdo rje gdan gyi byang phyogs na:bya rgod phung bo'i ri dang ni: spos ngad ldan pa'i ri bo yi: sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad brngan: tsa ri tsa kong la sogs pa'i: rgya gar shar phyogs yul rnams kyi:sa bdag gnyan po thams cad brngan: bsilab tshal gyi dur khrod dang :rngams pa sgra sgrog tshang tshing 'khrigs: ha ha rgod pa la sogs pa'i: dur khrod brgyad kyi sa bdag brngan: rgyal po'i khab dang yangs pa can: mnyan yod gnas bcas la sogs pa'i: grong khyer yul 'khor thams cad kyi: sa bdag gnyan po thams cad brngan: gzhan yang kha che 6rgyan yul: li yul bal yul la sogs pa'i: sa bdag gnyan po thams cad brngan: 'jig rten gsum snang ma : 'jigs byed la sogs 'dzam gling ri: sa bdag gnyan po thams cad brngan: ma dros la sogs mtsho rnams dang: gaṅgā par si sogs: chu chen rnams kyi sa bdag brngan: ti se gangs ri la sogs pa'i:mgul lha gnyan po thams cad brngan: ma dros klu gnyan la sogs pa'i: sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad brngan: ri bo gan+ta la sogs pa'i: li yi sa bdag gnyan rnams brngan: lcang ra /ga po la sogs pa'i: sog yul gzhi

bdag gnyan po brngan: gzhan yang spu gu zhang zhung yul: gar log la sogs mtha' khob yul: gzhi bdag gnyan po thams cad brngan: rgya gar rgya dag hor dang 'jang: bal yul bod yul li yul sogs: gzhi bdag gnyan po thams cad brngan:bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi:'khor srung rkyen zlog bar chad sol: bsam don sgrub la re ba skongs: bkra shis bde legs kun tshogs mdzod sger gsol mdzad dgos rnams dang dgra la dpang bstod g.yang 'gugs bcas skabs 'dir bya/rgyu: yul ni rdo rje brag dmar gyi:srid gcig gangs dkar sha med ma chibs su dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs: bshos bu snying dang gtor mas brngan: yul ni rma chen sbom ra yi:sring gcig kha rag khyung btsun ma chibs su gyi ling kha dkar chibs:bshos bu snying dang gtor mas brngan: yul ni dbu ru ka tshal gyi: sring gcig rdo rje g.yu sgron ma chibs su chibs rta sngon po chibs: bshos bu snying dang gtor mas brngan: yul ni ma hā de wa yi: sring gcig rdo rje kun grags ma chibs su chu glang sngon po chibs: bshos bu snying dang gtor mas brngan: yul ni lho yul de snying gi: sring gcig skyi mthing g.ya' ma skyong:chibs su gser sha yu mo chibs:bshos bu snying dang gtor mas brngan: yul ni snga phyi de grong na: sring gcig mug chos g.ya' mo bsil chibs su rus sbal mgo dgu chibs: bshos bu snying dang gtor mas brngan: yul ni bal yul gser phug na: e ka dza ṭi ral /cig ma chibs su g.yu 'brug sngon

mo chibs: bshos bu snying dang gtor mas brngan: yul ni na len shing len na:btsan la rol pa'i sman gcig ma chibs su dre'u rta rkang gsum chibs:bshos bu snying dang gtor mas brngan: yul ni kong yul kong phug na:gangs kyi yum chen g.yu bun mchi chibs su stag mo ris bkra chibs: bshos bu snying dang gtor mas brngan:yul ni mang yul mang ting na: che zhes gtsug bi 'od 'chang ma chibs su 'brong bu dar ma chibs bshos bu snying dang gtor mas brngan:yul ni dbu ru snying bo yi: byang gi ma ting ting mo btsun chibs su 'brong chen 'gying ba chibs: bshos bu snying dang gtor mas brngan: yul ni sgrub yul ka tshal gyi: mda' la btsan mo gdug pa 'dul chibs su dom bu snying dkar chibs: bshos bu snying dang gtor mas brngan: bstan ma chen mo khyed rnams kyis: bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi: bsam don sgrub la re ba skongs: bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs mdzod: rgyu bod yul kun gyi gzhi bdag ni: che dgu gnyan dgu thams cad brngan: rdo je legs pa la sogs pa'i: gtsang gi g.yas ru nyin srib kyi:gzhi bdag gnyan po thams cad brngan: thang lha bar lha la sogs pa'i:dbu ru nyin srib sa bdag brngan: shasto gangs bzang la sogs pa'i: g.yo ru nyin srib gzhi bdag brngan: yar 'brog g.yu mtsho phyug mo brngan: byang gi gnam mtsho phyug mo brngan: steng gi lha rgod mdung rtse brngan: 'o de gung rgyal la sogs pa'i: nyang po 'od dga'i ga/ bdag brngan: snam po dpal ri la

sogs pa'i: dwags po'i gzhi bdag thams cad brngan: kong btsun de mo la sogs pa'i: kong po'i gzhi bdag gnyan po brngan: rdo rje brag skyes la sogs pa'i mon yul rdo dang glo rnams kyi: gzhi bdag gnyan po thams cad brngan: sku lha mkha' ri la sogs pa'i: lho brag yul gyi gzhi bdag brngan: nags sogs chu rgyud dge bsnyen dang: ma la rjod kyi gzhi bdag brngan rngu yi nyin srib sa bdag dang ca gzhi bdag gnyan po thams cad brngan: lho yi rong lha rgyal mtshan dang: rong btsan kha ba dkar bo brngan:dpang lha mod non mched brgyad dang: dmag dpon dgra 'dul dbang phyug dang: thu ri smu btsan la sogs pa'i: tsha ba snang gi gzhi bdag brngan:skam gyi mthong la rmog gzhu dang: gze yi rnga mong ga pa dang: lce yi brag la mda' zug dang: zla snying dkar nag sum mdo dang: rtsi yi spa rgod mthon po dang:rgya mtsho gangs dkar mched brgyad dang: zla ba'i gzhi bdag gnyan po brngan: klu rgyal mi mgon dkar bo sogs: smar khams snang gi gzhi bdag brngan: lha yi dge bsnyen chen po ste: lhags chen stong ra la sogs pa'i:'bri gung nyin srib gzhi bdag brngan: ldan gyi wer te sme dgu dang ger mtsho'i ri bo dbang gzhu dang : mtshams lnga'i gzhi bdag gnyan rnams brngan: badz+ra bram ze la sogs pa'i: spom 'bor sgang gi gzhi bdag brngan:shar gyi rma chen sbom ra ni: rma rigs sum brgya drug cu'i mched: sring lcam bzhi bcu rtsa lngar bcas: rma khyung nyi/ /ba gzhi bdag brngan: be ru yi ni

dug ma/tsho dang: stong ri yi ni mtsho dag dang: ba lu'i tshwa mtsho dkar bo dang:khri shor rgyal mo'i mtsho dang niḥ tsong kha yi ni mtsho sngon dang: mtsho sman rgyal mo mched lnga brngan: dge ri gnyan po la sogs pa'i tsong kha'i gzhi bdag gnyan po brngan: bha dang bya rog ha la shad: ga dang byang ngos gzhi bdag brngan: bha da'i btsan rgod la sogs pa'i: gnas ri gnas mar sa bdag brngan: rma lung dan tig la sogs pa'i: rma yi yul gyi sa bdag brngan:gzhon nu kurti la sogs pa'i: ha ha'i yul gyi gzhi bdag brngan: gzhong lag la'o che la sogs pa'i: g.yar mo thang gi gzhi bdag brngan: spyi yi mdun re mthon po dang : spo ri brag dmar sgang rgyud dang: spo zi shel lung phyug mo dang: grol gyi ma lung gral gsum dang: rma grol bar gsum gzhi bdag brngan: dgu mig bzhi sum gzhi bdag brngan: nye gong nye dmar la sogs pa'i: sna gong nyin srib gzhi bdag brngan: brag dmar bya rgod la sogs pa'i te chu'i sa bdag gnyan po brngan: lha srin ma 'dug ma phye ba'i: 'o de ral gsum sa bdag brngan:shin tu khro gtum che ba yi: rgyal mo rong gi gzhi bdag brngan: 'jang ri smug po la sogs pa'i: 'jang yul gzhi bdag gnyan po brngan: ri bo rtse lnga la sogs pa'i: rgya nag yul gyi gzhi bdag brngan: shar phyogs ba reg 'o de yi: lha klu gnod sbyin dri za sogs: che dgu gnyan dgu thams cad brngan: bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi: re ba thams cad bskang ba dang: bkra miXs bde legs phun tshogs mdzod:

gzhan yang stong gsum 'dzam gling yul: sa 'og sa steng sa bla yi: gzhi bdag gnyan po thams cad brngan: sa la gnas pa'i sa bdag brngan: chu la gnas pa'i klu rnams brngan: brag la gnas pa'i btsan rnams brngan:bar snang gnas pa'i gnyan rnams brngan: yul lha gzhi bdag gnyan po brngan: la la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag brngan: 'phrang la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag brngan: gru zam gnas pa'i gzhi bdag brngan: lam la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag brngan: gzhi bdag gnyan po khyed rnams kyang: mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul so sor che: dpal dang 'byor ba so sor che: mnga' ris mnga' thang so sor che: mdzad pa 'phrin las so sor che: mchod pa'i 'os su so sor che:de bas gzhi bdag gnyan rnams la: phyag 'tshal mchod pa sna tshogs 'bul:'dod pa'i don la gsol 'debs kyis: sngon gyi thugs dam brtser dgongs la: dgyes pa'i mchod pa bzhes nas kyang: bdag gi re ba bskang du gsol: brngan thos khyed rnams brngan pa yis:bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs mdzod: rdu/ gzhan yang brngan par 'os pa'i mgron: ming dang mtshan nas ma thon pa'i: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro dang: srung ma dam can rgya mtsho dang: lha dang drang srong thams cad dang: yul lha nor lha nang lha dang :lam lha gnyan po thams cad dang: gzhan yang dus gsum pha ma dang:khams gsum rigs drug thams cad dang: yi dwags rnams dang bgegs rnams dang: lan chags snying rje'i //na rnams dang: glo bur lhags pa'i

mgron rnams dang: lhag ma'i mgron rigs thams cad la: rgyal pham med par thob nas kyang: yid la re ba rdzogs par shog:rgyu: de ltar mgron rigs thams cad kyi:mnga' ris spyan lam so so ru:mchod sbyin dam pa 'di bsngos pas: longs spyod nam mkha' mdzod gyur te: gang la ci dgos thob par shog: mgron rnams brngan pa'i byin rlabs kyis: bdag gi don rnams 'grub par shog: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma yis: rgyags brngan chen po 'di mdzad pas: gtsug lag grub cing mtha' dmag thul: rje yi dgongs pa grub pa ltar: bdag gi don rnams mngags pa yis: bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi: 'khor srung rkyen zlog bar chad sol: tshe bsring dpal dang 'byor ba spel: snyan pa sgrub la grags pa sgrogs: rtag tu 'gro zhing grogs mdzod la: 'gro lam bde zhing 'jigs pa med: lam 'phrang bde bar bgrod pa dang: rnyed pa chen po 'grub pa dang: gzhis byes kun tu bkra shis shog: lha dang srung ma thams cad kyang: dge dang zhi ba'i las mdzad pa: dam chos rin chen spyod par shog: kun kyang rgyal ba'i bka' la nyon:sdig pa ci yang mi spyad cing: dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad: rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul: 'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin: chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste: dag cing gsal la rnyog pa med: gzung du med cing brjod du med: rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung: ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa: de ltar chos rnams shes kyi sa: sems can don ni mnyam med

byos: 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye: de ltar chos dang zang zing gi: sbyin pas tshogs chen kun rdzogs te: thams cad mngon par sangs rgyas shog:'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub: gzhan don nus pa mthar phyin nas:byin rlabs dngos grub yid bzhin gter: kun bzang ye shes thob par shog: gnas skabs gnas dang lam bgrod dang: rtsod dang dmag dang dgra 'thab las: bdag cag yon mchod rgyal gyur cig: gang 'dod don kun 'grub par shog: mgron po dag ni don gnyer ba: phyogs rnams su ni 'gro ba na: bdag gi don kun 'grub pa dang rnyed pa chen po 'thob par shog:phyogs rnams kun gyi lha rnams dang: 'jig rten spyod pa grags dang ldan:bkra shis bde legs byed po rnams: skye dgu kun gyis bsrung bar shog:gsum pa mjug gi cho ga ni: yig brgyas lhag chad kha bskang la: rgyu: mgron rnams kun gyi spyan lam du: bdag gis mchod sbyin bshams pa la: 'gal 'khrul nongs pa ci mchis pa: thams cad ma lus bzod par gsol: gtso bos nus pa ma mchis pa: ma 'byor ma rnyed ma tshang ba: 'dir ni bya min gang byas pa: de dag thams cad bzod par gsol: o: khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad: rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol: sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang : slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das kyi: mgron rnams ma lus thams cad kun: rang rang bde bar gshegs nas kyang: slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol: e badz+ra
/ rdo/ mo slob dpon pad+mas mdzad pa rdzogs so brag ri dug skul srungs

bsang chung yid bzhin nor bu/༄ //chargyan pad+mas mdzad pa'i bsang chung 'di gzhis byes gar 'gro gar 'dug kyang don thams cad yid bzhin du 'grub pa yin no/ /na mo gu ru: bsang gi chas ni 'bring rgyas sha chang dkar gsum/mngaragasum gye mar g.yag lug ra gsum gyi gzugs/gsur dang gser skyems kyi chas rnams g.yang gzhi dkar bo'i steng du bsham la/bsang rdzas ganga'adzoms bsags nas 'di skad do// kye: bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong dang / /dgra lha yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas/ /ye shes lha dang 'jig rten srung ma rnams//bsang dang khrus la spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol/oṃ badz+ra sa ma ya dzaḥ pad+ma ka la ye ste: ma ti pu ho pratī ts+tsha ho:ma badz+ra ma pratī ts+tsha ye swāhā:i badz+ra 5bye pra tī ts+tsha ye swāhā:ma badz+ra pu ṣ+pe pra tī ts+tsha ye swāhā: badz+ra cu be pratī ts+tsha ye swāhā:ma badz+ra ā lo ke pra tī ts+tsha ye swāhā:ma badz+ra garnye pra tī ts+tsha ye swāhā: badz+ra nai wi bye pra tī ts+tsha ye swāhā:mi badz+ra shasnya pra tī myu ye swāhā kyi bsang gi rgyu ni gang nas byung //bsang gi rgyu ni gnam nas byung //yab ni gnam la 'brug chen sdir//yum ni sa la glog chen 'khyug /sras ni rta rgod gangs thigs la//rgya mtsho chu ni wu ba yin//bzang drug sman gyi nus pa yin//dri zhim spos kyi dud pas bsang //gser lo 'bar ba'i stag pas bsang //g.yu lo 'bar ba'i shug pas bsang //dung lo 'bar ba'i /khan pas bsang mchong lo 'bar ba'i

phur mos bsang //zangs lo 'bar ba'i ba lus bsang //dri zhim spos dkar dud pas bsang / /kye: dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste/ rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma bsang / /snga rabs 'das pa'i bla ma bsang / /phyi rabs 'byon pa'i bla ma bsang / /da ltar bzhugs pa'i bla ma bsang //chos sku kun bzang man chad nas//rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chad kyi/ /rnying ma brgyud pa'i bla ma bsang / /rdo rje 'chang chen man chad nas//rtsa ba'i bla ma yan chad kyi//gsang sngags gsar ma brgyud pa'i bla ma bsang //ston pa bla med sangs rgyas bsang //skyob pa bla — med dam chos bsang //'dren pa bla med dge 'dun bsang //phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad bsang //zhi ba lhun gyis grub pa bsang //khro bo rmad du byung ba bsang //'jam dpal sku yi lha tshogs bsang //pad+ma gsung gi lha tshogs bsang / /yang dag thugs kyi lha tshogs bsang //bdud rtsi yon tan lha tshogs bsang / /phur ba 'phrin las lha tshogs bsang / /ma mo rbod gtong lha tshogs bsang //bla ma rig 'dzin lha tshogs bsang //'jig rten mchod bstod lha tshogs bsang //dmod pa drag sngags lha tshogs bsang //rgyud sde bzhi yi lha tshogs bsang //drang srong bden pa grub pa bsang //bram ze dmod pa grub pa bsang // kye: dgos 'dod re ba skong mdzad pa'i//nor lha g.yang lha thams cad bsang //sprul ba'i dzam lha 'khor bcas bsang //rnal 'byor longs spyod char ltar phob/ /rnam sras mgon po 'khor bcas bsang // kyi: sangs rgyas bstan pa srung mdzad pa'i//phyag drug ༷gon po 'khor bcas bsang //ye shes

mgon po 'khor bcas bsang //dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba bsang /phyag bzhi mgon po 'khor bcas bsang //legs ldan dag po 'khor bcas bsang /bka' srung chen po 'khor bcas bsangan/smug mthing rgyal mo mched lnga bsang //dpal ldan lha mo 'khor bcas bsang / /bdud mo ma sring 'khor bcas bsang //sde dpon sum cu 'khor bcas bsang //ma sring dam can rgya mtsho bsang //bka' srung pho nya yongs rdzogs bsangan/slob dpon brgyud kyi srung ma bsang //dben gnas gnyan po'i srung ma bsang //gsang sngags srung ma thams cad bsang //dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga bsang kyi: dgra lha dmag dpon 'khor bcas bsang //srid pa chags pa'i dgra lha bsang //pho lha dgra lha thams cad bsang //mo lha zhang lha thams cad bsang //'go ba'i lha lnga thams cad bsang //skyob pa'i lha dgu thams cad bsang //mkhar gyi rtse lha thams cad bsang / /zangs zangs lha brag dkar bo bsang //che ba'i pho lha thams cad bsang //rta yi lha ni rta bdag bsang //ba yi lha ni g.yang skyong bsang //lug gi lha ni g.yang khug bsang / /'bri yi lha ni shar mo bsang / /ra yi lha ni tshe tshe bsang //phyi sdod 'jig rten thams cad bsang //nang bcud sems can thams cad bsang //bar gyi lha srin sde brgyad bsang //srid pa'i lha srin sde brgyad bsang //srid pa'i lha rigs thams cad bsang //sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad bsang //yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad bsang //bod khams brtan ma bcu gnyis bsang //'dzam bu gling gi srung sdu bsang //bod yul gzhi bdag thams

cad bsang //mnga' ris skor gsum gzhi bdag bsang //dbus gtsang ru bzhi'i gzhi bdag bsang //bod khams gzhi bdag thams cad bsang /gser gyi ri bdun gzhi bdag bsang //rol ba'i mtsho bdun gzhi bdag bsang //sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad bsang / /yul 'di'i gzhi bdag thams cad bsang / /gangs ri dkar la gnas pa bsang / /g.ya' ri sngo la gnas pa bsang //spang ri ser la gnas pa bsang //pha ri g.yas la gnas pa bsang //tshur ri g.yon la gnas pa bsang //'bab pa chu la gnas pa bsang //skye ba shing la gnas pa bsang //'gro ba lam la gnas pa bsang //sdod pa sa la gnas pa bsang //lha srin klu srin gnas pa bsang / /lha 'brog klu 'brog thams cad bsang // kyi:bdag dang yon bdag 'khor bcas la//dme grib gshinagrib ro grib dang //btsog grib nyams grib yugs grib dang //de la sogs pa'i sgrib rnams dang //lha dang mi la grib phog pas//sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba rnams//bsang gi mchod pa dam pa 'dis//thams cad byang zhing dag gyur cig /rang rang so so'i spyod yul du//longs spyod 'byor dgu rgyas par mdzod/ /snang srid lha srid khyed rnams kyis/ /bdag gi bsam 'grub re ba skongs//dgra bgegs bar chad thams cad zlogs//nad gdon thams cad zhi bar mdzod//snyan pa'i ba dan phyogs bcur sgrogs//bkra shis phun sum tshogs par shog/ /phyogs bcu'i mun sel bsdus pa ni/ steng 'og phyogs mtshams bzhugs pa'i sangs rgyas dang //skyabardzu mgon dam pa dkon mchog rnam

gsum sogs/ /dge sdig shan 'byed dam can chos kyi rgyal//bdag la skyabs bzhin re sa ma mchis pas/ /phyag 'tshal skyabs mchi bdag cag gar 'gro yang //dgra jag chom rkun gcan gzan 'tshe ba dang / nad gdon bar chad me chu phyugs nad sogs//'jigs pa kun skyob bsam don lhun 'grub mdzod par 'di sgrub pa po dkon mchogatshul khrims 'od zer ro/thub bstan bshad sgrub — nor bu'i gling du bzhugs/༄rna //lha mi'i rnam 'dren rgyal ba tshe dpag med/ /gdon bgegaX nad wazhi gtsug tor rnam par rgyal/ /tshe dpal rgyas shing 'khor ba las sgrol ma//tshe yi lha mchog gsum la gus phyag 'tshal/tshe lha rnam gsum gyi gzungs/

mnol bsang lha chab sngon mo/༄ //pad+ma sa wa la na mo/ slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/bsam yas mchims phu'i brag tu sgrub pa mdzad pa'i tshe/ rgyal po khri srong lde btsan sku khams yun ring ma bde zhing / de'i yul du btsa' sad ser gsum/nad yams mu ge la sogs pa mi bde'i mtshan ltas mang du byung bas/ der rgyal blon rnams kyis gros byas nas/ sman pa rtsis pa sogs gang las gang zab bos nas phyag rtsa brtag par/ sman pa'i zhal nas/ nad 'du ba rnam bzhi'i rtsa na mi 'jug cing 'thib kyi rtsa gcig 'dug pas/ mi gtsang ba'i mnol grib bsnang nad yin pa 'dra zer/ de nas mo bas mo btab/ rtsis pas rtsis byas pas thams cad kha 'cham par mi gtsang ba'i mnol grib kyis/ rgyal po dang yul lha thams cad 'khrugs par 'dug zer ba la/ der sman pa rtsis pa sogs kyis gang 'dras mnol ba ma shes par/ rgyal po'i btsun mo mang bza' khri lcam bya ba zhig la rtsog mnol gyi bu gcig byung bas/ btsun mos gsang nas khol mo zhig la gtad par khyod kyis 'di sus kyang ma mthong bar sbas pa gal che zer bas/khol mos phug gcig tu sbas pa'i rkyen gyis sa bdag gi lto bar phrad pas sa bdag yul lha thams cad la mi gtsang ba'i grib phog nas 'khrugs pas rgyal po dang yul khams thams cad du mi bde ba byung/ der khol mo la yang mi gtsang 66

ba'i grib phog nas na bas/ mgo dang yan lag zha grum du song / slar yang sman pa bos nas bstan pas 'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad ni mi 'dug mi gtsang ba'i mnol sgrub phog 'dug pas/ gang gis mnol ba ma shes na'ang khyod kyi nad de la phan pa'i thabs nga rang la med zer bas/ der khol mos khri lcam gyi bu sbas tshul ji bzhin du bshad pas/ der gcig smra gnyis smra bas rgyal po'i snyan du gsan pas/ rgyal pos mang bza' khri lcam la dris pas khri lcam gyis drang bor ma bshad na khol mo la srog nyen 'dug pa dgongs nas drang bor zhus pas rgyal po shin tu thugs khros dgongs nas/ khri lcam la chad pa gcad par 'os pas/khri lcam o rgyan rin po che'i mdun du skyabs 'tshol du bros pas/ 6rgyan chen pos rgyal po la phyag mdud yi ge bcas bskur nas/ btsun mo khri lcam la chad pa bcad pa mi 'os 'dra/ gang yin kyang nga snang srid bden med du rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor ba yin/ sna tshogs kyi snang ba rten 'brel du bsgyur shes pa yin pas/mi gtsang ba'i mnol grib 'di las che ba nyon mongs dug lnga'i grib sel bar byed pa la sla ba tshegs chung ba don che ba'i thabs yod pas/ rdzas dang yo byad 'di lta bu dgos pas thams cad tshang bar gyis la/ rgyal po thugs khrel ma gnang bar sang rgyal blon 'khor bcas bsam yas he po ri'i rtse mor byon cig ces gsungs pas/ rgyal po shin tu dga' nas rdzas dang yo byad bsags nas/sang he po ri'i rtser byon pa la/ der slob dpon chen pos gzhung nas byung ba'i rdzas rnams rin po che'i snod yangs shiX rgya che ba'i nang du bsags la/ raṃ yaṃ khaṃ

yi ge gsum 'od du zhu ba las 'byung ba lha'i ro bcud thams cad bsdus/bsang rdzas kha dog dri ro reg bya phun sum tshogs pa/mi gtsang ba'i dri ma nyes skyon thams cad sbyangs pas 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa/ bar snang nam mkha' sa gzhi thams cad yongs su khyab pa'i dud sprin bsam gyis mi khyab par bkang bar spros te/ sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs shing / dang po mnol bsang bya ba ni/'di skad do/kyiḥ sems can kun kyang ma rig 'thib bos mnol//nyon mongs dug lngas ye shes lha lnga mnol/ /sgo gsum mi dge lus ngag yid gsum mnol//'dul khrims nyams pas lus lha mkha' 'gro mnol//dam tshig nyams pas rdo rje slob dpon mnol//tshogs gtor chung ngus ma dang mkha' 'gro mnol//phud nyams lhag mas chos skyong srung ma mnol//ser sna bsags pas bka' srung dam can mnol//ting 'dzin 'khrugs pas srid pa'i ma mo mnol//brtse gdung 'khrugs pas mched dang lcam dral mnol//zhe snang 'khrugs pas zhi ba'i lha rnams mnol/ /nga rgyal 'khrugs pas rgyas pa'i lha rnams mnol//'dod chags 'khrugs pas dbang gi lha rnams mnol//phrag dog 'khrugs pas drag po'i lha rnams mnol//gti mug 'khrugs pas gsal byed lha rnams mnol//dkar dmar thab gzhob yul lha gnyan po mnol//thab 'khon 'khrugs pas byes lha gnyan po mnol//mi gtsang thab kyis khyim lha khyim bdag mnol//mi gtsang dri yis mgon skyabs lha rnams mnol/ 6/khyad par mi gtsang bud med pang sme

mnol//steng 'og bar gsum lha klu gnyan rnams mnol//phug lha sgo nor khyim lha khyim bdag mnol//lus ngag yid dang dgra lha phrag lha mnol//kye: lus mnol lus kyi mdangs nyams lus stobs shor//mgo mjing ro stod na zhing mig mi gsal/ /ngag mnol skad 'gag lkug cing smra mi bde//mchil snabs mang zhing sna 'tshub lce thog brnangs//yid mnol yid mi bde zhing tshig pa za//brjed ngas gnyid 'thib bying zhing mtshan mo yer//mgo mnol mgo 'khor mig grib rna ba 'on//yan lag mnol bas zha grum sbrid cing na//pho mtshan mnol bas mi 'greng rtsa dkar mang //mo mtshan mnol bas srid kyi skye sgo chad//rgyab rten lha mnol gzhi yi las mi 'grub//dgra lha mnol na dgra sribang dkar la//gyes lha mnol na mgron 'thoms grogs dang 'bral//mgron lha mnol na mgron rnams don mi 'grub//gzhi lha mnol bas gzhi lha sdod mi tshugs//yul lha mnol bas nad 'khrugs mu ge 'byung //khang lha mnol bas zag cing tsag sgra 'byung //rba lha mnol bas rul zhing ldog 'gyur mang //nor lha mnol bas stongs shing 'byor mi rgyas//phyugs lha mnol bas spu 'byi ltas ngan 'byung //zhing lha mnol bas zhing sa khol bur stong //thab lha mnol bas bcud med stong zhing 'gong //grogs lha mnol bas zas khar 'gong bo 'jug/go mtshon mnol bas go log rno mtshon rdugs//rta pho mnol bas rgal rdo 'gom lam nyams//sgo khyi mnol bas skad 'gag btsan rdzi zhan//kha rjes mnol bas mi rabs lad mo shor//dbang thang mnol bas brjed ngaX dbang bo nyams//rlung rta mnol bas

sems stor don mi 'grub//lus kyi lha mnol gnyid 'thib dran pa nyams//lus kyi klu mnol sha 'gul sha ro ldang //phrag lha mnol bas bkrag dang gzi mdangs nyams//lus kyi lha srung mnol bas lus mi bde// srung skyob lha —rnams mnol bas sems mi bde//lus kyi sha mnol sha 'chor nyams stobs chung //rus mnol rus kun zug cing srin bu ldang //khrag mnol thig le smad lhung khrag rnams 'dzag/pags mnol chu bur brdol zhing za 'phrug byed//chu rgyus rtsa mnol zha grum sbrid cing skrang //spu mnol spu rnams 'byi zhing slog kyin thul//gzhan yang sme mnol rtsog mnol rmug gi mnol//yugs sa'i mnol dang rabs chad pho mo'i mnol//nal bu mo mtshan zla mtshan zag pa'i mnol//zas mnol gos mnol thab gzhob 'khon gyi mnol//shi ba'i dur sri gson po'i nang dme'i mnol//sdig can bshan pa mna' zan dri bo'i mnol//de la sogs pa'i mnol grib thams cad kun// kyeḥ 'byung ba'i dwangs ma lnga las grub pa yi// sa la brten pa'i chu yis rab tu brlan//me yis drod skyed rlung gis rab bskyod pa'i//rtsa ba klu yi gnas nas skye ba'i shing //rtse mo lha gnas rab tu smin pa'i shing //lo 'dab mi yi gnas su khyab pa'i shing //dri yis phyogs kun ma lus khyab pa'i shing // kha dog dri ro nus dang ldan pa'i shing //shing mchog tsan+dan dkar dmar a ka ru//gser thing mkhan pa g.yu shing shug pa dngaka/dung shing ba lu stag pa spen dkar dang //'on bu spa snyag nya rub gser mgo can//pho shing mo shing bu shing shing sna'i tshogs//༷bras bu gsum dang bzang drug sman

sna'i tshogs//dri ldan ro nus kha dang ska ba'i rigs//nas 'bras gro dang so ba yungs ma dngan/'bras sna dkar dag 'bru yi rigs rnams dang //dar zab rin chen shing 'bru phye mar dang //gser skyems chang dang shing mchog khu ba'i bcud//dkar gsum phud dang mngar gsum dwangs ma dngan/sha khrag sna tshogs dbang bo rnam lnga'i gsur//byin gyis brlabs pa'i dam rdzas dkar dmar dang //gu gul dkar dag dri spos sna tshogs sogs//phyi nang gsang gsum mnol grib sel ba'i rdzas//mes bsreg chus bkrus rlung gis rab gtor bas//nam mkha' bzhin du stong bar gyur ba'i ngang //raṃ las skyes pa'i me la bsreg pa yis//dri mchog dri gsur rnam pa sna tshogs kyis//ye shes grib med ngang du sangs gyur cig /kyiḥ ma rig dbang gis mnol na rang byung ye shes bsang //dug lnga'i dbang gis mnol na rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas bsang //sgo gsum mi dges mnol na sku gsum lha rnams bsang / /'dul khrims nyams pas mnol na lus kyi mkha' 'gro bsang //dam tshig nyams pas mnol na rdo rje slob dpon bsang //brtse gdung 'khrugs pas mnol na mched dang lcam dral bsang //tshogs gtor chung bas mnol na ma dang mkha' 'gro bsang //phud nyams lhag mas mnol na chos skyong srung ma bsang //dam rdzas nang 'dres mnol na gtsang ris mgon po bsang //ser sna bsags pas mnol na nor lha g.yang lha bcasang //'khon grib mi gtsang mnol na bka' srung dam can bsang //ting 'dzin 'khrugs pas mnol na srid pa'i ma mo bsang //brtse gdung 'khrugs pas

mnol na snying rje'i mgron rnams bsang //zhe snang 'khrugs pas mnol na zhi ba'i lha rnams bsang //nga rgyal 'khrugs pas mnol na rgyas pa'i lha rnams bsang //'dod chags 'khrugs pas mnol na dbang gi lha rnams bsangan/phrag dog 'khrugs pas mnol na drag po'i lha rnams bsang //gti mug 'khrugs pas mnol na longs spyod lha rnams bsang //gnod grib 'khrugs pas mnol na yul lha gnyan po bsang //thab gzhob 'khrugs pas mnol na byes lha gnyan po bsang / /mi gtsang thab kyis mnol na khyim lha gnyan po bsang //nyams chag sgrib pas mnol na srung byed lha rnams bsang //mi gtsang dri yis mnol na mgon skyabs lha rnams bsang //rabs chad dur sris mnol na srid kyi lha rnams bsang / /mna' zan dri bos mnol na pho lha dgra lha bsang //sdig can bshan pas mnol na lhag pa'i lha rnams bsang //dme yugs mi gtsang mnol na bsang byed lha rnams bsang //gshin po'i ro grib mnol na phrag lha gnyan po bsang //gson po'i nang dmes mnol na 'go ba'i lha rnams bsang //thab kyis mnol na khang lha rba lha bsang //gzhob kyis mnol na pha lha ma lha bsang //yugs sa mnol na ma lha bu rdzi bsang //lus 'di mnol na lhan cig skyes lha bsang / /ngag mnol gsung snyan grags stong lha rnams bsang //yid mnol dran byed gsal byed lha rnams bsang //yan lag mnol na byes lha mgron lha bsang / /kyeḥ rmugs pa dwangs par byed pa'i lha rnams bsang //'thib pa bsang bar byed ༷/ lha rnams bsang //gtsang rtsog dbye

bar byed pa'i lha rnams bsang / /mnol ba bsang bar byed pa'i lha rnams bsangan/khyad par mi gtsang bud med pang sme bas//steng 'og bar gsum lha klu gnyan la sogs//phug lha sgo nor khyim lha khyim bdag dang //lus ngag yid dang dgra lha phrag lha dang //nor lha g.yang lha gos nor longs spyod dpal//mnol grib mi gtsang dri mas gos pa yi//rtsi shing sman mchog dri gsur sna tshogs dang //phyi nang gsang gsum 'dod yon dpag med kyis//mi gtsang mnol sgrub dri ma bsang gyur cig/ de nas bye brag tu bsang ba ni/ 'di skad do/ cha shing rtsi dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis//bla ma yi dam mnol ba bsang gyur cig /ye shes lha rnams rtsog gis mnol gyur na//sman sna tsan+dan dri yis bsang gyur cig /'jig rten lha rnams rtsog gis mnol gyur na//spos dkar shing sna'i dri yis bsang gyur cig /ma sring mkha' 'gro rtsog gis mnol gyur na//bha la bha dra'i dri yis bsang gyur cig /chos skyong srung ma rtsog gis mnol gyur na//sha khrag sna tshogs dri yis bsang gyur cig /gtsang ris mgon po rtsog shi sa mnol gyur na/ /dkar gsum mngar gsum dri yis bsang gyur cig /lha srin sde brgyad rtsog gis mnol gyur na//shing rtsi sman mchog dri yis bsang gyur cig /bka' srung dam can rtsog gis mnol gyur na//bye mar 'o skol dri yis bsang gyur cig /lha rnams mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na//spos dkar g.yu thug dri yis bsang gyur cig /klu rnams mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na//klu sman sna tshogs dri yis bsang gyur cig/gnya/ rnams mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur

na//dar tshon stag gzig dri yis bsang gyur cig/sa bdag mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na//nya rub gser mgo dri yis bsang gyur cig/gnas bdag mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na//stag pa sur dkar dri yis bsang gyur cig /gzhi bdag mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na//mkhan pa nya rub dri yis bsang gyur cig /yul lha mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na//spa snag dkar gsum dri yis bsang gyur cig/nor lha mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na//phye mar zas phud dri yis bsang gyur cig /g.yang lha mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na/ /rin chen sna tshogs dri yis bsang gyur cig/khang lha mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na//dar zab sna tshogs dri yis bsang gyur cig /thab lha mi gcig rtsog gis mnol gyur na/ /sha phud chang phud dri yis bsang gyur cig /zhing lha mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na//'bru rnams sna tshogs dri yis bsang gyur cig/pho lha mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na//dar tshon stag gzig dri yis bsang gyur cig /dgra lha mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na//phye mar gser skyems dri yis bsang gyur cig /byes lha mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na/ /'bras dkar rtsi bcud dri yis bsang gyur cig/mgron lha mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na//sha chang gser skyems dri yis bsang gyur cig /skye lha mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na//lha shing sur dkar dri yis bsang gyur cig /lus lha mi gtsang rtsog gis mnol gyur na//gu gul dkar nag dri yis bsang gyur cig/srung skyob lha rnams rtsog gis mnol gyuX na//shing 'bras me tog dri yis bsang

gyur cig /rig byed lha rnams rtsog gis mnol gyur na//g.yu thug ba lu'i dri yis bsang gyur cig /rgyab rten lha rnams rtsog gis mnol gyur na//spos sna shing sna'i dri yis bsang gyur cig/lus kyi go mtshon rtsogagis mnol gyur na//lha chab sman sna'i dri yis bsang gyur cig/zas nor longs spyod rtsog gis mnol gyur na//shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/mnol grib mi gtsang thams cad dag bsangs nas//shel bzhin gsal la dung ltar dkar gyur cig /shel sgong bzhin du phyi nang gsal gyur cig/de nas bsang dud sku gsung — bugs kyi rten lha dang srung ma rnams la 'di skad do/ : bla ma yi dam mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/chos skyong srung ma mnol ba yod na yang // shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /pho nya las mkhan mnol ba yod na yang / /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /gtsang ris lha rnams mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /lha srin sde brgyad mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/'jig rten skyong ba mnol ba yod na yang / /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /steng gi lha rnams mnol ba yod na yang / /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/bar gyi lha rnams mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur /ga /sa gzhi'i klu rnams mnol ba yod

na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /gzhi bdag gnas bdag mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/mched dang lcam dral mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /'jig rten lha srung mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/brgyud kyi lha srung mnol ba yod na yangan/shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /'go ba'i lha lnga mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/ma lha bu rdzi mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/rta lha 'phan po mnol ba yod na yangan/shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/nor lha phyug mo mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /lug lha rmin po mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /ra lha tsi mo mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/zhing lha tshangs pa mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /phug lha ge thung mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/sgo lha stag g.yag mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/thab lha yod mo mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /pho lha dgra lha mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /nor lha g.yang lha mnol ba yod ༷ yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis

bsang gyur cig /byes lha mgron lha mnol ba yod na yang / /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/ de nas srung ma'i phyi nang gi rten rdzas rnams bdugs nas 'di skad do/kyeḥ rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi/ /lha dang srung ma mnol ba yod na yang / /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/lha khang dri med mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /lha gos bse khrab mnol ba yod na yang / /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/lha rgyan lhab lhub mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /lha mtshon rno ngar mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/lha — rdzas ro brgya mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/lha btung gser skyems mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /lha rta btsan po mnol ba yod na yang / /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /lha lug don po mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/lha g.yag zhol mo mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/lha ra khrom po mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /srung ma'i dam rdzas mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/srung ma'i spyan gzigs mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /srung ma'i di/da rdzas mnol ba yod na yang //shing

mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/srung ma'i sgrub rdzas mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /srung ma'i rten rdzas mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/srung ma'i thugs dang 'gal ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/ de nas sbyin bdag gi mi nor phyugs gsum la bdugs nas 'di skad do/chabadag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor bcas kyi//srid kyi dbang thang mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/mkhas pa'i btsun g.yang mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /btsan po'i blo g.yang mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/gzhon nu'i dpal g.yang mnol ba yod na yangan/shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/skyon po'i thab g.yang mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /mang bo'i tshogs g.yang mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/rta pho'i mgyogs g.yang mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /phyugs kyi 'phel g.yang mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /zas kyi bcud g.yang mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /btsan po'i stobs g.yang mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /phyug po'i nor g.yang mnolasnya ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang

sman gyis bsang gyur cig/'phan po'i dar g.yang mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /btsan phyug 'phan gsum mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /gzhan yang bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi//rgyan pa'i ber gos mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /btags pa'i rno mtshon mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/btung ba'i zas skom mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/gzhi yi gnas sa mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/'dug pa'i mal sa mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /mi nor rigs rgyud mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /bran dang g.yog 'khor mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/phyugs dang sgo khyi mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/zas nor longs spyod mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /stobs dang mnga' thang mnol ba yod na yang / /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /bkrag dang gzi mdangs mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/tshe dang bsod nams mnol ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/kha rje dbang thaX /rnal ba yod na yang //shing mchog dri

bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/ gzhi bsang yin na 'di nyid kyi mjug tu 'og nas 'byung ba'i bdag cag dpon slob zhes pa nas bzung ste dkyus ltar bya/ nad sogs kyi don yin na slar yang bsang dud grib rkyen byungab rnams la bdugs nas 'di skad do/ḍūkhushing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas kyi//nyon mongs dug lnga'i gdung ba bsang gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis//'dod chags las gyur rlung nad bsang gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /zhe snang las gyur mkhris nad bsang gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis//gti mug las gyur bad kun bsang gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis//'du ba rnam bzhi'i nad rnams bsang gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /snying rlung rgyal 'gong nad rnams bsang gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis//glo gzer klu btsan nad rnams bsang gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis//mchin rgud sa bdag nad rnams bsang gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /mtsher sbos dri bo'i nad rnams bsang gyur cig/shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis//mkhal grum klu bsen nad rnams bsang gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis//pho gcong ye 'gong nad rnams bsang gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis//mgo dang yan lag nad rnams bsang gyur cig /shing /chog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis//

sha dang pags pa'i nad rnams bsang gyur cig/shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis//khrag dang chu ser nad rnams bsang gyur cig/shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis//rus dang srin bu'i nad rnams bsang gyur cig/shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis//rtsa dang chu rgyus nad rnams bsang gyur cig / shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /mdangs dang dbang bo nyams pa bsang gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis/ /dbugs dang rnam shes nyams pa bsang gyur cig /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis//dpal dang mthu stobs nyams pa bsang gyur cig/shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dud pa 'dis//tshe dang bsod nams nyams pa bsang gyur cig/gzhan yang bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la smre mnol rtsog gis mnol dang grib kyi mnol//shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /thab dang gzhob kyi mnol dang yugs sa'i mnol//shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /pho byi rabs chad zla mtshan nal bu'i mnol//shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/mdze can gcong bo dam nyams grib kyi mnol//shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/dri bzang dri ngad can dang mug dri'i mnol/ /shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /shi bo'i dur sri gson gyi nang dme'i mnol//shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /sdig can bshan pa mna' zan dri bo'i mnol//shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig/phud nyams mi gtsang

yas dang glud kyi mnol//shing mchog dri bzang sman gyis bsang gyur cig /gzhan yang mi gtsang mnol grib ma lus kun//shing mchog dri bzang sman gyi dri gsur gyis/ /nam mkha' sprin bral bzhin du dwangs gyur cig /nyi zla gza' skar ji bzhin gsal gyur cig /me long phyis pa lta bur gsal gyur cig /zla ba yar ngo ji bzhin rgyas gyur cig/me tog 'dab stong lta bur rgyas gyur cig/ston ldan 'bras dus bzhin du smin gyur cig /chab srid nam mkha' lta bur rgyas gyur cig /dgos 'dod nor bu lta bur 'byung gyur cig /rgyal po nad med bde dang ldan gyur cig /rgyal srid ri bo bzhin du brtan gyur cig /rgyal rgyud nyi zla lta bur gsal gyur cig /g.yog 'khor skar tshogs bzhin du 'phel gyur cig /nor phyugs rtsi shing bzhin du bstar gyur cig /snyan grags phyogs rnams kun cakhyab gyur cig /tshe ring nad med bde dang ldan gyur cig/lo brgya 'tsho zhing ston brgya mthong gyur cig/ ces gsungasanas rgyalablon 'khor dang bcas pa rnams the tshom ma byas par/'di lta bu nyams len byas na don dang ldan pa yod gsungs te/de nas rgyal blon 'khor dang bcas dga' zhing gus pas yi rangs te/gser gyi maṇ+ḍal phulanas phyag dang bskor ba byas nas 'di skad ces zhus so/kye slob dpon chen po lags/rgyun du nyams len ji ltar gyi don ji bzhin dang ldan pa lags/zhes zhus pas/slob dpon chen po'i zhal nas/ kye rgyal po chen po lags/ khri srong lde btsan/ spyir dal 'byor rten thob pa la don ldan du byed dgos pas/ de'i thabs su byang chub kyi rgyu grub pa la 'jig rten dang ༷/ga rten las 'das pa'i lha dang srung

mar gsol ba btab nas/ byang chub grub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad sel zhing /mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub mthun rkyen bsgrub pa yin pas/ de'i ched du lha dang srung ma bsten dgos pa yin la bsang bya ba ni/ slar yang 'di bzhin nyon mongs dug lnga'i grib mnol sbyang zhing / lha dang srung ma mi 'bral bar 'khor ba'i thabs yin pas/ rgyun du bsang bya ba ni don de dang ldan pa'o/ mnol bsang bya ba ni don de dang mtshungs pa la/ lhag par mnol grib mi gtsang ba myur du sel ba la mkho bas/ snga dro lha bsang dang phyi dro mnol khrus byas nas nyon mongs pa'i grib pa sbyong ba'o/ lha dang srung ma 'khor/ zas nor longs spyod byin chags lus kyi 'byung ba cha snyoms/ grags dang gzi mdangs bskyed/khams dang dbang bo gsal/ kun gyi yid du 'ong / snang srid kyi lha 'dre dang 'gal rkyen bar chad kyi dri mas mi gos pa sogs yon tan mang bo ldan pa yin gsungs so// rgyal po'i zhalanas/ legs so legs so/ slob dpon chen po lags/mnol khrus bya ba ni ji ltar yin lags/slob dpon gyi zhal nas/mnol khrus bya ba ni/spyir mdo sngags so so 'di lugs dang 'dra bas rdzas sbyor ba sogs byed tshul mang du yod pas 'di'i skabs su gong gi sman rdzas dang rin po che'i dri bzang sna tshogs chu gtsang dang sbyar nas rin po che'i bum pa'i dang du blugs la yul phyogs chab gtor bran na yul khrus dang / slar yang sku gsung thugs kyi rten rnams la khrus gsol ba ni rten grus dang / de nas mi nad phyugs nad nor rdzas sogs la rdo rje rnam pa/ 'joms pa'am khro bo sme brtsegs pa

bdud rtsi 'khyil ba sogs gang rung gcig gi nga rgyal dang ldan pa'i bsgoms bzlas byas pas grib khrus dang nor rdzas rta sogs la grib phog na chab gtor bran na chog pa yin gsungs so/de nas rgyal blon 'khor bcas dga' zhing gus pas thal mo sbyar te phyag dang bskor ba mang du byas nas slar yuladu gshegs so/phyin chad ring bo ma pon par rgyal po snang nad las grol nas yul kham sa su bkra gis dge ltas mang bo byung bar gyur ro//slob dpon chen po pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis mdzad pa'i mnol bsang lha chab sngon mo zhes bya ba rdzogs so/: — zur / ༄ //oṃ sa /badz+ra gu ru pad+ma sirnyi skye/ snye tsho lke — — sna

mnol bsang dang grib bsang /༄ //a skṛ tas bsangs/ oṃ su bha was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i dang du tsan dan a ka ru/du ru ka la sogs pa mnol ba sel byed kyi rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed par gyur/oṃ ā /:lan gsum brjod/r+yāchos rnams rang bzhin kun bral yang //rmi lam bzhin du nong ba gang //bsang dang bsang bya bsang yul sogs//rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings su bsang //mi gtsang zas shing rgyan pa dang //sku gsung thugs dang 'gal bgyes bsang //dam grib 'khon grib btsog grib sogs/ /bshan grib yul grib bag grib bsang / /mdze grib thab gshob mnol shor sogs//lha mi yongs la grib phog pa//ma lus bsang gi mchod pa bsang //bsang gis mi bsang gang yang med//mi gtsang ba ni thams cad bsang //mi mthun thams cad zhi ba dang //tshe dang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod//khams gsum dbang du 'du ba dang //ci bsam lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ ces pa'adi ni paṇa chen blo bzang chos kyi rgyal mtshan gyis sbyar ba'o// kyiḥ de ring dme grib thams cad bsang / /de ring 'khon grib thams cad bsang //de ring ro grib thams cad bsang //zas ngan kha ru zos pa bsang //gos btsog lus la gyon pa bsang //gson pa'i 'gom yugs phog pa 85

༄༅//thugs je kun la snyoms pa'i bcom ldan 'das/ /mtshan —tsam thos pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal sel/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla//be+eḍūr+ya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/sman bla'i mtshan brjod pa/

bstan srung spyi'i 'phrin bcol/༄byu //rgyu bde stong rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po ru/ /zung 'jug sgyu ma'i dpa' bor mngon bzhengs pa//khams gsum za byed 'jigs mdzad rdo rje sogs//yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro bka' srung mchog /myur mdzad stobs chen ma hā kā la dang //las kyi gshin rje'i rgyal po rnam pa gsum//'dod khams dbang mo dmag zor re ma ti//lha chen tshangs pa yum sras blon sogs bcas//dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs kyis bdag la dgongs/ /rdo rje 'chang nas rtsa ba'i bla ma'i bar//bka' bsgos dam tshig gnyan po ma bsnyel bar//dus 'dir rig 'dzin rnal 'byor bdag cag gi/re zhing bcol ba'i las 'di bsgrub par rigs//thub pa'i dbang bo'i ring lugs snying bo'i bcud//blo bzang rgyal ba'i zhal lung bdud rtsi'i rgyun//'dzin zhing spel ba'i bkra shis dar rgyas glingan/zhes pa'am/'di nyid srung skyob 'phrin las ma g.yel zhig /bdag cag dpon slob sde dang bcas pa la//nyes med bzhin du mtho mtshams glags lta zhingan/chos srid phun tshogs chom la mngon rtsom pa//dgra bgegs thams cad thal ba'i rdul du rlogs/ /pha rol rig sngags ngan pa'i rbod gtong dang / /byad stems mnan gtad sbyor ba mchis pa rnams//stobs ldan srung ma'i rdo rje'i mthu stobs kyis//las ngan dgra bo nyid kyi steng du bzlog //tha chad rgyal 'gong dam srim mo dngan/

drang srong gdug pa'i cho 'phul las 'ong ba'i//phyi nang nad gdon bar chad nyams chag sogs/ /da lta nyid du zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /yongs 'dzin dam pa'i zhabs pad yun ring brtan//dpon slob thugs mthun mdo sngags bshad sgrub 'phel//sde bzhi'i 'byor ba dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin//rnam pa kun tu rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//lha dang gnod sbyin gdeng can la sogs pa//rkang drug tshogs rnams chu skyes bcud la bzhin//dbyangs snyan sgrogs shing gus pa lhur len par//ci 'dod mthun rkyen 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//sde 'dir gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs kyi//don snying sha khrag srog dbugs bcas pa rnams//bā ling bcud du drangs te rol mdzod la//rngam brjid rnam par rgyal pa'i ru mtshon sbyor//sa la phun tshogs lo tog g.yur du za/ /bar la dam can srung ma'i ra bas brjid/ /mkha' la rdo rje'i bsrungs pa'i gur khang brtan//dge legs mtshan ma 'bum gyi bkra shis stsol/ces bstan srung chen po rnams kyi'aphrinabacol mdor bsdus/ gtad bzlogalalcang skya rolaba'ijo rjesasbyaraba'o//

gzhi bdag spyi'i dkar gtor/༄byu //rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug tu gyur/oṃ badz+ra a skṛ ta kun li ha na ha na rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ subha wa shurnyo shurnyo sarba dharma su wa shudhe shudhe ha/ stong ba'i nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyis dang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod yon nas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i bde ba khyad par can bskyed nas nam mkha' dang mnyam par gyur/ oṃ ma a rgyu: zhes pa nas shasta ā rgyu oṃ badz+ra ā skṛ ta nas ma su bha was sbyangs/ stong ba ngang las hūṃ las rin poche snad yangasashing rgyache ba'i nang dulha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum zagapa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi rgya mtsho chen por gyur/oṃ āḥ lan gsum brjod/ oṃ ā ka ro zhes sogasalan gsum/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rin chen zhes pa nas/'jigs pa thams cad bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di bsngo zhing 'bul ba'i gnas su gyur pa ni 'dzam gling skyong ba spyi dang khyad par du sa bdag sa'i lha mo brtan ma'i gtso byas pa'i bod khams skyong ba'i tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma bcu gnyis/ stod mnga' ris skor gsum/ bar dbus gtsang ru bzhi/ smad mdo khams sgang drug la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag gnas /dag yul lha dkar phyogs la mngon

par dga' ba rnams la bsngo'o 'bul lo/khyad par du sa cha yul phyogs 'di nyid la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag lha klu dge bsnyen mthu chen rnams la bsngo'o 'bul lo/ bzhes la rnal 'byor ba bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyis sa brko ba/ rdo slog pa/ shing gcod pa/ me 'bud pa/ dur 'debs pa la/ ma rungs pa dang phrag dog ma byed ku re rgyal kha rtsod par thugs zhi ba dang byang chub kyi sems dang ldan par gyur cig bdag gis bsam pas stobs dang ni/ zhes sogs brjod la/ rdu/ nga ni pad+ma 'byung gnas sprul ba'i sku//mngal gyis ma gos mtsho skyes rdo rje'i sku//skye 'chi gnyis spangs rdo rje thod phreng rtsal//gzi brjid sku yis srid gsum zil gyis gnon//drag po'i stobs kyis khams gsum dbang du bsdus//gtum rngams thugs kyis sde brgyad dam la btags//mtsho skyes rdo rje sku la phyag 'tshal lo//lus ni yi dam lha yi rdzong //ngag ni ting 'dzin sngags kyi rdzong //yid ni chos nyid 'od gsal rdzong / /khyod lha 'dre rtog pa'i 'jigs pa med//bar snang yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor na/ /lha srin sde brgyad shod yang rgod/ /shod yang shod la yengs te yengs//dngos med sems nyid stong ba la//lha yang med la 'dre yang med//nga la cho 'phrul ci bstan yang //nyam nga sdug bsngal tsam pa yin//mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya che 'di//phyag rgya'i pham rgyal rtsod pa med//bden pa'i tshig gis grol te bsngo/ /'di bzhes gshin po'i dur 'debs kyis/ /sa gnas so so'i gzhi bdag gsol//sa gzhi bkra shis ༷dzad du gsol//rnal 'byor bdag gi

sdongs grogs mdzod//yon bdag rnams kyi bsam pa 'grub//rmongs gzhi thod gzhi lha 'dre rnams//bka' dang dam las ma 'da' zhig /de ring lha yi nyi ma la//nyi ma thams cad dge ba yin//rgyu skar thams cad bzang bo yin//sangs rgyas thams cad rdzu 'phrul che/ /dgra bcom thams cad zag pa zad//mkha' 'gro chos skyong mthu stobs che//lha 'dre thams cad brtsigs pa mgyogs//mtho ba srid pa'i rtse mo man chad dang //dma' ba dmyal khams yan chad kyis//stong gsum mi mjed 'jig rten gyi//lha srin sde brgyad ma lus pa//dbang du bsdus la zil gyis gnon//gser skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la//gshin dur 'debs pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod//rnal 'byor bdag gi bka' ma gcog/snang srid lha 'dre thams cad dang //yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad kyis//gsor skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la//yul la nga yul ma zer cig/sa la nga sa ma zer cig /chu la nga chu ma zer cig/rdo la nga rdo ma zer cig /shing la nga shing ma zer cig/mchod sbyin gtor ma 'di bzhes la//gshin po'i dur gyis sa gnas zhu/ /rnal 'byor bdag gi sdongs grogs mdzod//sa gzhi bkra shis mdzad du gsol//lho rgyal 'dzam bu'i gling gi gzhi bdag rnams//'dzam gling bstan ma bcu gnyis dang //bod khams skyong ba'i srung ma rnams//gser skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la//gshin dur 'debs pa'i sa gnas zhu//sa gzhi bkra gis mdzad du gsol//rnal 'byor bdag gi sdongs grogs mdzod//yon bdag rnams kyi bsam pa sgrubs//shar stag sdu bo lam gyi lha//sto 'brug sngon mo chu yi

lha//nub kyi bya dmar gangs kyi lha//byang gi sbal ba nags kyi lha//sa bdag stong khyab rgyal po dang //sbar kha sme bar gnas pa'i tshogs//gser skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la//dur sa 'debs pa'i gnas yang zhu//sa gzhi bkra shis mdzad du gsol//rnal 'byor bdag gi sdongs grogs mdzod//yon bdag 'di yi kha 'dzin mdzod// phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad steng 'og sogs//so sor gnas pa'i mnga' bdag dang //de ring nyi ma 'di la dbang che bas//do nub rgyu skar 'di la rtsis zhib pa'i//dus tshod 'di la dbang ba'i bdag/snang srid lha 'dre khyed rnams kyi//gser skyems mchod gtor 'di bzhes la//sa la ser sna ma byed cig /rung nga phrag dog ma mdzad par//sa gzhi bkra shis mdzad du gsol//rnal 'byor bdag gi sdongs grogs mdzod//yon bdag rnams kyi bsam pa sgrubs//sa bdag lha klu'i dngos grub stsol//༄ //oṃ badz+ra pā ni rgyu phaṭaḥ ———bgasang bdag gi gzungs/ —————————

sa bdag klu gnyan gyi bsang mchod/༄snyo //rgyuḥ/bla ma mchog gsum thugs rje'i bden pa dang //rten 'brel bslu ba med pa'i nus mthu yis//mchod rdzas nam mkha' mdzod du rab spel zhing //'gro rnams dgyes par spyod pas tshim gyur cig/yul 'di'i nyin srib sa rdo ri brag shing //so sor gnas pa'i lha klu gnyan dang btsan//sde ba 'byung bo spyi dang bye brag kun//gdug pa'i sems srong phan pa'i 'phrin las sgrubs//spyan ras gzigs dbang zhi khro'i byin mthu yis//'gro kun 'phral yun sdug bsngal las grol te//gnas skabs mthar thug bde skyid snang ba yis//rtag par spyod pa'i dge mtshan rgyas gyur cig/ces pa 'di ni sbyin bdag tār nor nas bskul ngor/rong bo chos sde'i sprul ming ba blo bzang 'phrin las kyis sbyar ba dza ya /

'go ba'i lha lnga rlung rta nor lug bsang gcan gzan kha chings bcas kyi bsang bsdus nor bu'i phreng ba/ga //kye//khyad par bdag la 'go ba'i dam tshig can//pho lha dgra lha phrag lha srog lha dang //pha lha ma lha zhang lha grogs kyi lha//yul lha le'u'i lha dang byes ba'i lha//yul 'di'i gzhi bdag gnas bdag dkor srung sogs//srung skyob dngos grub ster ba'i lha rnams la/ /'dod dgu phun tshogs bsang gi mchod pa 'bul//mthu stobs dpung shugs dbu 'phang dgung ltar bstod//kha 'dzin sdongs grogs 'dod don lhun 'grub mdzod/ / rlung rtabasdus pa/oṃ su sti pra tshwa rtse//bslu med gtan gyi skyabs gnas mchog /dkon mchog gsum dang khyad par du//zhing khams rgya mtsho rgyal ba kun//bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs//bsod nams mchod yul dam pa la//ka shi ka yi cod pan 'bul//rgyu sbyor yon bdag 'khor bcas la//tshe ring dpal bskyed rlung rta dar//stobs 'byor longs spyod mnga' thang 'khor//dbyar gyi rgya mtsho 'byung ba bzhin//gong nas gong du rgyas gyur cig /gnas skabs nyer 'tshe'i sems ldan pa'i//dgra dang bgegs kyi bar chad kyis//nam yang tshugs par ma gyur cig/mthun pa'i rkyen rnams tshang bar shog /stag seng khyung 'brug 'dir yar bskyed//kun ci'adus sarba 'du 'du hoḥzhes pa 'di'aX zahoragyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshos

sbyar ba'o/ /spar ze'i bsang bsdus bzhugs/lo bla zhag dus spar sme gza' skar dang //'byung lnga snod bcud phyogs su gnas dang rgyu//gtsug lag srid pa rgyud kyi lha rnams kun//gsol lo mchod do zhi dang dge legs stsol//mi mapas so///rta bsang bsdus pa/ kye/ rta lha'i rgyal po ar+ya reman+ta//shel rmog gser khrab gsol zhing rta sngon bcibs//rang 'dra lnga brgya'i 'khor tshogs bcas pa rnams//'dir gshegs bsang mchod dam pa 'di bzhes la//rkang bzhi'i rta rnams 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod//rta lha khyed rnams bsang ba'i yon tan gyis//rta nad 'tshe bcu bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/dam chag med kyis mdzad pa'o// / be+e/ nor lha'i rgyal po gnod sbyin dzam lha la//nor lha pho dgu mo dgu 'khor dang bcas//rnam sras rigs lnga lha mo nor rgyun ma//gzhan yang nor la 'go zhing skyob mdzad pa'i//nor skyong bye ba 'bum gyi tshogs bcas la//gtsang sbyar bsang mchod dam pa phul pa yis//rtag canor phyugs 'phel zhing rgyas pa dang //nor la 'tshe ba'i nad yams mtha' dag kun//kun nas zhi zhing bkra shis bde legs stsol/zhesapa'ang thub bstan chos kyi rdo rjes so// /lug bsang bkus pa/ lug lha'i rgyal po gnod sbyin gang ba bzang //gser mdog gser khrab gsol zhing rta sngon chibs//phyag na zag med gter gyi bum pa 'dzin//'dir gshegs g.yu shug bsang gi dud pas bsang //dkar mo'i lug rnams 'phel ba'i dngos grub stsol//lug nad thams cad bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /lug bsanga'adi yang ra ga mgyes mdzadapa ༷ge'o// sgyugacan gzan kha chings bsus pa/

༄ //thabs mkhas thugs rje'i shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing //gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa//gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku//shākya'i rgyal po de la phyag 'tshal lo/ston pa shākya thub pa'i mtshan/

dgra lha bcu gsum bsdus pa/༄'i //bswo/legs ldan dgra bla'i dmag tshogs rnams//dar mdung sbyor la dung skad sgrogs//lha dmag gnyan dmag mgon dmag gsum//lha mgon dgra bla'i drang mkhan drug /nor lha grogs lha zas lha dgu/tshong lha mgron lha lam lha dang //srog lha dkar dang bcu gsum srid//btsan pa'i go khrab lus la gyon//rno ba'i mtshon cha lag tu thogs/ /mgyogs pa'i rta pho chibs su bcibs/ /'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams la//bdud rtsi bsang gi mchod pa 'bul//chos skyong dgra bla khyed rnams kyis//dgra dang zin du ma nor bar//dgra yi dmag mi stobs kyis sgrol/ /dgra bla zung la nor g.yang khug /bdag cag rnal 'byor 'khor bcas la/ /dmag la 'gro na dmag dpon mdzod//jag lha mgron lha lam lha dang //tshong la 'gro na tshong lha gyis/ /phar la 'gro na skyel ma mdzod/ /zas lha grogs lha nor lha dang //tshur la 'ong ba'i bsu ma mdzod//tshe lha srog lha khyim lha dang //gzhi la 'dug na kha 'dzin mdzod//mi nor chos gsum 'phel ba dang //dkar bo dge ba'i sdo ngas grogs mdzod//rmongs sdug dbul gsum med pa dang //dgra 'dre gdon gsum brlag pa ra mdzod//bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod/ rā bsagyes ma dzadapa'o/

lam lha'i bsang bkra shis don grub/༄rna //oṃ āḥrgyu/ rjes spyod la sogs phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang //khro bcu phyogs skyong bcu dang phyogs kyi lha/ /bkra shis don grub rgyal bar mdzad rnams dang //spar sme gza' skar lo zla zhag dus lha//bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong tshogs//dgra bla wer ma thugs dkar bang se dang //sna tshogs las dang dus dang phyogs so so'i//lam lha gnyan po 'khor dang bcas pa dang //rnal 'byor bdag gi rigs rgyud srung ma dngan/'go ba'i lha mgon yul ri'i zo dor bcas/ /khyad par gar 'gro'i phyogs kyi sangs rgyas dang //rgyal sras sems dpa' bkra shis lha mo'i tshogs//srid pa'i lha chen gnas yul dus kyi lha//sngon bsu rjes skyel sdongs grogs mdzad rnams la//dri zhim bdud rtsi bsang gi mchod pa'i sprin//kun bzang rnam rol bde ba chen pos mchod//bdag cag phyogs su don gnyer 'gro ba la//bar chad 'tshe ba gang yang mi 'byung zhing //ji sbyo/ dro // sdu/ /na kun yid bzhin 'grub//bkra shis bde legs phun sum ces pa 'di yang rdzogs chen mchog sprularin po che'i lha rdzas dang bcas te bkas bskul ba bzhin mi pham rnamaparargyal bsabakod pa/

glog sgron smon lam/nyi zla'i 'od ltar gsal la mun sel zhing 'tshig pa'i dri dang du ba'i bsdogs pa med/gtsang zhing yid 'ong glog gi sgron me 'di/rgyal ba sras dang bcas la gus pas 'bul/stong gsal chos dbyings mkha' las byung ba yis/dngas gsal ma 'dres ye shes 'od 'bar ba /lta/ /jordo /// /bye//// 31( :re/nga 'a da 'phrul sa bkugs pa ga da 'a sa/ma rig 'khor ba'i rtsa ba gzhom gyar cig/cuces glog bzo'i sgron me 'bul byed smon tshig cig dgos tshul dge slong shes rab rgya mtshos yang yang bskul ba ltar gung thung bstan pa'i dbang phyug ca'abod pasabrisapa'o/(

gnyis pa/ rlung rta/rlung rta'i bsang mchod/༄byu / /kyeḥ ma su sti pradzha rtse/ /bslu med gtan gyi skyabs gnas mchog /dkon mchog gsum dang khyad par du//zhing khams rgya mtsho rgyal ba kun//bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro'i tshogs//bsod nams mchod yul dam pa la//ka shu ka yi cod pan 'bul/ /rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi/ /tshe ring dpal bskyed rlung rta dar//stobs 'byor longs spyod dbang thang 'khor//dbyar gyi rgya mtsho 'byung ba bzhin/ /gong nas gong du rgyas gyur cig /gnas skabs nyer 'tshe sems ldan pa'i//dgra dang bgegs kyi bar chad kyis//nam yang tshugs par ma gyur cig /mthun pa'i rkyen rnams tshang bar shog /stag seng khyung 'brug 'dir yarabaskyed/ /kun 'dus sarba 'du 'du ho/ / zhes pa 'di'ang za hor gyi ban+de ngag dbang blo bzang rgya mtshosasbyar ba'o/ rgyuḥ /bla ma sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang //yi dam zhi khro myur mdzad mgon po dang //drag shad chos rgyal gshin rje'i dmag tshogs dang //dmag zor gur rgyal rnam sras lcam sring sogs//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu gzhi bdag la/ /bsang mchod 'di 'bul dbang thang // ṭ+wāṃ zlo//'i//tāḥ/ spra /spra shā/sa zla ba yar ngo bzhin/ /bsam pa'i don ci cedro pa 'diyang blobazangachos kyirgyal ma dron gyisasbyar ba'o/

rlung rta'i bsang mchod 'bul tshul/ga //oṃ sa / he nye rdzu 'phrul mthu ldan rta mchog rin po che//sbyin pa'i bdag po'i rlung rta yar la bskyed/ /myur mgyogs che ba'i rlung rta yar la bskyed//srog lus dbang thang tshe dang bsod nams bskyed//rta dang stag seng khyung 'brug 'dir yar bskyed//kun 'dus sarba 'du 'du hoḥ badz+ra.ā yu khegahā//lha he thams cad zil gnon bya khyung ga ru ṭa//yon tan ldan pa'i rlung rta yar la bskyed//tshe srog lus dang dbang thang rgyas pa dang //bsam pa'i don kun myur du 'grub par mdzod//kun 'dus sarba 'du 'du hoḥ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā/ /nye nye stobs dang ldan pa'i gdong lnga'i dbang bo ni/ /rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi//gzi brjid che ba'i rlung rta yar la bskyed//srog lus dbang thang gong nas gong du bskyed//kun 'dus sarba 'du 'du hoḥbadz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā//he he ngar skad dang ldan g.yu 'brug sngon mo yis//snyan grags che ba'i rlung rta yar la bskyed/ /tshe srog lus dang dbang thang rgyas pa dang //mi nor zas gsum dbang du bsdu bar mdzod/ /kun 'dus sarba 'du 'du hoḥ badz+ra ā yu ṣe swā hā//he nye dpa' rtsal ldan pa'i rgya stag khra bo yis/ /dpa' snying che ba'i rlung rta yar la bskyed//srog lus dbang thang tshe bsod rgyas pa dang / /bsam pa'i don kun yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod//kun 'dus snyo

sarba 'du 'du hoḥ badz+ra āyu ṣe swā hā//zhes pa 'di ni dad stobs kyis mngon par 'phags pa'i mtsho sngon po'i dpon po mer gan jo nang ngasag sgrol maskyabs kyis bskul ba'i ngor/shākya'i dge slong blo bzang dpal ldan ye shes kyis sbyar ba'o//ri ༄༅/ /oṃ a ra pa tsa najuḥ tsho ci /tsho'ajam pa'i dbyangs kyi gzungs/ ri

rlung rta bskyed chog༄ //oṃ rmad byung byin rlabs dngos grub char bzhin du//stsol mdzad bla ma yi dam mchog gsum dang //dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bstan srung tshogs rnams kyis//rnal 'byor bdag gi rlung rta yar la bskyed//gang gis mthu las nag po'i dpung 'joms shing //dkar bo'i phyogs rgyal bsam don yid bzhin du//'grub pa'i ba dan srid rtser bstengs pa yis//rnal 'byor bdag gi rlung rta yar la bskyed//stag ltar 'phyo ba'i rlung rta yar la bskyed//seng ltar ngar ba'i rlung rta yar la bskyed//'brug ltar ldir ba'i rlung rta yar la bskyed//khyung ltar lding ba'i rlung rta yar la bskyed//sna tshogs bsang rdzas bsregs pa'i dud sprin 'khrigs//rlung rta'i dar rtsog srid rtser bsgrengs pa yis//gnas skabs rlung rta rgud pa'i skyon bral te//lhun po'i spo bzhin rlung rta yar la bskyed//rlung rta yar la bskyed pa'i rten 'brel la//brten gnas 'gro 'dug spyod lam smra brjod sogs//ci byas lam du 'gro ba'i 'od snang gis/ /yid 'ong pad+ma'i ze'u 'bru bzhad par shog/stag seng khyung 'brug bzhi dang 'grogs pa yi//rlung rta'i dge mtshan phul du byung ba yis//bdag cag nyin mtshan kun tu skyob mdzad cing //mi mthun dgra sde brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//de ltar rlung rta bskyed pa'i dge mtshan la//brten nas bdag gi srog lus dbang thang dang //kha rje rlung rta 03

༄ //bslu med dkon mchog gsum gyi ngo bo nyid//ngan song 'jigs las sgrol ba'i dpa' bo ste/ /dag pa'i zhing du bgrod pa'i ded dpon mchog/mgon po 'od dpag med la gsol ba 'debs/mgon po 'od dpag med kyi mtshan/

gsum pa/ 'ju lag chu rgyud kyi gzhi bdag gi bsang brngon/'ju lag mthon po bcu gsum gyi bsang brngon/༄byu //bslu med skyabs gnas mchog gsum la/ /mi phyed dad pas gus btud nas/ /yul dang bstun nas bsang mchod ni//gzhan dag bzhin du 'dir 'god bya/ /zhes thog marashug pa stag pa/ mkhan pa sogs bsang shing du 'os pa'i rdzas rnams kyis dud chen btang /phyemar zas phud gser skyems spyan gzigs sogs gang mdzes subashamasal chab bran/yi shegasu ma dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/ kyeḥ rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam dkyil 'khor tshogs/ /mkha' 'gro chos skyong snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs//khyad par 'ju lag jag rong sa phyogs kyi//lha klu gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa kun//thogs pa med par gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang //rang rang 'dod pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol//dngos bshams yid kyis sprul ba las byung ba'i//mthun pa'i dam rdzas dpag tu med pa dang //gser bzang 'bar 'dra'i me nang dri bzang shing //bsregs pa'i dud pa mkha' klong la 'dren zhing //rig 'dzin rtsa

ba brgyud pa'i bla ma bsang / /bgrang yas zhi khro dkyil 'khor tshogs rnams bsang //dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma bsang //snang srid lha srin sde brgyad thams cad bsang / /mes lha gangs dkar mgon po gdong dmar dang //gnam mas bya dur khra leb ra rgod dang //stag btsan phyor 'dzong dmar mtho skya ka ri//lhun po'i rtse dang rab bzang klu ri ste//'ju lag mthon po bcu gsum zhes grags par//gnas pa'i lha klu gzhi bdag 'khor bcas bsang //gzhan yang zho lung 'bru gu'i brag dkar dngan/cog tse thang gi phyogs la gnas pa yi//lha klu gzhi bdag ma lus thams cad bsang //ka drod ri brag mtsho dang bcas pa la//gnas pa'i yul lha gzhi bdag ma lus bsang /jag rong stod smad bar gsum sa phyogs kyi//lha klu 'byung bo gzhi bdag thams cad bsang //de ltar bsang mchod dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i mi phyuṭa thams cad la//nad gdon dbul phongs kha smras 'thab rtsod sogs// kun zhi legs tshogs lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod//khyad par grub dbang pad+ma dang bcas kyi/ /rnam 'phul rgyal ba gnyis pa tsong kha pa'i//lung dang rtogs pa'i bstan pa de 'dzin bcas/ /yar ngo'i bsil zer can la 'gran par mdzod//bye brag bkra shis dar rgyas gling 'di ru//bslab gsum ldan pa'i tshogs kyis rab bkang nas//'chad nyan bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po//gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod//gtsug lag khang dang gnas mal yo byad sogs//'bad rtsol med par lhun gyis 'gruX /༷༷ mdzod//mi mthun nyer 'tshe thams

cad rab zhi nas//phun tshogs dpal 'byor thams cad 'phel bar mdzod//srid zhu bgyis pa'i sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams//mi nor yongs la dgra jag kun gsum dang //me chu gdug pa can gyi gcan gzan sogs//mi 'dod nyer 'tshe mtha' dag yongs zhi zhing //tshe dang bsod nams stobs 'byor mnga' thang rgyas//rigs rgyud dar zhing lhag bsam rnam dag gis/ rtag cadam pa'i chos la gzhol ba dang /'dod don mtha' dag lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod///rdo ཿ/ rjo/sa bya kā/da la mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par bsam zhing /zhes dpa' ris phyogs kyi yul lha rnams la bsang mchod cig dgos zhes/phyogs 'di'i don gnyer can rnams kyis bskul ba ltar/ btsun pa puḥ'i ming can te btsun pa//da nams rgya mtshos gzhan gyi ngag sbyor ltar g.yar zal du bgyis pa bkra shis par gyur ༄ //na mo bu d+dha ya/na mo dharma ya/ na mo sa gha ya/ ridakon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo ri
