yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum la bsang brngon gtong tshul dregs pa dgyes pa'i mchod sprin/༄byu //rgyal kun gsang ba gcig bsdus rdo rje 'dzin//grub pa'i gtsug rgyan pad+ma thod phreng rtsal//dri med bstan pa'i mnga' bdag tsong kha pa//dbyer med zhabs la spyi bos phyag byas te/ /gangs can mdo smad byang phyogs kyi/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i srung ma che//'ju lag mthon po bcu gsum gyi//bsang brngon cho ga 'khyer bde 'god//de la gzhi ma dkar bo'i steng du 'bru zan gtsang ma las gtor ma bang rim bzhi ba/ steng gidabus su dkar gtor gcig dang / mtshams bzhir lcogs kyi tshul gyi dkar gtor bzhi/ phyogasabazhir gnyisaganyisate bcu gsum dang de dag gi bar rnams ril busabakang ba/ de'i'og gi bang rim la rgyal srid sna bdun/bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs dang / bang rim gnyis par 'dod yon rnam lnga/ bza' bca' btung ba shing thog 'bru sogs dang /bangarim tha mar rtanor lug gsum/shārkyang ri dwags sogs srog chags gcan gzan ma yin pa 'i rigs rnams mar dkar ram zan las byas pa'am bris pa sogs gang 'byor dang / yang na bang rim rnams mar dang zan gyi ril bus byug pa gtams pa byas kyang rung /gzhan yang dkar gsum mngar gsum/ sha mar thud sogs zas sna/ phye mar gser sdomaX/na gzigs gang yod sogs bshams la/

skyabs sems dang lha'i rnal 'byorargyasabasdus cirigs skad cig dkrong bskyed lta bu sogs sngon du btang nas bsang dang dung skad btang la 'di ltar/ kyiḥ/rab dkar gangs ri'i phreng bas yongs bskor ba'i/ /bod yul mdo smad skyid pa'i sman ljongs kyi/ /byang phyogs nor 'dzin skyong ba'i dgra lha che//dge bsnyen mthon po bcu gsum dgongs su gsol//'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par gangs ri'i ljongs//bdag cag lha mi gang du gnas pa'i gzhir//bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel slad du/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba khyed rnams mchod par bya//lhag bsam dag pas tshul 'dir 'jug pa la//bla ma yi dam mchog gsum srung ma yis/ /'dod don phun sum tshogs pa'i byin rlabs stsol//dkar phyogs lha klus mngon shes thugs kyis skyongs//zhes brjod cing /mchod gtor rnams la chu gtsang gis bran la/chabadz+ra ma sbo tas bsangs/su bha was sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las mgron rnams kyi spyan sngar/ dngos bsham sa yid sprul gyis mchod pa rnams dga' bde byad par can bskyed pa'i 'dod dgu ma tshangab med pa'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa sa dang bar —snang gi khyon thams can rgyas par bkang ba'i nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin zad mi shes pa'abyung bar gyur cig uḥ: lan gsum/ oṃ sarba bad sogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs la bden stobs brjod/ mgron spyan 'dren pa ni/ rol mo gyer dbyangs dang bcas/cha dge bcu'i dpal gyis mdzes pa'i mdo smad yul//'ju lag klung 'gram nyin srib la brten pa'i//ri dbang mthon po bcu gsum zhes grags pa//dkar phyogs skyong blta ༷ sdong ngo mtshar cag/gangs dkar shel

gyi zur bud dgung du mtho//rdza ri dar dkar nyi zla'i rna rgyan can//g.ya' ri smug po na bun gos su rgyan//brag ri rin chen spungs 'dra brtan cing brjid//nags ri sna tshogs ljon pa'i rgyan gyis mdzes//spang ri dus bzhi'i tshon gyis rang mdangs gsal//la par brag dang nags tshal spang ljongs dang //'ga' zhig g.ya' spang 'dres pa'i ri bo ni/ /rtsa ba rab brtan 'dzin ma'i dkyil 'khor gnon//rtse mo 'od gsal lha yi grong khyer bsnyegs//phyi ru yul gyi skye 'gro du ma yis//bag phebs bde bar 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen 'dzoms//nang du bsod nams rang snang gzhal yas khang //snod bcud bkod pa'i khyad par phun sum tshogs//de lta'i gnas na dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gtso//mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs bsam mi khyab//nag phyogs 'joms la dpa' bo'i mthu rtsal can//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon bcu gsum ni//a skyes gangs dkar mgon po gdong dmar dang //gnam skas bya dur khra leb ra rgod dang //stag rtse phyor 'dzong dmar mtho skya ka ri//lhun po rtse dang rab bzang klu ri ste//'brog gnas mthon po bcu gsum zhes grags pa'i//dgra lha chen po khyed rnams spyan 'dren no//rang rang gnas nas sna tshogs rnam rol gyis/ /gsang yum blon dang bka' nyan las byed sogs/ /snang srid dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs dpag med pa//thogs med rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis gshegs su gsol//gzhan yang bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod kyis/ /rten mchod cho rigs brgyud dang 'brel ba yi//yul skyong dgra lha gzhi bdag mthu chen rnams//spyan

'dren 'dir byon mchod tshogs bzhes su gsol//sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang //dkyil 'khor bdag po rnams kyi bka' bzhin du//'dir gshegs mchod tshogs rgya mtsho 'di bzhes shing //'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/de nas brjod gtong ba ni/r+yā/gser ldan 'dzam gling yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor 'di/ /'bru bcud sman sna bsang shing sna tshogs dang / /skyes dang gnas dang smin dang longs spyod pa'i/ /dus kyi bskal ba bzang bo rgyun mi chad//de las gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yis//dkar gsum rgyan gyi gtor ma ri ltar spungs//bsang rdzas dri bzang du bas lha lam dkrigs//'dod dgu'i spyan gzigs dngos bshams yid sprul tshogs//bstan dang 'gro ba'i bsod nams legs tshogs rnams//rgyas pa'i mthun rkyen gang la rag las pa'i//yul skyong dgra lha chen po khyed rnams la//dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol//gling bzhi'i dbus na ri rgyal lhun po ste//rin chen las grub 'dod dgu'i 'byung gnas bzhin//bang rim bzhi ldan gtor ma ri rab tshul//sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin gyis brgyan pa 'dis//'ju lag yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag 'khor bcas brngan//lha klu dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad brngan//'di bzhes gang bcol 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrubs//mdog legs me tog dri zhim bdug pa'i spos//mun sel sgron me bde ster dri chab dang /ro brgya'i dpal bshos sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra /gdangs snyan sdo dgangs 'gyur ba sna tshogs kyis//'ju

lag yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag 'khor bcas brngan//lha klu dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad brngan//'di bzhes gang bcol 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrubs//mdzes shing yid 'phrog phyi nang gzugs kyi mchog/snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs bde ster byugs pa'i dri//zas mchog ro brgya 'jam mnyen reg bya sogs//dbang bo tshim byed 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas//'ju lag yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag 'khor bcas brngan//lha klu dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad brngan//'di bzhes gang bcol 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrubs//'jig rten 'di yi phun tshogs ma lus pa//dbang du byed pa'i rgyal srid sna bdun dang //phyogs kun dge legs mtshan ma rgyas byed pa'i//bkra shis rdzas rtags rin chen sna tshogs 'dis//'ju lag yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag 'khor bcas brngan//lha klu dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad brngan//'di bzhes gang bcol 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrubs//g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i go khrab mog /tshem bor sba kheb snying kheb sag thag dang //dpa' bo'i 'khor gsum rgyal ba'i ru mtshon sogs//rang srung yo byad sra brtan sna tshogs 'dis//'ju lag yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag 'khor bcas brngan//lha klu dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad brngan//'di bzhes gang bcol 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrubs//nag phyogs dgra sde thal bar brlag byed pa'i//mda' mdung charaX ni zhags pa me skyogs sogs//bsreg

bsnun 'ching ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs dang //sgro gshog ldan pa'i rno ngar 'bar ba 'dis//'ju lag yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag 'khor bcas brngan//lha klu dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad brngan//'di bzhes gang bcol 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrubs//sprin gyis shugs ldan cang shes rta mchog tshogs/ /'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin zhol mo g.yag rog dang //'ba' sgras g.yang ldan lha lug ra skyes sogs//'dod rgu 'byung ba'i g.yang phyugs sna tshogs 'dis//'ju lag yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag 'khor bcas brngan//lha klu dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad brngan//'di bzhes gang bcol 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrubs//mkha' lding bya rgod ngang ngur khrung khrung dang //rma bya ne tso ri skegs khu byug sogs/ /nam mkha'i rgyan gyur 'dab chags sna tshogs dang //skad snyan glu len byi'u sna tshogs 'dis//'ju lag yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag 'khor bcas brngan//lha klu dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad brngan//'di bzhes gang bcol 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrubs//gzhan yang chas gos bzhon pa phyag mtshan rgyan//sman rag bdud rtsi'i gtor ma gser skyems phud//bza' bca' tshogs kyi 'khor lo bsang mchod sogs//lha klu gzhi bdag dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas kyis//'ju lag yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag 'khor bcas brngan/ /lha klu dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad brngan//'di bsdos /di bcol 'phrin las tshul bzhin

sgrubs//'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i bsod nams kyi//rnam 'phrul rten 'byung sgyu ma'i mchod pa'i sprin//'dod dgu ci yang 'char ba'i ngo mtshar — gyis//snang ba kun dgar bsgyur byed ji snyed 'dis//'ju lag yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag 'khor bcas brngan//lha klu dregs pa sde brgyad thams cad brngan//'di bzhes gang bcol 'phrin las tshul bzhin sgrubs//sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i ched du brngan//sbyin bdag mnga' thang dar ba'i ched du brngan//mi mthun nyer 'tshe zhi ba'i ched du brngan//gang bcol 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i don du brngan//rgyags brngan bsangamachodaphulaga'adibazhesag/ganga'adodal bzhi'i 'phrin las ma lus pa//ma thogs g.yel med 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol//mtshams 'dir gzhi bdag gtor ma spyi ltar bsngo zhing 'phrin las bcol la/ ḍūkhu yul gyi lha klu 'byung bo khyed rnams kyis//'dod yon lnga ldan mchod gtor 'di bzhes la//sangs rgyas bstan bsrung dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod//'jig rten kun tu bde skyid 'phel bar mdzod//khyad par sa cha yul phyogs 'di nyid kyi//mi nad phyugs nad mu ge dmag 'khrug sogs//mi mthun nyes pa'i rkyen sogs kun zhi zhing //legs tshogs yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba mdzod//bye brag cayang dgon gnas dge 'dun sde//rnam dkar las kyi bya ba mtha' dag gi/bar chad nyer 'tshe ma lus yongs zhi nas//'chad nyan sgom dang sgrub pa'i bya ba rnams//yar ngo'i zla bzhin gong du 'phel ba sogs//legs rdogs ma lus lhun gyis 'grub par

mdzod/spyi sger gyi bsang dang gsol kha sogs kyang spro na 'dir bya/ skyukhyid ni bstod do snang srid mthu bo che/ /srid pa chags pa'i lha chen khyed rnams ni/ /sngon bsags bsod nams du ma'i dpal gyis mtho//dregs pa'i sde dpon chen po rnams la bstod//gtsang ris lha klu gnod spyin sde brgyad la//dbang bsgyur mngon shes rdzu 'phul mthu stobs kyis//bstan 'gro'i bde skyid spel zhing dgra bgegs 'joms//'jig rten skyong ba'i sde dpon rnams la bstod//sngon tshe g.yung drung bon gyis bsten pa'i tshe//'dre srin 'byung bo'i gdug pa tshar gcod cing //lha yi dmu dag mi yul zengs byed pa'i//ya rabs mi chos gtsang ma skyong la bstod//slob dpon chen po pad+ma kā rā yis//bka' btags phyag rgya gnyan pos dam bzhag tshe//mdo smad yul spu'i chos gzhi thams cad kyi//srung mar khas blangs dam can rnams la bstod//zung 'jug sgyu ma'i sku brnyes rdo rje 'dzin//sa rnying kurma'i mkhas grub du ma yis//thub bstan spel ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub mdzad pa'i//dam pa'i bka' srung chen po rnams la bstod//khyad par chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i//lugs bzang 'dzin pa'i bstan 'dzin du ma'i bka'//spyi bor mchod cing 'phrin las tshul bzhin du//bsgrub mdzad bstan bsrung chen po rnams la bstod//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i 'phrin las mi g.yel zhing //dag phyogs 'joms la mthu rtsal thogs med pa'i//snang srid 'di na mthon po bcu gsum zhes//snyan pa'i 'brug sgras phyogs kun khyab la bstod//lha yi sde dpon tshogs ni sku sna// dkar//yid 'ong lha klu sman ma'i

tshogs kyis bskor//dar gyi na bza' rin chen rgyan phreng can//nyer 'tshe zhi ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub la bstod/ /klu yi sde dpon gdengs ku'i cod pan can//sprin chen 'brug sgra sgrog cing char rgyun 'bebs//mi phyugs lo tog 'bru bcud spel zhing skyongs//'dod dgu'i dngos grub gang bsam stsol la bstod//'ga' zhig lha btsan dpa' gtum rnam 'gyur can//zhi drag ci yang ston pa'i rdzu 'phul gyis//snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs kun dbang du sdud//gang bsam 'dod don yid bzhin bsgrub la bstod//la lar gtum drag ma nges sna tshogs gzugs//drag shul mi bzad mtshon cha thog ltar spro//ya nga'i cho 'phrul gdug pa'i pho nya 'gyed//snang dgra rtsad nas gcod mdzad rnams la bstod/khyed rnams mchod gsol srung mar bsten pa rnams/rtag tu nag po'i g.yul las rnam rgyal zhing //dkar phyogs legs pa'i yon tan ma lus pa//rgyas mdzad dgra lha chen po rnams la bstod//gzhan yang skal ldan shing rta gnyis pa'i rgyun/ /'bab pa'i nyin srib kun tu gnas bcas shing //yul gyi mi nor sde bcas bsrung mdzad pa'i// 'brog gnas lha klu gnyan po kun la bstod/khyed rnams mthu stobs drag shul rtsal ldan dang //bka' nyan snang srid dregs pa'i grangs las 'das//zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las thogs med phyir//bstod cing 'dod don gsol 'di ma g.yel zhig /'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par gangs ri'i ljongs//mdo smad yul spu 'dir brten dgon grong 'brog/kun tu nad mug 'khrug rtsod nyer 'tshe zhi//4lo ༷kas bde skyid dga' ston dar bar

mdzod//phan bde rtsa lag bstan dang bstan 'dzin dang //dpon slob sde dang bcas pa thams cad la//gzhi lam byes gsum kun tu bar chad sol//mthun rkyen 'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /mi la na tsha ye 'brog zhi ba dang //phyugs la nad god gcan gzan gnod 'tshe srung //gnas la thog ser me chu'i 'jigs las skyobs//dgra la rgol tshe dgra lha'i dmag dpung bskyed//snyan grags mnga' thang rlung rta dgung ltar mtho//tshe dpal rigs rgyud chu bo'i rgyun bzhin ringan/'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas//bsod nams ri bo bzhin du brtan par mdzod/ /mdor na lha dang bla ma'i bka' bsgos bzhin//bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid spel ba'i don//bdag cag re ba'i yid kyis bcol pa yi/ /gang 'dod 'phrin las rnam bzhi bsgrub par mdzod//ces bstodacing 'phrin las bcol/yig brgya bzlas shing nongs pa bzod gsol bya ba sogs ni/ bdag cag sgo gsum bya spyod ma dag pas/ / dregs pa'i lha klu gnyan po khyed rnams kyi//thugs dang 'gal gyur nongs pa ci mchis pa brtse ba'i thugs rjes bzod par mdzad du gsol//dbyings rig rtsal gyis mkha' la chu 'dzin bzhin// dregs pa'i skur bzhengs dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams//ngo bo snang stong zung 'jug chos kyi dbyings/ /rnam pa rang rang dgyes pa'i gnas su gshegs//zhes gshegs gsol bya zhing shis pa brjod pa ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o// yulaskyong mthon po bcu gsum gyi/ /rgyags brngan 'bul tshul 'di bris pas//dge bas bstan daX 'a/ ba la//phan bde legs tshogs rgyas

gyur /༷ rgya/gas brngan gyi cho ga dregs pa dgyes pa'i mchod srin zhes bya ba 'di yang dad pa dang gtong ba'i nor gyis phyug pa'i sbyin bdag rdo rje nor bu zhes pas lha ngas bcas snga mo nas bskul cing nye char skyabs mgon khri zur rnam gnyis nas kyang lha rdzas re bcas dus 'dir nyer mkho snang bas cis kyang 'bri dgos tshul gyis gsung nan chen pos bskul ba'i /sdu/nga ༷tsu /sa pa sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi mas me stag cho 'phrul bla ba dang po'i tshes

ka drod kyi gsol kha bsdus pa/༄7//rdzobakra shis dge mtshan g.yas su 'khyil ba'i dbus//rab mdzes brag ri dkar bo gnas bcas pa'i//ka drod ces grags lha yi dge bsnyen che//rtse gcig dad pa'i yid kyis spyan 'dren no/ /'khor bcas 'dir gshegs dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs//ting 'dzin sngags kyi rol pa las byung ba'i//phyi nang gsang ba'i spyan gzigs mchod pa'i sprin//dpag med gang gi dal gyi rjes 'gro ba'i//'chi med lha yi lam kun yong gang zhing //ja chang bdud rtsi'i btung ba mtsho ltar 'khyil//dkar dmar bza' bca' lhun po lta bur spungs//sman spos bsregs pa'i dud pa sprin ltar g.yo//'dod yon mchod rdzas sna tshogs skar ltar bkram//mda' mdung ral gri'i go khrab bskang rdzas rigs//dam rdzas spyan gzigs ma tshang med pa 'di//dngos bshams yid kyis sprul te 'bul legs na//lha mchog khyed kyis brtse ba'i legs bzhes te//rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa la//lus dang grib ma bzhin du rab 'grogs nas//nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe mdzod//mi phyugs nad rims zhi zhing tshe bsod rgyas//khams gsum dbang bsdus dgra bgegs rdul du rlogs//mdor na rgyal sras phyag na pad+mo sogs//dngos brgyud bla ma'i bka' las ma 'da' zhig /yul 'dir bkra shis sda ༷/sa phun sum tshogs//mgron rnams

dkar bo'i chos la spyod pa dang //dge 'dun sde rnams bshad sgrub 'phel zhing rgyas//kun kyang bde zhing skyid pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ces pa'ang rnyarma badz+ra blo bzang bstan 'dzin chos kyi nyi mas gsungs so/tsho ga //dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che/ /bdag gi spyi bor byed bye'i ri/steng bzhugs la//bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste//sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub bstsal tu gsol/rje rin po che'i mtshan sngags/

ka drod kyi bsang mchod byin rlabs gter mdzod/spro //hriḥ ka drod mched dgu dung dkar spungs 'dra'i rdza//kha dog mu tig lta bur mtshar zhing mdzes//ga nas bltas kyang dkar phyogs skyong lha rnams//nga ro drag po'i phyogs ngan 'joms mdzad pa//ca co snyan pos bstan la gus bstod cing / /cha lugs zhi rgyas dbang gi dpa' chas spras//ja phud dkar gsum mchod pa 'di bzhes la//nya chu dang 'grogs ji bzhin dgra lha mdzod//ta thā ga ta'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin srungs//tha mal 'gro 'di bu bzhin skyong ba dang //da nas byang chub sems mchog bskyed mdzod la//na 'chi la sogs glo bur rkyen rnams sol//pa sangs gza' sogs steng gnod ma lus pa//pha rol bdud las rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan dang //ba dan dkar bo gyen du bsgreng mdzod la//ma lus bsam don 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//tsa ri lta bur brtan brjid lhun chags shing //tsha tsha 'phro ba'i gzi brjid dgra bo yi//dza lang dregs ldan dgra bgegs gang yin rnams//wa skyes lta bur sems mthar bskrad par mdzod/ /zhwa ser bstan la snang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams//za ma zhag dang lo zlar ma bzhag par//'a 'ur phaṭaḥ rbad drag pos spa bkong la//ya mtshan cho 'phrul du mas brlag par mdzod/ /ra lug gnag rta la sogs nor phyugs la//la lung nyul nas glags //sdo gcan gzan dang //sha za gnod

༄byu //mya ngan 'das zhi bde ba'i mchog brnyes pa//'gro ba'i dug gsum sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing / /'gro drug mgon dang dpal du gyur ba yi//mya ngan med mchog dpal la phyag 'tshal lo/sangs rgyas mya ngan med kyi mtshan/

ka drod kyi gsol kha dgos 'dod kun 'byung kho'i //cha gnas mchog bde chen ka drod gzhal yas nas//rtsa brgyud bla ma rnams dang yi dam lha//mkha' 'gro chos skyong rnams la gsol ba 'debs//las ngan rig sgrib 'dag par byin gyis rlobs//rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang //mchog dang thun mong dngos grub bstsal tu gsol kyiḥ/zhi ba'i nyams ldan yul lha ka drod ni/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas g.yon mda' gzhu bsnams//sku la go khrab zhabs la sag lham gsol/ /stag dong g.yas su gzig thubs rked la bcings//rta dkar sga srab gong ched can la bcibs/ /sprul ba ma nges ston la mchod par bgyis//mi dkar rta dkar g.yag dkar lug dkar dang //ba glang mdzo 'bri rnga mong bong bu dang //stag gzig dom dred 'phar spyang gcan gzan rigs//'brong dang rwa ba rkyang dang gtsod dang ni//rna ba rgo ba la sogs ri dwags bcas//sna tshogs bshams shing yid kyis sprul nas 'bul//bya rgod khyung sogs 'dab chags mkha' la lding //chu bya ngang ba khrung khrung rang sgra sgrog/khu byug gong mo co ku'i gsung snyan sgrog /sgra dbyangs snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs di ru ru//shing sna bsregs pa'i dud sprin nam mkhar khyab//dung dkar snyan po'i skad kyis khyed la 'bod//dbyar dus glog 'brug char sprin 'thib cing byon// /spyad la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul pa

ni//shing tog spos rigs sna tshogs bye mar dang //rin chen sna lnga 'bru sna dar sna'i rigs//dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bras chang rgyan chang dang //gar chang gser skyems sman phud bdud rtsi 'di//yan lag brgyad ldan chu sna'i chab bran nas/ /ro brgya zag med bdud rtsir bsgyur nas 'bul//bsang ngo gsol lo mchod do dgyes par mdzod// kyeḥ/lha khyed rtag tu gsol zhing mchod pa'i mthus//dgon gnas sde dang bcas pa gtsug lag khang //bdag cag rgyu sbyor sde dang bcas pa rnams//legs pa brgya sprod nyes pa stong las ba la//nad gdon chag che 'jigs pa kun las skyobs//bsam pa'i don 'grub rgyu nor rigs rgyud spel//rgyab kyi brten ma mdun gyi mkhar ba mdzod//phar 'gro skyel ma tshur 'ong bsu ba mdzod/ /mun pa'i sgron me lam 'phrang sgrol don mdzod/ /rtag tu gsol dang mchod cing sgrub pa'i mthus//'dod don las rnams rtag ca'agrub par mdzod/khyed la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus//bdag sogs gang du gnas pa'i sa phyogs der//nad dang dbul phongs 'thab rtsod zhi ba dang //chos dang bkra shis 'phel bar mdzad du gsol//cesalastong 'khor bsod nams rgya mtshos mdzad pa'i bsang yig dgos 'dod kun 'byung zhes bya ba 'di ni/lha lungastod kyi sgar du bzhugs pa'i dus su lha chen ka drod kyi zhaladangos su gzigs nas bsang mchod 'bul tshula'adi gsungs nas 'dir spel ba'o/

ka drod gsol mchod mdor bsdus dngos grub char 'bebs/༄rna //snang srid dag pa'i 'khor lor sdom mdzad pa'i//dpal mchog he ru ka yi pho brang che//phal ba'i snang ngor kun stug gor ma las//brtsegs pa'i rdza ri gnam la bsnyegs 'dra bar//gnas pa'i nyer bzhi'i gnas kyi mkha' 'gro dang //lha klu gnyan btsan mi min 'byung bo'i tshogs//khyad par dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu bo che/ /ka drod mched dgu yum sras bka' yi blon/ /dregs btsan sde brgyad dpung tshogs 'bum sde bcas//de ring bsang dang mchod pa'i mgron du byon//'ja' ltar bkra ba'i rtsi thog sna tshogs dang //lha shug su ru la sogs dri zhim shing //'bru drug zas sna dar zab la sogs pa//bsregs pa'i dud sprin mkha' la 'phyur ba dang //ro brgya ldan pa'i rgya ja'i btung ba dang //'bras chang rgun chang 'o zho la sogs pa//sngags dang ting 'dzin phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i//dngos bshams yid sprul mchod tshogs ji snyed pa//rtse gcig dad pa'i yid kyis 'bul lags na//ngoms med rol zhing dga' bdes tshim par mdzod/ /bdag cag rmongs pa'i dbang gis sgo gsum gyis//dgongs 'gal nyes pa ci byas bzod par gsol//lus dang grib ma bzhin du rab 'grogs nas//srung skyob 'phrin las g.yel ba med par mdzod//gza' dang rgyu skar btsan dang rgyal bsen dang //klu gnyan sa bdag 'byung bo'i gnod 'tshe —5

dang //sngon las 'phral rkyen ngan pa las byung ba'i//mi yi na tsha phyugs kyi god kha dang //kha mchu rtsod gleng thog ser shā 'od dang //jag kun gcan gzan gdug pa'i 'jigs pa sogs//'gal rkyen bar chad gang byung rdo tshan la//kha ba babs pa bzhin du zhi bar mdzod//tshe dang bsod nams stobs 'byor mnga' thang dngan/blo rig yon tan mtsho ltar rab rgyas shing //khab len rdo yis lcags bye 'dren pa bzhin//'dod pa'i dngos po dbang du 'du bar mdzod/ /rgyal bstan spyi dang mnyam med tsong kha pa'i//mdo sngags bstan la 'tshe ba'i bdud rigs dang //zhwa dkar can gyi rigs spyi'i phan bde la//gnod pa'i dgra ngan thal ba'i rdul du rlogs//mdor na khyed cag bsten cing mchod pa'i mi'i//'dod don legs tshogs yid bzhin 'grub pa dang //'byung ba snyoms spyang lo phyugs legs pa sogs//bde skyid dpal la rol pa'i dngos grub — —la/zhe/sa pa 'di yang rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa 'brug lo'i(1988〉hor zla bdun pa'i tshes mgor ka drod mtsho khar spro gseng du skyod skabs dor zhi skyes ming pas bris so/'dzam gling skyong ba spyi dang khyad par du/'ju lag yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum dang /stobs ldan dpal 'byor bom sngon gzi brjid 'phags/rma rgyal yum sras 'go ba'i lha lnga dang /dgra lha bcu gsum sdong / sde bzhi dang spyo

lo zla zhag dus bcas par dbang ba'i lha/kun kyang de ring bsang gi mgron du byon/bsang shā r+sha /rdo /ga 'di dag 'ja' ltar bkra ba zhes pa'i tshig gi gong der bcug na spyi ༄byu //rab 'byams rgyal kun 'dus pa'i ngo bo nyid//khyad par bcom ldan 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed//ngur smig 'chang ba'i gar mdzad rublo bzang grags//grub dbang rnam rol grags pa'i mgon la 'dud/rje stag chibs pa'i gzungs/

dkar phyogs skyong ba'i yul lha ka drod la rgyags brngan gtong tshul lha srung mnyes pa'i rol dbyangs/༄byu //bstan pa'i gtsug rgyan gu ru thod phreng rtsal//bstan don rgyud la 'beb mkhan ma ti sha//bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rgyal ba tsong kha pa/ /bstan 'gro'i skyabs mgon dbyer med gtsug bkur nas//'ju lag byang rgyud dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha//ka drod bsang brjod cho ga 'di ru 'god// ces mdo smad 'ju lag mthon po bcu gsum gyi byang rgyud/ stod tsa ri'i gnas bzhin du lhag tu grags skad che ba dang bla ma skyes chen dam pa mang bos zhabs kyis bcags shing byin gyis brlabs pa'i gnas khams can/dkar phyogs skyong ba'i yul lha ka drod la bsang brjod 'bul bar 'dod par/ thog mar gzhi dkar bo gtsang za byas shing dri bzang gis chag chag btab pa'am byugs pa'i steng du zan gtsang la bzang drug bsres te gtso gtor bang rim bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du/dbus su dkar gtor che ba gcig gi phyogs bzhir yang dkar gtor de las cung chung ba gnyis gnyis te brgyad dang /bang rim gsum par sde brgyad la dkar gtor brgyad dang / bang rim gnyis par bkra shis rtags brgyadadang 'dod yon rnam lnga sogs dang /bang rim 'og ma'i mtha'i mdun du g.yag lug ra gsum dang /spyan gzigs gang 'byor/de dag la 'chang 'theb ril bus rgyas par bskor la/ dkon mchog spyi gtor dang / srung ma'i spyi gtor/ gzhi bdagani////btsan dang klu bcas kyi gtor mdang /

yang / spro na rang nyid kyi yi dmasogs kyi sger gtor sogs kyang rgyas par bzhings pa'am ma 'byor na 'ang rung /mchod gtor rnams la rgyan ci mdzes kyis brgyan zhing /dkar gsum mngar gsum dang / phyemar zas phud/ 'bru sna dar sna/dar tshan snalnga/ bsang rdzas gang 'dzoms dang shing tog sman tog dug rigs ma yin pa'i me tog sna tshogs dang /chu gnyis nyer spyod kyi mchod pa rnams tshul bzhin du bsham la/gtsang zhing gtsang mar byin gyis rlabasapar chu gtsang gi chab kyisabran nas/rang nyid kyi skyabs sems rgyud 'dres nges tshad med bzhi sgoms/yi dam gang rigs kyi nga rgyal bskyed de/rol mo'i dbyangs dang bcas/ oṃ badz+ra a skṛ ta kun ṭa li ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ su bha wa shu sarba d+ma ma su bha wa shu rgyu/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du dngos bshams yid sprul gyi mchod gtor dang mchod rdzas rnams zag med kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur bar bsam la sarba bid ces nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags kyis byin gyis brlabs/spro na sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs la/bden stobs brjod/de ltar du gtor ma la chab bran nas/ oṃ lha'irgyu/lan gsum brjod mthar oṃ lha'ir+ghaṃ nas shasta'i bar mchod la/lha rnams spyan 'dren pa ni/ kyi dus gsum rtsa ba brgyud pa'i bla ma dang / /yi dam mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs nor lha gter bdag yul lha gzhi bdag rnams/ /'khor bcas ma lus gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la//cho rigs brgyud pa'i 'go ba'i lha srung rnams//da lta bdag gis mchod ༷༷ gnas 'di ru//dga' mgu dgyes

pa'i tshul gyis gshegs su gsol//rang snang bde ba'i snod kyi 'jig rten 'dir//zhi khro'i rnam 'gyur nges med sna tshogs kyis//bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i dkar phyogs kyi//lha klu sde brgyad tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol//dge bcu tshang ba'i gnas mchog yul spu 'dir//gnas pa'i dkar phyogs skyong ba'i srung ma che//zhi tshul bstan pa'i ka drod mched dgu'i tshogs//'khor bcas mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no//bod ljongs mdo smad 'ju lag byang phyogs kyi//mdun ri rgyab ri g.yas ri g.yon ri dang //ljon shing spang ljongs rdza brag ri klung sogs//ngo mtshar yid 'phrog rmad byung gnas mchog 'dir/ /ka drod ri brag rtse mo dgung la zug /rtsa ba rab brtan sa yi dkyil 'khor gnon//de ru rdzu 'phrul rta mchog rab dkar la//gser dngul sga srab gong rmed yob chen bcas//pā tra phra rgyan mdzes pas brgyan pa'i steng //zhi 'dzum ldan pa'i yul lha ka drod kyis/ /sku la khrab dkar rmog zhwa 'phru dmar mnabs/ /stag dong gzig shubs g.yas g.yon mda' gzhu bsnams//sku mched dgu la sogs pa 'khor bcas kyis//zhi dang khro tshul ma nges cir yang bstan//gcan gzan ri dwags 'dab chags tshogs mang bo//nam yang snga phyir 'khor gyis bskor nas 'byon//de 'dra'i ngo mtshar ldan pa'i lha tshogs rnams//ma lus mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no//gzhan yang yul 'di'i stod smad g.yas g.yon dang / / nyin srib phu mdo kun tu gnas pa yi//rang snang nyams dgar rol ba'i lha dang btsan//rdzu bdag klu gnyan sde brgyad dregs

tshogs rnams//kun kyang bsang mchod brten pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs//rnam dkar mos pas sngags dang ting 'dzin gyis//gus pas bsang dang mchod pa'i gnas 'di ru//sngon gyi dam bca' dgongs pa ji bzhin du//sprul ba'i gdan khri so sor bzhugs nas kyang //bcol ba'i 'phrin las bsgrub phyir dgyes par rol//pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/r+yā/lhun grub bde chen nam mkha'i klong yangs las//mchog gsum bden pa'i gzungs sngags zab mo'i mthu//'dod dgu cir yang 'char ba las byung ba'i//sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung rgyas par mdzod// gaṅga'i chu rgyun gtsang ma'i mchod yon dang //gdung ba kun sel bdud rtsi byugs pa'i dri//'dab rgyas rab mdzes dri zhim me tog tshogs//spos sna sna tshogs bsregs pa'i dud sprin dang //ji bcud dwangs ma'i sgron me brtse dga' spyod//yid 'ong bza' bca' gtsang ma'i zhal zas dang / /sna — tshogs rol mo snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas//dbang bo'i yul la dga' bde bskyed byed pa'i//'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga dang ni//ro brgya'i bcud ldan ja chang skyems kyi phud//mchog gsum srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag la//mos gus yid kyis 'bul lo bzhes su gsol//bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi//'dod pa'i re ba ma lus skongs gyur cig /ces mchod pa phulaba'i mthar bsang chen phul te/mchod gtor rnamasabyin gyis brlabs la/oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo rnyi sa twa shri dharma pā la sa pā ri wa ra e rda bha lo ta kha kha hi kha hi sogs lan gsum mam bdun gyis bsngol yang gong dzi /gang la ma nas shaga'i bar btags la

mchod/kyeḥ thugs rje bdag nyid rtsa ba'i bla ma dang //yi dam lha tshogs skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma bcas//gus pas bstod do mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ / ces bstod cing 'dod don zhu/slar yang brngan chas mchod gtor rnams ladamigs te/ oṃ lha'irdu lan gsum brjod cing / de rgya cher spel par mos te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ sa ra sa ra rgyu/lan gsum mam bdun/spro na lan bcu gsum mam nyer gcig gis bsngo zhinganade bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ da ni brngon gyer ba ni/kye/ phun tshogs kun gyi 'byung gnas thub bstan ni//kha ba'i ljongs su spel la mthu stobs kyi//'phrin las kun ca'ajug pa grub pa'i dbang //slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags//khong gis gangs chen grubapa sde brgyad du//lha klu dregs pa sde brgyad ma lus pa'i/ /tshogs la dbang bskur rdo rje tha tshig gis/ / rnam dag bstan pa'i srung mar bka' bsgo mdzad//mgon des phyi rabs rjes 'jug tshogs rnams la//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu mchod pa yi//tshul gyi rnam — grangs bstan 'gror bstan pa la/ /legs tshogs yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas pa dang / /sngon byon ya rabs dam pa'i srol rgyun la/ /bdag cag yon mchod 'khor dang bcas pa rnams/ /lha dang srung ma gsol zhing mchod pa yis//don rnams ma g.yel dgongs la gsan du gsol//'bul ba ni/ kyeḥ yid las skyes pa'i blang dor legs nyes las//'bras bu bzang ngan sna tshogs 'byung ba la//lha klu sde brgyad mchod cing bstod pa lasdu/—/bdag gzhan 'dod pa'i don

rnams lhun gyis 'grub/ /de phyir de ring gza' skar bzang bo 'di'i//tshes grangs dge legs mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa dang //dus kyi sbyor ba bzang bor bdag cag gis/ /rang gzhan 'dod don ma lus 'grub pa'i phyir//dkon mchog srid zhu'i mgron la mchod pa 'bul//mgon po yon tan mgrod la gtang rag gtong //gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong la 'phrin las bcol//gus pa'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/6 chos dbyangs rnam dag lhun gyis grub pa yi//rin chen snod yangs stong gsum mnyam pa'i steng //sngags dang ting 'dzin phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i//ri rab tshul du bzhengs pa'i gtor ma rnams//sna tshogs rgyan gyis mdzes par brgyan pa dang //gang bsam 'dod dgu 'jo ba'i mchod pa'i sprin//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i yul lha ka drod dang //de yi sku 'khor mched dgu'i spyod yul du//phul pas phral dang yun du bde ba ster//nam mkha' mdzod kyis sgo 'phar brgya bye zhing //'dod yon lnga ldan zag med mchod pa yis//ka drod mched dgu 'khor dang bcas pa brngan//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag thams cad brngan/ /skam sar skyes pa'i gro dang 'bras dkar dang //ma rmos lo tog nas dang so ba sogs//zas bcud ldan pa'i 'bru sna sna tshogs 'dis//ka drod mched dgu 'khor dang bcas pa brngan//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag thams cad brngan/ /shā dgo gna' gla la sogang ri shogs dang / /'phar spyang dom dred

gsa' sogs gcan gzan rigs//bya rgod go glag gong mo 'dab chags tshogs//ka drod mched dgu 'khor dang bcas pa brngan/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams brngan/ /yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag thams cad brngan/ /'bri yi mar gsar 'o ma zho dang ni/ /bu ram ka ra zang ma'i rtsi dang bcas//dkar gsum mngar gsum phye mar zas phud kyis//ka drod mched dgu 'khor dang bcas pa brngan//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams brngan/ /yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag thams cad brngan//mdzes pa'i gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra yi rigs/ /bdug spos dri dang ro brgya'i zas mchog dang / /srab 'jam gos sogs 'dod yon rnam pa lngas/ /ka drod mched dgu 'okhor dang bcas pa brngan//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag thams cad brngan//myur la mgyogs pa'i rta dang g.yag rog dang / /'o ma'i mdzod 'dzin 'bri dang g.yang mo lug /tshe tshe ra sogs g.yang phyugs mang bo yis//ka drod mched dgu 'khor dang bcas pa brngan//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag thams cad brngan//g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba'i go khrab rmog/rno ngar 'bar ba'i dgra 'joms mtshon cha'i rigs//phyogs las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon ba dan sogs/ /ka drod mched dgu 'khor dang bcas pa brngan//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag thams cad brngan//'khor lo nor bu btsun mo ltaX po dang / /stobs ldan myur mgyogs

glang chen rta mchog dang // dmag dpon la sogs rgyal srid sna bdun gyis//ka drod mched dgu 'khor dang bcas pa brngan//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag thams cad brngan//rin chen gdugs dkar gser nya bum pa dang / /pad+ma dung dkar dpal be'u bzhi bsnel dang / /rgyal mtshan 'khor lo bkra shis rtags brgyad 'dis/ /ka drod mched dgu 'khor dang bcas pa brngan//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag thams cad brngan//lha shing thug pa a gar stag pa dang //tsan dan dkar dmar ba li mkhan pa sogs//dri mchog ldan pa'i shing sna sna tshogs pas/ /ka drod mched dgu 'khor dang bcas pa brngan/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams brngan/ /yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag thams cad brngan//bzang bo drug dang ma nu spos dkar dang //pyi yang ku dang ga pa dra sogs//sman dang me tog dri zhim sna tshogs pas//ka drod mched dgu 'khor dang bcas pa brngan//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams brngan/ /yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag thams cad brngan/ /'bru yi nying bcud gtsang ma'i bdud rtsi chang / /bsil drod snyoms la zhim pa'i yungs dmar ja//btung ba'i skyems phud sna tshogs 'dzoms pa yis//ka drod mched dgu 'khor dang bcas pa brngan//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag thams cad brngan//me long zho dang dur ba bul ba dang //dung dkar g.yas 'gil sdi wang li khri dang /yungs dkar dang

bcas bkra shis rdzas brgyad kyis//ka drod mched dgu 'khor dang bcas pa brngan//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag thams cad brngan//bsil zhing zhim la yang zhing 'jam pa dang //dwangs la dri ma med cing mgrin par bde//ltor mi gnod pa'i yan lag brgyad ldan chab//ka drod mched dgu 'khor dang bcas pa brngan//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha yi tshogs rnams brngan//yul lha dgra lha gzhi bdag thams cad brngan//'dod dgu yongs su tshang ba'i bsang mchod 'di//sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba'i ched du 'bul//yul phyogs bde zhing skyid pa'i don du 'bul//mi mthun rkyen ngan bzlog pa'i ched du 'bul//sbyin bdag nyer 'tshe zhi ba'i ched du 'bul//rgyags brngan bsang mchod dam pa 'di bzhes la//ci bsam don kun 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol// ces brngon phul la gzhi bdag gtor ma spyi ltar bsngos/ kyiḥ/yul lha ka drod gtso dang 'khor rnams la//bsang dang mchod gtor gtsang ma phul pa yis//sangs rgyas bstan pa srungs la dgra bo sgrol//mi mthun nyer 'tshe ma lus zhi ba dang //mdo sngags bshad sgrub dar zhing rgyas par mdzod//khyad par sa cha yul phyogs 'di dag gi/dag phyogs pham ste dkar phyogs dar zhing rgyas/ /'brog la phyugs 'phel rong bar lo legs zhing / /btsa' than sad ser nor god bor stor chod//jag kun mi kha rtsod gleng dbul rgud sogs//ya nga'i mi mthun nyes skyon kun zhi zhing //dge legs yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas pa dang //dgos 'dod ma lu/ lalhun gyis 'grub par mdzod// ces

'phrin las bcol la/yang sgro na/spyi sger gyi bsang gsol dang /ja chang skyems rgyud kyi mchod pa dang / 'phrin bcolargyas pa sogs kyang 'dir bya/kyeḥ sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du//gangs can yul du bde skyid bskrun pa dang //khyad par sa cha yul phyogs 'di nyid kyi//sangs rgyas bstan srung lha chen khyed la bstod//dbu skra dkar la rgan po'i tshul 'dzin zhing //mda' gzhu bsnams pas dpa' bo'i chas spras pa//'dzum mdangs dkar mdzes gzhon nu'i nyams ldan pa//mdzad pa yongs su rdzogs pa khyed la bstod//'dzum bag ldan pas zhi ba'i tshul bstan cing //mya ngan bral ba'i rin chen 'khar ba rten//byang sems dkar ba ston pa'i thugs kho na//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha mchog khyed la bstod//skabs 'gar 'byung ba'i tshogs rnams 'khrugs pa'am//mi 'dod 'gal rkyen cho 'phrul bstan pa'i tshe//glog dmar thog rgod drag char phab dang lhan//khros pa'i tshul bstan khro gnyer bsdu la bstod//sku la khrab rmog zhabs la sag lham gyon//stag dong g.yas khur gzig thubs sked la bcings//g.yas g.yon mda' gzhu bsnams pas dpa' chas spras//phyi rol snang dgra ma lus bcom la bstod//chibs su rta mchog dkar bo 'brug 'dra la//gser sga dngul srab rin chen phra rgyan can/ /lcags kyi yob chen gong ched can la bcibs//myur mgyogs phyogs bcur skad cig slebs la bstod//g.yas su dmar mtho brag dkar lhun po dang //g.yon du g.yang rtse sham sto mdun stobs ldan//rgyab tu bom sngon a myes dge ༷༷༷ sogs//phyogs bcur yul lha mang

bos bskor la bstod//bde mchog lha mo dre'u dang seng gdong ma//rdo rje phag mo oṃ āḥskye la sogs//rang byung sku gsung gzugs ris gang mang bo ya mtshan can rnam mngon sum bzhugs la bstod//lha mo'i bla mtsho dang ni bde mchog dang //chos rgyal tshangs pa'i bla mtsho la sogs par//lha phug klu phug mang bo'i rdzu 'phrul gyis//dus chen tshes par glu gar ston la bstod//rdza rir gsa' la brag la 'phar chung dang //dgas su spyang ki spang la g.yi dkar dang //dom bu dred mong la sogs gcan gzan rigs//gzhi bdag sde brgyad 'khor du bkol la bstod//sha ba gla ba gna' dang rkyang dang gtsod//khu byug ne tso gong mo go bo rgod/ /ri dwags dang ni 'dab chags tshogs mang bo/ /lha gnyan chen po'i mtha' ru bskor la bstod//'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin 'bri dkar g.yang mo lug/rta dang mdzo dre'u bong bu rwa skyes sogs//dpal 'byor g.yang bcud rgyun chad med pa'i phyugs//nam yang ri lung thang ljongs bkang la bstod//gser dang dngul dang zangs lcags zha nye dang //pha lam cong zhi cu gang si ra//rin chen gter dang rtswa rtsi sman tog sogs//ci 'dod bang mdzod 'byung gnas khyed la bstod//khyad par o rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dang //a ti sha dang rgyal ba tsong kha pa//de bzhin dus gsum rgyud pa'i bla ma rnams//phyogs res bral ba'i bka' srung khyed la bstod//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha gnyan mthu rtsal can/khyed la bstod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus//bdag cag spyi dang khyad par sbyin bdag rnams//nad yams mi 'byung snaX dims bde ba dang //bgegs tshogs

mu ge kha mchu 'thab rtsod zhi//mi gtsang nyes pa'i mnol dang nyams grib sel//phyugs la g.yang chags gcan gzan gnod pa zhi//legs tshogs 'phel zhing bde skyid ldan par mdzod//yul phyogs 'dir gnas dgon dang dge 'dun sde//'phel zhing thugs mthun dbu 'phang dgung ltar mtho//bstan pa bsrung zhing 'gro ba'i mgon skyabs mdzod//gzhi lam byes gsum bar chad ma lus sol//mdor na mi mthun rkyen ngan thams cad bzlog /mthun rkyen sgrubs la dgos 'dod 'bad med stsol//yul la me chu 'byung ba'i 'jigs pa skyobs//snang dgra bzlog cing dgra lha'i dpung ba skyed//snyan grags rlung rta dar zhing mnga' thang rgyas/ /rigs brgyud 'phel zhing tshe bsod rgyas pa dang / /gang 'dod 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub par mdzod// ces bstod cing 'phrin las bcol/mtshams 'dir g.yang 'bod dang smon lam sogs kyang bya ba dang /gzhan 'phrin las rgyas pa spro na yang bcol 'os so/ yig brgya brjod/ bdag gi sgo gsum bya ba ma dag pas//yul lha gnyan po gtso dang 'khor rnams kyi/ /thugs la 'gal dang nongs pa ci mchis pa/ /brtse ba'i thugs kyis bzod par mdzad du gsol/ /dbyings rig rtsal gyis mkha' la chu 'dzin bzhin/ /zhi ba'i skur bzhengs dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs//ngo bo snang stong zung 'jug chos kyi dbyings//rnam pa rang rang dgyes pa'i gnas su gshegs/ badz+ra muḥ yig brgya brjod la/bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu zhi ba dang //mi mthun gnod pa'i rkyen dang bral ba dang //mthun par gyur cing sna/ snam tshogs gyur nas//bkra shis des

kyaX deng 'dir bde legs shog/ces sogs bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya //zhes dkar phyogs skyong ba'i yul lha ka drod la rgyags brngan gtong tshul lha srung mnyes pa'i rol dbyangs bya ba 'di yang yul phyogs 'di'i dad ldan rnam pas yang yang

yul lha'i sde dpon chen po dge bsnyen khra leb kyi gsol mchod rgyas pa dregs pa dgyes pa'i dbyangs snyan/ga / /dmigs med snying rje'i sprin chen 'khrigs klong nas/ /rmad byung 'phrin las char rgyun legs phab ste/ /'gro ba'i phan bde myu gu rgyas mdzad pa'i/ /bla ma mchog gsum zhabs la gus btud de//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu stobs dpal 'byor gyis//snang srid dregs pa'i khro rgyal mngon mtho ba//khra leb dge bsnyen chen po'i gsol mchod kyi//cho ga 'khyer bde yi ge'i lam du spel// de yang gzhi ma dkar bo'i steng du zan gtsang ma dkar gsum mngar gsum bsres pa'i rgyu las dkar gtor chebagacig dang /chung ba gnyis te gsum dang /gtor cog gcig bcas bzhi/ khra leb sgron yum bka' sdod dang bcas pa la 'bul rgyu thams cad mthar ril bus bskor ba dang /dkon mchog spyi la gtor ma/gzhi bdag spyi la'ang gcig bcas dang /gzhan yang phye mar gtsang ma/gser skyems zas sna mngar gsum gtso bor — gyur pa dang /shing tog sogs bza' bca' btung ba ci rigs dang /spyan gzigs go mtshon srog chags tshe thar 'bul rgyu so gas dang/mda' dar rnga sil dung sogs rolamo'i bye brag rnams dang /khyad par du bsang shing sna tshogs kyis bsang dud cher btang /skyabs — sems tshad med bzhi bsgom/lha'i rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus ci rigs sngon du btang ba'i rjes/skad cig dkrong bskyed sogs byasate/mchod gardor spyan gzigs rnams la chab gtsang mas

bran la/ma dgapa'i nyesaskyon sbyang bar mos te/masri tas bsangs/su bha lus sbyangs shing /stong ba'i ngangalas ma chodapa'i yobyadarnamasarang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba lasabyung ba'i mgron rnams la zag med kyi bde ba bskyed pa'i byed las dang ldan pa'i mchod rdzasaso so'i rnamapa khyad du'aphags pa nam mkha'i khams thams cad rgyas par 'geng ba'i mchod pa'isprin gyi phung bo chen por gyur/ oṃ ma skye lan gsum dang / sngags drug phyag brgya drug gi byin gyis brlabs te/ bden stobs brjod la snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcas te 'di skad do//kyeḥ /dge bcu'i lang tsho dar ba'i mdo smad kyi//nor 'dzin yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor mdzes pa'i rgyan/ /khra leb ces su grags pa'i sa 'dzin la//gnas pa'i yul lha'i rgyal po dgongs su gsol//rtsa ba rab brtan gser gyi gzhi la gnas//rtse mo mtho ba dgung sngon dbyings su bsnyegs//'od gsal nyi zla nor bu'i cod pan 'ching //rtag tu na bun sked 'ching bcings grol byed//dag byed chu bo'i rgyun bzang phyogs brgyar 'bab//rtsi shing dgas tshal sman sna'i dga' tshal rgyas/ /'dab chags ri dwags mi phyugs du ma'i rten/ /snod bcud khyad par 'phags pa'i sa 'dzin na/ /sngon bsags bsod nams rgyu las legs grub pa'i/ /rang snang bde dga' rgyas pa'i pho brang ni/ / nor bu'i 'od 'bar rin chen dra ba 'phyang //lhab lhub ba dan gser gyi rgyal mtshan can//phun tshogs yon tan 'dod dgu longs spyod tshogs//nam mkha' mdzod du bsnyil ba'i gnas mchog na//snang srid dregs pa kun la bsod nams kyi//rtsibs stong ༷༷/ gyi 'khor los dbang sgyur ba//

yul lha'i rgyal po chen po khra leb ces//grags pa'i 'brug sgra phyogs brgyar sgrog pa khyed/ /bdag cag mi nor 'khor bcas thams cad kyi/ /bar chad zhi zhing gang bsam 'dod pa'i don//'grub pa'i re ltos dad pa'i gdung thugs kyis//spyan 'dren gnas 'dir dgyes bzhin 'byon par mdzod//dgyes 'dzum zhal gyi dkyil 'khor zla ba bzhin//sna tshogs dar gyi na bza' 'ja' tshon bzhin//rin chen rgyan phreng rgyu dkar do shal bzhin//dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs na bun 'thib bzhin byon//bka' gnyan blon po'i 'khor tshogs khrigs se khrigs//lha klu sman ma'i dbyangs snyan lhangs se lhangs/ /dgra 'joms dpa' bo'i ru mtshon zangs se zangs//dgra lha'i dpung tshogs 'khor bzhin gshegs su gsol//gnas 'dir rin chen khang bzang brtan pa'i khri//mkho dgu'i longs spyod sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin//mdzes pa'i spyan gzigs yid mthun lha mi'i 'khor//phun tshogs 'byor bas dgyes bzhin bzhugs su gsol//rgyal kun ngo bo mtsho skyes rdo rje dngan/'jam dpal snying bo phyag na pad dkar 'chang //yab sras rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bla ma yi//bka' bzhin bdag cag srung skyob ma g.yel zhig ces spyan drangs shing / de nas mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ kyeḥ dngos bshams yid sprul mchod yon gtsang ma'i rgyun/ /chu skyes thang skyes me tog 'dab brgya bzhad//bsang shingaspos kyi dud sprin mkha' lam khyab//'od 'bar sgron mes phyogs bcu'i mun pa sel/ /dri bzang thug pas lus sems dga' bde bskyed//lha mi'i zhal zas bzaX bsdong sna tshogs dang //gdangs snyan

rol mo'i bye brag kun gyis mchod//gzugs mdzes lang tshos yid kyi brtan pa 'phrog /gdangs snyan glu dbyangs rna ba'i dpyid du 'jo/ /lhan skyes dri yis dbang bo'i kun dga' bskyed/ /ro brgya'i dpal ster 'chi med bdud rtsi dang //bde ster 'jam mnyen gos kyi reg bya sogs//'dod pa'i yon tan kun tshang mchod pa'i sprin//sa dang bar snang nam mkha' gang sprul te//lha yi rgyal po 'khor bcas mchod par bgyis//o hākhrirgyu/ oṃ sarba bid byu ra gu ra su ra su ra/ /a warta ya a warta ya hoḥbadz+ra sga ra ṇa khaṃ/ oṃ a pra ts+tsha swā hā nas shasta'i bar dang / oṃ rū pa nas shasta'i bar mchod/ bshags pa bya ba ni/rang lhar gsal ba'i thugs ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/sku las bdud ji dkar bo'i rgyun babs pas rang dang — yul lha 'khor dang bcas pa'i gnas gsum la thim pas/dam tshig 'gal nyams phog thug nyes skyon thams cad dag par gyur bsam la/yig brgya gang mang dngan badz+rasatwa ཿzhes pa sogs brgya phrag bzlas te gdung shugs drag pos/phog thug sngar byas la 'gyod pas bzod gsol dang /phyin chad yul lha'i thugs dang 'gal ba mibyed snyam pa'i sdom sems dang bcas pa 'di ltar/ r+yā /gdod nas rang bzhin dag pa chos dbyings su//'gal 'khrul nyes skyon rdul tsam ma dmigs kyang / /tha snyad snang ba sgyu ma'i 'phul 'khor gyis/ /nyams chag thams cad dmigs med dbyings su bshags//bdag cag lus sems bskyed pa'i pha ma dang /zas nor longs spyod gnas kyis skyong ba'i gnyen/ /drin cas —yul lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la/ /

phog thug 'gal ba gang bgyis mthol lo bshags//sa sko rdo slog shing bcad chu gnyan dkrugs//gtsang ma'i gnas kun mi gtsang nyes pas sbags// bsam sbyor nongs pas gzugs can gzugs med la//'khon grib gnod 'gal gang bgyis mthol lo bshags/ /khyad par lha chen khyed la bsten bcas pas bya dang ri dwags la sogs nyes med kun//gsod sogs nyer 'tshe gnod pa gang byas rnams//'gyod dang sdom pa'i sems kyis mthol lo bshags//lha srung chen po khyed kyis bdag cag gi/'dod don bsgrubs la gtang rag ma phul dang //mgon skyabs dpung gnyen bgyi tshul ma rtogs par//ma shes 'khrul ba gang bgyis mthol lo bshags//yul gyi legs tshogs nyams pa'i rgyu rkyen rnams//rang gis bsgrubs nas le lan gzhan la bda'//blang dor dris nas bka' bzhin mi bsgrub sogs/ /bsam bzhin bsgrubs pa'i 'gal ba ma lus bshags//mdor na ma shes skyon dang log rtog dang //snyoms las dbang gis bya spyod 'khrul ba'i rigs//ji snyed bgyis kun 'gyod pas mthol bgyid na//bzod par bzhes nas thugs rjes skyong bar mdzod//bla ma rdor sems mchog gsum byin rlabs dang //chos dbyings rnam dag tha snyad rten 'brel rnams/ /tshogs pa'i stobs kyis nyes skyon kun zhi nas/ /dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal zla ltar gsal gyur cig/ cesabashags pa bya/ slar yang bsang dud rol mo spyan gzigs sogasayod na spyan sngar bstar ba dang bcasate/ oṃ ma rgyu gis byin gyis brlabs la bskang ba bya ba ni 'di ltar/ kyiḥ/bde stong ting 'don di —des rol ba ni//mchod pa'i sprin

phung 'dod dgu nam mkha' mdzod//cir yang 'char ba'i rang 'dzoms sna tshogs kyis//yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //gser zhun phung bo 'bar ba'i me nang du/ /dri zhim shing sna brgya phrag du ba'i sprin//mkha' dbyings khyab pa'i rgya chen bsang mchod kyis//yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /ting 'dzin las grub 'od 'bar snod yangs su//ro brgya'i bcud ldan btung ba mtsho ltar 'khyil//bza' bca' tshogs kyi 'khor lo gser skyems 'dis//yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //rin chen sga srab mdzes pa'i cang shes rta//'jam pa'i spu ldan shel ltar 'tsher ba'i lug/'ba' sgra'i glu len ra skyes tshogs rnams kyis//yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //rngam brjid ngar sgra sgrog pa'i g.yag rog dang //'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin zhol mo sprin ltar 'thibs//'dod 'jo'i ba dang stobs ldan mdzo drel gyis//yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //g.yer kha'i phreng mdzes sgra sgrog nor skyong dang /drag shul mi zad stag sbyang dom dred sogs//mche sder rtsal ldan gcan gzan tshogs rnams kyis// yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //sngo ljang rtswa dang gtsang ma'i chu rgyun gyis//bde bar 'tsho zhing bag phebs rtsed 'jor rol//shwa rkyang rna ba la sogs ri dwags kyis//yulaskyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //'jigs pa'i sgra sgrog gshog pa'i rlabs g.yo ba'i//'phur lding gar gyis rol ba'i khra gla/ sdod//mchu sder mi bzad ldan pa'i bya

tshogs kyis//yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //'dab gshog 'ja' tshon ri mo ltar bkra zhing //kya kyur 'jam pa'i dbyangs snyan sna tshogs kyis/ /rtsed dga' 'phur lding rol ba'i byi'u tshogs/ /yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //lha klu sman mo'i na chung tshogs rnams ni/ /rin chen rgyan dang mdzes sdug lang tshos sgeg /snyan pa'i glu len mdzes pa'i gar bsgyur bas//yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //bgos pa tsam gyis ma rung g.yul ngo las//rnam par rgyal ba'i dpal sbyin khrab rmog dang / /dgra 'joms mtshon cha rno ngar 'bar ba yis/ /yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang za 'og sham bu rim brtsegs nor bu'i tog/mdzes ldan gdugs dang rgyal mtshan ba dan dang / /dar gyi lhab lhub na bza' rgyan phreng gis//yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //'bras ldan ljon pa'i shing dang sman sna'i tshal//chu skyes thang skyes me tog sna tshogs dang / /dag byed chu rgyun yan lag brgyad ldan gyis/ /yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /rtse mo mkha' la bsnyegs pa'i rdza ri dang //shing sna'i dga' tshal 'khrigs pa'i nags kyi ri//mar gad gos rgyan spang ri thang ljongs kyis/ /yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /mthing sngon nam mkha' yangs pa'i bla re bres/ /rgyu skar mu tig phreng ba'i do shal 'phyang //sna tshogs sprin gyi lda ldi g.yo ba yis//yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //rda/ /na stug po 'khrigs pa'i klong yangs

na/ /'brug sgra dal gyis rgod pa'i dbyangs snyan can//'chi med bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'beb pa yis/ /yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //rab yangs sdod du dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs//zas mchog sngags dang phyag rgya'i bden stobs kyis//bdud rtsir byin brlabs rgya chen gtor ma yis//yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangan/rtsibs stong gser gyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i//rgyal srid bdun dang khang bzang dgas tshal sogs/ /nye ba'i rin chen sna bdun dang bcas pas//yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //rin chen gdugs dang gser nya bum bzang dang / /pad+ma dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dpal gyi be'u/ /rgyal mtshan 'khor lo bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis//yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //lhan skyes rlung sngags zung du 'jug pa'i gdangs//snyan tshig dbyangs kyi rol mo rna ba'i bcud//mchod gsol snyan pa'i gdangs su bsgrags pas kyang / /yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //lha khyed 'jig rten dregs pa'i skur snang yang //rang bzhin dag pa'i dbyings su don dam gyi//chos sku bde ba chen por ro gcig pas//yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //mdor na 'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi//dge tshogs dpag tu med pa'i rnam 'phrul las//byung ba'i dngos bshams yid sprul mchod sprin gyis//yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bsna dwang shing nyams chag sos gyur nas/ /

dpal ldan bla ma'i sku tshe brtan pa dngan/dpon slob sde bcas bshad sgrub gong 'phel zhing //bstan pa'i sbyin bdag tshe bsod rgyas pa sogs//legs tshogs lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ ces bskang ba bya/ slar yang bsang gtor byin gyis rlabs la 'bul ba ni/ oṃ badz+ra ma skṛ tas bsangs/ swabha phas sbyangs la/stong ba'i ngang las r+ghaṃ las rin po che'i snodayangs shing rgya che ba'i dang du/oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor mdakar gsum mngar gsum sogs kham gyi zas ro bcud sun sum tshogs pa 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan pa'i ye shes kyi bdud ji zad mi shes par gyur/ oṃ āḥlan gsum brjod na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta ma wa lo ke te oṃ sa ra sa ra rgyu/lan bdun nam nyer gcig sogs kyis bsngo/de bzhinabashegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ gtor rdzongs spyi 'gro ltar ro// yang na/ phun tshogs 'dod yon lnga ldan pa'i//bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di//sa yi lha mo brtan ma sogs//tshe ring mched lnga bstan skyong bcas//stong gsum gzhi bdag thams cad dang //gangs can gnas pa thams cad dang //khyad par yul 'di'i zhing skyong che/ /lha chen khra leb mched gsum dang //lha ri brag dkar mthon po dang //dmar yag btsan rgod chen po dang //dgyes bskyed gsang ba'i yum rnams dang //'phrul gyi blon chen sde bzhi dang / /las byed bka' nyan pho nya'i tshogs/ /kun la bsngo zhing 'bul lags na//bzhes nas bdag cag 'khor bcas la//nyin gsum bya ra ma g.yel zhig /mtshan gsum mel tshe ma g.yel zhig /gzhi lam gyes gsum thams cad du/ /'gal rkyen sel la mthun rkyen sgrubasda/ 9/dpon slob sde bcas thams cad kyi/ /

chos mthun rnam dkar legs tshogs kun/ /lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol// zhes gtor ma bsngo zhing 'phrin las bcol/ spro na dam pa snga mas mdzad pa'i gsol mchod sogs kyang 'don zhing / spyi bsang yang gtong / de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/kyiḥ mchog tu mi 'gyur lhan skyes bde ba'i gar//'gro ba'i re skong dbang gi rgyal po'i mdzod/ /gang 'dul cir yang 'char ba'i bla ma lhar/ /gus pas bstod cing mchod do byin rlabs stsol//lho rgyal 'dzam gling yangs pa'i byang gi phyogs//phyag na pad+ma'i gdul zhing kha ba can//chen po bod kyi yul gru skyong ba'i lha/ /khra leb dge bsnyen chen po khyed la bstod/ /sum rtsen gnas su bsnyegs pa'i sa 'dzin ni//snod bcud phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal yon can//ri rab lhun po'i mched zla la gnas pa'i//yul lha'i rgyal po chen po khyed la bstod//sngon bsags bsod nams du ma'i rnam 'phrul gyis/ /legs sgrub rang snang bde ba'i pho brang ni//nor bu'i tog mdzes rin chen gzi 'od 'bar//gser gyi rgyal mtshan rnam par bsgreng la bstod//lha dang mi yi 'dod dgu'i 'byor ba yis//yongs su gtams pa'i khang bzang yangs pa na//rnam mang sde brgyad dregs pa'i 'khor gyi dbus//mthu stobs nus pa khyad 'phags khyed la bstod//rin chen khri la za 'og gdan gyi steng //sku mchog dkar gsal bgrang phreng nor bu 'dzin//lhab lhub dar gyi 'jol ber sku la gsol//dbang bsgyur stabs kyis rol ba khyed la bstod/ /las bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrub ba'i 'dun gros las//lhag bsam gcig gyur sku yi /rdoX zla gnyis//lha ri brag dkar mthon

po dang bcas pa'i/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i srung ma gsum la bstod/ /lha chen bka' yi las srung blon po'i tshogs/ /gzhan gyi yid 'gugs dgyes skyed gsang ba'i yum//dmar yag btsan gyi sde dpon mthu bo che/ /dag po'i g.yul 'joms dpa' bo che la bstod/ /re 'ga' rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan rta la bcibs//phyag g.yas sba lcags g.yon pas mdung ring 'dzin//dpa' bo'i 'khor gsum stag dong gzig thubs sprad//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon khyed la bstod//lha yi 'khor tshogs mkha' la rgyu skar bzhin//sde brgyad dmag dpung bar snang lho sprin bzhin/ /klu btsan stong sde sa yi dregs pa bzhin/ /'khrigs pa'i 'khor la dbang sgyur khyed la bstod//mchod sbyin brgya ba bzhin du mnga' thang mtho/ /rmugs 'dzin dbang bo bzhin tu dpal 'byor rgyas//tha gu'i sto bzhin mthu rtsal thogs pa med//bstan pa bsrung ba'i rtsal ldan khyed la bstod//bar chad tsha gdung zhi ba'i sprin chen dkrigs//chos srid legs tshogs rgyas pa'i spu char 'bebs//dbang sdud 'phrin las snyan pa'i dbyar rnga sgrog /drag rtsal thog 'beb las bzhi bsgrub la bstod/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin 'dus pa'i chos kyi sde//srung skyob 'phrin las g.yel med chos skyong che//dam ldan rnal 'byor yongs kyi bka' bsgrub pa'i//bka' bsrung dam can chen po khyed la bstod//re zhing ltos pa'i dgon grong 'brog gsum gyi//skye 'gro kun la nyin mtshan dus drug tu//'phrin las bsgrub cing 'dod pa'i blang dor kun/ /ston pa'i mngon shes thogs med khyed ḍi —bstod/ /lha dang bla ma'i bka' dang

dam la gnas//lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i 'khor gyis bskor//lha klu mi yi 'jig rten mngon sum gzigs/ /lha srung chen po khyed la bdag bstod do/ /dregs pa'i sde dpon khyed kyi bka' 'khor na//mthu stobs nus pa drag rtsal thogs med cing //dkar phyogs skyong la brtson pa'i g.yar dam can//snang srid sde brgyad 'khor tshogs rnams la bstod//bstan bsrung yul lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis//rgyal kun spyi gzugs pad+ma thod phreng rtsal//la sogs rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma yi//spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas ma g.yel zhig /'jam dpal rdo rje'i sgyu 'phrul tsong kha pa//phyag na pad+mo'i bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde//brtse ba'i gter chen zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal//la sogs sangs rgyas byang sems dngos brgyud pa'i//phyogs 'dir zhal skyong dam pa'i tshogs rnams kyis//thub bstan spyi dang blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan//bod yul spyi dang khyad par yul gru 'di/ /srung bar bka' bsgos dam bcas ji bzhin du/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas la//mi 'dod nad rims thog ser shā 'od glog /btsa' sad than pa dus min kha char rlung //la sogs gzugs med bgegs dang 'byung ba las//gyur ba'i gnod pa ma lus zhi bar mdzod//dgra jag chom kun gdug pa'i gcan gzan sogs//bsnyad 'tshol glags blta'i sems ldan gzugs can kun//'phrin las drag po'i stobs kyis tshar chod la//rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan bsgreng bar mdzod//yul gru kun tu dus bzhi'i 'byung ba snyoms//skye 'asdo /lha/'a dag dge ba'i las la brtson//lha

klu dkar phyogs skyong ba'i rtsal stobs rgyas/ /phan bde dge mtshan dar ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ ces bstod cing 'phrin las bcol/de nas slar yang gtang rag tu bsang kha gsol zhing/ 'di ltar/ kyeḥ bstan srung yul lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rnams//'phrin las dus su rten mchod gsol ba'i tshe//brtse ba'i thugs rjes dgongs nas 'byon pa sogs/ /'phrin las gang bcol g.yel ba med par mdzod//bdag cag bya ba spyod pa mi mkhas pas//mchod gtor dam rdzas ma tshang 'bags pa dang //dkar dmar thab gzhob la sogs nongs pa kun//dmigs med chos kyi dbyings su bzod par gsol//dbyangs rig dbyer med rtsal gyis mchod yul tu//spyan drangs sde brgyad dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs rnams//ngo bo gdod nas dag pa chos nyid klong //rnam pa rang rang dgyes pa'i gnas su gshegs// ces sogasamajug mchod dang shis brjod ji ltar rig pa'i mthar brgyan par bya'o// smras pa/ yul lha'i rgyal po dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams//yul mi'i dge sgrub rnam dkar la sogs kyis/ /yul lha'i thugs dang 'gal ba bshags byas nas/ /yul gyur bde skyid byung ba mchog nyid yin/ /bde ba'i phan pa lhag bsam bsod nams kyis/ /blo gros be+eḍūr rgyud mangs bsgrub pa las//bsang mchod drug ldan snyan pa'i glu dbyangs kyis//lha chen dgyes pa'i rol mor bdag gis phul//'dir 'bad dge tshogs nyin byed snang ba yis//nor 'dzin 'od kyis mun pa kun bsal te//skye 'gro mtha' dag bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi//dga' ston chen po /ga sa 'tsho bar shog/

ces mdo smad byang khams kyi yul spu skyong ba'i 'ju lag mthon po bcu gsum gyi nang tshan yul lha'i sde dpon chen po dge bsnyen khra leb kyi gsol mchod rgyas pa dregs pa dgyesapa'i dbyangs snyan zhes bya ba 'di yang bstan 'gror phan pa'i lhag bsam can bsgrub pa la rtse gcig tu gzhol pa'i bkrashis 'jil ba 'grin las rgya mtsho dang zhan chen dgon pa'i dad ldan dka' bcu legs bshad bstan 'dzin gnyis kyis bskul ngor btsun pa ngag

yul lha'i rgyal po khra leb chen po'i bsang bsngon 'bul tshul bde bskyed rta ljang dbang bo 'dren pa'i shing rta/༄sto //na mo gu ru rtse/ bsang gtor byin rlabasaspyi ltar la/ kye/ lhun grub bde ba chen po'i ngang //rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' sdod mchog /khra leb rig ldan dpa' bo khyed//'khor dang bcas pa gnas 'dir byon//mdun du 'ja' tshon gur khyim dbus//seng khri pad nyi'i gdan steng du//dgyes shing mnyes pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis/ /zhabs sen 'od chags brtan par bzhugs//sku mdog dkar la 'od zer 'phro//g.yas na shel 'phreng khrobs se khrobs//g.yon na gter kha shigs se shigs//lha chen sras po gnas 'dir byon//dgongs byon pho nya las mkhan dang //btsan dang ma mo 'khor g.yog bcas//rang 'dra'i sprul ba dpag tu med//'dir byon bsang gi mchod pa bzhes//gzhan yang lha klu dri za dang //ri brag la sogs yul phyogs 'dir/ /dbang byed sde brgyad 'khor bcas rnams//rangs pa'i tshul gyis da tshur byon//rang nyid 'jigs byed rdo rje yi//thugs ku'i hūṃ yis 'od zer gyis//phyogs bcur bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba rnams/ /rdo rje gsum gyis rnam rol du/ /spyan drangs so sor dbang bskur gsol//dzaḥrgyuḥ hoḥdabyer med cing //mgron rnams 'khon 'dzin dang bral nas//byams brtse bdag la dgaX3 ༷ra mdzod// de ltar rdo rje gsum gyi lha'i

mgron rnams kyi brgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam pa ni shin tu gal ste/'khru ldog sogs zhi ba'i thabasabla na med pa ste/bla ma'i man ngag gas/skabs 'dir ci mang bzlas/ kyiḥchos rnams spros dang kun bral yang //rmi lam bzhin du mnol pa sogs//ma lus 'gyod pa'i bshags bgyid na/ /sgrib med dag par mdzad du gsol//bsang gtor gyis bskang ba ni/phyogs kyi 'khor lo yongs gang ba'i//bsang mchod rgya chen dam pa 'di//khra leb 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//shin tu dgyes par mdzad du gsol/ /ro brgya bcud dang ldan pa yi/ /ja chang phud kyi bdud rtsi dang //lha lam gang ba'i bsang mchod kyis//dri bzang spos kyi dud sprin 'dis/ /bsang ngo khra leb 'khor bcas bsang / /mchod do khra leb 'khor bcas mchod//brngan no khra leb 'khor bcas brngan//zag med bde ba ster byed pa'i//sha khrag gtor ma'i gsur gyi nang //phyi nang nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga//nyi zla ri rab gling dang bcas//mchod do khra leb 'khor bcas mchod//bsang ngo khra leb 'khor bcas bsang //brngan no khra leb 'khor bcas brngan//bdag gis bzung dang ma bzung ba'i//g.yag lug ra dang cang shes rta//stag gzig dom dred lce spyang dang //gzugs 'gro rnam pa sna tshogs 'dis/ /bsang ngo khra leb 'khor bcas bsang / /mchod do khra leb 'khor bcas mchod//brngan no khra leb 'khor bcas brngan//dkar gsum mngar gsum zhal zas dang //mtsho dang ri brag nags tshal sman//gter chen bum bzang phye mar dang //rin chen bdu/ spyad rtags rdzas brgyad//bsang ngo khra

leb 'khor bcas /mchod do khra leb 'khor bcas mchod//brngan no khra leb 'khor bcas brngan//da ltar brngan pa'i yon tan gyis//bdag sogs yul phyogs dgon gnas bcas/ /sbyin bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi//tshe dpal stobs 'byor mnga' thang rnams//yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas pa dang //mi nad phyugs kyi god kha sogs//myur du zhi zhing lo phyugs legs//yul phyogs dar ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// mtshams 'dir dkar gtor spyi 'gro ltar bsngo'o/ kyeḥ'achi med lang tsho'i rjes 'gro bas//nyi zla'i 'od bzhin gzi brjid 'bar//rin chen rgyan spras rta la bcibs//rig ldan dpa' bo khyed la bstod//gsang yum dkon mchog sngo bsang ma//mda' dar me long brgyan pa bsnams//rjes sor dam pa'i mchog ster ma//bka' blon g.yog 'khor bcas la bstod//sngon tshe slob dpon chen po'i bka'//rdo rje tha tshig dran dgongs la//bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas//dgon gnas de 'dzin sbyin bdag rnams//srung zhing skyob pa'i dus la babs//rol ba bde ldan lam yangs por//dpag byed ngang ba'i shing rta khyed//dge ba'i lo tog rnam sad mdzod//'phrog byed zhon dang khyed gnyis kyis//mthu stobs rdo rje rtse brgya bas//nag phyogs sbyin skyes ma lus pa/ /rdul du brlag pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /dpa' bo khra leb 'khor bcas rnams//brten pa'i tshe na rgyang ma ring //bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra//bskul ba'i tshe na bang ma bul//rbad pa'i tshe na rtsal ma zhan//'jam dpal 'jigs med rdo rje bka'//ma g.yeX sdu —g.yel dran par mdzod//ma g.yel

bdag gis 'phrin las sgrub/ /bstan pa rin chen rgyas pa dang //'gro rnams bde skyid ldan pa dang / /lo legs char chu snyom pa dang / /dge legs chen po khyab gyur cig /ces yul lha'i rgyal po khra leb chen po'i bsang brngon 'bul tshul bde bskyed rta ljang dbang bo 'dren pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba 'di ni gzhung lugs blo mig yangasapa bla ma mkhas grub kyis gtso bo shing lung bsgrubs sde bla spyi nas bskul ba'i ngor/ lashākya'i dge slong rig pa 'dzin pa da lo be le rgog thu er lha ni nam han ngag dbang bub bstan dbang phyug ces bya bas sa mo bya'i lor rmi lam zhes bla ba'i yar tshes la chu bzang thub bstan rab rgyas gling du sbyar ba skye 'gro yongs la phan thogs par gyur cig/༄cho //aḥkaḥsaḥmaḥraḥtsaḥshaḥdaḥraḥsaḥmaḥr8pa'iphaṭa/seng gdong ma'i sngags/

srid pa'i lha chen khra leb mthon po'i bsang mchod legs byas dpal ster/༄byu //na mo badz+ra lha ra wa ya/ 'dir chos sde chen po dgon lung phyogs kyi yul lha'i gtso bo khri leb chen po labasang mchod 'bul bar 'dod pas/dkar gsum gyi mchod gtor go khrab mtshon gos dar rta g.yag sogs spyan gzigs tshar du dngar/bye mar dang sman sna dri bzang sna tshogs sbyar ba'i bsang dud cher 'bul zhing / skyabs sems sngon du btang ste rang lhar gsolaba'ibasang mchod spyi ltar byin gyis brlabs la/ kyeḥ dge bcu'i dpal 'byor tshang ba'i sa yi thig le//mdo smad byang phyogs rgyal khams yangs pa'i lte ba//mtho la brjid chags ri rab kun po'i mched zla//rin chen sna tshogs byur bur spungs 'dra'i ri bo//dung ltar ngo mtshar gzhal med lha yi khang bzang //nor bu'i gzi 'od mngon par mdzes pa'i dbus su//rin chen 'bar ba'i khri steng za 'og gdan la//bzhugs pa'i lha yi dge bsnyen khra leb chen po//phyag na bgrang phreng gter gyi bum pa 'dzin cing //dar zab gos dar rin chen rgyan gyis spras pa'i//gsang yum sras dang blon po lha klu'i 'khor tshogs//ri klung chu brag thang la gnas pa thams cad//rdzu 'phrul shugs kyis thogs pa med par gshegs shig /ka ma la ye ste/ ḍūkhu lha yi dge bsnyen mthu bo che/ /mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thogs med khyed/ /bsang mchod mgron du legs

bzhugs nas//brtse ba'i thugs kyis dgongs par mdzod//ma rig 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur te/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'gal ba yi//nyams chag nyes pa ci mchis rnams/ /mthol lo bzod pa bzhes su gsol/ /ting 'dzin zab mo'i mkha' dbyings su//phyag rgyas glog gis gar bsgyur zhing / /sngags kyi sgra brgya dang 'grogs pa'i//rdzas kyis gru char 'bebs pa ni//dwangs shing bsil ba'i mchod yon dang //lha yi me tog bdug pa'i spos//snang gsal dri dang ro brgya'i zas//snyan zhing brjid chags rol mo'i sgra//sra mkhregs rdo rje'i go khrab dang //rno dang mtshon cha 'bar ba'i tshogs/ /gtum drag rngams pa'i gcan gzan dang //sha rgyas spu sdug rkang 'gro'i khyu//gser dngul dar zab nor gyi mdzod//sna tshogs 'bru sna zas sna sogs/ /'dod yon rnam lnga'i dpal rdzogs pa'i/ /mchod sprin sa dang bar snang gi /khyon kun yongs su 'gengs pa 'dis//srid pa'i lha chen dge bsnyen mchog /khrab chen mched gsum thugs dam bskangs//brag dkar gnyan po'i thugs dam bskangs/ /dmar yag btsan rgod thugs dam bskangs//btsun mo sras dang blon po'i tshogs//'khor dang bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs/ /thugs dam yongs su bskangs gyur te/ /bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi//mi mthun rkyen ngan mtha' dag zhi ba dang //chos srid dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//mtsho skyes rdo rje rgyal ba gnyis pa sogs//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bsgos g.yar dam bzhin//nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel rdo ༷༷//srung skyob g.yel ba med pa'i

sdongs grogs mdzod//bshad sgrub bstan pa'i 'byung gnas chos grwa cher//chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs rgyas pa dang //bstan pa'i rtsa lag dpal ldan bla ma rnams//sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod// yul phyogs 'di ru sad ser than pa dang //nad mug 'khrug rtsod phyi nang nyer 'tshe kun//nye bar zhi zhing mnga' thang rigs rgyud dang //tshe bsod dpal 'byor gong du 'phel bar mdzod//mngon mtho'i dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i dga' tshal du//skye dgu'i bsod nams dge ba'i sa bon ni//yongs smin legs byas smon pa rgyas pa'i rtser//nges legs 'bras bu'i dga' ston smin par mdzod gtor ma yod na bsang sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dod yon lnga dang ldan pa lha chen 'khor bcas dgyes par byed ba'i mthu dang ldan par gyur/ ma — lha'irgyu lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta ma dzilo gi te chasam bha ra skye/lan bdun sogs kyis bsngo/ 7 dri zhim dang ldan bsang shing sna tshogs dang //bzang bo'i sman sna zas sna phye mar sogs//bsregs pa'i dud sprin sdug pa char sprin bzhin//lha lam yangs pa'i khyon kun 'gengs pa 'dis//lha yi dge bsnyen chen po 'khor bcas bsang //nyams chag nyes pa ma lus byang gyur te//phul byung bde dga' mchog gis tshim pa yis//mchod yon 'phrin las bsgrub la gzhol gyur cig /gzi byin 'od stong 'bar ba'i nyin mor byed//phyi nang nyer 'tshe'i mun pa'i dpung bcom zhing //legs tshogs 'dab brgya'i dga' tshal rgyas mdzad pa//lha chen nam maX sdor bu khyed la bstod//sngon tshe rdo rje

g.yar dam mdzad pa bzhin//bstan dang bstan 'dzin mtha' dag skyong byed cing //ljongs 'dir sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor rgyas mdzad pa//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha chen khyed la bstod/ khyed kyi thugs rje'i mthu stobs nus pa yis//yongs su bzung ba'i rgyal khams 'dir//mi shis rgud pa'i ming yang mi grags shing //bde skyid rdzogs ldan dga' ston rgyas gyur cig/mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gsol la/ 'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang //'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang //bde legs phun sum tshogs pa dang //yid la 'dod pa kun grub shog/bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin//snyan grags chen po nam mkha' bzhin du khyab//tshe ring nad med gzhan don lhun gyis grub//yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog/ces pa 'di ni bstan pa'i gsal byed sprulaba'i sku 'jamadapal ye shes bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho dang /rab 'byams pa mkhas grub dar rgyas/rdo dkar rdo sgo'i mgon kyis bskul —ngor/btsunapa dkon mchog bstan pa'i sgron mes bris pa'o/

khra leb gsol kha/༄༄ / /rmad byung dge mtshan bcu yi dpal ngom pa'i/ /bkra shis byin chags nor 'dzin lto ba ru//bsten bcas dgra lha'i gtso bo dregs rtsal can//bla mas ming btags gsang mtshan las rab rtsal//bde stong nyams kyi sgyu 'phrul rma rgyal sras//sku mdog dmar smug khro 'dzum sgeg pa'i nyams//phyag g.yas mda' dar nor bu bsam 'phel bsnams//g.yon pas dgos 'dod kun stsol bum pa 'dzin//rin chen gser g.yu dar zab rgyan gyis mdzes//gsang yum las byed pho nyar sprul 'khor sogs//rnal 'byor bdag gis spyan 'dren da tshur byon//dngos bshams yid sprul phyi nang bsang mchod dang //sman gtor rak+ta dkar gsum mngar gsum bcas//'bul gyis bzhes la 'phrin las rnam bzhi sgrubs//kurma'i rgyud 'dzin rigs mchog skal ldan bu//bu gcig ltar brtse nyams len gong du 'phel//'phel rgyas slob ma'i sa steng khyab par mdzod//yul phyogs kun tu nad mtshon dgra jag sogs//mi 'dod nyer 'tshe rgyad pa mi 'byung zhing //char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs rtag tu legs//legs tshogs phan bde dpal la spyod par shog/

stag btsan ra rgod nor skyong sogs yul lha'i bsang brjod/༄ //na mo gu ru/rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥci li kri tā na na rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ su bhā wa shud caḥsarba rnyarmaḥsu bhā wa shud dhe ha/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor sngon po gzhu'i dbyibs lta bu ba dan gyis mtshan pa/ de'i steng du raṃ las me'i dkyil 'khor dmar bo spu gsum pa/ de'i steng du āḥlas mi mgo'i snyed pu gsum gyi steng du/ āḥ las byung ba'i thod pa dkar bo/ de'i nang gi shar du sri las byung ba'i ba lang gi sha gos mtshan pa/ lhor e las byung ba'i khyi'i sha gus mtshan pa/ nub tu sgro las byung ba'i glang bo che'i sha das mtshan pa/ byang du khaṃ las byung ba'i rta'i sha has mtshan pa/ dbus su skye las byung ba'i mi'i sha nas mtshan pa/ shar stor lam̐ las byung ba'i dri chen pis mtshan pa/ lho nub tu rmā las byung ba'i rak+ta ras mtshan pa/ nub byang du baṃ las byung ba'i byang sems dkar bo thus mtshan pa/ byang shar du ṭ+wāṃ las byung ba'i rkang mar mas mtshan pa/dbus su las byung ba'i dri chu skus mtshan pa/ de dag gi steng du oṃ dkar bo āḥdamar bo rdu sngon po gsum steng nas steng du brtsegs par gyur/ rang gi thugs ku'i r+ghaṃ las 'od zer 'phros rlung la phog pas rlung

g.yos me sbar te thod pa'i rdzas rnams zhu zhing khol bar gyur/ yi ge gsum las 'od zer rim pa bzhin du 'phros pas/ sku rdo rje gsung rdo rje thugs rdo rje rnams bkug nas yi ge gsum la rim gyis thim pa rnams thod par lhung nas zhu bas/ hūṃ gis kha dog dri nus kyi skyon sbyangs āḥs bdud rtsir rtogs par byas/ oṃ gyis mang bor sbar zhing spel bar gyur/ oṃ āḥrdu/ lan gsum brjod/oṃ gri ཿyili kri tā na na hūṃ phaṭa/oṃ su bha wa shud caḥsarba rnyarmaḥswabha wa shud dhe ha/bsang rdzas rnams mi dmigs pa stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mnyes par byed pa'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ma sarba bed gu ra byu ra su ra su ra/ ā warta ya ā warta ya ho/ badz+ra sgar na khaṃ/ oṃ sa āḥrgyu/ oṃ pāji āḥrgyu/ buspro/ cu be/ ā lo ke garnye/ rna li bye/ shalha/ rū ba/ shasta/ garnye/ ra sa/ spar+sha/ oṃ swa bhā wa bi thud dhe rnyarmaḥte badz+ra sid rnyi rgyu/na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi rwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tad khaṃ ud ga te sgar na gyi me ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ oṃ ā sbo ta /phaṭa/ oṃ ā ka ro mu khaṃ sarba rnyarmaḥrna/ a t+ya nub na twad/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te/ oṃ sa bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/oṃ ru ru spu ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid rnya lo tsa ni sarba mtho sna rnya ni swā hā//bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni//de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin ༷༷sa dang //chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs

rnams kyis//don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun//de dag thams cad ci rigs par//thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig /lhun grub bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas pad ma thod phreng rtsal//rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas//thogs med thugs rje'i dbang gis gshegs su gsol//mdun gyi nam mkhar pad sdong yangs pa'i steng //seng khri pad ma nyi zla'i gdan khri la//yid 'phrog 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim dbus//zhabs sen 'od chags brtan par bzhugs su gsol//phyi yi mchod pas sa dang bar snang bkang //nang gi mchod pa zag med bdud ci'i mtsho//gsang ba bde chen smra bsam brjod las 'das//'gro ba'i don du dgyes bzhin bzhes su gsol// rgyuḥ /rig 'dzin grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung //lnga brgya'i gtsug rgyan dpal ldan mar me mdzad/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang blo bzang grags pa'i dpal/ /sna tshogs sprul ba'i gar mdzad de la 'dud//dpal ldan bstan skyong chen po 'khor bcas kyi//khyed kyi bka' dang da tshig la gnas pa'i//'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa dang /chos grwa chen po dar zhing rgyas par mdzod/zhi/rtsabargyud bla ma dkon mchog srid zhi'i mgron//phan gdegs las 'brel rigs drug snying rje'i mgron//bu lon sha gnyer glo bur lhag chad mgron//ma lus brjod chen mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs//bzang dgu'i mchod gtor zhim dgu'i gser skyems dang //bsregs pa'i dud sprin phyi nang gsang ba'i rten//yid 'ong brngon rdzas spyan gzigs sna tshogs dang //dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pas yongs bkang bas//ma lus 'khor bcas dgyes pa skyed gyur cig /bdag cag 'khrung ༷/ spyod pa sna tshogs kyis//sgrib sbags

mi gtsang dam tshig nyams pa dang / /gnyan po'i sa brkos shing bcad chu dkrugs dang / /rdo bshig ri klung skad kyis sgrog pa sogs/ /thugs dkrugs nor ba ma lus so sor bshags//brtse zhing bzod mdzod rjes su brtse dgongs nas//'gal rkyen sol la bsam don ma lus sgrubs//chos kyi sbyin pa kun nas dga' ba yis//yid la bsam pa thams cad 'grub par mdzod// maḥ rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog rin chen la//brjod chen dam rdzas spyan gzigs 'di phul pas//dam tshig nyams grib ma lus zhi gyur cig /srid zhi'i 'jigs pa kun las bskyab tu gsol//yi dam rin chen chos skyong drang srong la//brjod chen dam rdzas spyan gzigs 'di phul pas//phyi dang gsang ba'i nyes rtsang zhi gyur cig /nad dang gdon bgegs 'gal rkyen zlog par mdzod//tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma phyogs skyong la//brjod chen dam rdzas spyan gzigs 'di phul pas//dme 'khon thab gzhib ngan spyod zhi gyur cig/'khor dang tshe dpal longs spyod rgyas par mdzod//lha klu sde brgyad bag chags yul lha la//bangon chen dam rdzas spyan gzigs 'di phul pas//bya spyod ngan pa'i thugs dkrugs zhi gyur cig /sad ser gcan gzan 'tshe ba zlog par mdzod//rigs drug lan chags sha 'khon gnyer ba la/ /bangon chen dam rdzas spyan gzigs 'di phul pas//las ngan lan chags ma lus zhi gyur cig /byams sems ldan zhing bde skyid 'byung bar shog /byes su don grub mi rta nor rdzas legs//gzhi la 'tshe med mi nor bde sgyid 'dzoms//snyan grags dbyar mtsho bzhin du rgyas par shog/ ces pa 'di yang mgon sngags gnagyis bsang brngon 'di dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor 'dan ma grub chen sku gnyis pas smra baX/— ཿ rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog

gsum//yi dam mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs//yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad kyang //de ring mchod pa'i gnas 'dir byon//khyad par srung ma'i dgra lha che//stag btsan mthon po 'khor bcas bsang / 'byor ldan ra rgod 'khor bcas bsang //dpal ldan nor skyong 'khor bcas bsang //yul 'di'i srung ma mthu chen rnams/ /mthun pa'i bsang mchod bzhes phyir byon/ /btung ba dkar gsum gtsang ma'i phud//bza' bca' zas phud sna tshogs kyis//mgron rnams dgyes pa skyed gyur cig /dri zhim yid 'ong sbyar ba yi/ /dud pa'i sprin phung 'khrigs pa 'dis//dngos grub 'byung gnas rtsa brgyud kyi//mkhas grub bla ma thams cad bsang //phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas bsang //yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad bsang / /khyad par rdo rje 'dzin kun gyi//gtsug rgyan pad dkar 'chang ba yi//bka' sgrub stag btsan mthon po dang //yul 'di'i gzhi bdag thams cad bsang / /rgyal ba'i bstan pa rgyas pa dang / /bla ma dam pa'i sku tshe srings/ /yon mchod mi nor phyugs rnams kyi/ /kha 'dzin rgyab rten dpung gnyen mdzod/ /gcan gzan dgra jag chom kun sogs/ /'gal rkyen bar chad kun sol la/ /mthun rkyen dngos grub bstsal du gsol//

rgyal chen stag btsan don grub kyi gsol mchod shin cargyas pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs/cu //chos dbyings mkha' la rol ba'i gsang gsum sprin//mthu stobs glog gi zhags pa g.yo ba las/ /bgegs 'joms gnam lcags tsha tsha 'bum 'phro ba/ /bla ma gsang ba'i bdag pos dge legs stsol/ /gang zhig bsten na 'phral gyi 'dod pa'i don//ma lus yid bzhin stsol ba'i dgra lha che//lha gnyan stag btsan don grub dgyes byed pa'i//'phrin las cho ga rgyas pa 'godapar bya/de yang dkar gsum mngar gsum bsres pa'i zan gtsang ma las dkar gtor sgrom po che ba mthar ril bus bskor ba dang /zasaphud phye mar gser skyems nyer spyod sogs mchod pa dang /mda' dar go mtshon sogs spyan gzigs sna tshogs bshams/'byor na tshe thar rta nor lugasogs srung rtags cod paṇa mdzes pa'ang stagon bya/shug pa sogs bsang shing sna tshogs bsregs pa'i dud pa cher btang /rnga rol dung dkar sil snyan sogs rol mo'i bye brag rnamasakyang 'du byas te/rdo rje 'jigasabyed sogs yi dam gang yang rung ba'i lha'i rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus gang rigs sngonadu btang na shin tu gas yang na skyabs sems mdor bsdus sngon dubatang ste/rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yumadang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/oṃ badz+ra ma sbo tas mchod rdzas rnams bsangs /sdu rdo was sbyangs/ mchod gtor bsang

rdzas spyan gzigs rnams mi dmigs par stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i dregs pa'i sde dpon lha gnyan chen po 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes par byed pa'i yo byad gang bsam 'dod dgur 'byung ba sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad yongs su 'geng ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi sung bo 'byung bar gyur cig sarba bid tsi ra snu ra sogs sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs/ bdag gis bsam pa'i stobs dang ni/ zhes sogs kyis bden stobs brjod/ oṃ su bha wa shud dh+wa sarba nas shud lha nya haṃ/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las rang gi mdun du rin po che du ma'i khams kyi snying bo dang ldan pa'i g.ya' spang 'dres pa'i ri bo rtsa ba gser gyi dkyil 'khor la gnas shing /rtse mo nam mkha'i dbyings su zug pa/ yid du 'ong ba'i ljon shing gi phreng ba dang / sman gyi myu gu me tog sna tshogs dang bcas pas brgyan zhing / dwangs shing bsil ba'i yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu rgyun du ma phyogs bcur 'bab pa/ shā ba pho mo sogs ri dwags dang gcan gzan 'dab chags sna tshogs kyis nye bar brten cing / yul gyi mi phyugs sogs skye 'gro du ma'i nyer 'tsho'i gzhir gyur pa'i sa 'dzin gyi dbang bo la/ nang du srid pa'i lha gnyan chen po'i bsod nams kyi rang snang las grub pa'i lha'i pho brang chen po/ mtha' skor kun tu yangs shing rgya che ba'i lcags ris bskor ba'i nang du/ khrus kyi rdzing bu dang /skyed mo'i tshal dang mdzod kyi khang ba ༷ so/sa pa 'dod dgu'i yo byad sna
