tshogs kyis bkang ba'i dbus su/ rin po che du ma las grub pa'i khang bzang gser gyi rgya thabs 'od du 'bar zhing / brtan cing brjid pa'i cig pas bskor ba'i ba gam rab tu mtho ba/sgo khang dang rta babs rin po che'i them skas sogs kyis bkod pa khyad par du 'phags pa'i dang du/ gser g.yu mu tig sogs kyi phra tshom mdzes pa'i rin chen gnyis pa'i khri/ za 'og gi 'bol stan brtsegs pa'i gdan gyi steng du/lha gnyan dregs pa'i rgyal po stag btsan don grub sku mdog zla ba chu shel ltar dkar zhing dgyes 'dzum gyi nyams dang ldan pa/ dbang gzhu'i ri mo ltar bkra ba'i dar gyi na bza' lhab lhub cagasol zhing /g.yas yid bzhin gyi nor bu dang / g.yon pas bdud ci'i bum pa bsnams pa/dbu la rin po che'i sbog zhu mu tig gi dra bas mdzes shing / ut+pal sngon po 'ching ba gsol ba/ rgyal po rol ba'i stabs kyis dregs pa sde brgyad kyi dpung la mnga' bsgyur ba'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa'i 'khor du/ mdzes ldan lha sman gsang ba'i yum chen bzhi dang / dregs pa'i 'dun gros dbang ba'i blon chen sde bzhi/gzhan yang gnyan gyi dmag bskul/ dpung gi ru 'dren/mdzod kyi lde mig 'dzin/ ser ba'i sna khrid la sogs pa'i bka' yi las byed dregs pa sde brgyad kyi 'khor dang / nags tshal gyi lha dang / chu mig gi klu/ lam sung gi btsan la sogs pa'i gnyan dmag stong sde khri 'bum gyi 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho sa gzhi bar snang nam mkha'i khyon gang bas bskor bar gyur/ rang nyid lhar gsal ba'i thugs ku'i sa bon la/ /da zer gyi lcags kyu 'phros pas/ gar

bzhugs rang snang lha yi pho brang nas rgyal chen 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs te gnyis su med pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs par gyur/ zhes brjod la rol mo dbyangs dang bcas pa'i 'di skad do/ rnya lho rgyal 'dzam gling yangs pa'i byang gi phyogs//bod khams gling dgu'i nang tshan mdo smad kyi//yul gyi thig le srung ba'i dgra lha che//rgyal chen stag btsan don grub spyan 'dren no//bde ster btsun mo bzhi dang blon po bzhi/ /bka' yi las byed sde brgyad dregs pa'i 'khor//lha klu gnyan dmag stong sde khri 'bum sogs//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde tshogs spyan 'dren no//dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul ba yi//rgya chen mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo//phye ste gus pa'i yid kyis spyan drangs na//bsten cing mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal zla ba lta bur gsal//kun phan 'phrin las nyi ma'i 'od ltar snyoms//snyan grags g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i skad ltar sgrogs//mnga' thang dgung ltar mtho ba gshegs su gsol//dbyangs rol snyan pa'i sgra skad lhangs se lhangs//stag shar dpa' bo'i ru mtshon ldems se ldems//sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag tshogs shigs se shigs//dga' ba'i gar dang dpa' bo'i nyams kyis byon//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon chen po khyed//bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde spel ba dang / /dag phyogs dgra sde rtsad nas gcod pa'i phyir//mchod pa'i gnas 'dir da lta nyid du gshegs/zhesaspyan 'dren/dam bzhag dang bzhugs gsol ni/rgyu/dang por grub dbang pad+ma sam bha wa/—/༷༷ du blo bzang rgyal dbang pad dkar

'chang //tha mar 'jam mgon rgya mtsho bdun brgyud sogs//rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i spyan snga ru//dkar phyogs skyong bar khas blangs dam bcas bzhin//de ring rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi//chos ldan 'phrin las bsgrub phyir spyan drangs na//dgyes pas gshegs te brtan par bzhugs su gsol/ de nas mchod pa 'bulab ni/cha kun bzang bsod nams bye ba'i rnam 'phrul las//byung ba'i rab 'byams mchod pa'i sprin gyi phreng //dag byed yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon dang / /'dab rgyas ge sar phreng ldan me tog tshogs//dri zhim phyogs kun 'gengs pa'i spos kyi sprin//'od zer rtse dga' 'gyed pa'i sgron me'i phreng //ga bur ngad ldan dri chab bdud ci'i mtsho//lha mi'i bza' btung ro brgya'i zas kyi mchog /snyan brjid sgra ldan rol mo'i bye brag tshogs//lha chen 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul//zhes pa'i tshig bcad dang /sngags mchod kyang byed par spro na/oṃ ma hā.e se na pa ti sa pa ri wā ra a r+ghaṃ nas shag pra ṭī ts+tsha rgyu swāhā/zhesapa'i bar gyis mchod/de nas bshagasapa bya ba ni/rang gi thugs ku'i rdu las 'od zer 'phros//bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs mdun gyi nam mkhar spyan drangs/ yig brgya nyer gcig bzlas/ kyiḥ rang bzhin gdod nas spros pa kun bral yang //rmongs pa'i kun rtog 'khrul ba'i dbang gyur nas/ /srid pa'i lha gnyan chen po 'khor bcas kyi//thugs dang 'gal ba ci bgyis mthol lo bshags//dkar phyogs skyong la mthu rtsal thogs med khyed//dregs pa'i sde dpon che/ kyipo/ ma rtogs par//brnyas shing smod

dang bsang mchod ma bgyis dang / /skyob pa'i lha ru ma bsten mthol lo bshags//yul gyi rgyan gyur sngon shing nags tshal brag/yul lha'i sgo thog nyes med gnod pas gtses//yul gyi bcud g.yang nyams byed gang bgyis rnams//yul lha'i sde dpon khyed kyis bzod par bzhes//khas blangs bsang mchod gtor ma chag pa dang / /dkar dmar thab gzhob dri ngan du bas mnol//bsang rdzas mchod gtor yo byad dman pa sogs//ma dag nyes pa ma lus mthol lo bshags//lha klu gnyan po'i gnas dang yo byad la//gnod pa'i sbyor ba shing gnyan bcad pa dang //sa rdo gnyan po rko slog la sogs pa'i//phog thug thams cad dmigs med dbyings su bshags//rang phyogs srung zhing bar chad bsal ba dang //gzhi lam byes su lus dang grib ma bzhin//'grogs nas 'phrin las gang dgos sgrub pa la//ma shes gtang rag ma bgyis mthol lo bshags/ /mdor na yul mi bya spyod ma mkhas pas/ /yul lha'i thugs dang 'gal ba gang bgyis rnams//bzod par bzhes nas yul lha gnyan po khyed//yul mi'i kha 'dzin rgyab rten ma g.yel mdzod//bla ma rdo rje sems dpa'i lha tshogs kyi//byin rlabs thugs rje'i bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun gyis//'gal 'khrul nyams grib ma lus dag gyur nas//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu stobs rgyas gyur cig/ces gdung shugs kyis bshags pa bya/de nas thugs dam bskang ba ni/ kyeḥlhun grub bde stong nam mkha' yangs pa las//rdzas sngags ting 'dzin sprin gyi phung bo 'khrigs//bden stobs 'asdi/mi sdo sgrog dang lhan gcig tu//rab

'byams mchod pa'i char rgyun 'bebs gyur cig/'od 'bar rin chen snod du 'khyil ba yi//mchod yon bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng mkha' la g.yo//mdog legs dri bzang me tog sna tshogs pa//gung bas 'phur lding rol bas brten pa 'dis//rgyal chen stag btsan don grub yum sras blon//bka' nyan 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs//thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sos gyur nas//bar chad kun sol 'dod don 'phrin las sgrubs//brgya phrag spos sna bsregs pa'i du ba'i sprin//bzang bo'i dri yis phyogs kun 'geng ba dang //gser gyi pad+ma bsgrig pa lta bu yi//'od 'bar sgron me tshar du dngar ba 'dis//rgyal chen stag btsan don grub yum sras blon//bka' nyan 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs//thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sos gyur nas/ /bar chad kun sol 'dod don 'phrin las sgrubs//tsan dan la sogs dri bzang rab bsgos shing / /lus la byugs pas bde ster dri chab dang //dkar gsum mngar gsum bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs//ri ltar spungs shing mtsho ltar bskyil ba yis//rgyal chen stag btsan don grub yum sras blon//bka' nyan 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs//thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sos gyur nas//bar chad kun sol 'dod don 'phrin las sgrubs//snyan pa'i sgra yis sa chen rab 'gengs pa'i//sna tshogs rol mo'i bye brag mtha' yas dang //za 'og ri mo 'ja' tshon ltar bkra ba'i//'phan gdugs dar gyi ba dan bsgred sdu ༷dis//rgyal chen stag btsan don

grub yumasras blon//bka' nyan 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang /thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sos gyur nas//bar chad kun sol 'dod don 'phrin las sgrubs/ /mig la ya mtshan rgyas byed mdzes pa'i gzugs//drug ldan glu dang bdeb pa'i rol mo'i sgra//yid 'phrog dri dang ro brgya'i bcud ldan zas//lha yi reg ldan gos sogs 'dod yon lngas//rgyal chen stag btsan don grub yum sras blon/ /bka' nyan 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sos gyur nas//bar chad kun sol 'dod don 'phrin las sgrubs//myur mgyogs sprin gyi shugs ldan cang shes rta//gar bsam gnas su skad cig bgrod pa dang /ri yi dum bu 'gro ba lta bu yi//g.yag rog ngar sgras sa chen 'dar ba 'dis//rgyal chen stag btsan don grub yum sras blon//bka' nyan 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang /thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sos gyur nas//bar chad kun sol 'dod don 'phrin las sgrubs/ /'ja' tshon gos kyis bklubs pa'i sprin dkar bzhin//dar gyi cod paṇa mdzes pa'i lha lug dang //'ba' sgra'i glu dbyangs len pa'i rwa skyes tshogs//dpag bsam ljon pa'i phreng ba bsgrigs 'dra 'dis//rgyal chen stag btsan don grub yum sras blon//bka' nyan 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sos gyur nas//bar chad kun sol 'dod don 'phrin las sgrubs//drag po'i sgra sgrog 'phur lding gar gis /sna//khra glag bya rgod la sogs 'dab

chags dang //sgo khyi stag gzig dom dred ce spyang sogs//drag shul rtsal ldan gcan zan sna tshogs kyis/ /rgyal chen stag btsan don grub yum sras blon//bka' nyan 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sos gyur nas//bar chad kun sol 'dod don 'phrin las sgrubs//ldem ldem yal ga'i gar byed ljon pa'i shing /lhung lhung sgra sgrog 'bab chu gtsang ma'i rgyun//snyan snyan skad kyis glu len byi'u sogs//lhag lhag gnas kyi ngo mtshar sna tshogs 'dis//rgyal chen stag btsan don grub yum sras blon//bka' nyan 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sos gyur nas//bar chad kun sol 'dod don 'phrin las sgrubs//'od 'bar g.yul las rnam par rgyal ba yi//sabartan rdo rje'i go cha khrab rmog dang //rno ngar mi zad mda' mdung ral gri sogs//dgra 'joms 'bar ba'i mtshon cha sna tshogs kyis//rgyal chen stag btsan don grub yum sras blon/ /bka' nyan 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang /thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sos gyur nas//bar chad kun sol 'dod don 'phrin las sgrubs/ /lhab lhub dar gyi na bza' rin chen rgyan/ /yid bzhin nor bu gter gyi bum pa dang //bde ba'i mal cha nyams dga'i pho brang sogs//mthun pa'i cha rkyen mkho dgu sna tshogs 'dis//rgyal chen stag btsan don grub yum sras blon//bka' nyan 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam bskangs giX snams chag sos gyur nas//bar chad

kun sol 'dod don 'phrin las sgrubs//lnga phrag lnga yi snying bo dang ldan pa'i//dkar gsum mngar gsum sbyar ba'i gtor ma dang //'bru bcud btung ba bsang shing du ba'i sprin//nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab par 'khrigs pa yis//rgyal chen stag btsan don grub yum sras blon/ /bka' nyan 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskangs //thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sos gyur nas//bar chad kun sol 'dod don 'phrin las sgrubs//rtsibs stong gser gyi 'khor lo la sogs pa'i//mi dbang yo byad rgyal srid sna bdun dang //bkra shis rtags rdzas rin chen bang mdzod sogs//lha mi'i phun tshogs kun bsdus mchod sprin gyis//rgyal chen stag btsan don grub yum sras blon//bka' nyan 'khor tshogs bcas pa'i thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sos gyur nas//bar chad kun sol mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs/ de nas bzlog pa bya ba ni/ rgyu dzaḥbastan srung dgra lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas kyis//mthun pa'i dam rdzas rgya mtsho 'di bzhes nas//mthu stobs thogs pa med pa'i dpung bskyed la//sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i 'gal rkyen bzlog /bstan 'gro yongs la gnod pa'i spyi dgra bzlog/ bdag cag rnams la snang ba'i sgos dgra bzlog/las ngan 'bras bu nang gi nyer 'tshe bzlog/'phral rkyen mi bsrun 'byung bo khros pa bzlog/thog 'brug glog dang ser ba'i gnod pa bzlog/ban bon sngags pas mnan gtad thor gsum bzlog/kha smras gleng brjod 'thab rtsod 'khrug long bzlog /gza' skad /mi ༷ drag po'i thug 'phrad bzlog /ngan

gsum 'dzoms dus ldang ba'i sri rigs bzlog /bar gcod gdon bgegs nad rigs thams cad bzlog/ma mo'i dal yams lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul bzlog/btsan bdud bram kha rgyal bsen gnod pa bzlog/'byung ba'i dgra gshed lo yi bdun zur bzlog/spar kha'i dgu mig sme ba'i rtsub phreng bzlog/sa bdag rgyu ba phyogs ngan bdud gcod bzlog /lo zla zhag dang za ma'i skog sri bzlog /mdor na mi 'dod nyer 'tshe phyi nang dgra//thams cad snang bar byed pa'i dgra la bzlog/thams cad gnod par byed pa'i bgegs la skyoḥ//bh+yoḥbazlog 'phrin las dus bab sa ma ya//mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa//dus 'di bdag la bstsal du gsol//'khon dang bstan pa longs spyod rnams//rgyas par mdzod cig lha srung tshogs/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/gtor ma dngabasang la chab kyis ——bran la/ ma sbo tas bsangs/ su lha was sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las ji las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog lding rol bas brten pa 'dis/rgyal chen stag btsan don grub yum sras blon por gyur/oṃ ā ཿཿ/ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ oṃ a tā ro mu khaṃ sarba rnya rmaḥṇi āt+ya nut+pan+da twasta oṃ āḥrgyu phaṭa suhā/bdun nam nyer gcig sogs kyis bsngo/gong bzhin mchod la/'phrin las bcol ba ni/kyeḥ zhe la shas mtshan bod yul skyong ba'i lha//khe rgyal legs tshogs spel ba'i mthu stobs can//ge sar dgra lha'i rgyal po khyed nyid la/ /nged cag mchod cing bstod do 'phrin las —sgrubs//ce spyang stag gzig sna tshogaX ༷༷ brten pa'i//che zhing brtan brjid

lhun po'i rtse mo ni//je mthor dgung la bsnyegs pa'i pho brang la//nye bar brten bcas lha rgyal dgongs su gsol//te por bsang rdzas mchod gtor tshogs bshams nas//the tshom med pa'i yid kyis spyan drangs na//de ring bsten cing mchod pa'i gnas 'di ru//ne'u gsing ngang ba'i rgyal po 'phur bzhin byon//be dkar dkor mdzod lta bu'i mthun rdzas dang //tho zhes spyan 'dren dbyangs snyan rol mo'i sgra/bai ḍūr+ya lhun brtsegs bsang shing du ba'i sprin//me tog la sogs mchod tshogs rgya mtsho bzhes//rtse mo rno ldan 'od 'bar mtshon cha'i rigs//tshe thar g.yang phyugs rten rdzas mchod gtor rnams//dze reg med pa'i sems kyis 'bul ba 'dir//we ltar 'khri zhing 'dod pa'i 'phrin las sgrubs//zhe snang gdug pa'i sems 'chang dgra bgegs kyi//ze par 'phrin las drag po'i thog char phob//e phan thabs tshul brtson pa thams cad la//ye shes spyan gyis srung skyob 'phrin las mdzod//re zhing ltos pa'i yid kyis mchod bstod na//le lo btang snyoms med par bdag cag gi /shed mong rtsal stobs mnga' thang legs tshogs kun//se chen rgyal po'i dpal bzhin rgyas par mdzod//lha ru ka dpal 'jam mgon bla ma yi//e waṃ zung 'jug bstan pa'i snying bo mchog /'dzin la zla bral dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde'i//bshad sgrub legs tshogs 'phel bar mdzad du gsol//zhes 'phrin las bcol/drag tu bskul ba ni/6dzaḥ snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon che//rgyal chen stag btsan 'khor bcas kyis//mchod gtor rgya mtsho 'di bsdoX ༷//rnal 'byor bdag gi las 'di

sgrubs//khyed ni gdug pa'i 'khor mang zhing //sde brgyad dregs pa'i dpung re che//stobs dang drag rtsal mtha' yas pas//de ring drag po'i las la bskul//chas chas de ni dgra la chas//dgra bo'i yul du dmag la chas//dgra la mngon pa'i cho 'phrul thongs//dgra bo'i yul khams thal bar rlogs//gdug cing snang ba'i dgra bo 'dis//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' gsung bcag /dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang smad//nyes med sems can nyes su bcug /yi dam chos skyong khyad du bsad//lha dang srung ma brnyas shing smad//bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'joms//rnam dkar dge ba'i bar du gcod//khyad par bdag cag dpon slob dang /mi nor dge 'dun bcas pa la//'khu zhing 'tshe ba'i bsam pa yis//rtag tu gnod pa'i sbyor ba rtsom//res 'ga' dmag dang jag kha ston//'ga' zhig mnan gtad phur kha gtong //la lar 'dre gdon 'byung bo rbad//nor phyugs brku 'phrog byed la shoms//de 'dra'i nyes can gdug pa'i dgra//byung ngo ra mda'i dus la babs//de ring mchod do mthu ma chung //de ring bskul lo bang ma bul//de ring brngan no thugs ma g.yel//de ring rbad do rtsal ma zhan//nam mkha' yangs pa'i klong dkyil na//lho sprin nag po 'khrigs klong na//g.yu 'brug sgra sgrog glog dmar 'khyug/me rlung 'thab pa'i 'ur sgra ldir//chu rlung 'khrugs pas ser ba 'beb//gnam lcags thog gi tsha tsha 'phro//rtsub 'gyur 'bar ba'i shugs 'chang ba'i//sde brgyad dmag tshogs grangs med rnams//go khrab 'od 'bar lam se ༷///snatshon cha sna tshogs zengs se zengs//

'jigs pa'i sgra skad 'u ru ru//ki bswo ha lha'i sgra dang bcas//rngams pa'i gar stabs dpa' bo'i nyams//drag pos ltas dang cho 'phrul gyis//dgra yi steng du thog ltar rgyug /dgra bo'i yul khams mi nor dang //longs spyod kha rje dbang thang bcas//rtsad nas chod la drung nas phyung //thal ba'i rdul bzhin brlags nas ni//rjes med ming yang med par mdzod//bdag cag mi nor longs spyod bcas//mthu ldan srung ma khyed nyid la//gnyer du gtad do bdag mdzod la//mi mthun phyogs las rgyal bar mdzod/ /nyin gsum rgyang nas bya ra dang //mtshan gsum drung nas mel tshe mdzod//gzhi lam byes gsum thams cad du//bdag cag gar 'gro gar 'dug kyang //rgyab brten dgung gnyen mdzad du gsol//mdor na bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi/khyed la bsten cing mchod pa yis//'dod don ma lus lhun grub nas//dkar phyogs lha rnams rgyal gyur cig ces drag bskul 'di dmigs bsal gal can gyi skabs su ma gtogs mi 'don/de nas bsang chen btang zhing spro na dam pa gongams mdzad pa'i bsang gsol 'phrin bcol sogs kyang 'don cing gsar bsgrigs kyis bsang bsngo/ kyeḥ/bla ma yi dam mchog gsum gyi//thugs rje chos dbyings bden pa'i mthus//rgya chen bsang 'di mgron rnams kyi//dgyes byed mchod sprin 'byung gyur cig/gtsang zhing gtsang mar sbyar ba yi//bsang mchod rgya chen dam pa 'dis//drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma dang //yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs bsang / / phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad dang //chos dang theg gzhaX dge 'dun bsang //dpa' bo mkha'

'gro chos skyong dang /yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad bsang //khyad par dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gtso//rgyal chen stag btsan 'khor bcas bsang bsang mchod phul pa'i rten 'brel gyis//phog thug mnol grib sangs gyur cig /lha gnyan 'khor bcas dgyes gyur nas//mthun rkyen dngos grub kun stsol shog/ces lan gsum sogs kyis bsngo/de nas g.yang 'bod byed pa la/ phying dkar gyi steng du bre gtsang ma/ 'bras dkar ram nas kyis bkang ba la shug pa sogs 'bras bu can gyi shing gis kha brgyan cing / dbus su nor lha ci rigs kyi sku'am tsa ka li btsugs pa'i mdun du mda' dar me long gis brgyan pa gzugs/ de'i mdun du phye mar dang / dngos grub kyi rdzas tshogs pa tshang mar 'grem rgyu zas sna shing tog sogs ci rigs kyang sta gon byas te/oṃ aḥ//lan gsum brjod cing ye snyamatshar nyer gcig bzla/ de nas gtso bos mda' dar dang /tshogs pa thams cad kyi lag tu/ kha dar ram/ bsrung rtags dar tshon sogs g.yang gi 'bod dar ci rigs g.yob cing / chog 'don grwa ba rnams kyis dbyangs dang bcas te 'di ltar/ kyeḥ bsru med dkon mchog rin chen gsum//srid dang zhi ba'i rgyan du mdzes//bden pa de yis bdag cag la//legs tshogs phywa g.yang rgyas gyur cig/chos dbyings dag pa'i lha lam du//kun rdzob snang ba'i 'ja' tshon bkra//bla med snang stong tshogs pa'i g.yangan/de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//bslab khrims gtsang ma'i sa gzhi la//thos bsam sgom pa'i dpag bsam 'khrungs//don /nyisdu —'bras bu smin pa'i g.yang //de ring

'di ru g.yang la byon//lam ston mtshan ldan dge ba'i bshes//bka' sgrub rjes 'jug slob ma dang //bshad sgrub lung rtogs bstan pa'i g.yang /de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//phan bde'i rtsa ba rgyal ba'i bstan//kun tu dar zhing rgyas pa la//'gro la bde skyid 'byung ba'i g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//bstan la gus mchod lhur len pa'i//bstan pa'i sbyin bdag thams cad kyi//mnga' thang legs tshogs rgyas pa'i g.yangan/de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//steng phyogs tshe ring lha yi g.yangan/'dzam gling shes ldan mi yi g.yangan/'og phyogs klu yi 'byor ba'i g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon/ /'od gsal nyi ma bla ba'i g.yang //brtan brjid ri rab lhun po'i g.yang //'dzad med rgya mtsho chen po'i g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//dgos 'dod kun stsol yid bzhin nor//re ba skong ba'i dpag bsam shing //'dod dgu mi zad gter gyi g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//lugs gnyis blang dor shes pa'i blo/ /pha rol zil gyis gnon pa'i stobs//rtsal gyis dgra sde 'jom pa'i g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//dge ldan gnas dang grogs kyi g.yang //bde ster zas dang gos kyi g.yang //bsod nams longs spyod 'phel ba'i g.yangan/de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//yul mis dge ba bsgrub pa ga/yul gyi lha klu mthu stobs rgyas//yul khams bde ba'i rgyu yi g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//rgyu las 'bras bu 'byung ba yi//rten 'brel bslu ba med pa des//sde bzhi'i dga' ston rgyas paX gsang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//

rgyu 'bras phun sum tshogs pa des//chos bzhin sgrub pa'i rang phyogs kun//mi mthun phyogs las rgyal ba'i g.yang //de ring 'di ru g.yang la byon//mdor na bstan dang 'gro ba la//phan dang bde ba'i legs tshogs kun//deng 'dir phywa dang g.yang du len//g.yang chags mi 'gyur brtan par shog/lha dang srung ma'i byin mthu dang / /rnal 'byor bdag gi lhag bsam dang / /chos dbyings 'gyur med bden pa'i mthus//'dod don ma lus 'grub gyur cig/ ces pa dang / gzhan yang g.yang 'bod ci rigs 'don/'di gcig pu 'don pa'i tshe/g.yang chagasami 'gyur brtan par shog ces pa dang mnyam du mda' dar bres kyi nang du btsugs/mjug tu dngos grub kyi rdza tshogs pa tshang mar bkram nas longs spyod cing /mabusapa'i dngos grub ma lus zhes sogs brjod/de nas gtang rag gi bsang btang ste/bstod pa bya ba ni/ḍūkhu/sngon tshe bde skyid rdzogs ldan bskal ba'i dus//dge bcu'i lang tsho rgyas pa'i gnas yul 'di//bsod nams stobs kyis dbang ba'i mthu bo che/ /srid pa'i lha gnyan chen po khyed la bstod//rgyu yi dge tshogs du ma bsags pa'i mthus/ /dus 'dir dkar bo'i phyogs kun skyong ba la//dpag tu med pa'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul can//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gtso bo khyed la bstod//lha dang klu yi dpal dang 'byor ba'i tshogs//nam mkha' mdzod du bsnyil ba'i pho brang dbus//dregs pa'i 'khor la bka' yis dbang bsgyur ba//lha yi rgyal po chen po khyed la bstod//gser g.yu'i khri dang za 'og gdan gyi stengan/sku mdog dkar gsal nor bu bum bzang ba sna/sna//dar gyi na bza' rin chen rgyan

mang mdzes//'dod dgu'i gter bdag chen po khyed la bstod//res 'ga' rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan rta la bcibs//phyag g.yas mdung ring g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin/ /'khor du klu btsan dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bskor/ /sde brgyad dmag dpon chen po khyed la bstod//gzhan yang sku mdog phyag mtshan bzhon pa dang //ma nges rgyan dang cha byad sna tshogs 'chang //zhi dang khro bo'i rnam rol sna tshogs kyis//las bzhi'i 'phrin las thogs med khyed la bstod//dgyes bskyed gsang ba'i yum chen sman mo bzhi//lha yi sras po ming sring bka' yi blon//mdzod bdag dmag bskul dpung dang ser ba yi//ru 'dren nang gi 'khor tshogs rnams la bstod//chu mig lam srang ljon shing ri brag thang //kun la gnas shing rgyu ba'i lha klu btsan//gnyan gyi dmag tshogs stong sde khri 'bum sogs//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde tshogs kun la bstod//grub pa'i dbang phyug slob dpon pad+ma 'byung //sa chen yab sras rje btsun kurma pa//'jam mgon bla ma yab sras dang bcas pa'i//bka' la gnas pa'i srung ma khyed la bstod//khyad par stong skor mchog gi sprul ba'i sku//rim byon rnams kyis dpon slob sde dang bcas//srung zhing skyong bar bka' yis nyer gtad pa'i//bstan srung chen po khyed la gus pas bstod//dus kyi 'khrug pa kha smras gleng gzhi sogs//pha rol gnod pa'i tshogs kun zhi ba la//nus mthu thogs pa med pa'i dgra lha che//phyogs las rnam rgyal srung ma khyed la bstod/khyed la bstod cing mchod pa lhur len pa'i//bdag cag dpon slob 'a/sdu dang bcas pa la//gnas skabs chos

mthun legs tshogs 'phel ba dang / /gang 'dod 'phrin las tshul bzhin bsgrub par mdzod//ces bstod cing / gtang rag gi mchod bstod byas nas yig brgya bzla zhing bzod gsol bya/rten yod na/ dkar phyogs skyong ba 'khor bcas rnams//'dir ni rten dang lhan cig tso/brtan par bzhugs nas bdag cag la//'dod don 'phrin las bsgrub par mdzod//oṃ su pra taṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swāhā/ zhes brtan bzhugs bya zhing /shis pa brjod pa ci rigs pas mtha' brgyan par bya'o/ smras pa/dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon chen po la//mchod gsol bskang ba'i cho ga 'di bris pa'i//dge ba 'dis kyang 'jig rten thams cad du//phan dang bde ba'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cig/ ces rgyal chen stag btsan don grub kyi gsol mchod shin tu rgyas pa phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i sgra dbyangs zhes bya ba 'di ni/rnam dkar dge ba sgrub pa la gcig cabartson pa'i gzhan phan lhag bsam gyi mnga' bdag lha dang srung mas rjes su bzung ba'i rtogs —ldan chen po/ka drod sgom rgan tshang nas/yul phyogs 'di nyid kyi bstan 'gror phan bde rgyas pa dang / bar chad bzlog pa'i ched du 'di 'dra zhig khyed kyis 'bri dgos zhes gsung nan chen pos lha rdzas dang bcas lan du mar bskul cing /de phyogs kyi rgan pa bsam shes sangs rgyas skyabs dang / gzhan yang sngo kho 'ju lagatsho ba'i spyi dpon gnyis sogs lha lde — thun mong nas kyang bdog pa'i dngosapo dang bcasate nan tan gyis bskulaba'i ngor/khri zur sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi mas sa bya lo cho 'phul gyi bla ba'i yar tshes la sbyar ba 'dis kyang phan bde rgya chen po 'byung bar gyu/ sdog/

stag btsan la gsol mchod bya tshul dgos 'dod zang ci'i char rgyun/༄7//yul lha chen po stag btsan la bsang mchod 'bul bar 'dod pas/de yang gzhi gtsang ma'i steng du dkar gtor dang / bza' btung gtsang ma'i rigs ci 'byor/ snod gtsang ma gas chag med pa rnams kyi nang du bshams la/mda' dar spyan gzigs sogs ci 'byor bshams la chu gtsang bran/rang lha'i rnal 'byor bsgom pa sngon du btang la/kyeḥ/rab mdzes stag btsan zhes bya'i ri bo ni//rtsa ba tshang tshing nags kyis rnam par mdzes//rked pa g.yu yi ljang bu brtsegs pas mdzes//rtse mo sna tshogs shing sna'i tshul gyis mdzes//de ltar bsngags pa'i ri yi dbang bo de//phyi bltas sa 'dzin mthon po'i rnam pa la//dang du rin chen brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas khang //sa le sgram dang dngul gyi khri steng du/ /lha rje stag btsan don grub ces bya ba/ /sku mdog zla shel khu ba'i mdangs kyis chags/ /dbang sngon chu 'dzin dar gyi na bza' dang //mthon mthing ut+pal gsar ba'i kun nas mdzes//zla shel mdangs ldan phyag ring mdzes pa na//sna tshogs dar gyis spras pa'i rin chen dang //'chi med bdud rtsi'i bcud ldan bum pa bsnams/ /ma nges rgyan dang cha lugs sna tshogs 'chang //btsun mo bzhi dang bka' yi blon po bzhi/ /'khor tshogs rgya mtsho'i dbang dang bcas pa rnams//'phri/ ༷༷ thogs med bsgrub pa'i mthu stobs

kyis//da lta nyid du gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//mdun gyi nam mkhar yid 'ong mdzes pa'i dbus//sna tshogs dar gyis brgyan pa'i khri steng du/ /zla ba'i 'dzum dang bcas te bzhugs su gsol//byed po'i rnam 'phrul 'gog pa'i gdod ma'i gshis//sngags dang phyag rgya'i ze'u 'bru bkod pa las//rnam par smin pa'i nyer spyod zang rtsi'i rgyun//rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rtags rdzas brgyan//'dod yon lnga dang rin chen bdun la sogs//snang gter thig les brgyan pa'i mchod sprin tshogs//dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul nas 'bul//gzhan yang gser zhun 'khyil 'dra'i me dang du//rin chen sman dang gos dar 'bru sna bcas//bsregs pa'i du ba yongs su 'geng ba 'dis//yul lha 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes gyur cig/sngon gyi bsod nams brgya las grub pa yi//mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i lha rgyal khyed//bdag cag ma lus skyong ba'i rtsal mnga' ba//ma g.yel rtag tu bu bzhin skyong bar mdzod//gzhi lam byes gsum gar 'gro gang 'dug kyang //nam yang re zhing bltas tshe ma bslu bar//nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe dang //phar 'gro'i skyel ma tshur 'ong bsu ma mdzod//char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs rtag tu 'phel//me tog smin cing ji ༷cuda'abyis bu rgyas//kun ñtsha bde /nga /da pa'i longs spyod 'phel//phun — chagadī ༷༷ sdu/ / ༵༵༵ /bye /shā /sdu dpyo/rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/

dmar mtho'i gsol mchod/༄byu / /rang nyid skad cig gis 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyug tu gyur/oṃ ā rgyuḥ lan gsum brjod/ kyeḥ mdo smad yul gyi thig les mdzes pa'i rgyan//dmar mtho rdza ri dar dkar gur khang la//gnas bcas grags pa'i dbang phyug kun bzang mtshan/ /mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol//'brog gnas dpa' bo dar dkar na bza' can//rgyal mtshan mda' gzhu lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams//lha klu dkar phyogs skyong ba'i 'khor bcas la/ /dregs btsan 'gying stabs bgyis pa'i bzhugs su gsol/ /'od 'bar gser zhun 'khyil ba'i me nang du/ /sna tshogs bsang shing phye mar zas sna sogs/ /bsreg pa'i dud sprin 'dod yon lnga ldan pa'i/ /mthu ldan yul lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bdag cag dpon slob mi nor longs spyod bcas/ /'brog gnas yul lha'i rgyal po khyed nyid la/ /gnyer du gtad do 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ /mthun rkyen bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod//bstan srung dgra lha chen po 'khor bcas kyis//dge ldan bkra shis dar zhing rgyas pa'i gling //dpon slob sde dang bcas pa thams cad kyi//chos srid legs tshogasargyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//yul la bkra shis dus bzhi gshis lugs legs/ /mi la nad med sems mthun bde dga' rgyas/ /phyugs la dgra gnod gcan gzan nyer 'tshe zhi//rnam kun legs tshogs rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog/

dmar mtho'i bsang bsdus 'dod don kun 'grub/༄cu//rgyu/ bod khams skyong ba'i lha chen mthu bo che rig pa'i rtsal gyis sgron me sbar mdzad pa/slob dpon dmar mtho 'khor dang bcas rnams la/dkar mngar la sogs bsang rdzas dud sprin dang /slob khrid sbyang rtsom yo byad phul pa'i mthus/bdag dang rgyu sbyor yon bdag thams cad dang khyed la skyabs bcol slob bu ma lus par/'dod don sgrubs la re ba skongs gyur cig/ces pa 'di yang dad ldan slob bu mang bos re 'dod kyis bskul ngor/ sman rams pa'am sngags 'ching bsod nams tshe ring gis rab byung bcu drug pa'i shing pho stag gi lo'i dbyar tha zla ba'i tshes bco lnga'i nyin dmar mtho'i dbu rtser gsol mchod la phyin skabs —mos gusakyis phul pa'o/

rab bzang gi gsol kha/ga / oṃ su nyi/ 'dir rab bzang zhes pa'i gzhi bdag la gsol mchod bya bar 'dod pas spyan gzigs bshams/ bsang dud btang / chu gtsang gis bran/ rang yi dam gang rung gi nga rgyal la gnas pa'i ngang nas/ byin rlabs byas las 'di skad/ kyiḥ 'ju lag yul gyi ri bo rab bzang ni/ /ljon shing phreng bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus//za 'og nag po'i gur khang mdzes pa la//smad zhol rab dmar dar la byas pa'i nang //gnas nas dkar phyogs skyong ba'i yul lha che//gnyan chen rigs ldan rgya mtsho mthu rtsal can//dkar la smug pa'i mdangs ldan zhi ma khro//sku la za 'og ber chen nag po'i steng / /dar sna'i sho bsgrigs las byas stod g.yogs mdzes/ /dbu la gser zhwa rgod kyi ldem 'phru can/ /dar dmar cod paṇa 'phur lding g.yo ba gsol//phyag g.yas mdung rnon rnga thub sngo ljang can//ba dan mthing nag 'ja' ris kyis spras bsnams//g.yon pa'i phyag gis lcags kyu zhags pa bsnams//mi bzad ral gri mda' gzhu glo la btags//rta nag gser sga rin chen rgyan ldan zhon/ /yum chen klu mo bzang mo dung gi mdog /sku smad sbrul mjug phyag g.yas sbrul zhags 'dzin//g.yon na gser gzhong rin chen bkang ba bsnams//dbu skra thor tshugs me tog phreng bas spras//mthing dag dar gyi stod g.yo/ // g.yog gsol//rin chen sna tshogs

rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan//brang 'gro kha dog lnga yi gdengs ka byas//zhi 'dzum ldan zhing dwangs bsil rdzing bur bzhugs//mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i yab yum gyi//'khor du klu gnyan sa bdag lha btsan sogs//'dzum khro dpa' gtum sna tshogs gzugs 'chang ba//rnam mang gis bskor gzhan yang 'dab chags rigs//stag seng sbrul dang ri dgas sna tshogs sogs//sprul 'khor dpag tu med pa'i tshogs bcas rnams//deng 'dir bdag gis mchod phyir spyan 'dren no//rings par gshegs la dgyes bzhin brtan par bzhugs//ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i//dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs rnams bzhes//bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin bza' bca' btung ba'i rigs//ri ltar spungs shing mtsho ltar bskyil nas 'bul//bzang bo'i sman spos phye mar shing sna'i tshogs//bsregs pa'i dud sprin stong gsum gang bas bsang //snyan pa'i glu dbyangs mdzes pa'i gar la sogs//ngo mtshar ldan pa'i mchod pa sna tshogs dang //rnam mang rin chen gos dar pags rigs dang //go mtshon bzhon pa srog chags sna tshogs dang //sman sna me tog sna tshogs 'bru sna sogs//mthun rdzas tshogs kyis nam mkha' bkang ste 'bul//'dod yon kun ldan mchod tshogs 'di bzhes la/ /rgyal ba'i bstan dang de 'dzin tshogs bcas la//bar chad nyer 'tshe gnod pa kun zhi zhing //legs tshogs dbyar gyi chu gter ltar 'phel mdzod//bye brag chos sde bkra shis dar rgyas gling //dad shis brtson ldan skyes bus yongs bkaX /sa//rnam dkar bya ba gong du 'phel

ba dang / /nam yang mi g.yo rab tu brtan par mdzod/ /phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i skye rgu'i tshogs spyi dang //khyad par bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi//mi nor mtha' dag bu bzhin skyong ba dang //'dod pa'i don kun lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod//dgra jag gdon bgegs nad dang rims la sogs/ /mi 'dod rkyen ngan gnod pa kun zhi zhing //rnam dkar las dang rigs rgyud rgyu nor sogs//legs tshogs mtha' dag 'phel bar mdzad du gsol/ de nas rjes chog rnams spyi ltar bya'o/zhes pa 'di yang rig pa 'dzin pa stong skor ngag dbang bsod nams rgya mtshos chu bya'i hor zla drug pa'i tshes lnga la sbyar ba'o/༄༄ / /sdig sbyong sgrib sel rdo rje sems dpa' dang / /gdengs can sa gnyan kha gnon klu yi dbang / /yams nad 'joms la dpa' ba'i lo gyon ma//lhag pa'i lha mchog gsum la gus phyag 'tshal/lhag pa'i lha mchog gsum gyi gzungs/

lha gnyan chen po rab bzang la gsol mchod kyi cho ga phan bde'i char 'bebs/༄byu //na mo gu ru rat+na tra yā ya//kun bzang rigs brgya'i khyab bdag rdo rje 'chang //byin rlabs gter gyur yi dam dkyil 'khor lha//mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho sras bcas kyis//thugs rje bslu med shis pa'i dngos brgya stsol//bka' rtags phyag rgyas srid gsum dregs pa kun//zil gnon rgyal ba'i dbang bo pad+ma 'byung //blo bzang mkhyen pa'i gter dang dbyer med pa'i//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas te//mdo smad yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum zhes//grags pa'i dang tshan dkar phyogs skyong ba'i rje//gnyan chen rig ldan rgya mtsho mnyes byed pa'i//cho ga phan bde spel ba'i thabs su 'god/ 'di la thog mar bca' shom gyi rim pa ni/zan gtsang ma sha khrag gla rtsi sogs kyis ma sbag par chu gtsang dang dkar gsum gyis brdzis pa'ingon bshos/bangarim bzhi ba steng du dkar gtor rtse mo nor bu'i tog sogs mar rgyan gyis ci mdzes su spras pa/ steng gi gru bzhir mar gyi ril bu bzhi/phyogs bzhir 'o ma zho mngar gsumachang gi kham phor ting lo lta bu bzhi/bang rim steng ma'i ngos su dra badra byed/ gnyis pa'i ngos su bkra shis rtags brgyad/gsum par rgyal srid sna bdun/bzhi bar rin chen sna bdun nam nor bu sogs kyi rgyan mar dkar gyis bzos pa gang mdzes dang /de'i g.yas phyogs su dkon mchog spyi'i gtor ma ma gtor pad 'dab can dang g.yon du sde brgyad spyi gtor dkar gtor ril bus bskor ba dang zhal zas gtor cog bcas bshams/gzhan yang zangs sogs kyi sdod gtsang mar 'o ma la mngar gsum btab pa'i mngar skyems/ ja su/ ༷ sdu/ra sogs rin po che'i bye ma bsres pa'i

gser skyems/chu gtsang la sman sna btab pa'am ra dkar mo'am ba dmar gyi 'o ma la klu —sman ci rigs btab pa'ismanaskyems/chang la 'bru sna bsres pa'am chang gar ma gcig pu'i zhal skyems sogs btung ba'i bye brag zho 'o mjadakar chab sman sogs kyi mchod pa dang /nyer spyod lnga/ gzhan yang bkrashis rtags ngas rgyal srid sna bdun sogs kyi bris 'bur bcas dang / gye mar/ shagatsangabatsos ma/ bud 'khur ba shing tog sogs zas sna gang 'dzoms/ rta g.yag mdzo 'bri ra lug sogs g.yang phyugs rnams kyang nye 'khor du bkram pa bcud kyi spyan gzigs su gul te spar rang gi longs spyod du rung bas stabs bde na de dag dang /lha bsang gi yobyadadang /rnga rol dang /sil snyan rol mo gang rigs kyang 'dir bya —zhing /mchod gtor rnams bkod pa gang mdzes su bsgrigs te bshams/bsang dud cher btang la/ skyabs 'gro semasabaskyed yi dam gang byed kyi lha'i rnal 'byor rgyas bsdus ci rigs sam/skad cig dkrong bskyed lta bu sngon du btang ste mchod gtor bsang rdzas spyan gzigs bcas par chu gtsangagis bran la/ las sngags gang yin cho ga badz+ra ma sbo ta ku lis sngags kyis bsangs/ subha was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las bsang rdzas mchod gtor spyan gzigs rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba/ bla ma yi dam mchog gsum chos srung rnams dang lha klu sde brgyad mthu chen spyi dang / khyad par dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon lha gnyan chen po rig ldan rgya mtsho 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mnyes par byed pa'i mchod gtor bsang rdzas spyan gzigs sogs zag med 'dod dgu'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin du zad mi shes pa 'byung bar gyur cig sarba bid gu ra gu ra sogs sngagasadrug phyag rgya drug gi byin gyis brlabs la bden stobasabarjod de mos pa bzhin 'byung bar bsam/ de nas zhing khyad par can dkon mchog gsum gyi yon tan dran pa'i dad gus dang bstan 'gro yongs dang /rang gzhan la phan 'dod kyi bsamapa rgya chenapo dang bcas thog mar byin 'bebs — 97

ni/ 6 lhun 'grub 'phrin las nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas//gang 'dul sprul ba'i gsang gsum sprin gyi phreng / /gdul bya'i re skong byin rlabs char 'bebs pa'i//mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho dgongs su gsol//byin rlabs gter chen thub dbang rdo rje 'chang / /sras mchog rnam gnyis byin rlabs brgyud pa bzhi'i//smin grol gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin 'phags bod kyi//ji snyed mkhas dang grub pa'i tshogs rnams dang //khyad par grub pa'i dbang phyug thod phreng rtsal//phul byung zhabs dang 'jam mgon blo bzang grags//skyabs gcig rgya mtsho bdun brgyud rim byon bcas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs//chos sku dbyer med dbyings las ye shes kyi//rnam rol gzugs sku 'ja' tshon ltar bkra ba//bde gshegs rigs lnga yi dam rgyud sde bzhi//dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho'i lha tshogs gnas 'dir gshegs//zhi rgyas dbang drag 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi'i//gang 'dul sku yi rol ba sna tshogs kyis//'gro ba'i don mdzad ye shes srung ma'i tshogs/ /dam can chos srung rgya mtsho gnas 'dir gshegs/ /snod bcud gzigs shing gshegs pa'i dus ngan yang / /bdag cag dad mos gdung bas gsol 'debs na/ /dman dang nyam thag 'gro la cher brtse ba'i//dmigs med thugs rje'i shugs kyis nyer dgongs te//dus la bkra shis gza' skar 'dzoms pa dang / /gnas la g.yang chags dge mtshan rgyas pa dang //mchod rdzas 'dod dgur 'char ba'i ngo mtshar gyis//byin rlabs dngos grub char chen 'bab tu gsol// oṃ gu ru bu bo rnyi sa twa sarba sid+dhi me bra ya ts+tsha a be sha ya a/zhes pa'isngags rol mo dang bcas tebadun nam gsum sogs brjod pasabyin rlabs bya/de nas spyan 'dren sogs bsang mchod — mi

dngos gzhi ni 'di ltar/cha 'dzam gling snod bcud yangs pa'i byang gi phyogs//kha ba can ljongs mdo smad skyid pa'i yul//byang rong chu klung skal ldan shing rta'i 'gram//dge mtshan phreng ba ngoms pa'i yul gyi char//lha yi pho brang sa 'dzin rab bzang zhes//glang chen bres su nyal 'dra'i ri bo la//gnas bcas dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon che//gnyan chen rig ldan rgya mtsho spyan 'dren no//char sprin mkha' la 'phyo ba'i rta mchog ni//rin chen sga srab rgyan ldan la bcibs nas//dpa' brjid mdzes pa'i rnam rol du ma yi//dgyes pa'i nyams kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//bka' yi las sgrub 'dun gros dbang ba'i sgron/ /gter gyi srung ma mdzod 'dzin phyugs kyi bdag/dregs pa'i pho nya mngag gzhug phyag brnyan sogs//rnam mang 'khor tshogs dang bcas gnas 'dir gshegs//yum chen klu mo bzang mo dung gi mdog /rin chen rgyan ldan mdzes chags nyams kyis sgeg /lha klu'i na chung sman mo'i 'khor dang bcas//yid 'phrog dgyes pa'i gar dang bcas te gshegs//lha yi sras po ming sring gzhon nu'i tshogs//sna tshogs rgyan dang phyag mtshan bzhon pa sogs//ma nges cir yang snang ba'i tshogs rnams kyang //sna tshogs sprul ba'i gar dang bcas te gshegs//gzhan yang yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum dang //nye ba'i khor yug gnas pa'i lha klu btsan//sde brgyad dkar phyogs skyong ba thams cad kyangan/spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//mkha' la sprul bsgyur bkod pa lhags se lhags//bar snang sde brgyad tshogs mang khrigs se khrigs//sa gzhir dga' ba'i bro gar 'khrabs se 'khrabs//'a 'ur snyan pa'i sgra dang bcas te gshegs//rang rang dgyed ༷sdo gdan la legs bzhugs te//zab

zab sngags dang phyag rgya bden stobs kyis//gang gang 'dod dgur 'char ba'i mchod tshogs rnams//'dzum 'dzum dgyes pa'i nyams kyis bzhes su gsol/ zhes spyana'adren gdan 'bul rnams byas te/ mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ rgyuḥsdig med dge ba'i kun slong las skyes pa'i//lha khyed dgyes pa skyed byed mchod pa'i sprin//dag byed gtsang ma'i mchod yon rgyan bzang 'bab//sna tshogs me tog mdangs bkra lo 'dab rgyas//dri zhim spos kyi dud sprin mkha' lam khyab//rab 'bar sgron me 'od zer phyogs brgyar 'phro/ /dri bzang bsgos pa'i chu gtsang byugs pa'i dri//lha mi'i ro brgya ldan pa'i zhal zas tshogs//gdangs snyan rol mo rna ba'i bcud len 'gyed//yid 'ong nyer spyod tshogs kyi mchod pa 'bul/ a nas shasnya bra ti ts+tsha rdu swāhā/ gzhan yang yid 'phrog gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra//bde ster dri yis byugs pa ro brgya'i zas//'jam mnyen reg bya yid lus dbang bo la//dga' bskyed 'dod pa'i yon tan kun kyang 'bul//oṃ rū pa nas spar+sha pra tits+tsha hūṃ swāhā//rin chen snod du legs gtam zag med kyi//bdud cir byin rlabs gtor ma gser skyems dang //dkar gsum mngar gsum bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs//bsang shing dud sprin 'dod dgu'i mchod pa 'bul//a skṛ ta ba lo ta gu dza sa swāhā// rgyuḥ mthu ldan dkar slo phyogs skyong ba sde bcas rnams// grub dbang rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyis//bka' bsgos dam tshig dgongs te bdag cag gis//gang bcol 'phrin las bsgrub la ma g.yel zhig/ ces dam tshig bsgo de nas bskang gsol sogs rgyas tsam byed na bskang rdzas byin rlabs ni/bsang sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa ༷༷ snang ba'i bskang rdzas mchod gtor

spyan gzigs rnams bla ma yi dam chos srung rnams dang / lha gnyan dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon chen po 'khor bcas mnyes par byed pa'i mchod sprin 'dod dgu zad mi shes pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin can 'byung bar gyur/oṃ sarba pud snu ra smu ra sogs sngags drug phyag rgya drug gi byin gyis brlabs shing /bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang gisogs kyi bden stobs brjod de de dang mthunapa'i mos pa shugs drag po bya zhing /rol mo dang bcas te 'di ltar/ kyeḥ bde stong dbyer med nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor nas//ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya'i sprin dkrigs te//'dod dgu'i mchod tshogs char rgyun 'bebs pa yis//mchod yul rgya mtsho'i zhing kun bkang gyur cig/ rin chen gser dngul 'od 'bar snod yangs su//bshos bu gtsang sbyor yid 'ong rgyan gyis spras//bza' bca' btung ba'i phud kyis legs gtams pa'i/ /dam rdzas bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gtor tshogs dang //phyi dang nyer spyod 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga//bdud ci'i sman chab dkar gsum gtsang ma'i phud//mngar gsum skyems dang 'bru bcud btung ba dang //ro brgya'i zas mchog 'dod yon lnga ldan gyis//bla ma yi dam bstan srung tshogs rnams dang //gnyan chen rigs ldan rgya mtsho yum sras blon//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang //nyams chag sos shing 'dod don bsgrub par mdzod//cang shes sprin gyi thugs ldan rta mchog tshogs/ /rin chen sga srab ze long rgyan gyis spras/ /sprin phung dum bur chad 'dra'i g.yag rog tshogs//rngam pa'i sgra sgrogs rwa rtse gnam du mtho//za le 'bri tshogs 'o ma'i rgyun 'jo ba'i//rtsi bcud dkar gsum 'dod pa'i dpal sbyin 'dis//lha srung dkar phyogs skyong ༷༷ sdigs dam bskang //'jam pa'i spu

tshogs sprin dkar phung bo la//'ja' tshon mdangs ldan dar gyi cod paṇa mdzes//snyan pa'i dbyangs sgrog lha lug dkar bo dang /ra skyes spu yi gos ldan rgyan gyis spras// stobs kyis 'dod dgu sgrub la mthu ldan pa'i//khyu mchog bzhin pa sna tshogs 'dod 'jo'i ba//la sogs snod kyi rgyan gyur g.yang phyugs rnams//dbang bo kun tshang yid 'ong dga' skyed kyis//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i dbang phyug thugs dam bskang //lha rdzas ri mo rnam bkra za 'og gos//'ja' sprin tshon gyis mdzes pa'i na bza' dang //lha klu mi yi 'byor ba'i snying bo las//grub pa'i sna tshogs rin chen rgyan phreng dang //'od 'bar g.yul las rnam rgyal gser gyi khrab//khyung gi ding ri 'ur ldem btsan po'i rmog /pha rol zil gnon 'khor gsum dpa' bo'i chas/ /dgra 'joms mtshon cha rno ngar gzi ldan tshogs//tshar du dngar ba'i spyan gzigs tshogs rnams kyis//dgra lha dkar phyogs skyong ba'i thugs dam bskang //drag shul rtsal ldan stag gzig gcan gzan dang /gdug pa'i 'dab chags tshogs kyis gshog rtsal ngom//sna tshogs ri skyes bag phebs rtsed 'jos rol//byi'u'i tshogs ni skad snyan glu dbyangs len//sa yi rgyan gyur rtsishing ljon pa'i nags//lo 'dab g.yur za me tog 'dzum phreng bzhad//nam mkha'i rgyan gyur sprin sngon dbang bo gzhu//snyan pa'i sgra sgrog bdud rtsi'i char rgyun 'bebs//yid la dga' bskyed snod bcud 'byor ba yis//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon thugs dam bskang //rtsibs stong 'khor lo yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal//bde ster btsun mo tha snyad mkhas pa'i blon/ /theg chen glang bo rdzu 'phrul shugs 'chang rta//'byor ba'i mdzod 'dzin khyim bdag rgyal srid bdun//—ri/ rden gdugs sogs bkra shis rtags

rdzas brgyad//gter bum 'dod 'jo'i ba dang dpag bsam shing //mda' dar me long sna tshogs rin chen dbyig/'dod dgu'i mchod zhin dam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo//bye ste dkar phyogs skyong ba'i thugs dam bskang //shug pa ba lu a kur mkhan pa sogs//dri zhim ngad ldan spos shing bsregs pa yis//steng 'og bar gsum mnol grib sel pa la//nus pa khyad par ldan pa'i du ba'i sprin//lha lam phyogs kyi 'khor lo khyab pa yis//'dod yon kun tshang rgya chen bsang mchod dang //dngos bshams yid sprul sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin//'dod dgu ci yang 'char ba sna tshogs 'dis/ /bla ma yi dam mthu ldan bstan srung dang / /gnyan rje dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon che//rig ldan rgya mtsho dkar phyogs skyong tshogs kyi//thugs dam gnyan po bde stong dbyings su bskangs//bstan dang bstan 'dzin yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi//nyams chag sos shing bar chad zhi ba dang //'dod don legs tshogs lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod/ ces bskang ba bya zhing /bsang brngon gtong bar 'dod na/gtor ma kha gso/bsang dud cher btang /gye mar dang gser skyems bshamasal/ma sbo tas bsang dang /oṃ lha'irgyudang sarba pid gu ra gu ra sogs namamakha' mdzod kyi sngags rgyas byin gyis brlabs la/brngon gyer ba ni/ kyeḥ rnam dag chos dbyings bden pa yis//byin rlabs mchod tshogs 'dod dgu'i sprin//bsang mchod rgya chen dang bcas pa'i//lha srung dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs//spyi dang yul skyong lha gnyan gyi//rje bo dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gtso//lha gnyan rig ldan rgya mtsho che//'khor bcas brngan zhing mchod 'dir dgongs//'bru sna'i phye ma bcud bzang gis/ /gcig bsdus bdud phyir byin brlabs pa//zag me da bsdo ster gtor ma yis//dkar phyogs

skyong ba khyed rnams brngan//bdag cag yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi//phyi nang bar chad zhi ba dang //mthun rkyen 'dod pa'i dngos po kun//'bad med 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//bshos bu gtsang stor bkra shis pa'i//rtags mtshan rgyan gyis mdzes pa 'dis/ /lha khyed brngan no bdag cag la/ /dge mtshan rten 'brel rgyas par mdzod//rgyal srid bdun sogs 'dod khams kyi//srid 'byor snying bo'i tshogs kyis brngan//bdag cag dpal 'byor mnga' thang gi / dbang phyug 'thob pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /rta nor lug sogs g.yang phyugs rigs//mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan tshogs kyis brngan//rgyu sbyor yon gyi bdag po yi//gnag phyugs 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//nas 'bras gro sran khre ma sogs/ /'bru sna bzang dgu'i tshogs kyis brngan/ /bdag cag yon mchod thams cad la//nor 'bru 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//srab 'jam gos dang rin chen rgyan//'dod dgu'i phyag mtshan bzhon pa dang //sna tshogs chas gos zhwa lham sogs//mkho dgu'i nyer spyod tshogs kyis brngan//'khur ba sha thud bza' ba dang //shing thog 'bru yos bca' ba'i rigs//ja chang 'o zho btung bas brngan/ /zas sna 'dod dgus tshim par mdzod/ /gser dngul mu tig be+eḍūr+ya//byu ru g.yas su 'khyil ba sogs//nor bu rin chen tshogs kyis brngan//dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i rten 'brel skyongs//'bras chang rgun chang dkar mngar skyems//gser skyems bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshos brngan//bzhes nas snod bcud phun tshogs kun//dbang du 'du ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//ri skyes gdug can bya glag khra//dgra 'joms mtshon cha drag po'i chas//mthu ldan dmar chen gtor mas brngan//bstan dgra gdu/ ༷/ brlag par mdzod//'dod dgu'i

mdzod kyi sgo bye nas//gtor ma bdud rtsi bsang mchod dang //yo byad sna tshogs phul pa 'di//bzhes nas rgyu sbyor bdag cag la//nad rims dgra jag chom rkun dang //btsan sad than pa 'khrug rtsod dang //gcan gzan gdug pa'i nyer 'tshe sogs//mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzod/ /mi la mnga' thang legs tshogs rgyas//phyugs la yar 'phel 'dod dgu 'byung //lo legs bde skyid phun tshogs pa'i/ /'phrin las rtag tu ma g.yel mdzod/ de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/chas lan gsum/oṃ gu ru bu bo rnyi sa twa ki ni shri sarba rnyarma bā la sa pa ri wā ra i rda bā ling ta kha kha khā gyi khā gyi/ lan gsum sogs/oṃ ma nas shag bra ti ts+tsha / thugs rje'i bdag nyid rtsa brgyud bla ma dngan/yi dam lha tshogs skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs//skyabs yul dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal bstod//cham hā ku chag ra yā ṇa sa bā ri wā ra na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta a wā lo ki te oṃ sa bha ra saṃ bha ra skye/lan gsum bdun cu sogs kyisabasngol/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di//gnyan chen rig ldan rgya mtsho che//yum sras blon 'khor bcas pa dang / /dkar phyogs lha klu'i tshogs la 'bul/ /bzhes nas rnal 'byor dpon slob kyi//'dod don rnam dkar legs tshogs rnams//tshul bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las dang / /sdongs grogs gnas po bzang bo mdzod//bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// zhes pa nas/ thogs pa med pa 'byung gyur cig/ ces gtor bsngos dang 'phrinabacolasogs kyang bya'o/g.yang 'bod bya bar spro na g.yang ngas dang dngosagrub kyi rdzas sam/zas sna gang 'byor bshams la/oṃ āḥ dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags brjod/bla ma lha srung rnams kyi sku las 'od zer — —03—

dmar bo lcags kyu lta bu/ steng 'og bar gsum kun tu 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i snad bcud legasatshogs thams cadadagos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu rin chen sna tshogs kyi rnam par bkug ste lha gnyan chen po'i pho brang gi nang khor yug kun dang /yul 'di'i gnas gzhi 'brog khyim/phyugs lhasar ba gnas khang bang mdzod thams cad gang ba gyur/bar mos la/ oṃ ye rnya rmā he tu bra bha bā nye turnye ṣan+ta thā ga to h+ya ba data/ te ṣāñtsa yo ni ro d+dha e waṃ wā dri ma hā shra ma ṇaḥ ci 'grub bzla zhing mda' dar tshon sna lnga 'am/dar dkar kyi g.yab mo dang bcas 'di ltar/ kyeḥ phun tshogs bkra shis 'khyil ba'i gnas mchog 'dir//'dod pa'i mchog ster phywa dang g.yang gi tshogs/ /khab len rdo dang lcags kyi snang tshul bzhin/ /dga' ba'i gar dang bcas te thogasamed khug /gser mngal mgrin sngon 'khor lo'i lag pa can//grags pa'i mu 'khyud 'khor lo'i bsgyur ba sogs/ /srid 'dir mngon par mtho ba'i tshogs rnams kyi//phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol//legs bris tshogs kyi 'chi med btung ba dang //klu dbang gtsug gi yid bzhin nor bu mchog /mi dbang sngon 'gro'i rgyal srid sna bdun gyi//phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol//rin chen gdugs dkar gsor nya bum pa bzang //pad+ma dung dkar g.yas 'khyil dpal be'u sogs//rgyal mtshan 'khor lo bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi/ /phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol//rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras po'i bkra shis pa'i//dngos por byin rlabs dge legs 'byung ba'i sgo//rten 'brel lhun gyis grub pa'i rdzas brgyad kyi//phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol//tshe ring nad med 'dod pa'i don kun 'grub//stobs dang mnga' mthaX ༷byor ba phun sum tshogs//bde zhing

skyid pa'i dga' ston thams cad kyi//phywa g.yang dpal 'byor snyan grags ma lus stsol//lan gcig gam gsum/mthun pa'i dngos grub ma lus pa//dus 'dir bdag la bstsal tu gsol//'khor dang bstan pa longs spyod rnams//rgyas par mdzod cig yul lha'i tshogs/ /'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos pa'i/ /yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing //sems can re ba bskang mdzad pa'i//bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog/ces bya'o/de nas snyan pa'i gyer dbyangs kyis bstod pa bya ba ni/ kyi chos nyid ma bcos ka dag klong yangs su//gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor phyi nang snod bcud kyi//bkod pa ya thog ring mo'i drang srong che//deng dus lha gnyan tshul 'dzin khyed la bstod//mchog gi zhing la bsgrun pa'i dge tshogs kyi//'bras bus tshe dang longs spyod bsod nams dang / /mthu ske stobs rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med pa yis//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mnga' thang dgung du bstod//sngon dus srid pa chags pa'i bskal ba la//lha klu mi gsum gcig mthun bsod nams las//snod bcud dge mtshan rgyas pa'i yul spu 'dir//dbang bsgyur dregs pa'i dbu 'phang gnyan po bstod//brgya byin lha yi dbang bos 'dzam gling gi/dregs pa yongs la bka' rtags bstsal ba'i tshe//mdo smad yul 'dir ma 'ongs dus rnams su//gnas 'dzin srung skyob bskos pa khyed la bstod//rang snang bsod nams las grub gzhal yas na//bde ba'i yo byad snod bcud phun tshogs la//dbang bsgyur dregs pa'i sde dpon rab bzang zhes//yul lha'i sde dpon chen po khyed la bstod//gna' dus bon ston sems dpa' che rnams kyis//'gro la phan bde spel phyir g.yung drung gi /theg pa rim dgus blang dor ston pa'i tshe //riXn rabs bka' bzhin 'jig rten

skyong la bstod//dkon mchog gsum gyi byin rlabs thugs rje'i mthu//dus su smin pas gtan bde sgrub pa yi/ /blang dor ma nor snang ba gsal ba'i tshe/ /dkar phyogs skyong ba'i mthu ldan khyed la bstod//grub pa'i gtsug rgyan rgyal dbang pad+ma'i bka'//dregs pa zil gnon rdo rje'i re khā yis//snang srid yongs la phyag rgyas btab pa'i tshe//bka' grub phyag brnyan chen po khyed la bstod/ /'khor 'das dbyings su ro gcig phyag rgya che//bde stong ye shes mngon gyur grub pa'i dbang / /chos rje kurma'i bka' srung mthu rtsal can/ /gsang chen bstan pa'i srung ma khyed la bstod//blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa'i 'khrul bral bstan//nor 'dzin snang ba'i rgyan du shar ba na//gru 'dzin bdag po yab sras brgyud bcas kyi//bka' gnyan bstan srung chen po khyed la ci bstod//dkyil 'khor bdag po bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde//sku phreng snga phyi rim byon la sogs pa'i /dam pa du mas yul gyi srung ma cher//mnga' gsol lha yi rgyal po khyed la bstod/khyed kyi sku yi rnam 'gyur bgrang yas kyang //rta nag rin chen sga srab rgyan mdzes steng //rgyal ba'i ru mtshon yid bzhin nor bu 'dzin//dkar gsal dpa' brjid nyams kyi sgeg la bstod//za 'og dar gyi na bza' lhab lhub dang //nor bu'i cod paṇa yid 'ong rgyan gyis mdzes//mnga' thang dgung du mtho bas snang srid la//dbang bsgyur dregs pa'i gar gyis rol la bstod//yum chen klu mo rab dkar nor bu 'dzin//mdzes sdug nyams can sna tshogs rgyan gyis spras//bde ster 'dod pa'i sgyu rtsal ngom pa yis//dregs pa'i yid 'gugs dpal mo khyed la bstod//lha yi sras po ming sring gzhon nu'i tshogs/ /sna tshogs rnam 'gyur 'do/ /sna'i phyag mtshan 'dzin/ /dar gyi na

bza' rin chen rgyan dang bcas//rab dga'i rtsed 'jor rol ba kun kyang bstod//gzhan yang 'khor gnas dregs pa'i lha srin tshogs//zhi drag ma nges rnam 'gyur sna tshogs can/ /las mthun nyer spyod phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'chang //gang bcol 'phrin las thogs med rnams la bstod/ kyeḥ dge ldan yul lha'i gtso bo gnyan gyi rje//bdag cag rnams la skyob byed dgra lha che//rtag ca'abral med srung ma khyed bsten na//brtse zhing gdung ba'i dbang gis snying ma ring //glo bur 'dod pa'i 'phrin las bcol ba'i phyir//gsol mchod bos pa'i tshe na snyan ma sra/ /kha 'dzin rgyab brten las sgrub brda thabs su/ /dar dkar g.yab pa'i tshe na spyan ma bskyod//drag myur 'phrin las skabs su babs pa na//bskul ba'i tshig bzhin bsgrub la bang ma bul//rnam dkar bar du gcod pa'i snang dgra la//tshar gcod drag po'i nus mthu rtsal ma zhan//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i spyan sngar khas blangs bzhin//bdag cag srung skyob 'phrin las ma g.yel zhig/khyad par yul 'di'i skye dgu'i phan bde'i gzhi//bkra shis dar zhing rgyas pa'i chos kyi gling //bslab gsum bshad sgrub gong 'phel mthun pa'i rkyen//ma lus yid bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//yul 'dir mi phyugs nyer 'tshe nad rims dang / /dgra gcan gdug pa'i gnod pa kun zhi zhing /char chu dus su 'bab cing lo legs sogs//bde skyid dga' ston dar ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//mi rnams ya rabs rigs rgyud rgyun bzang zhing //phyugs la g.yang 'phel gang bsam 'dod dgu 'byung //zhing sar lo 'bras rtsi bcud yongs smin nas//kun kyang rnam dkar gsos su 'gyur bar mdzod//mdor na gang bcol 'phrin las 'di dag rnaX/—/ji bzhin bsgrubs nas bdag cag

yon mchod la//rtag tu rnam par dkar ba'i legs tshogs kyis//dpal 'byor rgyun mi 'chad pa'i bkra shis stsol ces bstod cing 'phrin las bcogade nas yodag pa'i nyes spyod spyi dang /khyad par mchod gtor bsang ngas ji bzhin ma 'byor ba dang ser sna 'bag btsog sogs kyi nor 'khrul zugs 'gal zhi phyir yig brgya ba zhing / bdag cag rmongs 'khrul nyes pa'i dbang gyur las//'khor 'das mchod yul gnyan po khyed rnams kyi//thugs 'gal spyi dang mchod rdzas 'bags sogs kyis//nyes kun bzod par bzhes shing brtse bas dgongs/ de nas gshegs gsol ni/ lkomuḥ dbyings rigs rtsal gyis mkha' la chu 'dzin bzhin//rang snang sgyu ma'i rnam rol snang srid mgron//kun kyang dgyes pa'i gar gyis gdod ma'i gshis//cir yang 'char ba'i rang rang gnas su gshegs//ces gshegs su gso zhing shis brjod kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o//deng dus mchog dman phal cher lha srung la//gsol mchod 'phrin las bcol la ches brtson phyir//lha 'dir bsten pa'i dad ldan mchod gzhi yis//bskul las nyer mkho don tshang tshul du bris//dge bas yul skyong thugs la dga' bskyed cing //yul mi rnam dkar nor gyis phyug gyur na~X/ / /ra ba ba/ ldan thabs 'dis 'gro kun la//byang chub mchog gi dgaswā ༷ / ga/ / snro/ po ༷ba/ bzangalagasolamachod kyi cho ga phan bde'i char 'bebs /sna //nga kārdodī dīr+sha/ rnyi dīX rdo/ dītādri /bas tshang tsho sde spyi'i bskul ngor/ dge sbyong

rab bzang gsol mchod mdor bsdus rin chen rdul brtsegs ma/༄ //rin chen rdul brtsegs sa 'dzin mthon po la//gnas pa'i dkar phyogs skyong ba'i dgra lha che//rigs ldan rgya mtsho yum sras blon 'khor bcas//da lta bsang dang mchod pa'i mgron du byon//gang 'dzoms dri zhim shing lo sman thog dang //'bru drug zas sna dar zab bsregs pa'i sprin//ja chang 'o zho zhim mngar btung ba'i tshogs//'bul lo dgra lha 'khor bcas dgyes par rol//rmongs pa'i dbang gis dgongs 'gal ci bgyis pa//snying nas bshags pas brtse bas bzod par gsol//gzhis khyim mi nor khyed la gnyer gtad pas// srung skyob rdo rje ra ba brtan par mdzod//dus dang las dbang 'phral gyi rkyen ngan las//byung ba'i 'gal rkyen nyer 'tshe zhi ba dang //tshe dpal bsod nams longs spyod rab rgyas shing //'dod don legs tshogs yid bzhin dbang du 'dus//bstan dang 'gro ba'i bde sgyid spel ba yi//dkar phyogs rgyal ba'i ru mtshon dgung du sgrengs//nag phyogs mi dang mi min 'joms pa la//gnam lcags thog dang mtshungs pa'i mthu dpung skyed//kha rje dbang thang rlung rta yar la skyed//snod bcud legs tshogs gdi dze+e 'du bar shog/

ces pa 'di yang rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa 'brug po'i(1988〉dbyar zla tha —chung gi nyer bdun nyin rab bzang sdings su spro gseng lotheg skabs/nye gnas stobs tshang bsam 'grub sogs dad 'dun can du ma'i 'dod mos ltar/dor zhi skyes ming bas shar mar bris shing / nye gnas stobs tshang yum skyabs nas yi ger btab/yul lha gzhan dag kyang mchod 'dod na/༈'ju lag yul skyong mthon po bcu gsum dang //ka drod mched dgu stobs ldan dpal 'byor sogs//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i dgra lha gzhi bdag kun//bsang dang mchod pa'i mgron du da tshur byon/ cibya'o/ ces pa'i sho lo ka 'di gang 'dzoms dri zhim shing lo zhes pa'i gong der bcug par rtso — — wa dag dzā ga //oṃ bi sha tsi wa ṇi sha pa ri sarba dzo ra pra sha ma na ye swā hā/ sko lo gyo ḍima'igazungs/:

dmar mtho gtso ba'i yul lha spyi la bsang brngon 'bul tshul lha srung dgyes bskyed/༄ //na mo dharma rba ya/ yul chen mdo smad byang phyogs yi sa cha//yul spu 'ju lag lung ba'i stod smad kyi//yul phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu dkar phyogs la//yul lha'i bsang brjod gtong tshul 'god par bya//bsang brjon gyi mgron yul lha la gtor ma 'dod pa la/dkar gtor chenapo ril bu gang mang gis bskor/ dkar gsum mngar gsum ja phud chang gud sman sna shing tog 'bru zan gser dngul dar chen zas phud zan las grub pa'i srogachags kyi rigs sna tshogs/ tshe thar byed smyu phyugs gang 'dzoms/spyan gzigasaci 'byor/mchodapa gang rgyas rnams bshams/bsang dud btang chab kyis bran/dkon mchog gsum7skyabs su 'gro/zhes pa nas/ yang dag bskyed/ lan gsum brjod/ rang nyidaskadacig gis dpal rdo rje'ajigs byed kyi skur bzhengs par gyur/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥbasangs/ su bhā was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las rgyu las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum zag pa med pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ lha'irdu/ lan gsum brjod/ oṃ hrīḥdhīḥ bsang sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang nas bsang rdzas rten rdzas rnams rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i/ sa

phyogs yul rigs 'di dag skyong ba'i gnas gzhi bdag po dang bcas pa rnams mnyes par bsang rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig sa phyogs yul rigs 'di dag skyong ba'i gnas gzhi'i bdag po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig zhes sogs dang nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags lan gsum brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rgyal ba rin chen mang lophyag 'tshal lo/zhes pa nas thams cad dang bral ba la phyag 'tshal lo/ de bzhin thugs rje byin rlabs dang / chos kyi dbyangs rnams dag cing bsam gyi ji ltar brjod pa'i don thams cad de bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig bdag gi bsam pa'i zhes nas 'byung gyur cigadamar mtho skor gyi gzhi bdag spyi spyan 'dren pa ni/cha dmar mtho ri bo dar dkar gur khang dbus/ /yul lha dregs bkrag sku mdog dkar bo la//ber dkar gsol zhing dbu la zhwa dkar mnabs//phyag g.yas mda' dang rgyal mtshan g.yon pa na//mchog dkar gzhu dang lcags kyu zhags pa thogs//sked la mi bzad 'khor gsum 'bar ba bcings/ /g.yas brkyangs g.yon bskums stabs kyis rnam par 'gyings//rnam mang 'khor bcas gnas 'dir da tshur byon/ /kun kyang rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan khri la/ /brtan par bzhugs la mchod bzhes 'phrin las mdzod/spyi'i spyan 'dren ni/ kyeḥ rang snang dag la sgyu 'phrul gzhal g.yas na//yul lha gzhi bdag gnyan po thams cad dang //khyad par sa cha yul phyogs 'di dag gi/stod smad nyin srib bar gsum la gnas pa'i/ /srung skyob legs zhas ༷byed pa'i mthu rtsal che/ /sde brgyad

dmag tshogs gtor zhing bya ra byed//ma nges zhi khro'i rnam rol ston mdzad pa//rang rang gnas su bzhugs pa'i srung ma rnams//'khor ba'i thogs pa med pa'i rdzu 'phul dang //rnal 'byor bdag gis yid ches brtan pa'i mthus//ma lus bsang brjod gnas 'dir gshegs nas kyang / /rang rang 'dod pa'i gnas la bzhugs su gsol// kyiḥ nor 'dzin sa yi thig le nyams dga' 'dir//rab 'bar me lce phyogs kun g.yo ba las//shing sna phye mar zas phud gsog pa yi/ /dri bzang dud sprin ldang ba'i bsang mchod 'di//dmar mtho gtso 'khor yul lha gzhi bdag dang //yul 'di'i srung ma chen po khyed rnams la//thugs mthun dgyes pa bskyed pa'i bangon du 'bul//thugs phog gnod 'gal yod na zhi ba dang //dam tshig nyams chag yod na sos par mdzod//chu mig gtsang ma'i mchod yon zhabs bsil dang //dbyar skyes spang ljongs me tog sna tshogs bkra//dri zhim sman tog spos kyi dri ngad ldang //nyi zla gza' skar tshogs kyi snang ba gsal//dri bzang 'dres pa'i zil ba'i dri chab dang //shing tog ja chang mngar ba'i zas kyi rigs//dung dkar sil snyan glu dbyangs snyan pa'i sgra//chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo'i mchod pa 'di//dmar mtho gtso 'khor yul lha gzhi bdag dang //mig gi yul du mdzes pa'i gzugs kyi mchog /rna ba'i lam du rdung na snyan pa'i sgra//shangs la yid du 'ong ba'i dri mchog dang //ljags la myong na shin tu mngar ba'i ro//lus la reg na bde bar reg bya'i mchog/phun sum tshogs pa'i 'dod yo/ /ma pa lnga//dngos su bshams dang

yid kyis sprul ba dang / /sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs pa 'di/ /dmar mtho gtso 'khor yul lha gzhi bdag brngan//rtsibs stong ldan pa'i gser gyi 'khor lo dang //'bad med dgos 'dod kun 'byung yid bzhin nor//mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba'i lus phra ma//bya ba kun la rab mkhas blon po'i tshogs//yan lag lnga ldan glang bo rin po che//rngog ldan shin tu mgyogs pa'i cang shes rta//go khrab mtshon cha thogs pa'i dmag dpon dang //bkra shis rtags brgyad dang bcas mchod pa'i rdzas//dmar mtho gtso 'khor yul lha gzhi bdag brngan//sha ba rna ba la sogs ri dwags dang //ce spyang 'phar ba stag gzig gcan gzan dang //rta nor g.yang phyugs sna lnga'i rigs kyis brgyan//khu byug 'jol mo la sogs spyan gzigs dang //khyad par lug dkar dbang bo kun tshang ngam//be'u rgyud 'dzin lha g.yag zhol bo dang //'o ma'i rgyud 'dzin zhol mo gang rung la//tshe thar srung ba'i rtags kyis brgyan pa yang //dmar mtho gtso 'khor yul lha gzhi bdag dang // kyeḥ sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis//lha srung dam la btags tshe bka' bsgrags ltar//dam rdzas mna' chu blugs la thug sa dgos//dam rtags rdo rje dbu la 'jog mi dgos//dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod gtor 'di bzhes la/ /dam las ma 'da' bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// kye: lha khyed bos pa'i dus su snyan ma sra//lha srung brten pa'i tshe na 'gyang ma ring //lha srung bskul ba'i tshe na bang ma bul//lha gnyan rbad pa'i tshe na mthu ma chung /—//rdod dus bdud rtsi'i dngos grub char

ltar snyil//bsten na lus dang grib ma bzhin du 'grogs//bskul tshe 'dod pa'i las la ngang ma ring //bcol ba'i 'phrin las gnyan po tshul bzhin sgrubs//gzhi la gnas pa'i dus su rgyab rten mdzod//lam du 'gro ba'i tshe na skyel ma mdzod//byes su 'dug pa'i dus su srung ma mdzod//gzhi lam byes gsum kun tu sdongs grogs mdzod//sa bcud g.yang chag nyams pa sos gyur cig /lha srin sde brgyad thugs kun zhi gyur cig/tshe bsod mnga' thang rigs rgyud rgyas gyur cig /'khor g.yog chos bzhin dbang du 'du gyur cig /skye dgu'i phan bde'i re ba rgyal ba'i bstan//bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas//dkar phyogs skyong rnams mthu stobs gzi brjid 'phel//char chu dus su 'bebs shing lo tog rgyas//mi phyugs nor rdzas mnga' thang longs spyod rnams//gong nas gong 'phel chos bzhin spyod pa yi//dge legs rgya mtsho'i dpal la spyod gyur cig /oṃ/'chi med dpal ster rab dkar bdud ci'i — chus//dbang bsgyur thig phreng mdzes pa'i lan tshar g.yo//tshe mtha' phyin pa'i yul lha rnams kyi mthus//phyogs 'dir tshe ring nad med bkra shis shog /stag shar dpa' bo dgra la chas pa bzhin//dma' nag nyi zla'i snang mig g.yo ba can//gnas skyong dgra lha gzhon nu'i gzi byin gyis//nag phyogs g.yul las rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog /mu tig 'khri shing yang dag ra ba bzhin//yid 'ong 'jo sgeg lang tsho kun dga'i dpyid//lha klu na chung sman mo'i tshogs kyi mthus//ljongs 'dir bde skyid 'dzoms pa/ baX /sa shog/gser gyi rgya phibs 'bar

ba'i khang bzang sogs//rang snang gzhal yas bkod pa sna tshogs pa//dge mtshan des kyang sa gzhi bcud ldan zhing //ji shing lo 'bras smin pa'i bkra shis shog /dbyar skyes sgra ldan lha yi char chen bzhin//shis brjod dbyangs dang 'brel ba'i bstod tshig gis//khyed thugs 'o mtshor dgyes dgur 'gyur ba las//legs byung rlabs phreng phyogs brgyar g.yo bar mdzod/ces mdo smad kyi yul phyogs 'ju lag gi yul lha'i bsang brngon gtong tshul 'di yang 'go tsha dge slong dkon mchog bstan 'a la dang / btsun pa legs bshad mkhas sgrub pa/ sngags 'chang bkra shis tshe brtan dang /rig pa smra ba dge bsnyen thar gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ sngon gyi slob dpon chen mo'i mdzad pa'i brngon chog rnams la gzhi byas te———shākya'i btsun pastod rgyud mkhan zur nor bu sprul ming gis sbyar ba'o/

lhun po'i bsangan༄snyo //na mo gu ru badz+ra ra ya/ 'dir lhun po dpal brtsegs la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag gi bsang mchod byed par 'dod pas/ kye dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs pad+ma 'byung //mkhyen gter ngur smrig gar mdzad blo bzang grags//bslu med skyabs gcig ma gi ṣā ya'i//rnam gsum dbyer med zhabs pad gtsug gis mchod//dge mtshan bcu ldan mdo smad bod yul gyi//'dzin ma'i byang phyogs 'ju lag ces grags pa'i//klung chen gang gā'i mched zla'i rgyab brten pa'i//dkar phyogs skyong mdzad lhun po zhes bya ba//spu 'dzin bdag po'i ye shes sgyu ma'i gar//phyogs kyi mdzes ma'i rgyan gyur dpal brtsegs zhes//shel dkar rdul mang brtsegs pa'i sa 'dzin la//gnas pa'i lha yi dge bsnyen chen po khyed//bdag gis dad gus sngags dang ting 'dzin gyis//dngos bshams yid sprul rgya chen bsang mchod 'dis/ /mgron du 'phrin las rnam par bsgrub pa'i phyir//thogs med rdzu 'phrul thugs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs//'khor bcas khyed rnams rang rang dgyes pa'i khrir//brtse ba'i thugs kyis brtan par bzhugs nas kyang / /lha lam 'gengs pa'i bsang gi mchod pa'i sprin//'dod dgu ma tshang med pa'i mchod tshogs bzhes//snyigs dus skye bo bya spyod mi mkhas pas//dka/ dmar thab gzhob sa chu brkos

dkrugs sogs//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i thugs dang 'gal ba'i tshogs//ma lus dmigs med chos dbyings ngang du bshags//sngon bsags bsod nams stobs kyis bskrun pa yi//mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mthu stobs dpag yas pa//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i dgra lha mthu bo che//khyed la mchod bstod 'phrin las bcol ba ni//skye dgu'i phan bde'i rtsa ba rgyal ba'i bstan//'dzin skyong spel ba'i bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan cing //gang der gus mchod bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams//mi mthun phyogs kyi g.yul las rgyal bar mdzod//khyad par bdag cag dpon slob mi nor bcas//mi 'dod nyer 'tshe kun las srung skyob cing //'dod don legs tshogs tshe bsod dpal 'byor dang //snyan grags yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas par mdzod//gzhi lam gyes gsum gar 'gro gar 'dug kyang //nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe mdzod//nam yang re zhing ltos tshe 'phrin las bzhi//'dod don gang bsam sgrub la ma g.yel zhig/mdor na gang bcola'aphrin las ma lus pa//byang chub mchog gi rgyu ru 'gyur ba'i phyir//gzhan phan /dīkā py-i /chog gi rang gzhan gyis//mthar thug don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub ces lhun podapal brtsegs la gnas pa'igazhi bdag gi bsang mchod legs tshogs kun 'grub ces bya ba 'di ni/ dad ldan phyin bdag tshe dpag skyabs zhes bya bas bskul ba'i ngor btsun pangag dbang legs bshadanyi mas gsungs so/

ra rgod gzhi bdag gi bsang brjod phan bde 'dod 'jo/mu //na mo gu ru badz+ra pā k+ṣ-i ya/ 'dir ra rgod brag rir gnas pa'i gzhi bdag la bsang brngon gyi mchod pa 'bulatshul brngon par bya ste/de yang gzhi ma dkar bo gtsang mar/ 'o ma dang chu gtsang gi bsrus pa'i zan la/ zan leb spu bzhi nyis brtsegs kyi steng du dkar gtor kum po ril bus bskor/mthar chang bu nyal bas bskor ba/zur bzhir theb kyu kha gyen bslang gi nang du mar gyi ril bu re bzhag pa rgyan ci mdzes dang /gzhan dkon mchog spyi la dkar gtor gcigagazhi bdag sde brgyad spyi la gtor cog chang bu theb kyu ril bu dang bcas pa dang / gzhan yang ja dkar/ 'o ma/ chang phud dang /gsor skyems/phye mar/ 'khur pa/ thud/sha rjenapa mayin pa'i sha gtsang ma ja mar sogs zas sna rnams sdod gcig tu spungs pa'am so sogang 'byor dang / mngar gsum 'bru sna sogs dang /chu gtsang me tog spos sogs gang 'byor/ ngos dag rgya che bshams la bsang bdug byas/gzhan rnga rol dung dang sil snyan sogs rol mo/ bsang shing gtsang ma dud pa dri bzang dang bcas sta gon rnams tshang bar byas te/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi sgoms/ sngon du 'gro ba'i yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed dam/krong bskyed bcas/ rdzas rnams bsang——sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las /lasabyung ba'i rin po che'i snad yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/ oṃ yig zhu ba las mchod //ra spyan gzigs rnams mgron rnams

dang / dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon ra rgod dge bsnyen chen po/ mthu — stobs dpal ldan rtsal 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes par byed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin 'dod dgu bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bar snang gi khyon thams cad yongs su gang bar gyur/ ces pa dang sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs la/'di ltar/kye'i rab 'byams rgyal ba'i mthu stobs nus pa kun//lnga rig paṇa chen grub pa'i gtsug rgyan du//pad sdong las 'khrungs sprul sku gu ru rje//mkhyen brtse thugs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//'phags bod mkhas shing grub pa thams cad kyi/ /ngo bo skyabs gsum kun 'dus bdag nyid du/ /bzhugs te bdag cag lha mi snod bcud la//'phral yun legs tshogs rgyas pa'i byin rlabs stsol// oṃ lha'igu ru pad+ma sirnyi rgyu rdu/ oṃ lha'iskye/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa rgyu/ zhes pa rnams ci 'grub bzlas la/ bsang gyer ba nirol mo dngabacas/ kyeḥ gser ldan yangs pa'i 'khor yug chen po 'dir//skye dgu'i bsod nams chu gter rgyas pa las//ngo mtshar snod bcud bkod pa'i rba rlabs phreng //dge bcu'i 'bras bzang bdud rtsi ci yang spros//de las bod yul mdo smad skyid po'i ljongs//rong dgu'i dang tshan 'ju lag mag thig rong //skal ldan shing rta gnyis pa'i klong 'gram gyi//sra brtan ra rgod ces bya'i sa 'dzin la//gnas bcas dgra lha'i rgyal po mthu stobs can/ /sku mdog dkar gsal zhi 'dzum hur ba'i nyams//rin chen rgyan dang za 'og na bza' mdzes//phyag g.yas rgyal mtshan rin chen tog mdzes bsgrengs// ga /na sha rin chen nor bu'i gzhong ba

bsnams//dar khra thod bcings snyan rgyan 'od du 'bar//sra brtan khri la byed dkyil gar gyis 'gyings//dgyes skyed gung sman yum sras blon 'khor bcas//sna tshogs chas gos dar 'phan gter bum sogs//ma nges phyag mtshan 'ching ba thams cad dang //nye 'khor lha klu drag btsan sde brgyad kyi//'khor tshogs rgya mtsho gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no//rang rang dgyes pa'i gnas dang rten rnams la//bzhugs nas bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la//'dod don 'phrin las tshul bzhin bsgrub pa'i phyir//mchod par 'bul ba 'di dag bzhes su gsol// oṃ ma pra ti ts+tsha rdu/ pa nas shasta pra ti ts+tsha rgyu/ rū pa sogs 'dod yon lnga bcas phul/ bsang brngon 'bul ba ni/ 7 lhun grub bde stong sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu//bsam gyis mi khyab bden pa'i cho 'phul gyis//'dod dgu ma tshang med pa'i mchod sprin tshogs//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i spyan lam rgyas gyur cig/'bru sna gtsang phye sbyar ba'i gtor ma ni//zag med bdud rtsi'i snying bo lnga phrag can//sna tshogs bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs bcas 'dis//dgra lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //sna tshogs bsang shing mnol ba sel byed kyi//du ba'i sprin tshogs lha lam khyon gang ba//dri bsung 'dod yon lnga ldan bcas pa 'dis//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon 'khor bcas brngan//rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rtags rdzas brgyad/ /nor bu cha brgyad gter bum 'dod 'jo'i ba//nyi zla ri gling bkod pa dang bcas pas//yul lha'i sde dpon 'khor dang bcaX ༷3 /chod//rta g.yag ra lug mdzo 'bri 'o

ma'i rgyun//'dzad pa med pa'i g.yang phyug tshogs rnams dang //sna tshogs skad snyan nam mkha'i 'dab chags tshogs/ /rtsed 'jo rol ba'i ri skyes tshogs bcas 'bul/ /rin chen rgyan phreng skar ma'i tshogs ltar bkra// za 'og na bza' sprin ltar lhab lhub g.yo//snyan pa'i sgra skad rna ba'i bcud len du//dbyangs su sgrog pa'i rol mo'i tshogs kyis mchod//chu skyes thang skyes mdog legs me tog tshogs//ljon shing sna tshogs zhim po'i 'bras bu can//lo 'dab phang phung g.yo ba'i nags tshal sogs//snod kyi khyad par phun tshogs kun gyis mchod//sra brtan khrab rmog 'khor gsum dpa' bo'i chas//rno ngar mtshon cha 'od du 'bar ba'i tshogs//'ja' tshon ltar bkra g.yul las rnam rgyal ba'i//ru ba dar gyi cod pan rgyan bcas 'bul//gzhan yang 'bru bcud bsdus pa'i btung ba dang //phye mar 'o zho ja dkar bdud rtsi'i mchod//rin chen bdar ba'i gser skyems bsang mchod sogs/ /dbang bo drug la dga' bde mchog ster ba'i//phyi dang 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga//yid kyi snang ba kun dgar bsgyur byed tshogs// dngos bshams yid sprul ma tshang med pa 'bul//bzhes nas bdag cag dpon slob ltos bcas la//chos mthun legs tshogs rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/de nas gtor ma rnams/oṃ āḥrdu yis byin gyis brlabs la/saṃ lha ra lan bdun sogs kyis bsngo/ma sogs kyisamachod/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshanabarjod/ bdud rtsi rgya mtsho'i gtor ma 'di//bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum//chos skyong srung ma mkha' 'asdiX /kas//mthu stobs dpal ldan dgra lha

che//lha klu sde brgyad kun la 'bul//bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas — rnams//dkon mchog gsum gyi rjes 'dzin cing //chos skyong srung mas 'phrin las sgrub//dkar phyogs skyong bas sdongs grogs mdzod//bdag gis bsam pa'i stobs dang ni// sogs bden stobs brjod pa/ spyi sger gyi bsang dngagasol kha 'phrin bcol sogs kyang mtshams 'dir bya/ de nas bstod pa dang 'phrin bcol ni/kyiḥsngon gyi bskal ba dang po'i srid pa la//dge bcu tshang ba'i gnas kyi bye brag 'dir//bsod nams stobs kyis dbang bsgyur mthu bo che//mthu stobs dpal ldan rtsal chen khyed la bstod//grub pa'i gtsug rgyan pad+ma 'byung gnas dang //blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang bo pad dkar 'chang //sras bcas grub dbang tshul khrims rgya mtsho sogs//rdo rje 'dzin pa'i bka' srung khyed la bstod//thub bstan spyi dang rgyal ba tsong kha pa'i//mdo sngags bshad sgrub bstan pa 'dzin pa yi//'dus pa'i sde kun nyin mtshan dus drug tu//bsrung mdzad bstan srung — chen po khyed la bstod//re ltos gus mchod lhur len bdag cag la//gzhi lam 'bras gsum kun tu 'dod pa'i don//gang bsam 'bad med lhun gyis 'grub mdzad pa'i//srung ma yid bzhin nor bu khyed la bstod//dkar gsal lang tsho rdzogs pa mdzes pa'i sku//rin chen rgyan spras dar tshon na bza' can//'gying bag tshul bzhugs dgyes bskyed yum sras 'khor//dregs pa'i tshogs la dbang sgyur khyed la bstod//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon che khyed kyis//dus 'dir bdag cag dpon slob dis/ bcas la//nyin mtshan kun tu srung

skyob ma g.yel bar/ / rtag tu sdongs grogs gnas po bzang bor mdzod/ /mi phyugs zas nor longs spyod bcas pa la//nad rims dgra gcan nyer 'tshe kun zhi nas//tshe dpal stobs 'byor mnga' thang rigs rgyud sogs//legs tshogs yar ngo'i zla bzhin rgyas par mdzod//gnod byed mi min 'byung bo'i tshogs rnams kyang / /mthu stobs drag pos rtsal gyis dbang sdud cing //gang mtshams drag po'i tshar gcod 'phrin las sgrubs//srung mar bsten mchod 'phrin las ma g.yel zhig/khyad par phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi//bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyes bu thams cad kyi//bshad sgrub bstan pa'i bya ba gong 'phel zhing //sku tshe brtan cing mdzad 'phrin rgyas par mdzod//yangs pa'i nor 'dzin spyi dang khyad par du//yul 'dir nad mug 'khrug rtsod ming tsam yang //mi grag sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor bde skyid kyi//rdzogs ldan dga' ston rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ ces bstod pa dang 'phrin las bcol pa rnams kyang byas te slar yang gtang rag tu bsang 'bru gsum gyis brlabs la/ snang srid mgron — rnams 'khor bcas kyis//rgya chen bsang mchod 'di bzhes la//bdag cag bya spyod mi mkhas pas//nongs pa gang mchis bzod par bzhes//oṃ muḥmagron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur//'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos pa'i//yid bzhin nor bu dpag bsam shing //sems can re ba skong mdzad pa'i//bsam pa 'grub pa'i bkra shis shog/ ces sogs shis brjod kyang bya'o//'di yang yul gyi lha mi kun//rnam dkar /// pa'i rgyur gyur cing //mthar thug

byang chub thob pa yi//mthun rkyen mchog ca'agyur bar shog/ces ra rgod gzhi bdag gi bsang brngon phan bde 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba 'di yang /mos ldan don spub tshe brtan sogs sbyin bdag rnams kyis bskul ba'i ngor/ sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi mas bris pa'o

skya ka ri la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag dge bsnyen gtsug phud bzang la bsang brngon gtong tshul snyan pa'i 'brug sgra/༄'i //na mo gu ru badz+ra rnya ra ya/ dngos sgrub 'dod dgu lhug par 'jo ba yi//mchog gsum sprin chen yid mkhar legs brtan na//byin rlabs gru char rgyun gyi phan bde yi//lo tog g.yur du za ba'i shis pa stsol/ 'dir chos sde chen po bkra shis dar rgyas gling gi nye 'khor bkra shis lung dkar gyi skya ka ri la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag dge bsnyen gtsug phud can gyi bsang brjon gtong bar 'dod pas zan gtsang mar dkon mchod spyi gtor dang /sngon gtor bang rim gsum brtsegs steng du dkar gtor rgyan can mdzes pa/phyogs bzhi khams sogs mar gyi ril bus bkang ba re dang bang rim brtsegs gang mang bkra shis rtags rdzas gtor bum sogs mar rgyan gyis bzo ba'am yang na mar gyis nor bu'i dra ba dra byed/ bang rim bar mar mar rgyan ci mdzes dang /rtsa bar zan ril spungs dang / gye mar dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bru sna klu sman 'khur ba/ shaṅkarlon ma gtogs pa'i bza' bca' btung ba gser skyems rnams/gzhi gtsang mar bshams la/bsang bdug bya zhing chu gtsang bran la spyan gzigs gang 'byor bshams/ bsang du — cher btang / sil snyan dung sogs rol mo dang spro na gar rol sogs kyang bya/ rang nyid kyis skyabs sems rgyud 'dres nges dang / tshad med bzhi sgom sogs byas/ yi dam gang ——rigs kyi nga rgyal gnas pas/mchod gto/ /sdud bsang sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las ji

las byung ba'i rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi dang du rang rang gi ming yig dang po las byung ba'i mchod gtor brjod chas gser skyems sogs bza' btung gi rigs rnams dang /dgyes pa bskyed pa'i spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag 'dod dgu ma tshang ba med pa/ bla ma yi dam mchod gsum srung ma spyi dang /khyad par yul skyong gzhi bdag chen po 'khor dang bcas pa mnyes par byed pa'i mchod sprin bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung bar gyur cig/oṃ sarba bid smu ra pu ra na sga ra ṇa khaṃ/oṃ su bha lha bi shud rnye rnya rmā te badz+ra sid rnyi rdu/zhes pa nas ga ga khaṃ swā hā/ sngags drug phyag drugabadag gi bsam pa nas 'byung —gyur cig de bzhin du gyur parabasamal/ bsang mgron spyan 'dren pa ni/kyeḥ chos dbyings gdod nas dag pa'i dkyil 'khor nas//'gro la rjes chags bde chen snying rje'i gar//gang 'dul cir yang 'char ba'i gtan gyi skyabs//mchog gsum rgyal ba rgya mtsho gnas 'dir gshegs//khyad par bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi//cho rigs brgyud la 'go ba'i lha srung rnams//bdag gis mchod cing bstod pa'i gnas mchog 'dir//dgyes pa'i tshul gyis rings par gshegs su gsol//rang snang bde ba'i dzod kyi 'jig rten 'dir//zhi khro'i rnam 'gyur ma nges sna tshogs kyis/ /bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i dkar phyogs kyi//lha klu sde brgyad tshogs rnams gshegs su gsol//khyad par dge bcu tshang ba'i yul 'dir spyan 'dren no//'dzam gling mdzes pa'i srung ma tshe//lha yi dge bsnyen mthu ldan gtsuka ༷༷༷ bzang //'khor bcas mchod pa'i
