gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no//'dzam gling mdzes ba'i dpal du brtan pa'i ri//sna tshogs ljon shing spang ljongs chu brag sogs//ngo mtshar bkod pa du mas yid 'ong ba'i//rang snang pho brang che nas gshegs su gsol//rdzu 'phul shugs ldan rab dkar cang shes rta//rin chen sga srab rgyan gyis mdzes pa'i steng //'gying bag rol ba'i nyams ldan yul lha che//ma thogs rings pa'i tshul gyis gnas 'dir gshegs//dgyes 'dzum 'jo sgeg gar gyis bde ster ba'i//yid 'ong sman btsun sras blon 'khor dang bcas//las byed dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs ma lus pa//da lta mchod cing brngan pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs//gzhan yang nyid srib phu mda'i gnas rnams su//rang snang nyams dgas rol pa'i lha klu btsan//sa bdag gnyan sogs sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs//kun kyang bsang mchod brten pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs//rnam dkar mos pa sngags dang ting 'dzin gyis//sprul ba'i gdan khri so sor gang 'dod du//sngon gyi dam bca' dgongs bzhin bzhugs nas kyang //bcol pa'i 'phrin las sgrub phyir dgyes par rol//pad+ma ka ma la ye ste//7 lhun 'grub bde stong nam mkha' yangs pa nas//mchog gsum bden pa gzungs sngags mos pa'i mthus//'dod dgu cir yang 'char ba las byung pa'i//sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung rgyas gyur cig/lha yi chu rgyun gtsang ma'i mchod yon dang //khrus chab bdud ji gdung sel byugs pa'i dri//mdog legs dri bzang 'dab rgyas me tog tshogs//sna — tshogs spos sna bsregs pa'i du ba'i /spya/—/rtsi mar sgron me 'od zer rtse dga'

spro//lha mi'i bza' bca' yid 'ong bdud brtsi'i zas//sna tshogs rol mo sil snyan glu dbyangs sogs//dbang bos yul la dga' bde bskyed byed pa'i//'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga yi tshogs//ro brgya'i bcud ldan gser skyems bdud rtsi bcas//mchog gsum srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag la//gus pas 'bul lo dgyes pa chen pos bzhes/ /bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la//'dod don legs tshogs rgyas pa'i 'phrin las stsol/ ces mchod pa 'bul/de nas bsang btang ste/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo rnyi ba twa shri rnyarma pā la sa pā ri la ra yi dam bha lo ta kha kha khā gyi/ sogs bdun gyis bsngo la gong gi sngags la a sogs/ thugs rje'i bdag nyid rtsa brgyud bla ma dang // yi dam lha tshogs skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma bcas//gus pas bstod do mchog mthun dngos sgrub stsol// ces bstod cing 'dod don bcol zhor slar yang brngon chas mchod gtor rnams la dmigs ste/oṃ ā rgyu/lan gsum brjod/de rgya cher spel te/ sa ra gsum bdun bcu gsum gang rigs kyis bsngo zhing de bzhin gshegs pabazhis mchod brjod de bsang dang bsngon gyer ba ni/ skyukhuphun tshogs kun gyi 'byung gnas thub pa'i bstan//kha ba'i ljongs su spel la mthu stobs kyi//'phrin las kun tu 'jug pa grub pa'i dbang //de nas pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags//de yi gsang chen grub pa sde brgyad du//gangs can lha klu dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs//bcug nas dbang bskur rdo rje tha tshig gis//rnam dag bstan pa'i srung ma/ di/'a bsgo mdzad//mgon de phyi rabs

rjes 'jug tshogs rnams la//lha klu dkar phyogs skyong ba mchod pa'i tshul//rnam grangs du ma bstan te bstan 'gro yi//legs byas yar ngo'i zla gzhon dpal la 'gran//sngon byung ya rabs dam pa'i srol bzang der//mos ldan bdag cag dpon slob 'dir 'khod rnams//lha dang srung mar mchod cing gsol 'debs pa'i//don 'dir dgyes pas dgongs shing gsan du gsol//ḍūkhu dang po kun khyab nam mkha'i rang bzhin la//ye yod gnam sa'i 'jig rten so sor bye//yid las skyes pa'i legs nyes blang dor las//bzang ngan 'bras bu sna tshogs so sor 'byung / /lha klu sde brgyad mchod cing grogs byas pa'i//rang gzhan 'dod don 'grub pa'i rten 'brel 'grub//de'i phyir de ring gza' skar 'phrod sbyor legs//dge ba'i tshes grangs mthun rkyen 'dzoms pa yi//dus kyi sbyor ba bzang bor bdag cag gi/rang gzhan 'dod don bsgrub pa'i bsam sbyor gyi//dkon mchog srid zhi'i mgron la mchod pa dang //mgon po yon tan mgron la gtang rag dang //gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong la grogs bcol ched//gus pa'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol//ḍūkhuchos kyi dbyangs las lhun gyis spub pa'i gshis//rin chen snod yangs stong gi khyon mnyam du//sngags dang ting 'dzin phyag rgya bden stobs kyis/ /gang bsam 'dod dgur 'dzoms pa'i mchod sprin 'dis//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon gtsug phud bzang //'khor dang bcas pa'i dbang bo'i spyod yul du//'phral dang yun du bde ba mchog ste/ —༷༷//nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar rgya

phye zhig /'bru sna lnga yi snying bo las grub cing //dkar gsum mngar gsum gtsang ma'i phud kyis brgyan//'chi med bdud rtsi rgya mtshor byin brlabs nas//'dod yon lnga ldan zag med gtor ma yis//gzhi bdag dkar phyogs skyong ba'i 'khor bcas brngan//yid 'phrog mdzes pa'i gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra//dri zhim spos dang byugs pa'i ro brgya'i zas//srab 'jam mdog legs lha yi gos rnams kyis//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon 'khor bcas brngan//sman sna lnga phrag sbyar ba'i btung ba dngan/'bru bcud gtsang ma'i chang dang rin chen skyems//ro brgya'i bcud ldan bdud rtsi'i tshogs rnams kyis//lha yi sde dpon 'khor dang bcas la mchod//sna tshogs rin chen rgyan dang bgo ba'i gos//mal stan bzhon pa gnas dang yo byad kyi//khyad par yid du 'ong ba sna tshogs kyang //dregs pa 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i dngos por 'bul//myur mgyogs sga srab rgyan mdzes cang shes rta//rngam brjid ngar sgra sgrog pa'i g.yag rog dang //'o ma'i rgyun gyi 'dod 'jo zhol mo'i tshogs//sde dpon 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i rten du 'bul//dro 'jam spu yi gos ldan g.yang dkar lug /'ba' sgra'i dbyangs ldan rwa skyes la sogs pa//'dod dgu 'byung ba'i g.yang phyugs sna tshogs kyang / /lha khyed 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i rten du 'bul//'od 'bar g.yul las rgyal ba'i go khrab rmog /rno ngar mi bzad dgra 'joms mtshon cha dang //rnam par rgyal ba'i ba dan ru mtshon sogs//dgra lha chen po dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul//yid 'ong gser sdi sdu/ra lo rtsibs stong can//'dod dgu

gang bsam stsol ba'i yid bzhin nor//bde ba mchog ster btsun mo rin chen dang //bsam don sgrub pa'i blon po rin po che//theg mchog stobs ldan glang bo rta yi mchog /mdzod ldan khyim bdag rin chen sna bdun dang //'dod 'jo'i bum bzang bkra shis rdzas rnams kyang //yul lha'i sde dpon 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//gser zhun 'khyil ba'i zhugs kyi gung bo'i dang //lha shing shug pa tsan dan a ka ru//dung shing ba lu stag pa spen dkar sogs//dri zhimangad ldan sna tshogs spos kyi shing //bsreg pa'i dud sprin lha lam khyab pa 'dis//lha klu dkar phyogs skyong ba 'khor bcas bsang //bsang mchod 'dod dgu ma tshang med pa yis//lha yi sde dpon 'khor bcas khyed rnams la//mchod nas 'phrin las bcol ba 'di dag kun//bsgrub pa'i sdongs grogs gnyan po ma g.yel zhig /dge ldan yul phyogs bkra shis kun tshang 'dir//thub bstan spyi dang 'jam mgon tsong kha pa'i//mdo sngags bshad sgrub dar zhing rgyas pa yis//'dzam gling bde skyid rdzogs ldan rgyas par mdzod//khyad par bdag cag mi nor ltos bcas la//phyi nang 'gal rkyen nad rims dgra jag sogs//mi 'dod nyer 'tshe ming yang mi 'byung bar//legs tshogs 'dod dgu yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod//sad ser btsa' than shā 'od la sogs pa'i//snod kyi rgud pa nam yang mi 'byung zhing //char chu dus 'bab lo legs 'bru bcud sogs//dus su bsam pa'i 'bras bu smin par mdzod//gzhi la bkra shis mi la tshe bsod rgyas//phyugs la yar 'pheX za sna la g.yang bcud ldan//bzhon khal

stobs rgyas go mtshon dgra lha 'khor//'dod dgu g.yang 'khyil chos srid rgyas par mdzod//mdor na gzhi gyes lam dang ldog gnas su//bsu skyel mel tshe byams skyong ma g.yel bar//yul gyi lha mi 'dun gros gcig gyur pa'i//gtan gyi legs tshogs 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod/ ces brjod dang 'phrin las bcolab sogs byas te/spar yang bstod de gshegs su gsol/ཿkhri dgung du bstod do yul gyi lha klu gnyan/khyed cag dbu 'phang gnyan po yar la bstod//srid pa ya yod dang po'i bskal ba la//'dzam gling dag pa lha yi gnas dang mnyam//de tshe 'od gsal gtsang ris lha yi rigs//bsod nams phul du byung ba khyed la bstod//g.yung drung lha yi rmu thag 'dzin pa yi//tshe la dbang ba'i lha gnyan chen po khyed//sngon byon rgyal blon byang sems paṇa grub tshogs//kun gyi bka' sgrub sung ma mdzad la bstod//'gying bag sku yi bkod pa yid 'ong ba//zhi ba'i nyams ldan lha rdzas na bza' gsol//skar phreng ltar bkra rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes//mig gi bdud rtsi kun dga' sbyin la bstod//yum sras lha klu sman mo mdzes sdug gar//yid la dga' skyed 'khor tshogs du ma'i dbus//rang snang 'dod dgu lhun gyis grub pa yi//lha yi sde dpon chen po khyed la bstod//sprin gyi shugs ldan rta mchog 'phur shes ni//rin chen gser rgyan sga srab mdzes pa'i steng //mdzes brjid zhi khro dpa' bo'i rnam 'gyur gyis//snang dgra zil gnon dregs pa khyed la bstod//bsod nams dbang thang lha dbang dpal ltar rgyas//snyan pa'i grags pa g.yu 'brug skad ltas ldir//dgra 'joms dpa' rtsal ge

sar dpung la 'gran//mthu stobs mnga' bdag lha gnyan khyed la bstod//khyad par yul spu sa phyogs 'di nyid du//mi phyugs nyer 'tshe zhi zhing bar chad sel//mthun rkyen 'dod pa ma lus 'bad med du//stsol ba'i bsam 'phel nor 'dra khyed la bstod//skyabs gnas bslu med mchog gsum dngos gyur pa'i//rdo rje 'chang dbang mdo rgyud rgya mtsho sogs//dpal ldan bla ma dam pa'i tshogs — rnams kyis//bka' sgrub srung ma gnyan po khyed la bstod//bla ma yi dam ye shes srung tshogs kyis//dregs pa'i sde dpon khyed la dge legs mchog/rgyas pa'i me tog spu char 'bebs dang ldan//bdag cag skyong ba'i srung mar mnga' gsol lo//mchod cing bstod nas 'phrin las gang bcol rnams//lha gnyan dkar phyogs skyong ba khyed rnams kyis//ma bsnyel dus su gang dgos bsam don — rnams//yid bzhin lhun gyis 'grub pa'i bkra shis stsol/ ces bstod//rang snang bsod nams mthu dang dbyings rig gshis//cir yang snang ba sems kyi rnam 'phrul las//mgron rnam snang ba kun dga'i rang gnas su//gshegs nas dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog/ces bkra shis lung dkar gyi gzhi bdag dge bsnyen gtsug phud bzang la bsang brngon gtong tshulasnyan pa'i 'brugasgra zhes bya ba'adi yang/dad brtson blo dang ldan pa rgya: sdog dge slong yon tan yar 'phel gyisabaskul ngor/btsun pa sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi masashing phag hor zagasum pa'i rgyal ba dang po'i 'grub spyor khyi lobris/

phyug lung skya mtho'i gzhi bdag gi gsol kha/༄༄ //kyeḥ phun tshogs dge bcu'i dpal yon rab rgyas pa'i//phyug lung nor 'dzin mdzes pa'i ri bo ni//zon gan dpal gyi skya mtho la gnas pa'i//kun bzang rab brtan sku mdog dkar dmar mdangs//phyag g.yas rgyal mtshan g.yon pas gter gzhong bsnams//ral ba thod bcings mu tig chun 'phyang mdzes/ /lha gos stod g.yog rin chen rgyan phreng g.yo/ /lhab lhub na bza' 'ja' ris gung sngon gsol//g.yas brkyangs rol ba'i stabs kyis rin chen khrir//srid 'byor dpal gyis tshims shing rab rgyas pa'i//dgyes 'dzum nyams dang ldan par bzhugs su gsol//ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag brgya'i bden stobs kyis//mchod gtor spyan gzigs chas gos bzhon pa sogs//sa dang bar snang nam mkha' bkang sprul te//lha gnyan 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul//sna tshogs bsang shing bsreg pa'i du ba'i sprin//'dod yon lnga ldan dri zhim phyogs kun khyab//lha klu'i mnol grib kun sel 'di 'bul la//nyams chag skong zhing dgyes pa skyed gyur cig /yid la dga' bskyed bka' nyan mthun pa'i 'khor//'dod dgu kun tshang spro zhing bag phebs gnas//rang srung yo byad dgra 'joms go mtshon sogs//snang ba kun dga'i dpal ster kun kyang 'bul//dwangs bsil gasdi /sdi 'khyil ba'i snying bo ni//dge mtshan

dpal gyis mtho ba'i ri bo la/ /bsod nams stobs kyis dkar phyogs skyong mdzad pa'i/ /yul lha'i sde dpon chen po khyed la bstod/ /rdo je 'dzin pa'i bka' sdod srung ma che/ /yul 'di'i mi nor skyong ba'i yul lha che/ /mthun rkyen 'dod dgu stsol ba'i gter bdag che//lha klu'i sde dpon chen po khyed la bstod/ /rgas med tshe ring 'dzad pa med pa'i nor/ /srung skyong mngon shes rdzu 'phrul thogs med cing //dgra 'joms mthu stobs nus pa thogs med pa'i//dgra lha chen po khyed la bdag bstod do//khyed la mchod gtor 'phrin las bcol ba ni//sangs rgyas bstan srung bla ma'i sku tshe bsringan/dge 'dun thugs mthun bstan pa'i bya ba rgyas/ /dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod cing sbyin bdag rnams//ya rabs spyod bzang legs tshogs gong 'phel mdzod/ /khyad par bkra shis dar zhing rgyas pa'i gling //dpon slob sde dang bcas pa thams cad kyis/ /chos srid legs tshogs 'dod dgu ma lus pa//'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /khyed la bstod cing mchod pa lhur len pa'i/ /sbyin bdag mi nor 'khor dang bcas rnams la//bar chad kun sel yid la gang bsam don//bsam pa ji bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//ces pa 'di yang lung rtogasayon tanagyis mnga' bdag yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po khri zur ngag dbang yon tan 'phel rgyas kyi gsung gi bskul ngor/ bla gzugs sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshadagyi mas bris pa'o/

mdo smad lha ri byug rdzong mchod thabs/༄༄ / /kyiḥ/mdun gyi lha lam yangs pa'i nor 'dzin gzhir//rnam bkra 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur gyi dbus//rab dkar chu 'dzin lang long g.yo ba'i dang //g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i steng na rab tu 'gying //rnal 'byor bdag cag mgon dang skyabs mdzad pa'i//gzhi bdag chen po lha ri zhes grags pa//mar gad mdog can dar zab ber dkar gsol//rnam mang rin chen rgyan gyis rab mdzes shing //dbu la dar dkar nor bu'i thod bcings pa//phyag g.yas dgra srog gcod pa'i gri gug 'phyar//phyag g.yon khams gsum dbang sdud lcags kyu bsnams//'gying bag dgyes pa'i gar gyi skyil spung bzhugs//gsang yum blon po sprul ba yang sprul dang //snang srid lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs//dam can 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho bcas pa rnams//'dir byon 'phrin las sgrub phyir brtan par bzhugs//bde chen kun tu bzang ba'i rnam 'gyur las//dngos su bshams dang yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin//zag med ye shes bdud rtsi rgya mtsho che//rnam bkra'i me tog dri zhim bsang mchod tshogs//stong gsum mun sel 'od 'bar sgron me gsal//ro brgya'i bcud ldan gtor ma ri ltar spungs//snyan brjid 'bud dkrol rol mo'i bye brag bcas//'dod rgu'i bcud ldan gser skyems mchod pa dang //ri klung lha dang mi yi longs spyod gter/ /dkor cha spyan gzigs mthun rdzas ma tshang med/ /mdor na dngos

bshams yid sprul mchod tshogs kyis/ /lha tshogs 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang gyur cig /de ltar thugs dam gnyan po legs bskangs nas/ /sku gsung thugs dang 'gal 'khrul ci mchis pa/ /nyams chag nyes tshogs thams cad dmigs med du/ /rnam dag chos sku'i ngang du bshags par bgyis/ /sgo gsum 'bad pas mchod cing bstod pa'i mthus//khyad par dga' ba'i dpal ldan dam chos gling //bshad sgrub thos bsam dar rgyas 'phel ba dang //yul phyogs sde bcas 'bangs 'khor thams cad kyi/ /mi mthun sad ser btsa' than mu ge dang //mi phyugs nad rims bar chad kun zhi zhing //tshe bsod dpal 'byor lo phyugs 'phel zhing dar//bde skyid dga' bde'i dpal la rol bar mdzod/ /sngon byon dam pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i//'gyur med dam tshig dran bzang yul phyogs 'di//nyin mtshan dus kun srung skyob mi g.yeng bar//bcol ba'i rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las thogs med mdzod//'dir tshogs rnams kyi srung ma'i dbang bo khyed//mgon dang skyabs mdzad mnga' gsol gzengs bstod pas//gyes su lam 'phrang chu jag 'jigs las skyobs//gzhi ru mi nor tshe srog mnga' thang dar/ /phyi dang mkho rgu'i dpal 'byor dbyar mtsho ltar/ /༷phel /da rgyas k+to bsam don legs tshogs kun//bde legs grub pas bkra paX spyas su/ ༵ 'i /ri/ /phyugardzongagi bsang 'di/sgrobazang thub bstan rgya mtshos gsungs

dgra lha'i rgyal po dge bsnyen dpa' 'bar gyi gsol mchod/༄byu //rgyuḥ/lhun 'grub bde stong nam mkha'i rol pa las//dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag nyid pad+ma 'byung //dri med bstan pa'i mnga' bdag blo bzang grags//sna tshogs sprul ba'i gar mdzad khyed la 'dud//'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par mdo smad kyi//'ju lag mthon po bcu sum nang tshan gyi//kun bzang ri bo lhun po ltar brjid pa'i//ri phran du mas mtha' nas yongs bskor ba//de yi dbus su sngon shing las grub pa'i/ /pho brang dam pa gser gyi tog mdzes can//de yi dbus su kun bzang stobs rgyas zhes//sku mdog dkar dmar zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa//phyag g.yas bgrang phreng g.yon pas nor bu 'dzin//rin chen gnyis pa las grub dbu rmog gsol//gser khrab 'od ldan sku la — legs par brgyan//sga srab brgyan pa'i rta mchog sngo nag bcibs//las byed blon po klu ri thang khu dang //gser khes rmog mgo gzhan yang las byed sogs//dam bzhag la dgongs thogs med gnas 'dir gshegs//'dir byon rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs//ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgya las byung ba'i//'dod yon mchod pa'i phud dang sman sna'i tshogs//'dus pa'i bsang mchod chu 'dzin ltar 'khrigs pa//staX spyoXzang stobs rgyas 'khor dang bcas

la 'bul/ /bsang mchod 'di bzhes tha tshig nyer dgongs la/ /sangs rgyas bstan srung dge 'dun sde skyong dang //khyad par yul phyogs 'di la gnas bgyid pa'i//bdag sogs 'khor bcas legs tshogs rgyas par mdzod//khyad par dkar la brtson mdzad rjes 'brangs pa'i//sbyin pa'i bdag po mi nor yo byad rigs//gnod sems rku 'phrog mi dang mi min dang //gcan gzan gdug pa'i ngar 'jigs zhi bar mdzod//mdor na rtag tu khyed gsol khyed bsten na//mthu rtsal ma chung bu bzhin skyong ba dang //'thab rtsod mu ge nad yams nyer 'tshe'i rigs//mi mthun phyogs kun myur du zhi bar mdzod// rgyuḥrnam dag chos dbyings rang bzhin 'od gsal las//yul lha'i rgyal po kun bzang mthu rtsal can//gter bdag rnam rol dngos grub stsol mdzad pa'i//dgra lha'i sde dpon khyed la bdag bstod do//las byed dang blon gtso bo'i tshul 'dzin pa//sku mdog dkar la dmar zhing zhi ma khro//rin chen du mas brgyan cing sbrul zhags 'dzin//dngos grub stsol mdzad khyed la bdag bstod do//srog bdag bshan pa'i tshul 'dzin thang khu dang //mthu stobs ngar ldan ming 'dzin gser khes dang //las byed kun gyi skyong rje rmog mgo sogs//'phrin las sgrub mdzad 'khor chen gsum la bstod//sngon tshe dbang chen rol ba'i dkyil 'khor du//dbang bskur tha tshig gnyan po nyer dgongs la//bdag cag dpon slob yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi//bsam don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i grogs mdzod cig /zhes pa ni sngo kho ngag dbang legs ba//lha rdi mas bris pa'o/

stobs ldan la bsang mchod 'bul tshul/༄4 //rgyuḥ/chos dbyings rang bzhin lhun grub pho brang nas//dpal ldan gzhi bdag stobs ldan dpal 'byor che//sku mdog dkar bo phyag g.yas be con dang / /phyag g.yon zhags pa gter gyi bum pa bsnams/ /dar khra'i na bza' gsol zhing rta dkar bcibs/ /chos ldan sgrub pa po la dgyes pa'i nyams//'khor bcas mi mngon dbyings nas bzhengs su gsol//mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog tsan dan dri//mun sel dri chab bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs//sgra snyan rkang gling rol mo'i tshogs rnams 'bul//bzhes nas dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol/ oṃ lha'ihūṃ/lan gsum brjod/gser skyems 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen po 'di//stobs ldan dpal 'byor 'khor dang bcas pa la//'bul lo bzhes nas bdag cag yon mchod kyi//chos mthun bsam don ma lus bsgrub cagasol//ba lu thug pa tsan dan dri bzang sogs//phye mar 'o ma rgya ja'i btung ba'i tshogs//stobs ldan dpal 'byor dam can 'khor bcas la//bsang mchod dam pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol//yul phyogs 'dis mtshon yul gru thams cad du//nad yams 'khrug rtsod mi shis rgud pa'i tshogs//nye bar zhi zhing chos mthun legs tshogs kun//yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i sdongs grogs mdzod//yul gzhi skyod ba'i srung ma mthu rtsal can//'phrin las

༄༄ //chos dbyings rnam dag dbyings las ma tha/byes kyang //thabs kyis khro bo'i skur ston gdug pa 'dul//che ba'i che mchog lha yi lhar gyur pa//kun bzang lha ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo/bde mchog lhan skyes kyi gzungs/

stobs ldan la bsang brngon gyi cho ga 'dod don 'grub pa'i glu dbyangs/༄ //na mo gu ru badz+ra d+dha ra ya/ 'dir yul skyong gzhi bdagachen postobasaldan dpal 'byor la bsang mchod rgyas par byabar 'dod pa'i rgyas parabasang brngon gyi tshul byed na/ dkon mchog yul lha'idakar gtor sum po pad 'dab can dang / brngon gyi gtor ma gru bzhi bang rim bzhi ba ri rab ma'i tshul du bgyis pa'i steng du skum po'i gtor mchung ba nyi zla nor bu tog can gyi mthar ril bus bskor ba dang /sde brgyad spyi dang 'dab 'brel gyi/gzhi bdag lhaklu rnams la/dkar gtor gcig bcas bshams/'bring gsol mchod spyi 'groltar byed na/dkar gtor cha rgyan ci mdzes mthar ril bus bskor ba gcig gis kyang chog de gnyisagang byed kyang gye mar gser skyems/sha khrag ma 'dres pa'i zas: phud mda' dar go mtshon sogs spyan gzigs ci'abyor bshams/ shug pa sogs kyis bsang dudachen po btang zhing /skyabs semasatshad med bzhi bsgom pa sogs dang /yi dam gang rung gi rnal 'byor rgyas pa'am/ skad cig dkrong bskyed byas te mchod gtor rnams la chu gtsang bran la/oṃ badz+ra ma sgri tas bsangs/oṃ su bha was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las mchod gtor bsang rdzas spyi rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i mgron rnams la gang 'dod kyi dgyes pa'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ oṃ ā:rgyu:lanagasum brjod/ spro na sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs/ bden stobs brjod/ rol mo'i dbyangs dang bcas 'di ltar/4srid zhi'i dge legs kun gyi byed sdo sdu/ga /mchog gsum dbyer med bla ma

yi dam lha/ /lha klu dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs bcas rnams/ /rnam dag mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//khyad par bsil ldan ljongs kyi mdo khams smad//dge bcu kun tshang yul gyi bye brag la//gnas bcas dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon che//stobs ldan dpal 'byor 'khor bcas spyan 'dren no//lha yi rgyal po chen po sku mdog dkar//phyag g.yas rin chen 'bar ba'i be con dang / /g.yon pa'i zhags pa gter chen bum bzang 'dzin/ /dgyes 'dzum nyams kyis mchod pa'i gnas 'dir byon//rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan rab dkar rta la bcibs//sku la lhab lhub dar gyi na bza' gsol//'khor du lha klu sman mo'i tshogs kyis bskor//kun kyang ma thogs rangs pa'i tshul gyis byon//nam mkha' mdzod du spel ba'i mchod sprin dbus//rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la legs bzhugs nas//sna tshogs mchod pa'i bye brag 'di dag kun//bzhes nas rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /zhes spyan 'dren dang bzhugs su gsolanas mchod pa 'bulab ni/ /lha chab gtsang ma'i mchod yon zhabs bsil dang //sna tshogs me tog spos sna'i du ba'i sprin//mun sel sgron me dri bzang bsgos pa'i chab//ro brgya'i zas dang gdangs snyan rol mo'i tshogs//yid 'phrog gzugs dang rna ba'i bdud rtsi'i sgra/ /dri mchog zhal zas 'jam mnyen lha yi gos//gzhan yang mchod pa'i bye brag sna tshogs kyi//lha chen 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig /ces pa'i bar brjod/ sngags mchod byed par spro na/ oṃ ma hā de wa sa pā ri wa ra sa nas shabha'i bar dang rū ba nas spar+sha pra ti ts+tsha hūṃ su hā:zhes pa brjod/mtshams 'dir spro na yig brgya ci 'grub bzlas/kyeḥ bla ma yi dam bka' sdod srung ma/ /kas//lha klu dkar phyogs skyong ba'i

tshogs rnams dang //khyad par lha chen stobs ldan dpal 'byor che//'khor bcas dgyes pa'i thugs kyis bdag la dgongs//bdag cag mi shes rmongs pa'i dbang gyur nas//'gal 'khrul phog thug nongs pa gang byas rnams//deng 'dir 'gyod pa'i sems dang gdung thugs kyis/ /mthol zhing bshags na tshangs par bstsal tu gsol/zhes bshags pa bya/ka dag dbyings nas stobs ldan lha khyed la//kha dog dbyibs legs mchod pa'i bye brag tshogs//ga bur ngad ldan bsang shing dud sprin bcas//nga rol snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'bul 'dir dgongs//ca co'i glu dang lhan cig 'dod yon gyi//cha shas kun tshang gtor ma ri ltar spungs//ja chang gser skyems btung ba'i mchod pa 'di//nya rgyas zla ltar dgyes pa'i 'dzum zhal ston//ta la'i 'dab ma rgyas pa'i bsang shing tshogs//tha dad gcig tu bsreg pa'i du ba'i phreng //da lta nyid du stong gsum 'gengs byed pa//na bun phung bo 'thibs pa'i bsang gis mchod//pa sangs ltar dkar lha lug zhol pho mo//pha rol kun myur thugs ldan cang shes rta//ba gam mngon mtho khang bzang yo byad tshogs//ma lus mchod pa'i sprin gyis thugs dam bskangs//tsa ko ra sogs mdzes ldan 'dab chags rnams//tsha grang rgyas kyi shan 'byed skad snyan sgrog /dza lang gdug pa'i gcan gzan sna tshogs dang //wa sogs ri skyes srog chags kun kyang 'bul//zhwa gos bzhin pa phyag mtshan rin chen rgyan//za 'og dar gyi na bza' go khrab mtshon//'a 'ur sgra sgrog rngam brjid rol cha'i dbyangs//ya mtshan 'dod dgu'i mchod tshogs rgya mtsho'i mchod//rwa gdengs rdo rje'i mtshon cha'i rjes 'gro ba'i//la btsas dgra lha dgyes pa'i rten 'brel rdzas//sha ru'i btsas sogs rten rdzas sna tshogs

'dis/ /sa 'di'i lha klu btsan gsum dgyes gyur cig /ha har bzhad pa'i gsang sngags bden stobs kyis//a don dbyings su dgyes pa'i mchod sprin 'dis//dngos grub 'byung gnas bla ma yi dam lha//dkar phyogs skyong mdzad stobs ldan gzhi bdag che//lha klu btsan sogs mthu ldan sde brgyad rnams//mchod do 'dod don 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol//mdor na dkar phyogs skyong ba khyed rnams kyis//sangs rgyas bstan pa'i dbu 'phang gnyan po bstod//bstan 'dzin skyes bus gang bskos 'phrin las sgrubs//sbyin bdag ltos bcas kun gyi 'gal rkyen sol//mthun rkyen ma lus yid bzhin 'grub pa dang //yulaphyogs 'di kun bde zhing skyid par mdzod//khyad par thub dbang bstan pa'i rtsa lag mchog/'jigs byed rdo rje can dang dbyer med pa//mthong ba don ldan gdul bya rgya mtsho'i mgon//gang de'i bka' sgrub mdzad 'phrin rgyas par mdzod//ces dang 'phrin bcol bstod pa ni/7 snang sems dbyer med lhan cig skyes pa'i 'phrul//snang ba ci yang mdzad pa'i zlos gar las//snang srid dbyer med stobs ldan dpal 'byor che//snang stong gnyis su med pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod//sngon bsags bsod nams du ma'i stobs kyis brjid//las bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrub pa'i mthu rtsal ldan//dge mtshan dpal gyis kun las mngon par mtho//'dod dgu'i 'byor ba kun tshang khyed la bstod//gus pas bsten na gang 'dod 'phrin las sgrubs//mchod cing bstod na 'dod pa'i dngos grub stsol//drag rtsal myur mgyogs stobs ldan dgra lha che//'khor dang bcas pa rnams la bdag bstod do//chos skyong gzhi bdag chen po 'khor bcas kyis//chos mthun bsang mchod rgya rden ༷ni bzhes nas//chos ldan rnal 'byor

bdag gi bsam don rnams//chos bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las dngos grub stsol//ces bstod cing /yig brgya bzlas la nongs pa bzod pa gsol// ḍūkhurmongs pa'i dbang gi cho ga 'khrul ba dang //ser sna'i dbang gyur mchod gtor dman pa sogs//bzod par bzhes nas rnal 'byor bdag cag gi /'dod don legs tshogs ma lus 'grub par mdzod//ces bzod gsol bya zhing / shis par brjod pa ci rigs pas mthar brgyan par bya'o/'di yang don gnyer can 'gas nan tan tu bskulangor ngag dbang legs bshad nyi bye/ nir/ shāḥ // /sdus sdus kār+sha/ po dgyes pa dang / yul khams kun tu bde

skya ring sngo ring sogs rang rtags phyogs kyi gzhi bdag gi bsang mchod mdor bsdus/༄༄ / /kyeḥ bkra shis byin chags rang rtags 'dzin ma'i ljongs//skyong mdzad bkra shis spo mtho zhes grags gnyan//re 'ga' klu dbang re 'ga' rab byung chas//bdag gi phyug g.yang spel phyir gshegs su gsol//khra leb rnga chen rnga chung go tshang brag /skya ring sngo ring la sogs yul ljongs 'dir/ /ri brag nags tshal lung ba thang snang gshong //chu mig 'bab chu mtsho la gnas pa yi//lha klu dmu btsan sman mo la sogs pa'i//dkar bo'i phyogs skyong ji snyed mchis pa kun//gnas 'dir bsang gi mgron du spyan drangs na//thogs med rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis gshegs su gsol//zho 'o rtsi mar ja chang dkar dmar zas//sha thud 'khur ba shing tog rin chen dang //rgyan gos bzhon pa la sogs mchod pa'i sprin//gzhi bdag 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul//rin chen 'bru sman dri bzang phye mar phud//ye shes mer bsregs dbang sngon dud sprin gyis//spo mtho khra leb rnga chen go tshang brag/yul phyogs 'dir gnas gnyan rigs thams cad bsang / /gdong yag lha ri rdza cha dbu thog sogs//mtsher lhas gla kyo'i nyin srib la gnas pa'i//mngon shes rdzu 'phul mthu stobs cher — ga

mnga' ba'i//lha klu gzhi bdag sde brgyad ma lus bsang //bsang mchod rgya chen phul pa'i yon tan gyis//rmongs pa bdag cag bya spyod mi mkhas pas//sa rko rdo slog shing gnyan bcad la sogs//khyed cag thugs dang 'gal rnams bzod par gsol//'dir yang dgra jag chom kun kha mchu dang //me chu gcan gzan dgra gdon nad rims sogs/ /mi shis mtshan ma'i ming yang mi 'byung bar//rigs rgyud mnga' thang longs spyod rgyas par mdzod//༄rna //thabs mkhas thugs rje'i shākya'i rigs 'khrungs shing //ci rigazhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung bcom pa//gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku//shākya'i gtso bo de la gus phyag 'tshal//thub pa rdo rje gdan gyi gzungs/

gnas bdag byams pa dbang phyug gi gsol mchod rnam rgyal snyan pa'i 'brug sgra/༄'i //na mo gu ru/ 'dir gnas bdag byams pa dbang rgyug la gsol mchod rgyas par bya tshul ni/dkar gsum mngar gsum gtsor gyur pa'i gtor rdzas kyi zan gtsang ma'i dkar gtor kum po ril bus bskor ba/ nyer spyod lnga/ gye mar/ zas phud/ gser skyems/spyan gzigs gang 'byor rgyas par bshams/ bsangadud cher btang / dung dkar rnga sil sogs rol mo rnams sta gon byas te/ skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgoms pa sngon du btang /yi dam gang yang rung ba'i rnal 'byor ram/skad cig dkrong bskyed byas te/mchod pa'i yo byad rnams la chab kyis bran la/oṃ badz+ra ma bla tas bsangs/su rna las sbyangs/stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las sne las rin po che snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ āḥrgyu zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod gtor bsang rdzas spyan gzigs rten rdzas rnams dang mkho dgu'i longs spyod 'dod yon lnga ldan mchod yul spyi dang gnas bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mnyes par byed pa'i mchod sprin sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khams 'gengs shing zad mi shes pa nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ oṃ sarba bid gu ra gu ra gu ra gu ra sogs sngags drug phyag drug gis byin kyis brlabs/ de nas bden stobs brjod/ rol mo dbyangs dang di/sa pas 'di ltar/ cha dge mtshan

phun tshogs mdo smad skyid pa'i ljongs//'ju lag bkra shis thang zhes grags pa'i gnas//gangs ri g.ya' brag ri bo mkha' la bsnyegs//ljon pa'i phreng ldan dgas tshal lo 'dab rgyas//spang ljongs me tog sna tshogs tshon gyis bkra//dag byed chu klung dal 'bab 'khyil zhing rgyu//gtsug lag khang dang gnas gzhi 'brog dang grong //snod bcud 'byor ba phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus//bsod nams las grub rang snang gdan khri'i steng //yul 'di'i dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon che//klu gnyan chen po byams pa dbang phyug ni//sku mdog dkar dmar phyag g.yas rin chen snod//g.yon pa shel dkar phreng ba rgyan ldan bsnams//dar ljang 'jol ber btsun gzan dmar khra gsol//ral ba thod bcings nor bu'i cod paṇa mdzes//rin chen prog zhu mu tig do shal dang //sna tshogs rgyan 'chang rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs//'khor du lha klu sde brgyad mthu bo che//mdzes sdug sman mo'i tshogs bcas dregs pa'i tshogs//rnam 'gyur gzugs dang cha byad sna tshogs can//du mas bskor ba'i mthu ldan srung ma che//mchod pa'i gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs su gsol//sngags 'chang grub dbang gong ma rim byon dang //rdo rje 'chang dngos bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde'i//dgon gnas dge 'dun sde bcas nyer gtad pa'i//dam tshig la dgongs 'dir byon 'phrin las sgrubs/ kyiḥ lha chab gtsang ma'i mchod yon zhabs bsil dang //dri zhim mdog legs lha mi'i me tog tshogs//phyogs kun khyab pa'i dri ldan bdug pa'i spos//༷rdi /ra rtsi mar sgron me 'od du 'bar//dri

bzang gis bsgos spos chab byugs pa dang //dkar gsum bza' bca' zhal zas ro brgya ldan//rnga sil dung dkar snyan pa'i rol mo sogs//gnas bdag yul lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//oṃ a pra tī ts+tsha rdu su hā/ nas shastam+bha rgyu/mdzes sdug nyams dang mdog legs yid 'ong gzugs//drug ldan snyan pa'i glu dbyangs rna ba'i bcud//lhan skyes sbyar byung dri bzang stong gsum 'gongs//zas mchog kun gyi bcud du gyur pa'i ro//reg bya mchog gis bde ster lha yi gos/ /dbang bo lnga la dga' bde mchog ster zhing / /yid dbang tshim byed 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga//gnas bdag yul lha 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//oṃ rū ba nas spar+sha lha'irgyu/ 7 lhun grub bde stong nam mkha' yangs pa la/ /rten 'byung cir yang 'char ba'i ngo mtshar dang //gzungasarig phyag rgya ting 'dzin rol ba las/ /byung ba'i 'dod dgu kun tshang mchod pa'i sprin/ /klu gnyan chen po byams pa dbang phyug dang / /lhan skyes yul skyong gzhi bdag 'khor bcas dang / /lha klu sde brgyad mthu chen 'khor bcas kyi/ /spyan lam 'byung zhing dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig /gser dngul rin chen las grub snod yangs su//bdud rtsi'i mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog spos//'od 'bar sgron me dri chab zhal zas dang //yid 'ong rol mo'i cha byad glu gar dang //gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya mchog gyur pa'i/ /phyi nang 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga//mthun pa'i nyer spyod mchod sprin rgya mtsho 'dis//byams pa dbang phyug 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //'phan //kas rgyal mtshan ba dan 'ja' ltar

bkra//rnam par rgyal ba'i ru mtshon mkha' la bsgrengs//rang srung rdo rje'i go khrab 'od du 'bar//dgra 'joms rno ngar mtshon cha tshar du dngar//srid zhi'i dpal 'byor snying bo rgyal srid bdun//gdugs dkar gser nya bum pa pad dkar dung / /dpal be'u rgyal mtshan 'khor lo la sogs kyis/ /byams pa dbang phyug 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //gang bsam yid bzhin 'jo ba dbang gi rgyal/ /'dod dgu kun 'byung gter chen bum pa bzang //lha mi'i dpal 'byor rgyas pa'i rin chen tshogs//nyer 'tsho'i longs spyod gtso bo 'bru sna lnga//ro brgya ldan pa'i bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs//nad 'joms ro nus phun tshogs sman sna'i rigs//dri ro phun tshogs ljon 'bras sna tshogs kyis//byams pa dbang phyug 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //myur mgyogs cang shes rta mchog sprin ltar 'phyo//zhol g.yag pho mo srung rtags dar tshon mdzes//'jam pa'i spu ldan lha lug dkar bo dang //klu ra dkar mo sman mchog 'o ma can//sha rkyang ri dgas 'dab chags sna tshogs dang //thig le ri mor mdzes pa'i stag gzig gung //rten rdzas yid 'ong srog chags sna tshogs 'dis//byams pa dbang phyug 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //rin chen rgyan phreng lha gos na bza' dang //gzi 'od 'bar pa'i prog zhu nor bu'i tog/rin chen snod dang shel phreng bum pa bzang //'ja' tshon ltar bkra lhab lhub za 'og gos//go khrab sag lham mdung ring zangs gri dang //rgyal mtshan cang te'u nor bu la sogs pa'i//'dod dgu'i nyen ldiX phyag mtshan sna tshogs 'dis//byams

pa dbang phyug 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang /mkha' la char sprin 'brug sgra char rgyun 'bebs//sa la ljon shing rtsi bcud lo 'dab rgyas//lhun sdug ri bo'i phreng ba tshar du dngar//nags tshal spang ljongs nyams dga' sna tshogs mdzes//rgyun bzang chu klung tshogs rnams phyogs kun 'bab//bkra shis dge mtshan rnam bcu rab rgyas pa'i//rang byung gnas kyi ngo mtshar du mas kyang //byams pa dbang phyug 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //rab yangs snod du 'bru sna'i zan gyi rigs//dkar gsum mngar gsum snying bo lnga phrag lnga//sbyar ba'i gtor ma zag med bdud rtsi ru//ting 'dzin sngags brgyas byin gyis brlabs pa dang //bza' bca' btung ba bye mar mngar gsum skyems//ja dkar chang rgod gser skyems la sogs pa//mchod gtor 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dis//byams pa dbang phyug 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //lha klu mi yi mnol grib sel ba'i shing //sna tshogs bsang rdzas bsregs pa'i du ba'i sprin//bsreg gtor bkrus pa'i dri zhim mchod pa ni//'dod dgu'i dngos por kun nas 'char ba dang //gzhan yang dngos bshams yid sprul mchod rdzas kyis//klu gnyan byams pa dbang phyug thugs dam bskang //yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //mthu ldan sde brgyad tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs pas bdag cag 'khor bcas la//'dod don 'phrin las ma lus bsgrub par mdzod// bshags pa ni/ bdag cag bya ba spyod pa mi mkhas pas//dkar dmar thab gzhob la sdogasdu nongs pa'i rigs/khyed rnams

thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis kun//dmigs med ngang nas bshags kyis bzod par mdzod// ces bya'o//gtor mal/oṃ badz+ra ma sbo tas bsangs/su lha pas — sbyangs/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las rgyu las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du cha'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur/oṃ āḥrgyu/ lan gsum brjod/na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta a wa lo ke te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūṃ/lan bdun nam bco lnga/ nyer gcig sogs kyis bsngo/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ bdag gi bsam pa'i zhes pa nas 'byung gyur cig yul gyi lha klu 'byung bo khyed rnams la/zhes pa nas/legs tshogs ma lus lhun gyis grub par mdzod ces brjod/bstod pa ni/ ḍūkhurgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag grub pa'i dbang //mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i sku phreng rim byon gyis/ /dpon slob sde bcas nyer gtad srung ma che//klu gnyan byams pa dbang phyug khyed la bstod//sku mdog dkar gsal lha yi cha byad can//rin chen rgyan 'chang dar tshon na bza' bklubs//rat+na'i snod dang shel dkar phreng ba 'dzin//mdzes sdug nyams kyis rol pa khyed la bstod/ /yid mthun gnas kyi 'byor ba phun sum tshogs//lha klu dkar phyogs skyong ba'i 'khor gyis bskor//sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs rnams bran du bkol//snang srid dregs pa mthu chen khyed la bstod//mngon shes rdzu 'phul mthu stobs thogs pa med//re zhing ltos tshe gang 'dod 'phrin laX rdi/ //mchod cing bstod na khas blangs

chad mdo btsan//dam can srung ma chen po khyed la bstod//res 'ga' dpa' gtum nyams ldan klu ma btsan// lcags khrab gsol zhing mdung ring btsan zhags thogs//gdug pa'i klu btsan 'byung bo'i dmag dpung can//bgegs 'joms dgra lha chen po khyed la bstod/khyed dang gnyis med klu dbang mthu bo che//'chi med bdud rtsi'i bum pa sbrul zhags 'dzin//klu dang sman mo'i 'khor tshogs dang bcas pas//sdod bcud kun gyi legs tshogs spel la bstod/ /gzhan yang ma dros klu dbang mthu bo che//dpa' bo'i bka' srung rnam rgyal rab brtan sogs//nyin srib ri dang dgas tshal chu mig la//gnas bcas dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams la bstod//yul 'di'i lha klu mthu ldan khyed rnams ni// sngon gyi khas blangs dam bcas nyer dgongs te//dgon gnas dge 'dun sde dang gtsug lag khang / /skyong la 'phrin las rnam bzhi ma g.yel cig /dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde rnams thugs mthun zhing //bshad sgrub bstan pa'i bya ba dar zhing rgyas//gus mchod lhur len sbyin pa'i bdag po rnams//dpal 'byor legs tshogs gong du 'phel bar mdzod//ku 'phrog 'khrug rtsod 'khu ba'i sems ldan rnams//ltas dang mtshan ma gdug rtsub rnam 'gyur gyis//thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag pa dang //mi 'dod nyer 'tshe mtha' dag bzlog par mdzod//nad mug btsa' ser than pa shwa 'od sogs//phyi nang 'byung ba'i gnod pa kun zhi zhing //lo legs char snyoms sdod bcud thams cad la//bde skyid dga' ston dar ba'i 'phrin laX /sdod//ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang //

gang yang nus pa ma mchis pa/ /'di ni bya ba gang byas pa//de kun khyed kyis bzod par mdzod/ zhes pa nas/ mdzad du gsol/ stong gsal mkha' la sprin bzhin mos stobs kyis//spyan drangs mthu ldan dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams/ /rang snang nyams dga'i gnas dang rten sogs la//gshegs gsol brtan par bzhugs shing dgyes par mdzod//ces brtan bzhugs sogs bya zhing / shis brjod ci rigs kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o/zhes bkra shis dar rgyas gling gi gnas bdag byams pa dbang jig la gsol mchod rgyas pa bya tshul rnam rgyal snyan pa'i 'brug sgra 'di ni/ lung rtogs yon tan gyi gter mdzod/slob dpon skya bo tshang dang / khri zur tshang ba rin po che rnam gnyis nas 'di 'dra zhig 'bri dgos pa'i bka' gsung lha rdzasabacas bstsal paspyi bor mnos te/ khri zur ngagadabang ske legs bshad nyi mas shing glang smin drug zla ba'i dam ra phyogs rdzogs pa gnyis pa'i nyin sbyar ba dge legs su gyuracig/

bya dkar bsang bsdus/༄ //hūṃ/bde stong ting 'dzin sgyu ma'i rnamarol las//byung ba phyi nang rten rdzas sna tshogs dang //dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod gtor gser skyems sogs//gnam sa bar snang khyon kun gang ba 'dis//dge bsnyen bya dkar chen po thugs dam bskang /sde brgyad 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho thugs dam bskangan/thugs dam bskangs nas 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsolaspyos ci sa 57 r+shaX shu tsho sa sdoX ci rme jibye/ cig ba'i ci 4)rngo ༷༷1 —2nya

drang srong chen po kurma bzang skyong gi gsol mchod 'phrin las bskul byed g.yas 'khyil dung gi rang sgra/༄ / /na mo gu ru lhaḥ/ rigs brgya'i 'dab stong cig char rdzogs pa'i dpyid/ /rigs kun spyi gzugs byang chub kun tu bzang / /rig 'dzin mtsho skyes blo bzang grags pa'i dpal//rigs gsum dbyer med skyabs mchog rnams la 'dud//gser ldan 'dzam gling yangs pa'i lus phra ma/ /mdzes byed rgyan gyi thig le mdo smad kyi/ /yul lha'i gtso bo kurma bzang skyong zhes//grags pa'i ba dan srid na mtho ba yi//mchod chog g.yas 'khyil dung gi rang byung sgra/bskul pa'i mod la dge mtshan bye ba'i char/ /mos ldan zhing la dbab pas 'dod dgu'i 'bras/ /'khrungs par 'gyur ba'i cho ga 'dir rten cig/ ces mdo smad dpa' ris sa cha'i zabasung skyid pa'i ljongs kyi yul lha garma bzang skyong la bsngon gtongabar 'dod pas/ zan byegatsang mar bzang drug dkar gsum mngar gsum sogs bsres pal dkon mchogaspyi gtor/brngon gtor bangarim bzhi ba de'i steng du skum gtor pada'adab bzhib bcad khams kyis bskor ba/mdun du blon gtor zur gsum/mtha' skor du ril bu stong / sde brgyadagaser skyems/gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs la mar rgyan mdzes par btang / gnag phyugs mdzo rta ra lug sogs sgo phyugs/stag gzig dom dred sogs gcan gzan rigs/rwa rkyang rgo rna shaX/ ḍi dwags/mda' mdung mtshon cha go khrab

sogs spyan gzigs sna tshogs/chu gnyis nyer spyod dung gling rnga sil sogs rolamo/'dod yon rgyal srid bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs mchod pa sna tshogasa'adu byas la bsang dud cher btang /rang nyid kyis thachang sgog tsong sogs spangs te skyabs sems sngon tu 'gro ba'i yi dam lhagang yang rung ba'i ngargyal dang ldan pa'i sgo nas 'di skadado/cha rang bzhin dag pa dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor du//ma bcos lhun 'grub dngos pa'i rten 'brel gshis//bde gshegs rgyal ba kun gyi smon lam dang //'gro ba'i las snang mthu las 'di ltar grub/ /gser ldan 'dzam gling yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor la//gling bzhi'i 'dab ma ri bo'i se'u 'bru rgod//'dod khams lha las bskyed pa'i mi'i 'gro ba//rgyal blon 'bangs bcas brtan g.yo'i 'jig rten srid//'dzam bu'i shing gis mtshan pa'i ma : rtsa'i//byang phyogs gangs ri'i ra ba'i 'dab ma'i sbubs/ /mdo smad sum rtsen sa la 'phos pa'i zhing //dpal yul lha yi skyed tshal gnyis pa'i zla/ /phun tshogs dge bcu'i dpal g.yang 'khyil ba'i gzhi//rdza ri gangs dkar shel gyi mchod rten brtsigs//spang ri rtsi sngon sngo ljang gos kyis bklubs//nags ri lhun sdug skra yi lan bu g.yo//chu rgyun yan lag brgyad ldan phyogs kun 'bab/ /rtsi sman me tog sna tshogs tshon gyis bkra//bung ba'i tshogs rnams snyan dgu'i mgrin glu len//'phur lding rol ba'i 'dab chags gshog rtsal 'gran//shā rkyang rna ba sdig med zas kyis 'tsho//stag spyang dom dred 'jigs pa'i ngar sgra sgrog /de lta'i ngo mtshar 'dzoms pa'i yul ljongs 'dir//dngos bshams yid sdi sal ba'i mchod sprin tshogs//sa la rtsi

bcud bar snang zang char dang //mkha' la sprin bzhin 'khrigs shing gtibs pa'i klong //rang snang bsod nams las grub khang bzang dang //khri stan bzhon pa sna tshogs grub 'dir dgongs// de nas mgron spyan 'dren pa ni/kyiḥ 'od lnga rab 'bar 'ja' tshon gur khyim du/ /drug zung dpe mtshon che phra sgyu ma'i sku/ /chos dbyings mdzes ma'i rol ba dang 'grogs pas//gang 'dul sprul ba'i bkod pa sna tshogs pa//byin rlabs gter gyur rtsa brgyud bla ma dang //dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam zhi dang khro//sa lam grogs mdzad dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang //'phrin las dbang phyug chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs//bdag cag mos pa'i mchod sprin bstar ba'i dbus//dwangs pa'i mtsho la zla ba'i gzugs brnyan bzhin/ /snang stong rten 'brel bslu med ngang nas gshegs//dgyes 'dzum klong nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol//khyad par rdza dkar mchod rten brtsigs pa'i dbyibs//khor yug spang ri rkang bzhi'i 'tsho ba'i rten//lhang lhung sgra ldan chu rgyun phyogs kun 'bab//sa 'dzin sna tshogs nags tshal smad g.yog mdzes//rab dkar chu 'dzin dar gyis thod 'chang rtser//nyi zla'i 'od 'bar lhun brjid ri bo'i klong //rin chen khang bzang gser g.yu'i rgya thabs can//rab mdzes rnam par bkra ba 'bum gyi dbus/ /dbang sngon zhun ma dag pa'i be+eḍūr+ya'i//khang bzang rin chen rgya phibs tog gis mdzes//nor bu'i 'phyang 'phrul g.yer kha'i sgra snyan 'khrol//dbang bo'i khang bzang bsnyems pa 'phrog pa'i nang //'ja' tshon sprin dkar diXdi mar 'khrigs pa'i klong //lha g.yag

dkar bo rnam par 'gying ba'i steng //lha yi drang srong kurma bzang skyong zhes//de ring bsten mchod gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no//mdun ngos gnam lcags gur bu'i dbyibs ldan ri//bka' blon sha sgrol smug dag khro gtum nyams//btsun phran nyams ldan stong sde pho nya'i tshogs//lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs bcas gshegs//khyad par yul phyogs yul gru 'dir gnas pa'i//yul lha gzhi bdag lha klu bdud btsan sman/ /mi min 'byung bo ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /gnas 'dir mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ de nas mchod gtor rnams bsang sbyangs/sngags drug gis byinagyis brlabs te 'bul ba ni/cha rab dkar sems nyid dag pa'i chu mtsho las//legs 'khrungs mchod ngas chu skyes dkar bo'i tshal//ting 'dzin sngags rgya'i 'od kyis phye ba 'di//'khor 'das mgron kun dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul//dwangs bsil chu gnyis me tog bdug pa'i spos//snang gsal dri chab zhal zas rab snyan sgra//'dod yon rnam lnga rgyal srid rin chen bdun/ /bkra shis rdzas rtags la sogs mchod pa 'bul/ /dri zhim shing sna bye mar zas phud sogs/ /rab 'bar me la bsregs pa'i dud sprin gyis//kun gsal nam mkha'i dbyings kun khyab pa 'dis//drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs kun bsang //yi dam zhi khro rab 'byams ma lus bsang / /spang rtogs mthar phyin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bsang / /gzhan la phan brtson rgyal sras tshogs rnams bsang //srid par zhen log nyan rang ma lus bsang / /zhing sngags lhan skyes dze+e ༷sna mkha' 'gro bsang / /thub dbang

bstan srung rdo rje chos skyong bsang //dkar phyogs skyong ba'i yul lha gzhi bdag bsang //khyad par 'dzam gling skyong ba'i yul lha'i gtso/ /sa bcu'i sems dpa' 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshul//srid pa'i lha chen rma rgyal sbom ra che//yum sras 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus bsang //gang gra'i sring mo klung chen 'ju lag 'gram//rab brtan sa 'dzin mthon por gnas bcas pa'i//a skyes gangs dkar mgon po gdong dmar dang //gnam skas bya dur khra leb ra rgod dang //stag btsan phyor 'dzong dmar mtho skya ka ri//lhun po'i rtse dang rab bzang klu ri ste//'brog gnas mthon po bcu gsum zhes grags pa'i//dkar phyogs skyong mdzad 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho bsang / /bye brag lha yi drang srong btsun pa'i nyams//snang srid bla ma kurma'i mtshan can bsang //btsan phug stong sde bka' blon sha sgrol dang //phyag brnyan dregs pa'i sde tshogs rgya mtsho bsang //snang zhing srid pa'i lha klu gnyan gyi tshogs//mgron du 'os shing 'dus pa ma lus bsang //sems nyid rang bzhin mkha' ltar dag pa'i dbyings//glo bur nyon mongs srin gyis g.yogs pas mthus//sgo gsum log par spyad pa'i nongs pa kun//bsang mchod rten 'brel 'di yis dag gyur cig /bag med dbang gis ri phyugs bya gcan bsad/ /sa rko rdo slog shing bcad chu gtsang sngags/ /khas blangs chag sogs thugs 'gal gang bgyis pa/ /lha gnyan chen po'i thugs klong mkha' bzhin mdzod//las dang rkyen gyis bsgrun pa'i nad rims god//gdon bgegs kha smras mthu byad gas/5 pa'i tshogs//nyin byed 'od snang smag

la 'thab pa bzhin//skad cig nyid la ming gi lhag mar mdzod//mthu chen khyed kyi 'phrin las 'od zer gyis/ /bdag cag nyer 'tsho'i mun las rab rgyal zhing //bkra shis snang bas sngon bsags skyed tshal du//bde skyid pad+ma'i 'dab phreng rgyas par mdzod/ /cesabasang mchod phul/de nas brngon dang 'brel bar bskang ba gtong b.ra'adod na/ kyi lhun grub bde stong dag pa'i mkha' dbyings su//mchog gsum thugs rje chu 'dzin phreng ba 'khrigs//ting 'dzin sngags rgya'i sgra brgya rgod pa las//sna tshogs mchod pa'i spu char dbab pa ni//yan lag brgyad ldan mchod yon lhung lhung 'bab//pad+ma ut+pal me tog 'dzum dkar dgod//dri zhim spos sna bsregs pa'i du ba 'thul//mun sel sgron me snang ba phyogs brgyar 'bar//dri bzang phye mas bsags pa'i mtsho chen 'khyil//lha mi'i zhal zas ro brgya'i dpal dang ldan//sgra 'dzin dpyid gyur rol mo'i dbyangs snyan sgrog/'dod yon lnga yis nam mkha' bkang ba 'di//rtsa gsum lha dang dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gtso//kurma bzang skyong 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //rin chen in+d+ra'i rmig brtse 'bar ba yis//nor 'dzin bu mo'i bzhin ras 'dar byed cing //sra mkhregs rdo rje ra gdengs glog lce 'khyugs//dgra bo'i snying gas 'jigs rung ngar sgra can//gangs ri sa la rgyu 'dra'i lha g.yag 'di//sna tshogs dar dang rin chen du mas brgyan//dung dkar phur bu yo byad sna tshogs pas//drang srong chen po'i thugs dam dbyings su bskang //bskal ba'i rlung gi shugs 'chang cang shes rta//sprin dkar du/ ༷༷ chad 'dra'i zhol pho mo//spu sdug 'jo

ba'i lug dang rwa skyes tshogs//'phur sding gar gyis rtsen pa'i 'dab chags rigs//gnyis skyes dgra 'joms rgod glag hor ba khra//stag gzig dom sogs mche sder mtshon cha can//pha rol sde las rgyal ba'i rdo je go/dgra 'joms rno ngar 'bar ba'i mtshon cha yis// gdug pa kun 'dul rdo rje srung ma'i tshogs//dkar phyogs skyong ba 'khor dang bcas pa la//myur 'gros bang gis snyems pa'i shā ba rkyang //yang rtsal rol bas khengs pa'i rna ba rgo//rtsi bzang sman gyis 'tsho ba'i ri phyugs tshogs//snyan dgu'i mgrin glu 'gugs pa'i ko ki la//gong mo ngang ngur mthing ril bha ma ra//lhun sdug dgas tshal me tog rgyas pa'i tshal//'bru drug smin pa'i sngo ljang zhing gi tshogs//snod bcud legs tshogs ma tshang med pa 'di//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i ba dan che mtho ba//yul lha 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i chas su 'bul//ro brgya'i dpal dang ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i zas//dkar gsum rgyan gyis spras pa'i bā ling ta//mar thud bza' bca' ri bo lnga bur spungs//ja chang 'o zho dbyar mtsho lta bur 'khyil// yid 'ong khang bzang sbra gur skyed tshal dang //khri stan mal cha chos gos bzhon pa'i tshogs//bstan srung 'khor bcas mnyes pa'i rten du 'bul//dgyes bzhin bzhes nas thugs dam bskang gyur cig/rtsibs stong rab 'bar gser gyi 'khor lo sogs//mi dbang 'khor bsgyur la 'os rin chen bdun//gdugs dkar gser nya bum bzang pad+ma dung //'khor lo rgyal mtshan dpal gyi be'u dang //me long gi wang bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad//nags tshal lha/ ༷/sna nyes pa'i rin chen bdun//srid

zhi'i dpal 'byor snying bo ma lus pa//'bul lo bzhes nas dgyes pas thugs dam bskang //rin chen ri rab gling bzhi rol mtsho bdun//dgos 'dod kun 'byung dpag bsam sngon pa'i shing //'dod 'jo'i ba dang gter bum ma rmos 'bru//phyi dang dkor mdzod gsang ba'i rten rdzas sogs//dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa sna tshogs 'dis//srid zhi'i mgron dang dkar phyogs skyong ba yi//drang srong 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs gyur nas//nyams chag sel zhing 'dod don lhun grub mdzod//gtor ma phul te 'phrin las bcol ba ni 'di ltar/charin chen gzi 'od 'bar ba'i sdod mchog tsa/sman lnga 'bru lnga snying bo lnga la sogs//nas dkar gtsang ma'i zan dang sbyar ba yi//ro brgya ldan pa'i bdud rtsi'i gtor ma'i tshogs//chos kyi dbyings dang mchog gsum bden pa'i mthu//ting 'dzin gzungs dang rig sngags mos pa'i stobs//phyi nang rten 'byung tshogs pa'i chos nyid kyis//'dod dgu nam mkha' mdzod du 'char ba 'di//rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mchog gsum dang //mkha' 'gro chos skyong rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul//srid zhi'i 'jigs skyob mchog thun dngos grub stsol//sa lam grogs mdzod las bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrubs//rten gnas lha klu gzhi bdag tshogs la 'bul//bya bar ko long ma sdom gnas po mdzod//khyad par drang srong kurma bzang skyong che/ /bka' blon sha sgrol btsun stong sde 'khor la//lhun po brtsegs pa'i dbyibs ldan rgyan mdzes sogs//gtor tshogs 'di dag 'bul lo legs bzhes nas//mtsho skyes rdo sdo /sha chen kurma pa//spyan ras gzigs

dbang dkon mchog yar 'phel gyis//rdo rje'i gtsug gtad bdud rtsi lce la bzhag /snying la bran pa'i tha tshig dran dgongs la//phyogs 'dir chos srid legs tshogs 'dod don kun//'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//yul 'di bde skyid 'dod don 'grub pa'i gzhi//gzhi dang rtsa ba rnam dkar dge ba'i las//las mthun bsam sbyor chos dang mthun pa'i dpal//dpal 'byor mnga' thang dar ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//yul 'di'i bde skyid gang la rag las pa//mi shigs rdo rje khams su rtag brtan cing //'phrin las grags pa kun phan gzegs ma yis//lcags ri dkar bo'i khyod kun 'gengs par mdzod//ma bu grogs kyi 'byung khams 'phrod pa yis//smra brjod bden tshig bsam pa mkhas pa'i blo/ /bya ba gegs med 'dod don kun sgrub la/ /dbang thang rlung rta dgung ltar yangs par mdzod//khyad par nad rims dgra jag chom rkun dang //gcan gzan gnod 'tshe thog ser btsan than sogs/ /phyi nang rkyen ngan bar chad chu 'dzin sogs//'phrin las kun khyab dbyings su zhi bar mdzod/ /mi phyugs longs spyod chos srid 'dod don kun/ /bsam pa tsam gyis don la mi bslu ba'i//yid bzhin nor dang bum bzang 'dod 'jo ltar/ /legs tshogs mtsho ltar rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//bye brag bkra shis dge mtshan 'khyil ba'i mtsho//don mthun bshes gnyen nor bu'i yongs su gang //'chad nyan rlabs phreng mkha' la g.yo ba la//gtong ba'i spu char dbab pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//yul 'diX ༷9 /la bsam ngan sbyor rtsub las//byung

ba'i nad gdon byad kha phur kha dang //mi kha gleng brjod mi 'dod rkyen ngan kun/ /pha rol dgra bo'i steng du bzlog cing bsgyur//gzhi la 'dug tshe sems nyid dga' bas tshims// byes su 'gro tshe lus la ngal dub med/ /phar 'gro'i skyel ma tshur 'ong bsu ma dang //nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe mdzod//mdor na dus kun dge legs 'khri shing rtser//gang gi mthu stobs rta bdun rol ba yis//las bzhi'i 'dab ma 'bum du bzhad pa las//phan bde zang rtsi'i dga' ston rgyas par mdzod// spyi sger gyi bsang gsol 'jug pa spro na mtshams 'dir 'don/denas bstod pa bya ba ni/ cha dge legs mthu stobs 'od brgya'i phreng ba yis//skye rgu'i phan bde pad+ma dkar bo'i tshal//rtag tu rgyas mdzad dregs ldan ral ba'i rtser/ /zhabs sen zla ris 'god mkhas khyed la bstod//spros kun bral ba'i dbyings las ngur smig gar/ /lung rtogs yon tan mdzodal mnga' brnyes pa/ /deng 'dir mi min zor gyi rgyal bstan dang / /'gro kun skyong ba'i srung ma khyed la bstod/ /gang sngon rnam dkar rgya mtshos nyer bsgrun pa'i//mthu stobs 'phrin las gser gyi rtsibs stong 'bar//snang srid dbang byed mu khyud gsar ba can//stobs kyi 'khor bsgyur drang srong khyed la bstod//rab yangs byang phyogs gser ldan dga' ma'i ljongs/ /lhun brjid sabartan gor mo brtsegs pa'i klong / /phyi bltas rab brjid sa 'dzin rnam pa la//nang du rin chen las grub pho brang dbus//brjid ldan lha g.yag dkar bo 'gyings pa'i steng / /lha yi drang srong rab dkaX / ba'i zhal/ /zhabs gnyis byed

dkyil rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs//dung zla mtshams sprin gzhon nu 'khyud pa'i rtser//nyin byed 'od 'bar mdzes pa 'gog byed pa'i//gur kum mdangs ldan chos gos bad zhwa gsol//bag yod rtul zhugs 'chang ba khyed la bstod//phyag g.yas dung dkar snyan pa'i sgra brgya pas//sde bzhi'i dga' ston gcig char mgron ca'agugs//g.yon pa'i dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i nor bu yis//mos pa'i zhing la 'dod pa'i char ba 'bebs//mthu stobs rdzu 'phul dpal la mnga' brnyes te//zhi drag rol ba'i 'od phreng 'bum 'gyed pas//mi shis dpung 'joms 'dod yon 'dab brgya bzhad/ /gang 'dul sprul ba'i gar mdzad khyed la bstod// khyed kyi nang blon khro gtum dpa' bo'i nyams//sku mdog smug nag gnam lcags zhun khrab gsol//dbu la dngul dkar rmog mo rgod 'phu ldem//phyag g.yas lcags kyi dgra sta dgra la 'phyar//g.yon pa'i me yi zhags pa bgegs la 'debs//'jigs rung rgya stag 'phyo ba'i bzhon pa can//gdug can srog gi spu gri 'jigs pa'i gzugs//sha sgrol dpa' bo zhes grags khyed la bstod// rigs lam me tog gsar ba'i phon po dag /rnam dpyod sor mo'i 'phrul gyi 'phen mkhas pa/ /dngos stobs rigs par nges rnyed btsun pa'i sne/ /lung rigs rtsal gyis snyems pa rnams la bstod//kun tu 'jigs med mthu dang rdzu 'phrul gyis//dge bcu'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgrengs pa yis/ /phan dang bde ba'i dbyig gi char 'bebs pa/ /yul lha gzhi bdag gnyan po 'khor bcas bstod//gzhan ding bka' 'khor dregs pa'i lha srin

dang //klu btsan sde brgyad bya khra stag spyang tshogs//sa gsum 'geng ba'i sprul ba 'bum 'gyed pa/ /dkar bo'i phyogs skyong dag phyogs 'joms la bstod/ /yangs pa'i 'jig rten skyong ba'i dpal mnga' ba/ /drang srong 'khor bcas mchod cing bstod pa'i mthus//bstan dang bstan 'dzin yon mchod ma lus pa//srung zhing skyob la bsnyel ba med par mdzod/ /mdo khams spyi dang khyad par yul phyogs 'dir/ /mi nad phyugs nad mu ge dmag 'khrug dang / /me chu shwa 'od stobs bcud nyams pa sogs/ /rkyen ngan bar chad ming gi lhag mar mdzod//sa spyod nga las nu yi dus bzhin tu//char chu snyoms shing lo phyug rtag tu 'phel//chos ldan bya ba'i nyin mtshan kun 'da' ba'i//rdzogs ldan dga' ston mgron nubasu bar mdzod//thos pa'i lam du thub pa'i tshangs dbyangs kyis//sdig spang dge sgrub rang sems yongs su dag/khyad par gang snang rang bzhin med gsungs pas//bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du dgongs par mdzod/ /lam bzang sgrub pa'i mthun rkyen sgrub byed cing / /'gal rkyen sel byed mi dang mi min kun//tshe rabs kun tu rgyal bas bsngags pa yi//rnam dag lam dang 'bral bar ma gyur cig /gang tshe drang srong mchod cing bstod byed la//mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul dpung gis stobs bskyed de/ /srung skyob sdongs grogs g.yel ba med pa yi/ /phan bde dpal la rol bzhin bkra shis stsol// gser skyems dang g.yang 'bod bya bar 'dodan/gzhan lasa'abyung ba bzhin bya/ de nas yigabargya gang mang brjod de bzod par gsoX ༷ //4rmongs pas dbang gis 'phrin las

'khrul bar gyer//mchod pa'i dam rdzas ma tshang sbags pa sogs//nyes pa'i tshogs kun snying nas bshags byed na//bzod par mdzod cig thugs rje che ldan rnams/ /gshegs su gsol ba ni/ phan bde dpung gnyen dam par spyan drangs pa'i//snang zhing srid pa'i mgron rigs ma lus pa//ngo bo ma bcos lhun grub chos kyi dbyings/ /rnam pa rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs/ /badz+ramuḥ shis pa brjodapa ni/yid bzhin nor dang bum bzang 'dod 'jo'i ba//dpag bsam shing ltar 'dod pa'i dngos grub kun//'bad med stsol mdzad bla ma yi dam lha//mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i bkra shis shog/ 'jig rten bde zhingasogs shis brjod cirigasabarjod de me tog gi char dbab par bya'o// smras pa/chos srid legs tshogs 'dod pa'i mtsho chen por//mthu ldan 'phrin las gru gzings ba dan can//mchod chog dri bzhon shugs kyis nyer bskul nas/ /'dod pa'i don chen 'grub pas bsten par rigs/ /gzhan phan 'dod pa'i lhag bsam nya rgyas zla//yid kyi chu mtshor shar ba'i skyes bo la//'phral yun phan bde ku mud gsar ba'i tshogs//rgyun tu bzhad pa rten 'brel chos nyid yin//lha yi 'phrin las gzi 'bar nam mkha'i nor/ /rab snyan mchod chog rta bdun shing rtas drangs//yul 'di'i bde skyid pad+ma'i dga' tshal dag/rtag tu bzhad pa'i snang ba 'bar gyur cig/ces dam bzang skyong gigasol mchod 'phrin las bskul byed g.yas 'khyil dung girangasgra zhes bya ba 'di ni/ yul 'di'i snyi/ ༷/ka dad can 'ga' zhig gis bskul pa dang /

nye char mdo sngags rig gnas la gzhan dring mi 'jog pa'i mkhyen rab can bde dgu mkhan rin po ches gsung gisamatshams sbyor gnang ba bzlog mnus par/btsun gzugs rgya tig skyes ming ba ngag dbang dkon mchog rgya mtshos de nyid kyi gzhol du bris pa'i yi ge pa gi rig pa smra ba dgeslong bstan 'dzin gyis bgyi ba dge legs 'phel/༄༄ / /ngan song sbyong rgyal kun rig rnam snang mdzad/ /bde ldan zhing gi mgon po 'od dpag med/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla//'gro ba'i mgon po gsum la gus phyag 'tshal/'gro ba'i mgon po gsum gyi gzungs/

gzhi bdag chen po yum cha kurma bzang skyong gi gsol mchod/༄7 //snang srid dbang bsdus pad+ma thod phreng dang //dbyer med bla ma'i zhabs la gus btud nas//dpa' ris nor 'dzin thig le bye brag gi/yul lha mchod thabs bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun spel// zhes 'ju lag srib ngos kyi ri bo yum cha la gnas pa'i gnyan tshogs kyi bsang mchod byed par 'dod pas/ mkho ba'i yo byad rnams rigs 'dra'i choga'i byin gyis brlabasate 'di skad do/ rgyu/ ka dag chos dbyings 'chi med lam yangs por//lhun grub gzugs sku'i chu 'dzin 'khrigs pa las//dngos grub spu char mchog tu g.yo ba yis/ /bgegs 'dul pad+mas dregs pa dbang du bsdus//dpa' ris zhes grags snyan pa'i ba dan dkar//srid 'dir mtho ba'i nor 'dzin sgeg mo yi//thig le g.yon lung kho shun rang rtags kyi//ri klung chu mtsho ne'u gsing thang sogs la//gnas pa'i lha klu bdud btsan sman mo sogs//mi min 'byung bo ji snyed mchis pa kun/ /gnas 'dir bsang gi mgron du spyan drangs na//zag bcas rdzu 'phrul thugs kyis gshegs su gsol//khyad par dge bcu'i dpal g.yang 'khyil ba'i gzhir/ /rtse ljon me tog ngo mtshar phung phung ldem//kya kyur sgra sgrog 'dab chags 'phur lding g.yo//shā rgo ma bu sgeg pa'i rtsed 'jo byed//chu mig 'bab chu lhang lhung phyogs kun 'bab//de lta'i ngo mtshar dpal gyis spel ba yi/ /sra brtan gor ma glegs bam ltar —— 73

brtsegs pa'i//yum cha zhes grags lhun brjid ri bo'i klong //gser g.yu'i rgya babs tog gis mdzes pa yi//rin chen khang bzang rgyu skar phreng ba bzhin//tshar du dngar ba'i dbus na be+eḍūr+ya'i//khang brtsegs g.yer kha'i sgra snyan 'khrol ba'i dang //'ja' tshon sprin dkar 'dres mar 'khrigs pa'i klong //lha g.yag dkar bo rnam par 'gyings pa'i steng //lha yi drang srong kurma bzang skyong zhes//sku mdog rab dkar zhi ma khro yi nyams//ngur smrig na bza' bad zhwa sne ring gsol/ /phyag g.yas dar dkar g.yon par phur bu bsnams/ /zhabs gnyis byed dkyil rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs//'khor du btsun phran nyams can stong gis bskor//mdun ngos gnam lcags phur bu'i dbyibs ldan ri//bka' blon sha sgrol smug nag khro gtum nyams//gnam lcags zhun khebs dngul rmog rgod 'phu ldem//lcags kyi dgra sta me yi zhags pa 'phen//rgya stag steng na 'jigs pa'i chas kyis 'gyings//bya khra stag spyang sku yi pho nyar 'gyed//lha srin sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bcas//thugs dam dbang gis 'dir gshegs brtan par bzhugs//bde stong ting 'dzin sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul las//legs 'ong chu gtsang 'o zho mtsho ltar bskyil//mar thud bza' bca' ri bo lta bur spungs//dung gling rnga sil rol mo phyogs kun 'khrol//'dab chags ri dwags gcan gzan 'phyo zhing rgyug /na bza' mal cha go mtshon brag ltar gtams//dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i sprin phung gis//drang srong lha gnyan 'khor bcas mchod cing brdaX/6/shazang drug tsan dan lha thug shing

sna'i rigs//dkar mngar snam khur 'bru phye dar zab ras//ye shes mer bsregs du ba be+eḍūr+ya'i//chu 'dzin lta bur lha lam kun khyab 'dis//yul 'dir gnas pa'i srid zhi'i mgron tshogs bsang //lha yi drang srong kurma bzang skyong bsang //bka' blon sha sgrol btsun phran stong sde sogs//'khor tshogs sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag tshogs bsang //phog thug nyams sgrib nyes pa'i dri ma sogs//kun byang dgyes 'dzum klong nas dngos grub stsol//thub dbang rdo rje 'chang dngos pad+ma 'byung //spyan ras gzigs dbang grub chen kurma pas//rdo rje gtsug tor bdud rtsi lce la bzhag /snying la bran pa'i tha tshig dran dgongs la//phyogs 'dir 'khod pa'i gus ldan sbyin bdag kun//me chu gcan gzan nad rims dgra gyod gdon//mi mthun 'jigs tshogs g.yul las rnam rgyal te//tshe bsod rigs rgyud snyan grags rgyas par mdzod//bden pa ma mthong skye bo bdag cag gis/ /bya spyod thugs dang mthun par 'ong dka' ba'i//cung zad tsam la phrag dog mi mdzad par//'gro kun mar dgongs byams pas skyong bar mdzod//sngon tshe thub dbang smra ba'i nyi ma des//sdig pa ci yang mi bya dge tshogs spyad//khyad par chos kun rnam rtog ri mo yis//bos pa tsam gyi don du med gsungs pa'i//bdag gzhan mnyam pa nyid du dgongs mdzod la//yul 'di 'thab rtsod mu ge 'jigs sogs zhi//char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs rtag tu legs//phan tshun sems mthun bde skyid dpal gyis 'tsho//bstan dang bstan 'dzin gus mchod lhur len mdzod/—/gaXdi 'bod bzod gsol sogs mjug

chog ltar bya'o/ smras pa/ ma rig gnyid kyis sad pa'i 'khrul snang ngor//rdzun gyi ri mo ji snyed shar ba las//bden min rdzun min tshig gi phreng ba 'dis//sgyu ma'i skyes tshogs bde ba 'thob gyur cig/ces g.yon lung kha stod kyi gzhi bdag yum cha zhes grags pa'i gsol mchod drang srong dgyes pa'i mchod srin zhes bya ba 'di ni/ dad pa can shes rabakun tshogs dang rgya tig 'tsho byed lha mgon tshe brtan sogs/rgya tig tsho ba'i sbyin bdag dad ldan rnams kyis bskul pa'i ngor/ la stag tshang stod rgyud mkhan zur ba bsam gtan don 'grub kyis zab lung gong kha'i sa char bris pa dge legs 'phel/ sna /

yul skyong kun bzang stobs rgyas kyi gsol mchod bya tshul dregs pa dgyes byed 'dod dgu'i dbyangs snyan/༄snyo / /na mo gu ru badz+ra d+dha ra ya/ /kun khyab rigs brgya'i byed po rdo rje 'chang //ngur smrig gar gyis rol ba byin rlabs gter//ma nor lam ston drin can bla ma rje//zhabs pad byang chub bar du spyi bos bsten//rgyal kun thugs rje chu mtsho las skyes pa'i//rig 'dzin kun gyi gtsug rgyan pad+ma 'byung //phan bde rtsa lag blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang //yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i zhabs la 'dud//dkar phyogs skyong la bsam sbyor nus pa mthu//khyad par 'phags pa'i kun bzang yul lha che/ /mnyes byed bsang mchod rgyas pa sgrub tshul gyi/ /cho ka 'dod dgu'i dbyings kyi rol mo 'khrol/ 'dir mchodagator bca' shoms kyi rim pa ni/zas gtsang ma 'o mdang mngar gsum gyi spros pa/gla rtsi dug rigs tha ma kha sogs kyidri rdul ma 'dres pa las/dkon mchog spyi'i gtor ma kum gtor bshos bu dang bcadakhams can nam/yang na zlum gtor pad 'dab can dang /yul lha'i gtor ma dkar gtor bcad khams can/ldebargyad spyi la cog dang /brjod dang 'brel tshe brngon gtorabang rim bzhi/steng du zlumagator phyogasabazhir gtor chung re dang bcas pa'ang bshamasashing / de dag mar rgyan ci mdzes dang ril bus bskor ba/gzhan yang bye mar zas phud gser skyems chang phud sogasadang /spyan ///sna ganga'abyor bshams/ba lu shug pa stag

pa mkhan pa sogs bsang shing gi dudasprin dung rnga sil snyan sogs 'jam rol dang bsang chung /dkar gsum gyi phud bcas sta gon rnams grub rjes skyabs sems tshad med bzhi bsgom pa dang yi dam gang rung gi bdag bskyed dam/grong bskyed gang rigs sngon tu btang la/mchod rdzas rnams/ mobadz+ra ma sbo tas bsangs/ su bha wasasbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bsang rdzas rnams dang mchod gtor spyan gzigs dang / 'khor 'das kyi mgron rnams la dgyes ba bskyed pa'i zag med mchod pa'i sprin gyi sung bo sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon thams cad bkang zhing nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo 'phar brgya phrag phyed pa'i rang bzhin zad mi shes par gyur/ cha gsal stong kun tu bzang bo'i rang rtsal las//thugs rje rang gdangs 'gag med longs spyod rdzogs//'gro ba'i khams dang bsam pa ji bzhin du//snang ba'i sna tshogs sprul ba'i zlos gar las//'ja' 'od gur khang dbus su pad zla'i steng //mar me mdzad dpal blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang //rnam pa sangs rgyas kun dngos pad ma 'byung / /khro 'dzum hur nyams zil gnon lta stangs can/ /g.yas g.yon rdo rje thod pa kha ṭaṃ brten//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro rig 'dzin grub pa'i 'khor//dpag med dbus su lhun chags tshul gyis bzhugs//byin rlabs thugs rje'i 'jug pa bsam mi khyab/ /mchog thun dngos grub gang bsam 'dod pa 'jo//bar chad kun sel las bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrubs//srid zhi'i gdung sel skyabs gnas kun gyi da/sdu/—/ye shes sku dang dbyer med bzhugs

su gsol//gsang gsum yon tan dran pas mos gus kyis/ /phyag 'tshal phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul//sgo gsum sdig rtsang 'gyod pas bshags bsdoms shing //srid zhi'i dge tshogs kun la rjes yi rangs//bskal brgyar brtan bzhugs nges gsang chos 'khor gyis//'gro kun rnam grol lam la 'god du gsol//dge tshogs de dag mar gyur 'gro kun gyis//bla med byang chub thob pa'i rgyu ru bsngo//bde gshegs rgyal ba kun 'dus bla ma lhas//thugs rjes dgongs te mchod gtor bsang rdzas sogs//snod bcud kun la ye shes byin brlabs nas//zag med 'dod dgu lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod//oṃ sarba bid gu ra sku ra sogs dang sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis bsang rdzas mchod gtor rnams byin gyis brlabs te bden stobs brjodapas de bzhin 'byung bar mos/ spyi mgron spyan 'dren pa ni/ cha rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i bde chen gnas//dag pa rab 'byams dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nas//thugs rje'i byin rlabs gter gyur bla ma lha//yi dam dkyil 'khor rgya mtsho gnas 'dir gshegs//sras bcas rgyal ba'i 'phrin las rol ba'i gar//zhi drag cir yang snang ba'i sgyu 'phrul gyis//'phrin las kun sgrub ye shes srung ma dang //'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs bcas gshegs su gsol//gzhan yang bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la bar chad sel zhing bsam don 'grub pa yi//sdongs grogs mdzad pa'i dgra lha 'go ba'i lha//lhan skyes srung ma'i tshogs bcas gnas 'dir gshegs//oṃ gu ru buca bo rnyi sa twa shrī sarba rnyarmā pā la kai rti sdo/ pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ de nas yul lha

'khor bcas spyan 'dren pa ni/bsang dud rol mo dang bcas/ kyiḥ ye yod srid pa dang po'i bskal ba la/ /mkhyen rab 'phags pa 'jam dpal sprul ba'i sku//'byung bzhi'i dwangs snyigs dbyings su phye ba las//ma ha gser gyi rus sbal ser bo srid//de yi phyi nang gsang ba'i rnam par 'phrul//rigs drug 'gro ba'i las snang dang 'dres pas//gling bzhi ri rab nyi zla gza' skar dang //sa bdag rje blon snang srid 'jig rten grub//de nas sto rgyal 'dzam bu'i dpag bsam gyis/ /mtshan pa'i gling chen shākya'i rgyal po'i zhing //sa chen dum bu drug las bod yul zhes/ /grags pa'i bsil ldan ljongs kyi mdo smad yul//dge bcu'i lang tsho dar ba'i nor 'dzin la//bstan dang bstan 'dzin nor bu'i rgyan phreng gis//rnam par sgeg pa'i ngo mtshar 'bum phrag gi /sum rtsen gnas kyi dpal yang zil gyis gnon/ /skal ldan shing rta'i mched zla 'ju lag zhes/ /grags pa'i klong chen 'bab pa a thi rongan/ri bo'i phreng ba nags tshal sman gyi ljongs//dal 'bab chu rgyun mkho dgu tshar du dngar//de ni gnas kyi dge mtshan phun tshogs pa'i/ /brtan brjid sa 'dzin yul gyi 'gro ba'i rten/ /'brog gnas dkar phyogs skyong ba'i pho brang ni//kun bzang klu ri mthon por gnas bcas pa'i/ /lha yi sde dpon chen po dgongs su gsol/ /khyed ni rmad du byung ba'i bsod nams dang //mthu stobs rdzu 'phul yon tan du ma yi//yul 'di'i snang srid lha klu thams cad la//dbang bsgyur kun bzang stobs rgyas zhes su grags/ /grub pa'i gtsug rgyan rig ༷rdoX thod phreng rtsal//phyag na pad+ma rgyal

sras chos rje sogs//bstan 'dzin du mas bka' srung mthu bo che//kun bzang yul lha'i sde dpon chen po khyed//de ring bsten mchod gnas 'dir spyan 'dren no//brgya byin dga' ba'i tshal du rtsen pa'am//'khor sgyur gling bzhi'i dpal du rol pa bzhin//rnam mang 'khor tshogs dga' ba'i gar dang bcas//rang snang nyams dga'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//lha yi 'khor tshogs mkha' la sprin phung bzhin//dregs pa'i sde tshogs bar snang zang char bzhin//klu gnyan 'khor tshogs sa gzhir na bun bzhin//thams cad 'dir gshegs rang rang gdan la bzhugs//ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/ kyiḥ dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon 'khor bcas rnams//sngon gyi khas blangs dam bca' nyer dgongs te//dgyes byed mchod tshogs bsang shing dud sprin gyis//'dod dgu nam mkha' mdzod la dgyes par rol//sngon tshe gangs can bod kyi yul ljongs su//rigs gsum rnam 'phrul chos rgyal rje blon dang //mkhan slob chos gsum thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul las//phan bde'i rtsa lag rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar//de tshe rgyal dbang pad+ma ye shes kyi//rnam rol 'jig rten mchod bstod dkyil 'khor du//snang srid dregs pa'i tshogs la dbang bskul cing / /bka' rtags rdo rje'i g.yar dam spyi bor bcings//ma 'ongs dus su 'gro ba'i bde skyid smad//'das dang ma 'das mchod yul spyi bye brag/khyad par snang srid dregs pa dgyes byed kyi//bsang mchod chos nor gter du bstsal pa las/ /grub pa'i rig 'dzin rje 'bangs gsang chen gyis//gtams paX snadzod mnga' grub pa'i tshogs rnams

kyis//bka' gter chos kye bstan dang 'gro ba la//phan bde spel ba'i smin grol lam bzang bstan/ /khyad par snang srid mnol grub sel byed cing / /'khor 'das mgron la dgyes pa bskyed byed pa'i//bsang mchod 'phrin las spel bzhin bdag cag gis//de ring bsang gi mchod pa 'bul 'dir dgongs// kyeḥ phun tshogs rten 'brel sgyu ma'i rol gar gyi//'dod dgu'i dngos po cir yang snang ba las//sna tshogs bsang rdzas bsregs pa'i du ba'i sprin//zhing khams nam mkha' mnyam par 'khrigs pa 'dis//dmigs med thugs rje chen po'i gter gyur pa'i/ /drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma thams cad bsang //rgyud sde chen po bzhi dang 'brel ba yi//dngos grub 'byung gnas yi dam lha tshogs bsang //ston mchog sangs rgyas de'i gsung dam pa'i chos de 'dzin tshogs bcas rin chen rnam gsum bsang //bar chad kun sel bde stong lam bzang gi/grogs mdzad gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bsang //'phrin las rnam bzhis dam ldan sgrub pa pos//'dod don kun sgrub chos skyong srung ma bsang / /gtsug lag phyi nang 'byung ba'i rten 'brel lha/ /spar sme sa bdag rgyal blon 'bangs bcas bsang / /srid pa'i lha chen rje yi mgur lha dang //tshe ring mched lnga bstan ma bcu gnyis bsang //las snang bsod nams mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis/ /dkar phyogs skyong mdzad yul lha gzhi bdag bsang //khyad par dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon che/ /yul skyong kun bzang stobs rgyas gnyan po/ /bde dgyes /spya sdo lha sras ming sring sogs//nang gi

'khor tshogs dregs pa thams cad bsang //bka' yi blon bzhi pho nya las byed dang / /dregs pa'i dmag tshogs lha klu sde brgyad bsang //yul phyogs 'dir gnas lha klu gzhi bdag dang //sde brgyad snang srid lha klu gnyan rnams bsang //mnol grib sol byed bsang shing du ba'i sprin//rdzas sngags bden pa'i stobs kyis byin brlabs pa'i/khasang mchod phul pa'i rten 'brel bslu med 'dis//ma dag nyes skyon nyams grib dag gyur cig /gdod nas grub pa cir yang ma dmigs shing //'khrul ngor rmi lam yul gyi dga' sdug bzhin//med kyang snang ba'i 'gal 'khrul 'bras bu bcas//rang bzhin stong ba'i dbyings su dag gyur cig /khyad par bdag cag rmongs pa'i dbang gyur nas/ /sdom gsum bcas rang nyes snang mi dge'i las//lha klu gnyan po'i thugs 'gal cing spyod kun//bsang mchod rten 'brel 'di yis sangs gyur cig/bsang shing du ba'i mchod sprin 'dod pa'i dngos/ /nyer spyod 'dod pa'i yon tan rnam pa lnga/ /bkra shis rtags rdzas spyan gzigs mchod sprin gyis//skyabs mchog rtsa ba gsum gyi lha tshogs mchod//phyi nang rten 'brel dbang ba'i lha rnams mchod//bstan ma bcu gnyis tshe ring mched lnga mchod//yul 'di'i ri brag ljon shing chu mtsho la//gzhug mar gnas pa'i lha klu gzhi bdag mchod//bsang mchod phul pa'i rnam dkar rten 'brel 'dis//bdag cag rmongs pa'i dbang gis sgo gsum gyi/ /nyes spyod spyi dang khyed rnams thugs 'gal kun/ /dmigs med dag pa'i dbyings su sangs gyur na //85/rtag tu mdza' sa 'od zer snang ba

'bum//spro ba'i brtse chen thugs rje'i nyi 'od kyis// bdag sogs 'dod don 'dab brgya 'dzum khrol ba'i//don gnyis zang rtsi'i dga' ston rgyas gyur cig/ces bsang mchod 'bul/bskang bshags dang 'brel bar brjon gtong bar 'dod na 'di ltar/kyiḥ chos dbyings dag pa'i mkha' la rten 'byung gi/rnam 'gyur snang stong dbyer med mchod pa'i sprin//gzungs rigs mos pa'i 'brug sgra bzhad pa yis//'dod dgu cir yang 'char ba'i spu char ni//dag byed gtsang ma'i rgyun gyi mchod yon dang //sman sna'i me tog dbang bo'i gzhu ltar bkra//bsang shing dri bzang spos kyi dud sprin 'khrigs// mun sel 'od kyi phreng ldan rtsi mar sgron//bde ster dri bzang bsgo ba'i bdud rtsi'i chab//ro brgya'i zhal zas sna tshogs rol mo'i sgra//rna ba'i bdud rtsir spro ba dang bcas pa'i//mchod pa'i tshogs 'dis srid zhi'i mgron rnams dang / /kun bzang lha gnyan 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //mig la dga' bskyed yid 'ong kha dog dbyibs//snyan pa'i dbyangs rol brjod bral rna ba'i bcud//dri zhim ngad kyis dga' ba bskyed pa'i dri//bcud ldan lha mi'i bdud rtsir ro brgya ngoms//'dod pa'i bde ster 'jam mnyen reg ldan gos//rnam lnga'i dbang bo bde ba'i dga' ston la//sbyor ba'i phyi dang 'dod yon rnam pa lnga//zag med bde chen bskyed pa'i nus ldan 'dis/ /skyabs mchog rtsa gsum lha dang yul lha'i gtso//kun bzang dge bsnyen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //sga srab rgyan mdzes rta mchog rlung ltar 'phyo//zhol chen pho sdo ཿkyi/ gyi dum bu bzhin//lha lug dar gyi

cod pan mdzes pa'i khyu/ /snyan pa'i dbyangs sgrog rwa skyes sprin ltar 'khrigs//'dod 'jo'i ba dang stobs ldan khyung dkar mdzo//sna tshogs 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i g.yang phyugs rnams//kun bzang dgra lha chen po 'khor bcas kyi//rten tu 'bul zhing dgyes pa'i thugs dam bskang //'brong g.yag smug po ngur sgras sa chen khengs//shwa ba dung gi rwa bcu dgung du rgyas//rgo ba rkyang sogs mgyogs kyi bang rtsal 'gran//rtsed 'jo'i phu gu 'brangs pa'i yu mo dang //brag ngos yang rtser rol pa'i rna ba sogs//sdig med zas kyis 'tsho ba'i ri skyes tshogs//bag phebs rtse dga' rol ba sna tshogs 'dis//dkar phyogs lha gnyan 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //yangs pa'i mkha' la 'gur ring rol pa yi//'dab chags tshogs rnams gshog sgra'i rtsal gyis snyems/ /nags tshal ljon pa'i 'khri shing yal 'dab la//byi'u tshogs rnams snyan dgu'i mgrin glu len/ /me tog rgyas pa'i tshal du bung ba'i tshogs//sprang rtsi'i chang gis myos pa'i zlos gar rtse//sdod bcud dge ba'i 'bras bu sna tshogs 'dis//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i thugs dam dbyings su skongs//rab dmar phod ka dril chung phreng ba'i rgyan//mgul bar rab mdzes nor skyong nga ro sgrog/'jigs rung ri mo rnam bkra stag gzig gung //pha rol zil gnon sgra sgrog dpa' rtsal ngom//gtad med bya ba'i zlos gar sna tshogs kyis//rtsed 'jos dga' bskyed spra spre'u dred mong sogs//mche sder mtshon chas dgra 'joms ri skyes kyi//dpa' bo'i tshogs kyang rngam brjid rten du 'buX/—8/pyangs pa'i mkha' la gza' skar 'od

snang bkra//bar snang chu 'dzin phreng bas bla re bres//snyan pa'i 'brug sgra rab dga'i dbyings su sgrog /phyogs su kun phan gru char dal bur 'bab//sngo ljang lo 'dab snye ma'i khur gyis dud//dus bzhi'i 'jug pa chol med dge mtshan gyi//dpal yon mchog tu rgyas pa'i ngo mtshar kun//yul lha 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i gshis su 'bul//'byung ba rnam bzhi'i bcud las skyes pa yi//'bru sna'i bye mar sman sna'i bcud bzang bcas//bshos bu gtsang sbyor gtor ma zag med kyi//bdud rtsir rgya mtsho 'dod dgur 'char ba 'dis//bla ma mchog gsum yi dam srung ma'i tshogs//gtsang ris lha tshogs kun dang yul phyogs 'dir//gnas bcas dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon che//kun bzang dge bsnyen 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//lhun po brtsigs pa'i dbyibs legs rgyan gyis mdzes//zhim po'i dri 'thul bdud rtsi'i ro brgya ldan//bde ster reg bya'i dbang bo rnam pa lnga//dga' bskyed 'dod pa'i yon tan ma lus tshang //lha dang mi yi zas bcud bdud cir spungs//klu dang gnod sbyin tshogs kyi rin chen rgyan//dri za mi'am ci yi dbyangs rol dang //lhan cig zag med bde sbyin bā ling ta//chos kyi dbyings dang mchog gsum bden pa'i mthu//ting 'dzin gzungs dang rig sngags mos pa'i stobs//phyi nang rten 'byung tshogs pa'i chos nyid kyis//'dod dgu nam mkha' mdzod du 'char ba 'di//rtse gcig dngas pa'i sems kyis 'bul legs na//dgyes pa'i thugs kyis dgongs nas 'dzum pa'i nyams//dga' ba'i gaX /da bcas te legs bzhes nas//gang

bcol 'dod don 'grub pa'i dngos grub stsol//gzhan yang 'khor 'das dge mtshan rnam 'phrul las//byung ba'i dbang byed rgyal srid rnam pa bdun//bkra shis rtags brgyad byin rlabs rdzas mchog brgyad//'dod 'jo'i ba dang re skong dpag bsam shing //gter chen bum bzang nye ba'i rin chen bdun//la sogs mchod pa'i sprin phung zag med kyis//kun bzang yul lha'i rgyal po yum sras dang //bka' yi blon dang las byed pho nya dang //phyag brnyan dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa'i//thugs dam gnyan po dgyes pa'i dbyings su bskang / /bdag cag 'khor bcas 'gal 'khrul bya spyod kyis/ /nyes tshogs nyams chag thams cad sos gyur nas//'gal rkyen bzlog cing mthun rkyen 'dod don kun//'bad med yid bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod// ces bskang gsol gtong zhing / kyeḥ 'di ltar bdag cag rtse gcig bsam sbyor ni//'gro ba'i phan bde spel ba la dmigs nas//rnam dag zhing la dngos bathams yid sprul gyis//mchod sbyin rnam dkar bsgrun pa'i dge tshogs 'dis//drin can rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyis//tshe rabs kun tu rjes su bzung du gsol//mchog gsum thugs rje bslu med bden pa'i mthus//srid zhi'i 'jigs pa kun las bskyab tu gsol//yi dam dkyil 'khor lha tshogs byin rlabs kyis//mchog dang thun mong 'dod dgu'i dngos grub stsol//gnas gsum mkha' 'gro zhing sngags lhan skyes kyis//rim gnyis lam bzang sgrub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod//rten gan ri spya gi gzhi bdag tshogs rnams kyis//bya

bar ko long ma sdom gnas po mdzod/ /khyad par yul mi bdag cag 'khor bcas kyis//pha mes cho rigs brgyud kyi dgra lha che//kun bzang dge bsnyen snang srid dregs pa'i gtso//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon 'khor bcas kyis//yul phyogs 'dir 'khod mchod gnas sbyin bdag gi/mi phyugs longs spyod chos srid 'dod don la/ /gnod 'tshe log lta bsam sbyor ngan 'chang ba'i//snang dgra gnod byed thal ba'i rdul du rlogs//nad rims dgra gcan thog ser btsan than sogs//phyi nang rkyen ngan bar chad zhi ba dang //'dod dgu dbang du 'du zhing tshe bsod dang //dpal 'byor mtsho ltar rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//bdag cag chos srid ya rabs lugs srol gyi//rang gzhan don brtson bya ba gang la yang //'gyel ba slong zhing yo ba srong ba dang //chad pa mthud cing brjed pa bskul sogs kyis//gzhi yi gnas srung lam gyi sdongs grogs dang / /phar 'gro'i skyel ma tshur 'ong bsu ma mdzod//nyin gsum rgyang nas 'tsho ba'i bya ra dang //mtshan gsum drung nas srung ba'i mel tshe mdzod//bsam pa'i don la mi bslu mkhas pa'i blo//smra brjod ji bzhin 'grub pa bden pa'i tshig /bya ba gegs med 'grub pa 'dod pa'i don//kun la dbang thang rlung rta'i dpal bskyed mdzod//mi la bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa dang //phyugs la nad god gcan gzan gnod 'tshe zhi//zas nor dpal 'byor gong 'phel phywa g.yang gis//bde skyid mnga' thang dgung ltar yangs par mdzod//yul phyogs bde skyid dpal 'byor /sdu ༷ ni//yul mis dge ba sgrub la rag

las phyir//yul gyi mi rnams bsam sbyor chos mthun gyis//yul 'dir bde skyid dar ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//phan bde rtsa ba sangs rgyas bstan pa dar//bstan 'dzin skyes bus bshad sgrub chos spyod 'phel//bstan pa'i sbyin bdag mnga' thang longs spyod rgyas/ /sde bzhi'i dga' ston dar ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// ces gtor 'bul dang 'phrin bcol bya zhing / gzhan yang spyi sger bsang gsogagaser skyems 'bul ba sogs kyang spro na mtshams 'dir bya/de nas bstod pa bya ba ni/4 srid zhi'i dge mtshan nor 'dzin yangs pa'i gzhir//phan bde'i chu gter g.yas su 'khyil ba'i rlabs//bskyod pa'i shugs 'chang srid pa chags pa'i lha//kun bzang snyan pa'i grags ldan khyed la bstod//mdo smad skyid pa'i sman ljongs lus phra mas//rtse dga'i grogs su 'gugs pa'i sa 'dzin ni//dbyibs legs brtan cing brjid pa'i ngo mtshar gyis//phyogs kyi khor yug yangs pa'i rgyan du gyur//de ni lha gnyan chen po'i bsod nams kyi//rang snang ngo mtshar lha yi pho brang ni//khor yug brtan cing brjid pa'i lcags ris bskor//rtse mo 'od gsal nyi zla'i lam du bsnyegs//rgya phibs nor bu'i ba gam gzi 'od 'bar/ /'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor nam mkha' mdzod kyis gtams/ /phyogs kun 'khyams dang khang bzang nyams dga' ba'i//sna tshogs bkod pa mdzes shing yid 'ong dbus//sga srab nor bu'i rgyan mdzes cang shes rta//char sprin mdog 'chang rnga rngog sprin ltar g.yo//pha rol zil gyis gnon pa'i gzi brjid can//'dzam gling skad cig myur ba'i 'groX ༷na steng //lha yi rgyal chen rab dkar zla
