ba'i zhal/ /'dzum khro dpa' bo'i nyams kyis sgeg ldan cing / /dregs pa'i 'khor la bka' yi dbang bsgyur ba'i//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon che khyed bstod//phyag g.yas zla shel thig le bstar ba yi//bgrang phreng rnam dkar spel ba'i rtags kyis spras// g.yon pa dgos 'dod stsol ba'i nor bu yis//gzhong ba'i re 'dod skong ba khyed la bstod/ /gser bzang gzi 'od 'bar ba'i go khrab ni//sna tshogs rin chen rgyan gyis rab mdzes pa//sku la gsol zhing dngul dkar rmog mo yis//dung ri dgung du mtho bas brgyan la bstod//res 'gag za 'og 'bol stan brtsegs pa'i khrir//kun la dbang bsgyur rol ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs//sprin dkar g.yo ba'i dar gyi na bza' bklubs//rin chen sna tshogs rgyan phreng 'dzin la bstod//bsod nams stobs kyis dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs//snang srid kun la mngon shes rnam par gsal//mthu stobs rdzu 'phul dpag tu med pa yi//yul skyong lha yi rgyal po khyed la bstod//mthu stobs nus pa'i sprin chen 'khrigs pa las//drag rtsal gnam lcags thog mda' 'bebs pa yis//nag phyogs brag ri rmeg med bsnyil mdzad pa//gdug pa kun 'dul dgra lha khyed la bstod//mi 'dod nyer 'tshe kun las bzlog byas nas//'dod don legs pa'i dngos po kun stsol cing //don spyod kun la bde legs 'grub pa yi//'phrin las thogs med srung ma khyed la bstod//grub pa'i gtsug rgyan pad+ma sam bha was//bka' brgyad sgrub sde zhi khro rab 'byams kyi//dkyil 'khor gnyan por rdo rje'i tha sdoX gis//bka' bsgos rig 'dzin srung

ma khyed la bstod//bstan pa'i rtsa lag bla chen dgongs pa gsal//dmar g.yo gtsang sogs thub pa'i rtul zhugs kyis//rnam dag thub bstan rgyan gyur 'dul ba 'dzin//khrims ldan du ma'i bka' srung khyed la bstod//pad dkar 'chang ba zil gnon bzhad pa rtsal//thugs rje'i gter chen rgyal sras snga phyi sogs//dge ldan bstan pa'i rtsa lag du ma yi//bka' sgrub bstan srung chen po khyed la bstod/khyed kyi nang blon klu yi sde dpon che//sku mdog dkar la dmar mdangs zhi khro'i nyams//'jol ber dkar bo dar dmar mtha' can gsol//rin chen 'od 'bar phrog zhu dbu la brgyan//phyag g.yas sbrul zhags g.yon pa srab skyogs kyis//rdzu 'phrul rta dkar sprin gyi 'gros bskyod cing //'phrin las thogs med dpa' brjid rnam 'gyur gyi//snang srid myur ba'i shugs ldan khyed la bstod//shar gyi bka' sdod klu gnyan sbom ra che//khro gtum dpa' brjid ma nges rnam 'gyur can//rdzu 'phrul stobs ldan dregs pa'i kha lo bsgyur//grangs med 'khor tshogs mnga' ba khyed la bstod//lho yi phyogs skyong rta sngon mdung dar can//lcags kyu zhags pa g.yon pa'i 'debs shing 'gril//gser zhu rgod ldem 'jol ber lhab lhub gsol//'khor gsum rked 'chang dpa' bo khyed la bstod//rta dmar klu btsan sde dpon thang khu zhes/ /sku mdog dmar gsal bse yi khrab rmog gsol//phyag g.yas gri ring g.yon pas srab mda' bskyod//dgra lha'i dmag dpon chen po khyed la bstod/ /rmog mgo'i ri gnas gzhi bdag mthu bo che//'brog bying gong sdaX —༷ dkar 'phru can gsol//rta rag la

zhon sba lcag zhags pa 'dzin//pad rag rked 'ching rgyan gyis spras khyed bstod//gzhan yang thugs la bde dga' bskyed byed yum//sman mo mdzes sdug nyams ldan na chung tshul//lha yi sras po ming sring rtse dga'i gar/ /sna tshogs nyams kyis rol pa rnams la bstod//bka' sgrub pho nya las byed dregs pa'i tshogs//lha srin sde brgyad dmag tshogs grangs med pa//cho 'phrul du mas snang dgra tshar gcod cing //dkar bo'i phyogs 'dzin 'khor bcas rnams la bstod//bod yul spyi dang khyad par mdo smad kyi//yul skyong lha yi sne dpon chen po khyed//'khor bcas kun gyi bsang mchod 'di bzhes la//gang gsol 'phrin las ma lus thogs med sgrubs//dkon mchog gsum gyi dbu 'phang gnyan po bstod//sangs rgyas bstan pa spyi dang khyad par du//khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa'i//bstan dang bstan 'dzin sbyin bdag bcas la skyongs//khyad par ngag gi dbang phyug chos kyi rje//thugs rje che ldan gdul bya rgya mtsho'i mgon/ /dkon mchog gsum dngos thub bstan yar tshes zla'i//rjes 'gror 'phel mdzad yab rje bla ma'i bka'//'gyur med rdo rje'i ri mo gtsug rgyan du//brten nas bkra shis g.yas su 'khyil ba yi//sgrub pa'i sde 'dir rnam grol don gnyer rnams//chos bzhin bsgrub la srung skyob g.yel med mdzod//gus mchod lhur len bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rnams/ /nyer 'tshe g.yul las rgyal zhing mnga' thang dar//tshe bsod dpal 'byor rigs brgyud la sogs pa//mthun rkyen gang bsam bcol ba'i 'phrin ༷༷ /dzod//kun mkhyen thub pa'i dbang

bos legs gsung bka'i/ /don bzhin sdig spang dge sgrub lhur len dang / /'khor 'das sgyu mar shes pa'i gzhan phan gyis//bsam sbyor dag pa'i byang chub mchog 'grub mdzod// ces bstod cing 'phrin las bcol/gzhan yang bsang gsol dam pa snga mas mdzad padang /spyi sgeragyi gser skyems g.yang 'bod la sogs kyang sbyar 'dod na gzhan las 'byung ba bzhin bya/de nas gshegs gsol ni/rnal 'byor rig pa'i rang rtsal mkha' dbyings las//'khor 'das mchod yul ji snyed spyan drangs pa//kun kyang snang stong dbyings dang dbyer med kyang //snang ngor rang rang gnas gshegs dgyes par mdzod/ badz+ra mu ces bya'o/ de nas/'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / sogs kyi sngon smon dang / shis brjod kyi tshig bcad ci rigs pas kyang mtha' rgyan parabya 'di ni rang gzhan rnam dkar bsgrub pa la//gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha klu dkar phyogs pa//bsten mchod 'phrin las bcol ba chos ldan gyi//bya ba 'grub pa'i mthun rkyen mchog tu gsungs/ chos bzhin snying nas sgrub pa'i gang zag gi /chos mthun 'dod don 'grub pa gshis yin kyang / /chos kyi srung ma dkar phyogs skyong rnams la/ /chos ldan 'phrin las bcol ba'ang dam pa'i tshul//chos bzhin snying nas sgrub pa'i gang zag gi/de'i phyir bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel slad du//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu mchod pa yang //bsam sbyor dge bas zin phyir rang gzhan gyi//'di phyi'i don chen 'grub pa'i thabs su bzang / /de phyir mgrin pa ngag gi longs spyod kyi//cha shas gsol mchod snyan pa'i sdo ༷༷ngas su/ /bsdebs pa'i dge 'dis

༄snyo //chos dbyings skye med ngang las chos sku/ bzhengs gzi brjirno rgyal po nyi ma 'bum shar 'dra//mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba dpal gyi sku//'gro ba'i sdug bsngal dug sel mchog la 'dud/klu dbang rgyal po'i gzungs/

dge 'phel gzhi bdag gi gsol kha/༄ //oṃ su sti/ gzhi gtsang dkar ba'i steng du/bye mar/dkar gsum mngar gsum gtso bor gyur ba'i mchod gtor spyan gzigs sogs ci 'byor bshams/dri zhim dang ldan pa'i bsang dud btang /chu gtsang ma bran/rang spyan ras gzigs sogs yi dam lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pa'i ngang nas byin brlabs rgyas bsdus gang rung brgyud sde'og ma ltar byas la/ ཿkhri gangs can bod yul mdo smad byang phyogs kyi//'ju lag ces grags lung ba'i srib ri'i char/ /gnam gzhung dge 'phel sgrub sde nye 'khor gyi//gangs ri rdza brag nags tshal g.ya' dang spang //chu mig ne'u gsing phyugs lhas sung ba dang / lam dang lam spang sogs la gnas pa dang / /myul ba'i lha klu gnod sbyin 'byung ba'i tshogs/ /rang rang 'khor dang bcas te gnas 'dir byon/ /khyad par sra brtan brag dkar lha ri la/ /gnas pa'i lha btsan chen po mthu bo che//sku mdog dmar bo zhi ma khro ba'i nyams//phyag g.yas rgyal mtshan rin chen tog mdzes bsgrengs/ /g.yon na snyan pa'i sgra ldan cing te'u bsnams//dbu skra kham nag thor gtsug rin chen spras//sku la za ber nag dmar mthing ka gsol/ /sag lham gsol zhing rgya stag ri bkra bcibs/ /dri dga' dmar smug khro gzugs phyag g.yas na//mdung rnon g.yon par thod rlon khrag bkang thogs//ral ba 'di ༷/ zhan rjes dpa' gtum gzugs//la

sogs sna tshogs sprul ba'i rnam 'gyur can//bde byed rnam rgyal rab brtan 'khor bcas rnams//thogs pa med par gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//gnas bdag gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas rnams ni//dgyes pa'i gdan khrir brtan par bzhugs su gsol//bdag gi dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa'i tshogs/ /'bul gyis dgyes bzhin nye bar bzhes su gsol/ /gser bzang mdangs ldan byugs kyi phung bo ru//sna tshogs dri zhim sman spos shing sna'i tshogs//bsregs pa'i dud sprin lha yi lam bkang bas//lha klu gzhi bdag tshogs rnams mnyes gyur cig/sa chen khyon ltar yangs pa'i snod bzang bor//dkar gsum mngar gsum la sogs bza' bca' dang //btung ba'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa//bdud rtsi rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs te 'bul//rin chen 'bru sna dar zab gos kyi rigs//grangs med srog chags rnam pa sna tshogs dang //go mtshon la sogs mthun pa'i dam rdzas rnams//ting 'dzin sngags brgyas byin gyis brlabs te 'bul// bdag cag ma rig nyon mongs dbang gyur pas//lha klu gzhi bdag gnyan po khyed rnams kyi//thugs dang 'gal ba ci bgyis bshags byed na//bzod par bzhes la bcol ba'i las rnams sgrubs//phyogs 'dir mi nad phyugs nad mu ge dgra//chom thun thog ser sad dang than pa sogs//mi mthun nyes pa'i tshogs kun yongs zhi nas//snod dang bcud kyi legs tshogs 'phel bar mdzod//sde 'dir gnas pa'i dpon slob thams cad kyi//rnam dkar sgrub pa'i mthun rkye/ // 'dzoms shing //rkyen ngan bar chad
—deXduwarawaXskor+sha danaXpyala'os/— —pha(〈ne dzadzo)gong mdzes ba ge0mchos) bye rdzo ༷ r+sha phel rdzongashā r+sāsno༄༄༄khe/— —rte49shel65mi cha ba //klongar+sā1 47 4 7to 4 44 cho4༄ po〉〉༷༷〈〈〈949tsho

dge 'phel gnyan chen rnam rgyal rab brtan gyi gsol mchod bsam 'phel dbang rgyal/༄snyo /bkra shis dge mtshan nor 'dzin yangs pa'i gzhir//phan bde'i me tog char du bsnyil mkhas pa//bla ma yi dam mchog gsum bcas pa yis / bral med thugs rjes byung chub bar du skyong //byang chub sgrub pa'i yan lag sbyor ba bzhi//thabs mkhas nyams len dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde//mchod chog bsam 'phel dbang gi rgyal po 'di/ /bsten na dgos 'dod nor gyi char chen 4 'bebs/ /de phyir blo gros dga' ba'i skyed tshal du//dbyangs can rigs pa'i rkang 'byung 'khrigs pa'i khrod//pad dkar gzhon nu 'dzum pa'i dga' ston la//don gnyer rkang drug dga' ba'i gar byos shig /de'ang mdo smad dpa' ris dal 'bab 'ju lag gi klung 'gram/chos sde bkra shis dar rgyas gling gi nye 'dabs/dge'aphel gzhi bdagakye khe'u gnyan rje mthu bo chernam rgyal rab brtan zhes grags pa'i ba dan srid na g.yo zhing mchod bkur bsnyen pa tsam gyis 'dod don 'grub pa la mngon tshad shin tu che bas/ 'di nyid la bsang brngonagatong bar 'dod pas/ gzhi ma dkar gtsang steng du phye mar dkar gsum mngar gsum gtso bor gyur pa'i gtor ma bang rim bzhi ldan steng du cog gtor dang//mtha' bshos bu'amaril busabaskor/gzhi ma dkon mchog spyi gtor/—pi

gzhi bdag gtor ma sogs zur du bzo thos rnams la mar rgyan gang mdzes kyis brgyan/bsang dang gser skyems sogs tshags su chud par byas te/skyabs sems sngon du btang la/yi dam gang yang rung ba'i bdag bskyed rgyas bsdus gang rung byasal/rol cha bsang dud —sogs btang nas/ /thog mar byin 'bebs dbyangs rta dang bcas 'di skad do/kye/ dge legs mtshan ma rgyas pa'i nor 'dzin la// dge mtshan bkra shis spu char stsol mkhas pa'i/ /dge kun rtsa ba drin can bla ma yis//dge legs byin rlabs char ba dbab tu gsol//kun khyab bde chen ye shes chen po'i 'phrul//kun bzang sna tshogs rol ba 'byams klas pas//kun gsal dkyil 'khor yongs gang yi dam lhas//kun phan dngos grub bye bas snod bcud bsgyur//rab 'byams rgyal ba'i 'phrin las rnam pa bzhi//rab 'byams khro dang zhi drag rnam rol gyis/ /rab mang gdul bya'i gshed du mngon bzhengs pa//rab 'byams srung mas rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrubs//rnam dkar las kyi 'bras bus snang srid la//rnam par dbang zhing dkar bo'i phyogs skyong bar//rnam kun grags pa'i lha klu gzhi bdag gis//rnam dkar mchod pa'i las la sdongs grogs mdzod//khyad par dngos bshams yid kyis sprul ba yi//khyad 'phags mchod pa'i dngos po 'di dag kun/ /bde stong ye shes ting 'dzin sngags rgyas mthus/ /bde chen bskyed pa'i rdzas su byin gyis rlobs//bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags kyis bsangs/su bhā wasasbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las skye las rin po che'i yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du rang rang gi ming yig dang sdi thika les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i

mchod gtor dam rdzas spyan gzigs mkho rgu'i yo byad bsam gyis mi khyab pa sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyod thams cad yongs su bkang bar gyur/oṃ sa /lan gsum/nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags dang phyag rgya dang /sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs labaden stobs brjod/ de nas mgron spyan 'dren pa ni/ r+yāphul byung brtse chen 'od dkar cha rdzogs pa//sna tshogs mos pa'i khams dang bsam pa bzhin//chu zla'i rol bar 'char ba'i sgyu 'phrul can//dkon mchog srid zhi'i mgron kun gnas 'dir gshegs//drag gtum nyams brgya'i char sprin stug po'i khrod/ /mthu stobs gnam lcags me yi tsha tsha 'phro/ /dag phyogs dgra sde gzhob tu bsreg byed pa'i/ /mgon po yon tan mgron kun gnas 'dir gshegs/ /'di snang bde bar 'khrul ba'i 'ching thag gis/ /rtag tu 'khor bar bcings pa'i zo chud bzhin//bla 'og brje ba'i mar gyur rigs drug 'gro/ /snying rje'i mgron kun thogs med gnas 'dir gshegs//gdod nas grub pa cir yang ma dmigs shing / /sngon las 'phral rkyen phyi dang rten 'brel las//gdon bgegs lan chags mgron du shar ba rnams//byams pa'i sems kyis mchod sbyin gnas 'dir gshegs//khyad par 'dzam gling yangs pa'i byang gi phyogs//gangs ri'i ra bas bskor pa'i bod kyi yul//sa yi thig le dpa' ris zhes grags pa'i/ /bkra shis dar zhing rgyas pa'i chu lha'i ngogs/ /6khe'u sra brtan brag dkar lha ri'i mgul//rab dkar chu 'dzin glog gi rol gar dang / /lhan cig dbyar skyes rnga ༷༷di sgrog pa'i klong //rnam bkra dbang

gzhu gsal ba'i gur khyim nang //rgya stag ru bkra'i bzhon par rab 'gyings pa'i//gnyan rje rnam rgyalarab brtan drag rtsal can//yum sras ming sring las byed sgron po dang //'khor dmag dpung tshogs dang bcas gnas 'dir byon//gzhan yang gnas 'dir gnyug mar gnas pa dang //glo bur lhag pa'i lha klu 'byung bo sogs//mgron du thos pa ji snyed mchis pa kun//rang rang 'khor g.yog dang bcas gnas 'dir gshegs//mdun du ting 'dzin rol ba las byung ba'i//bkod mdzes gzhal med khang dbus sna tshogs gdan//ji srid mchod 'bul bar du legs bzhugs nas//khas blangs dam bcas don rnams dran par mdzod//ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ/zhes spyan drangs dam la bzhagade nas mchod pa 'bul ba gi/rab dkar dge tshogs 'o ma'i rgya mtsho las//legs 'khrungs mchod rdzas 'dam skyes dkar bo'i tshal//mchod dman mgron kun dgyes pa'i dga' ston la//spyod pa'i dngos por lhun gyis grub pa ni//dngas bsil bdud rtsi'i mchod yon mtsho ru 'khyil//rab mdzes me tog sna tshogs sa steng khyab//bsung zhim spos kyi du ba'i lha lam gang //nyi zla nor bu'i 'od kyis phyogs kun gsal//dri zhim byugs pas lus sems dga' bde bskyed//bza' bca' btung ba sna tshogs ri ltar spungs//rnar snyan yid 'bab rol mo'i 'brug sgra sgrog/bslu med mchog gsum yul lha'i tshogs la mchod//khyad par btso ma'i gser zhun 'khyil 'dra ba'i//'bar ba'i me dang dri zhim bsang gi rdzas//shing sna gos dar rin chen bye mar bcas//bsregs pa/gli sdod sprin lha lam yongs gang ba//

sngags dang ting 'dzin phyag rgya bden stobs kyis//'dod rgu cir yang 'char bar byin brlabs nas//rgya dang phyogs dus yongs su ma chad pa//bsang gi mchod pa gtsang zhing gya rnam pas//dngos dang brgyud pa'i bla ma thams cad bsang //yi dam zhi dang khro bo ma lus bsangan/bslu med mchog gsum rin chen rnam gsum bsang //sa lam grogs mdzad gnas gsum mkha' 'gro bsang //'phrin las kun sgrub chos skyong srung ma bsang //gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu rtsa lnga bsang / /rigs drug ma gyur snying rje'i mgron kun bsang / /gdon bgegs lan chags sha 'khon gnyer ba bsang //khyad par yul 'di mthu stobs rdzu 'phrul gyis//rtag tu srung mdzad gnyan rje mthu chen dang //yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor dang bcas pa rnams//bsang gi mchod pas lhag par mnyes gyur cig/de ltar bsang mchod phul pa'i rten 'brel gyis//ma dag nyes skyon dbyings su dag gyur nas//mchog gsum rnams kyi mgon skyabs dpung gnyen dang //srung ma yul lhas las bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrubs//bdag cag sgo gsum nyon mongs dbang gyur nas//sdom gsum bcas dang mi dge sdig pa'i las//nongs pa gang bgyis 'gyod pas bshags byed na//bzod par bzhes la dngos grub bstsal tu gsol//phyogs 'di'i phan bde sgrib byed nyer 'tshe'i sprin//mthu stobs rlung shugs drag pos mthar bskrad nas//bde skyid legs tshogs nyin byed 'bar ba yis//snod bcud kun khyab dga' ba'i dpal thob shog /don gnyis pad ma dkar bosdo ༷༷di tshal la//sde bzhi'i 'byor ba sbrang

rtsi'i bcud chags pas// lus can rkang drug gzhon nu'i dga' ston du//nam yang zad pa med pa'i bkra shis stsol//de ltar bsang mchod phul nas bsang brngon gtong bar 'dod pas gyer dbyangs rol mobacas bsang dud cher btang la/ kyiḥ pha mtha' yongs bral 'gyur med chos kyi dbyings//bde chen lang tsho 'bar ba'i sgyu 'phul gar//rab yangs mkha' la dbang bo'i gzhu ris dang //rin chen 'byung ba'i gnas kyi rlabs phreng bzhin//gang 'dod mchod pa'i dngos por shar ba yis//sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyon bkang bas//bla ma yi dam bstan srung chos skyong dang //lha gnyan 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed gyur cig/mchod yon zhabs bsil me tog bdug spos dang //snang gsal dri chab zhal zas rol mo'i sgra//'dod yon rnam lnga rin chen gdugs dkar dang //gser nya bum bzang bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis//bla ma yi dam srung ma'i thugs dam bskang //gnyan rje mthu chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sel gyur nas//gang bsam 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod//rtsibs stong rab 'bar gser gyi 'khor lo sogs//'khor bsgyur la 'os mdzes pa'i rin chen bdun//ston pas byin rlabs bkra shis rdzas mchog brgyad//khang bzang tshal sogs nye ba'i rin chen gyis//bla ma yi dam srung ma'i thugs dam bskang //gnyan je mthu chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangan/thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sel gyur nas//gang bsam 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub par sdaX///rdzu 'phrul rlung gi thugs ldan cang

shes rta//char sprin dum bu chad 'dra'i 'brong g.yag dang //spu sdug rtsid 'jol lug dang rwa skyes tshogs//mkha' la gar gyis rtsen pa'i 'dab chags kyis//bla ma yi dam srung ma'i thugs dam bskang //gnyan rje mthu chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sel gyur nas//gang bsam 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod//lha shug a kur tsan dan dkar dmar dang //mkhan pa stag pa ba lu su ru sogs//bsang shing sna tshogs bye mar zas phud rnams//bsregs pa'i dud sprin lha lam gang ba 'dis//bla ma yi dam srung ma'i thugs dam bskang //gnyan rje mthu chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sel gyur nas//gang bsam 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod//rin chen dang gis mdzes pa'i rgyal mtshan dang //rna ba'i bdud rtsi brjid ldan cing te'u sogs//rno ngar mi bzad sra ba'i mdung rnon po//gdug pa'i khrag gis rab gang thod sogs kyis//bla ma yi dam srung ma'i thugs dam bskang //gnyan rje mthu chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sel gyur nas//gang bsam 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod//za 'og dmar nag mthing ga'i ber chen dang //rin chen prog zhu sag lham yu ring sogs//nyer mkho'i chos gos dpa' bo'i go cha mtshon//rgya stag ru bkra'i bzhon pa dang bcas pas//bla ma yi dam srung ma'i thugs dam bskang //gnyan rje mthu chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //sdoXsdu— dam bskangs shing nyams chag sel

gyur nas//gang bsam 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod//gzhan yang thugs la bde dga' gaskyed byed pa'i/ /phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod tshogs mtha' yas pa//dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul ba yis//sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khyod bkang bas//bla ma yi dam srung ma'i thugs dam bskang //gnyan rje mthu chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs shing nyams chag sel gyur nas//gang bsam 'dod don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod//ces bsang brngon gtong /gtor ma 'bul bar 'dod na yongs grags ltar 'bul/ spyi sger gyi bsang gser skyems sogs gtong 'os yod na mtshams 'dir gtong /de nas bstod pa ni/ kyiḥ da ni bstod do gang bsam 'dod pa bzhin//'bad med stsol mdzad bla ma yi dam lha//mchog gsum rin chen bka' sdod chos skyong ba//dam can rgya mtsho bcas la gus pas bstod//ka dag chos dbyings nam mkha'i klong yangs nas//kha ba'i rdul ltar sna tshogs sprul ba yis//ga na rgyal bstan gnas pa bsrung mdzad pa//nga cag skyong mdzad dgra lha khyed la bstod//ca co'i gdangs kyis spyan 'dren bskul byas na//cha lugs ma nges rnam 'gyur sna tshogs kyis//ja dngul phugs mdzod sgo phyugs dpal 'byor kun//nya rgyas zla ltar spel mdzad khyed la bstod//ta la'i 'dab ltar yangs shing rgya che ba'i//tha spu kun la phan dang bde ster zhing //da lta mi bzod gnyan rims kyis gdung ba'i//na tsha sdug bsngal sel mdzad khyed la bstod//pa wa sangs ltar dgyes 'dzum 'boX ༷nyi ༷'i//pha ltar byams shing ma ltar brtse

ba yis//ba spu rdul phran lta bur grangs med pa'i//ma lus 'gro ba skyong mdzad khyed la bstod//tsa tur 'phrin las kun sgrub dpa' gtum gzugs//tsha zer mthu stobs gnam lcags me char gyis//dza ya'i bstan dang 'gro la gnod byed pa//wa skyes lta bur mthar mdzad khyed la bstod//zhwa ser ring lugs yid bzhin dbang gi rgyal/ /za 'og rgyal mtshan rtse mo'i tog bzhin du/ /'a 'ur 'chad nyan dgos 'dod char 'bebs pa'i//ya mtshan dgon sde skyong ba khyed la bstod/ /rā ma ṇa yi zla bo khyed kyi 'khor//la lung phyogs kun nyul ba'i rdzu 'phrul can/ /sha za khrag 'thung 'byung bo bye ba'i 'khor/ /sa gsum dkyil 'khor gang ba rnams la bstod//ha har snang grags bstod tshig me tog phreb //a a lha chen dgyes pa'i mchod sprin du//spros pas chos srid 'dod don ma lus pa//'bad med bsam bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mchod cing bstod de 'phrin las bcol ba ni//phan bde rtsa ba rgyal bstan rtag tu rgyas//bstan 'dzin skyes bu dam pa'i sku tshe brtan//dge 'dun sde bcas dar ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /khyad par gser sbyangs 'bar ba'i cod pan gyi/ /dge mtshan bye ba'i 'od kyis khyon 'gongs pa//zhwa ser ring lugs phyogs las rnam rgyal ba'i//rgyal mtshan srid zhi'i bla na mtho bar mdzod//tshangs la ma nor dge ldan lugs bzang gi /mdo sngags legs bshad 'chad nyan sgom sgrub kyis//'dzin pa'i dge 'dun thugs mthun chos spyod 'phel//ltos bcos mnga' thang dar ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//snyigadi sdus rang mtshang nad mtshon brgal ba

yis/ /'gro ba'i phan bde mog por byas pa yi/ /nor phyugs god kha gcan gzan 'tshe ba sogs/ /mi 'dod rkyen ngan zhi ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /sa bdag klu gnyan khros pa'i cho 'phul gyis//mdze grum shi ba rdo phol gnyan lhog sogs//rims tshad nad rigs sogs kyis sdug bsngal ba//zhi zhing ming tsam med pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /ring bo tshe dang chen po bsod nams dang / /dpal 'byor mnga' thang snyan pa'i grags pa sogs//chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs ma lus pa//'bad med bsam bzhin 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//bsru med mchog gsum mchod pa'i cha rkyen dang //dbul phongs 'gro la sbyin pa'i dngos 'byor rdzas//mtha' dag char dus nam mkha'i glang bo ltar//rtag tu 'du ba'i 'phrin las g.yel med mdzod//yul 'di'i phun tshogs mi bzod gdug sems kyis//byad gtad mthu dang ku 'phrog gleng 'gel lga/dngos dang dngos med sbyor rtsub dgra dang bgegs//thams cad drag po'i chad pas rdul du rlogs//mdor na dus dang gnas skabs kun tu yang //bdag cag dpon slob sbyin bdag 'khor bcas la/ /nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe dang //phar 'gro'i skyel ma tshur 'ong bsu ma mdzod//mi 'dod rkyen ngan bar chad thams cad sol//mthun rkyen gang bsam 'dod don thams cad sgrubs//gser ldan yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa//bkra shis bde legs chen pos khyab par mdzod// ces bstod cing 'phrinalas bcol/dam pa snga mas mdzad pa'i g.yang 'bod sogs bya'o/yig brgya brjod/sdu /dayongs su sogs kyis bzod gsol/chu

las chu bur brdol ba ji bzhin du//rig pa'i rtsal gyis mgrod du bsus pa rnams/ /ngo bo gdod nas skye ba med pa'i klong / / rnam pa rang rang so so'i gnas su gshegs//badz+ra mu/ 'khor 'das mgron rnams rang gnas su gshegs par gyur/ shis brjod pa ci rigs byas te me tog gi char dbab par bya'o//smras pa/ legs bshad tshon brgyas ri mor bris pa yis//legs lam mchod chog dbang gzhu mtshams sbyor gyis/ /legs pa'i lha chen thugs mkha' mos blo'i gzhi//legs 'brel mdza' gcugs shis pas khyab gyur cig/ces bsang 'di ni/mtho ris yon tan gyi rgyan dang ldan pa sngags pa sangs rgyas skyabs dang ban+de tshe ring gser 'od skyabs rnams nas nan tan chen pos yang yang bskul ngor/ btsun gzugs rgya tig skye ming ba ngag dbang dkon mchog rgya mtsho'am mtsho byung /spra/ pa'i blo ldan du 'bod pas sbyar zhing yi ge ba nimadzod pa dge slong dkon mchog rgya

dge legs rab brtan la bsang brjod 'bul tshul lha rgyal snyan pa'i gad rgyangs/༄'i //na mo gu ru tsa kro sa 'a de 0tā giḥ 'dir yul nyi shu rtsa bzhi'i cha shas grub pa'i gnas mchog dag pa ka drod dpal gyi ri bo'i lhun po dpal brtsegs la brten pa'i gnas sgo srung ba'i yul lha'i rgyal po dge legs rab brtan la bsang bsngon gtong bar 'dod pas/ gzhi ma dkar bo'i steng du zan gtsang mar bsngon gtor bang rim bzhi brtsegs kyi steng du kum gtor rgyan ldan/ bang rim gzhan rnams la rgyal srid sna bdun/bkra shis rtags brgyad/'dod yon rnam lnga sogs mar ram bris pas brgyan pa'am/ yang na mar zan gyi ril bu'i phyur bur bkang gzhan bza' bca'i rigs ci 'byor dang bye mar dkar gsum mngar gsum sman sna gser skyems gang 'byor bshams/skyabs sems sngon du 'gro ba'i yi dam gang rigs kyi nga rgyalal gnas pa'i mchod gtor bsang sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang gis las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du/rang rangagi ming yig las byung ba'i bsang rdzas rnamasadang mchod gtor brngan chas gser skyems sogs bza' bca' btung ba'i bye brag snatshogs pa mchod yulaspyi dang khyad par yulaskyongachen po dge legs rab brtana'akhor dang bcas pa dgyes pa bskyed pa'i mchod sbyin bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'dzad pa medapa nam mkha' ma dzod kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/oṃ sarba thad sogs sngags drug dang phyag rgya yis byin rdi/ brdabs la bden stobs brjod/bsang dang

dung skad btang //rlung rta 'phyar/ /rnga sil dbyangs rol bcas 'di ltar gyer par bya'o/ /kyeḥdage bcu kun tshang mdo smad sman gyi ljongs//'ju lag g.yas skor dal 'bab yul gyi dbus//dam pa dpal gyi ri bo ka drod ces//snyan pa'i ba dan 'jig rten gsum na mtho//dus bzhi'i rang mdangs 'ja' tshon gos gyon pa'i//spang ri lhun sdug rdza ri'i thor cog can//nyi 'od prog zhu'i nor bu mthor btegs nas//'chi med bdag po'i grong la lta ba bzhin//de ru gnas gnas dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dang / /dam can zhing skyong sprin gyi tshogs bzhin du/ /phyogs mtshams lha sku yig 'bru phyag mtshan sogs//rang byung mig gi bdud rtsir 'dod par 'jo//delta'i gnas na dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gtso//da 'a bo'i bka' srung dge legs rab brtan che//yum sras bka' sdod phyi nang blon po'i tshogs//rnam 'gyur bkod pa du mas gnas 'dir bshegs//gzhan yang rlung rta'i rgyal po sde bzhi dang //'go ba'i lha lnga skyes lha dgra lha'i tshogs//lo zla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha//thams cad dgyes pas dgongs la myur du byon/ /mdun du rang rang ji ltar 'os pa yi/ /khri stan bzhon pa'i gdan la legs bzhugs nas//dngos bshams yid sprul bkod pa sna tshogs las//byung ba'i mchod pa 'bul lo dgyes par rol/ /snang srid zil gnon pad+ma ra ka sogs//ris med mkhas grub spyi dang khyad par du//grub pa'i dbang phyug mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i sde//sku phreng brgyud par bcas pa'i dam tshig dgongs//bla ma mchog gsum srung ma'i bden stobaka spyad //chos nyid rten 'byung kun rdzob

bden pa'i mthus//yul lha chen po'i mthu stobs rdzu 'phul dang //las bzhi'i 'phrin las mthu dang ldan par mdzod// sgyurang dang yul lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa'i mdun gyi nam mkhar tham rdo rje sems dpa' yab yum bzhugs pa'i sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi dang 'od zer gyi rgyun dpag tu med pa babs/ snod bcud kyis grib dang mi gtsang spyi dang /khyad par du sa rko rdo slog mar gtad dmar bshal thab gzhob 5 sogs pa'i sgo nas yul lhaganyan po'i thugs dang 'galab 'khon du bcug pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa thams cad ngang gis dag yul gyi sa bcud nus pa/yul lha'i mthu stobs gzi brjid/yul mi'i tshe bsod dpal 'byor snyan grags rlung rta la sogs pa thams cad rgyas parabyas te bde skyid rdzogs ldan gyi lhami dang skal ba mnyam par gyur bsam la yig brgya mang du bzla/de nas bsang brngon 'bul ba ni/ kyiḥ na tshogs rten 'byung sgyu ma'i bkod pa las//'dod dgu'i dngos por ci yang 'char ba'i 'phrul//'dzad med mchod sprin nam mkha' mdzod kyi sgo//brgya phrag cig car 'byed do dgyes par mdzod//gser ldan dga' ma'i sto ba las 'khrungs pa'i//phun tshogs rtsi bcud me tog sman sna'i rigs//bsregs pa'i dud sprin nam mkha' 'gengs pa 'dis//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i rgyal po 'khor bcas bsang nga ma'i mchod yod zhabs bsil dngan/sna tshogs me tog dri zhim bdug pa'i spos//'od 'bar snang gsal dri chab ro brgya'i zas//gdangs snyan rol mo'i bye brag kun gyis mchod/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod gtso bo yon tan lnga/ /srid pa'i dpal 'byor snying bo rgyal srid bdu///3/ba pas byin rlabs bkra shis rtags

rdzas sogs/ /sna tshogs mchod pa'i bye brag kun gyis brngan/ / gling bzhi'i lte ba'i snyems pa 'phrog nus pa'i//bang rim bzhi ldan gtor ma ri rab dbyibs//'dod dgu ma tshang med pas brgyan pa 'dis//mthu chen lha yi rgyal po 'khor bcas brngan//phyi yi spyan gzigs rta g.yag ra lug bya//nang gi chas gos bzhon pa phyag mtshan rgyan//bde ba'i mthun rkyen zas gos gnas mas sogs/ /phyi nang 'dod dgu'i longs spyod tshogs kyis brngan/ /rang srung sku mkhar rdo rje'i go khrab lham//pha rol dgra 'joms rno ngar mtshon cha'i rigs//rgud pa'i g.yul las rgyal thabs ji snyed pas/ /yul skyong dgra lha'i gtso bo 'khor bcas brngan//snod kyi 'jig rten nyams dga'i bkod pa dngan/bcud kyi 'byor ba lha mi'i longs spyod sogs//rnam dkar 'bras bu yid 'ongs sna tshogs pas//snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon 'khor bcas brngan//gsang ba'i yum sras phyi nang blon po brngan//yul lha dkar phyogs skyong ba thams cad brngan/khyed rnams mchod pas bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi//chos srid legs tshogs rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//spro na mtshams 'dir gzhi bdag gtor ma dang /spyi sger kyi bsang nang gser mas sogs gzhan yang bya/de nas bstod cing 'phrin las bcol ba ni/ kyeḥ na bsags bsod nams ka sha'i ras dkar la//rnam smin spyir gyis bris pa'i dregs pa'i gzugs//sprul ba'i zhing skyong dge legs rab brtan che//nag phyogs g.yul las rgyal ba'i dbu 'phang bstod//gser 'od glog gi rtse dga' dang 'grogs pa'i/—/chadi sprin gzhon nu lang long 'phyur ba'i

dbus//srid gsum 'dar ba'i sgra ldan g.yu 'brug steng //rab dkar zla shel 'dzum zhal ngom la bstod//lhab lhub gos bzang dar gyi 'jol ber dngan/sil sil sgra ldan rin chen ska rags rgyan//khral khrol sna tshogs nor bu'i 'phyang 'phrul sogs//mang mang rin chen du mas brgyan la bstod//bdud sde g.yul las rgyal ba'i dpa' rtags su//phyogs kyi khor yug 'gengs pa'i dar mdung dang //srid gsum 'dod dgu cig car 'ching byed pa'i//zla zer zhags ring phyogs brgyar 'phen la sdod//gzhan yang thugs la dgyes bskyed gsang ba'i yum//lha yi sras po ming sring bka' sgrub blon//mngag gzhug bran g.yog ru 'dren 'bangs dang bcas//phyogs 'di'i lha klu mthu chen kun la bstod//pad+ma ra ga g.yung ston rdo rje dpal//sa chen yab sras chos rje kurma pa//phyag na pad+mo rgyal ba'i sras po sogs//dam pas bka' bsgos srung ma che la bstod//khyad par zung 'jug sku brnyes rdo rje'i 'chang //mdo rgyud rgya mtshos grub pa'i gnas chen 'di'i//'phrin las sgo brgya thog mar 'byed pa'i dus//dam pa'i bka' sgrub dpa' bo che la bstod//sngon dus rang gis khas blangs dam bca' dang //da ltar gsol ba btab bzhin bdag cag la//dgung sngon dbyings nas dag pa'i lha mig gis//nyin mtshan kun tu srung skyob bya ra mdzod//mdo smad spyi dang khyad par yul phyogs 'dir//bstan pa dar zhing dkon mchog dbu 'phang mtho//dge 'dun thugs mthun bstan pa'i bya ba rgyas//sbyin bdag mnga' thang stobs dang ldan par mdzod//'jarda ciXl dbyangs dngos tshul khrims rgya

mtsho'i zhabs/ /sku tshe brtan cing rnam dkar mdzad 'phrin rgyas/ /bka' 'bangs 'dus sde'i bstan pa'i bya ba kun//gang gis bzhed pa ji bzhin 'grub par mdzod//khyad par bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi//srog lus dbang thang stobs ldan rta mchog bzhin//chos srid las bzhi'i bya ba gang brtsams rnams//bsam pa tsam gyis bgegs med 'grub par mdzod//rgya stag bzhin du dgra sde spa bkong zhingan/seng ge bzhin du kun la 'jigs pa med//khyung chen bzhin du srid gsum zil gyis gnon//g.yu 'brug bzhin du snyan grags rgyas par mdzod//lus la nad med bsod nams gzi brjid 'bar//smra la dbang btsan don la bsru ba med//bsam tshad 'grub cing chos srid 'char sgo yangs//ci byas lam du 'gro ba'i rlung rta bskyed//srid pa gsum gyi mthu chen ma lus pa'i//zas nor longs spyod dbyar gyi sprin bzhin bsdus//'dod dgu'i 'byor ba char chen bzhin du phob//gzhi lam byes gsum gar 'gro gar 'dug kyang //phyi dang 'byung ba dgra gdon chom rkun sogs//mi 'dod rgud pas nam yang mi gtses par//bsam don chos bzhin 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzod//mdor na gang bcol 'phrin las ma lus pa//byang chub mchog gi rgyu ru 'gyur ba'i phyir//gzhan phan bsam pa mchog gis rang gzhan gyi//mthar thug don gnyis lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod//yig brgya mang du bzla la/ sgyu ma'i skyes bus mgron gyi 'phrul 'khor bzhin//mi shes rmongs pas cho ga 'khrul ba sogs//'khor gsum dmigs med ngang ladi bsdud bzhes la//rang snang nyams dga'i

gnas su badz+ra mu ཿ 'jig rten bde zhing sogs shis pa brjod pas 'jug brgyan par bya'o// smras pa/ sras bcas rgyal ba'i 'phrin las 'jug pa dang / /sna tshogs gdul bya'i bsam pa'i khyad par las/ /'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das dregs pa'i tshogs// grangs dang tshad bzung bral ba nam mkha' bzhin//de phyir rang gzhan mchod sbyin chu bo brgya//kun mkhyen rgya mtsho chen por 'dren pa'i ched//sbyor ba bzhi ldan thabs mkhas 'bab stegs su//rang rang mchod chog rnam grangs mang zhig mthong //de phyir dge legs rab tu brtan pa'i lha//phyogs las rgyal ba'i ru mtshon bsgrengs dang lhan//dregs pa dga' bskyed mchod chog lha rgyal 'di//snyan pa'i gad rgyangs mgrin pa btegs te 'then//dge 'dis dkar phyogs skyong ba thugs dgyes shing /sdod bcud bde skyid dbyar zla'i spun gyur te// rnam dkar snang ba dkar bos 'jig rten khyod//rdzogs ldan ku mud gzhon nus khyab gyur cig/ces lhun po dpal brtsegs la gnas pa'i yul lha'i sde dpon chen po dge legs rab brtan la bsang brngon 'bul tshul lha rgyal snyan pa'i gad rgyangs zhesabya ba 'di yang / rang gi nye gnas blo gros kyi nor dang ldan pa'i lhabatsun bstan 'dzin chos ldan nas bkra shis pa'i lha rdzas dang bcas bskul ngor/4khri zur ma ṇi zhabs drung ngag dbang 'phrin las: kyis yul lha de nyid kyi lha zhol du gtogs pa'i spang ljongs me tog bkra ba'i thang ljongs nyams sudaga' ba zhiganas chu stag zla tshes dge ba'i nyin bris pa rgyal bar gyur cig/

tshangs pa'i bsang yig༄mya//hrīḥ/rgyal ba kun dngos pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa bsrung bar bka' bsgos pa//tshangs pa chen po dung gi thor tshugs can//mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs shing brtan par bzhugs//ga pur tsan dan gu gul la sogs pa'i//dri ngad ldan pa'i spos sna stong phrag sogs//bsregs pa'i dud sprin lha lam khyab pa 'dis//bstan srung dung thod chen po 'khor bcas bsang //yang dngos bshams yid kyis sprul ba las//byung ba'i phyi dang dang gi mchod pa'i tshogs//sngags dang ting 'dzin phyag rgyas byin brlabs nas//sa dang bar snang khyon kun bkang ste 'bul//bzhes nas bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi//mi mthun rkyen dang bar chad zhi bar mdzod//tshe dang bsod nams dpal dang 'byor ba dang //mthun pa'i rkyen rnams yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod//mdor na chos skyong rgyal po khyed nyid kyis//g.yel ba med par mgon skyabs grogs mdzod cig /'phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub ma lus pa/ /'bad med lhun gyis 'grub par mdzad du gsol//hrīḥ/ rab 'byams rgyal ba'i gsang gsum ma lus pa//gcig bsdus slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas kyi//bka' gnyan tshangs pa dung gi thor tshugs can//'khor dang bcas pa rnams di bdaka bstod do//

bzhi ba/ jag rong gzhung chu'i gzhi bdag gi bsang bsngon/gzhi bdag lha'i dge bsnyen gzi brjid 'phags kyi gsol mchod lha mchog dgyes pa'i rol mo/༄byu / /byin rlabs dngos grub gter mdzod bla ma dang / /yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs la//sgo gsum gus pa chen po'i phyag bgyis te//yul lha'i rgyal po'i gsol mchod cho ga 'god// 'diramado smad byang rgyud kyi gzhi bdag rnams kyi gtso bor gyur ba lha'i dge bsnyen chen pogazi brjid 'phags kyi gsol mchod bya ba la/stegs kyi khar snod gtsang ma'inang du dkar gtor skum po che ba 'khor lha grangs dang bcas pa ril bus bskor b.lamarargyanaci mdzes bkod pa dang / phye mar zho 'o ma ja phud chang dkar mo lagagayas/ nyeraspyodabasangamachodarnams gtsang zhing bkod pamadzes par bshams/'byor na 'og nasa'abyung ba'ispyanagazigs rnams dngos samari mo bris pa dang /rnga rol dang dar mtshonarol mo'i bye brag rnamasakyang tshags par byas/skyabs sems sngon du btang /'jigs byed rta mgrin gang rungasogs yi dam gyi mngon rtogs rgyas pa'am skad cig dkrong bskyed lta bu byasal/mchod gtor spyan gzigs rnams la dmigs te mtha tas 3 9

bsangs/ swa bhā was stong bar sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las ji las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ dang rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i zhal zas ro brgya ba/ lha'i longs spyod bzang dgur spel ba/ mi'i zas mchog yongs su sbyar ba/ bzang zhing gtsang ma mkho dgu tshogs pa/ lha dang mi dang gnod sbyin gyi dbang bo rnams kyi rkyen du 'os pa'i yo byad mdzes dgus phyug pa/ gzhan yang phyi nang gsang ba'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ bde stong gnyis su med pa'i ngo bo ro gcig cing sngags dang phyag rgya dang ting nge 'dzin gyis cir yang spel ba/ rgya nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam zhing / yul dus gnas skabs thams cad du zad mi shes par 'byung ba nam mkha'i mdzod kyi rang bzhin can du gyur/ dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la ma sarba bid gu ra byu ra/ su ra su ra/ a warta ya/ a warta ya ho/ badz+ra sga ra ṇa khaṃ/zhes pa lan gsum dang sgro na sngags drug dang phyag rgya drug gis kyang byin gyis brlabs/bdagagi bsam pa'i sogs kyis bden stobs brjod/ rnga siladakrol zhing bon gyer byaba'am rol dbyangs dkyus mas kyang rung ste/ kyiḥ dge mtshan bcud ldan nor 'dzin yangs pa'i gzhir/ /dbyibs legs sa 'dzin tshar du dngar ba'i dbus/ /mar gad phung bo spungs 'dra'i 'brog ri che//rab brjid lhun chags rtse mo mkha' la bsnyegs/ /na bun yol ba 'ja' tshon lding khang bkra/ /sprin dkar stod g.yogs spang ljongs sham /sdus bklubs//nags kyi do shal me

tog tshom bus spras//phu chu'i 'og pag snyan pa'i sil sgra sgrog/phyi bltas yid 'ong sa 'dzin lhun po la//nang du 'dod yon longs spyod dpag med kyis//yongs su gtams pa'i lha yi gzhal med khang //brgya byin grong gi ngo mtshar la 'gran pa//de'i dbus yul lha'i rgyal po mthu rtsal can//lha yi dge bsnyen chen po gzi brjid 'phags//dkar gsal zla ba rgyas pa'i zhal bzang gi/dgyes pa'i 'dzum ston zhi ba'i gzigs stangs mdzad//shel dkar lhun po lta bu'i sku mchog la//'ja' tshon 'khyud 'dra'i na bzas nyer bklubs cing //nor bus spras pa'i gser sked bcings pa'i steng //zla zhun 'khyil 'dra'i dar dkar 'jol ber gsol//rinachen za ra tsag gi rgyun 'byang can//'dzam bu na da'i ga'u mgul 'chang zhing //nor bu'i rna rgyan gser gyi gdu bu sogs// rgyan gyi khyad par du mas rnam par brgyan//shel gyi smyug ma lta bu'i phyag g.yas kyis//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i ru mtshon mkha' la 'phyar//g.yon pa'i phyag gis dgos 'dod kun 'byung ba'i/ /rin chen gter gyi bum pa dku la brten/ /dbu la phying zhwa nor bu'i tog can dang //zhabs la sag lham dag po 'ja' ris gsol//shel sga g.yu yi srab mthur gong ched dang //rin chen rgyan cha g.yer khas brgyan pa yi//rdzu 'phrul shugs dang ldan pa'i cang shes rta//sprin sngon dum bu g.yo 'dra la bcibs nas//res 'ga' khro dang chags dang sgeg pa'i gar//sgyu ma'i rnam 'phrul bzhin du ci yang ston//bzhin mdzes yid 'ong gsang ba'i yum bzhi dang //lang tsho da/ la babs pa'i sras po dgu//bka' yi

blon po bcu gnyis sde dpon gsum//las mkhan btsan brgyad pho nya klu bdud bdun//cha byad rnam 'gyur ci yang ston byed pa'i//sprul ba yang sprul 'khor tshogs bsam mi khyab//dbyar gyi char sprin 'thib pa ji bzhin du//sa dang bar snang nam mkha' bkang ste bzhugs/ kyeḥ yul lha'i rgyal po dge bsnyen gzi brjid 'phags//'khor bcas mchod pa'i mgron du spyan 'dren gyi//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig nyer dgongs la//gnas 'dir thogs pa med par gshegs su gsol//lha khyed dgyes pa'i mthun rdzas legs bshams te//gdung dbyangs g.yab dar rol mos 'bul lags na//rab brjid rdza ri smug po'i mgul ba nas//myur mgyogs rlung gi thugs bzhin gshegs su gsol//gsang yum sras blon sde dpon las mkhan dang //pho nya sprul ba yang sprul dang bcas pa//dgyes pa'i gar dang cho 'phrul mtha' yas kyis//sa gzhi bar snang 'gengs bzhin gshegs su gsol//gzhan yang phyogs 'di'i dgon grong lha khang dang //ri brag nags tshal spang ljongs thang sgang gshong //chu mig 'bab chu pha bong shing gcig dang //lha khang lab rtse sogs la gnas pa yi//steng gi lha dang 'og gi sa bdag klu//bar gyi btsan dang rgyal po gnyan la sogs//mi min 'byung bo ji snyed mchis pa kun//rang rang gnas nas thogs pa med par gshegs//mdun du sprin dkar lang long 'khrigs pa'i klong //yid 'phrog 'ja' tshon sna lnga'i gur khyim dbus//yul lha'i rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa rnams//ji srid dran pa de srid bzhugs su gsol/ /kyeḥ / ཿyi dge bsnyen chen po 'khor bcas

dang //phyogs 'di'i yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad la//ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i//dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa 'bul ba ni//dwangs bsil yid 'ong lha chab gtsang ma yi//mchod yon mtshor 'khyil zhabs bkru'i chu rgyun stengs//me tog tshal bzhad dri zhim du sprin 'khrigs//mar me tshar dngar spos chu'i dri chab 'gyur//rol mo'i sgra sgrog zhal zas sna tshogs bshams//mdzes pa'i gzugs dang snyan pa'i sgra dbyangs dang //zhim pa'i dri dang mngar pa'i ro mchog dang //'jam pa'i reg bya rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ /ka ra bu ram zang rtsi shing thog rigs//ja chang zho 'o 'bras chan 'khur ba can//dkar mo lag g.yas phye mar bshos bu sogs//bza' bca' btung ba'i bye brag sna tshogs 'bul//rlung gi thugs ldan rta mchog sga chas — spras//dbang sngon rwa gdengs 'brong g.yag zhol chen ngur//'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin mdzo 'bri 'dod 'jo'i ba//g.yang dkar lug dang ra yi tshogs rnams 'bul//bya dang byi'u 'phur lding skad snyan bsgyur//lus mdzes ri dwags rtse zhing bang rtsal 'gran//'jigs rung gcan gzan 'dur rgyug ngar skad 'don//'phur 'dzul 'phyo dgu'i srog chags sna tshogs 'bul//gser dngul gnam lcags las grub go khrab dang //mda' gzhu ral gri mdung sogs mtshon cha'i rigs//rnga dung cha lang la sogs rol mo'i sgra//dar gyi ru mtshon rnga thug rnams kyang 'bul//bai ḍūr+ya dang gser dngul mu tig g.yu//pad+ma rā ga byu ru mu med dang //mchong dung gzi dang zangs lcags la ༷/sa pa//lha klu mi yi rin chen sna tshogs

'bul//gos dar rin chen srog chags pags rigs dang //nas 'bras gro sogs bza' ba'i 'bru rnams dang //rtsi shing 'bras bu sa rdo'i sman sna dang //mkho dgu'i yo byad ma tshang med pa 'bul//'jam mnyen dar gos na bza' snatshogs dang //snyan cha gdu bu la sogs rgyan gyi tshogs//rin chen rtse phran nor bu'i tog dang zhwa//khri stan bla re ba dan rgyal mtshan 'bul//'khor bsgyur la 'os rgyal srid rin chen bdun//bkra shis dge mtshan spel ba'i rdzas rtags brgyad//mdor na lha mi'i longs spyod mtha' yas pa//kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin la 'gran pa 'bul/ 6 lha ri gnyan por skyes pa'i snyag ma la//rgod kyi sgro skyon gnam lcags mde'u btsugs//dar sna me long gis brgyan phyug btsan gyi//khab dang leb rgan btags pa'i nyag phran dang //gzhan yang dar tshon lnga dang dkar dmar dang / /g.yu chung mig med rin chen sna tshogs dang //shing sna gsum dang byang bu mig dgu dang //chang bu nas dkar lha g.yag dkar bo rnams/ /yul lha dgra lha gnyan po 'khor bcas la/ /chags pa'i rten dang dgyes pa'i skongs su 'bul/ /rten las ma 'da' 'bem las mi g.yo bar//bdag cag mi nor rigs rgyud srung skyob mdzod// 6 tsan dan dkar dmar a gar rigs gsum dang //ba lu tshu lu stag pa mkhan pa dang //bzang drug sman dang dri zhim spos kyi rigs//dar zab rin chen 'bru sna'i phye ma rnams//rab 'bar mer bsregs bsang gi du ba'i tshogs//mkha' la be+e ḍūr+ya chu 'dzin ltar 'khrigs pa//'dod pa'i yon ta/ lnga dang ldan pa 'dis//yul lha'i rgyal

po lha yi dge bsnyen bsang //bde chen bskyed pa'i btsun mo rnam bzhi bsang //dpa' rtsal mthu stobs ldan pa'i sras dgu bsang //blon po bcu gnyis sde dpon rnams gsum bsang / /las mkhan btsan brgyad pho nya klu bdun bsang //phyogs 'di'i dgon gnas lha khang lha rten dang //ri brag lung ba thang snang la nyag gshong / /nags tshal spang ljongs ne'u gsing mtsho dang mtshe'u//'bab chu chu mig khron pa lam 'phrang sung //sum mdo bzhi mdo zam pa gad g.yang skyibs//pha bong shing gcig sogs la gnas pa yi//lha klu gzhi bdag gdon bgegs lan chags gnyer//mi min 'byung bo bsang 'os thams cad bsang //bdag sogs ma rig rmongs pa'i las dbang gis//brag gnyan bshigs dang shing gnyan bcad pa dang //chu gnyan dkrugs dang sa gnyan slog pa dang / /gnyan sar dmar bshas thab gzhob bshang gci dor/ /mi gtsang grib kyis lha klu mnol ba sogs//phog thug byung ba thams cad bzod gsol gyis//'khu ldog las byung gnod 'tshe kun bsal nas//dgyes pa'i thugs kyis bu bzhin skyong du gsol//cha'abrog gnas chen po dge bsnyen gzi brjid 'phags//dgra lha'i gtso bor mnga' gsol gzengs bstod kyis//zla ba rgyas 'dra'i lha zhal mthor btegs nas//shis pa'i skad rgyang phyogs bcur sgrog par mdzod//rang phyogs skyong la brtse ba'i pha ma dang //dgra phyogs 'joms la rdo rje'i me char dang //dgos 'dod stsol la dpag bsam shing bzhin du//bdag cag re 'dod yid sdusan bskang bar mdzod// kyiḥ sngon tshe

slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang //'jam dbyangs rnam sprul sa skya paṇ+ḍita//'gro mgon 'phags pa rgyal ba tsong kha pa//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i bka' bsgos nyer gtad bzhin//phan bde 'byung gnas thub bstan spyi dang ni//khyad par blo bzang grags pa'i ring lugs kyi//mdo sngags bshad sgrub phyogs dus thamasacad du//dar rgyas yun ring gnas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//bstan pa 'dzin skyong spel la rab brtson pa'i//dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe mdzad 'phrin rgyas//bslab gsum ngur smrig 'ching ba'i khrims ldan gyi/ /'dus sde sa steng thams cad khyab par mdzod//khyad par yul 'di'i bshad sgrub sder bzhugs pa'i//dge 'dun thams cad thugs mthun nang khrims gtsang //chos spyod rnam bcu 'khor lo gsum gyi las/ /dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin du 'phel bar mdzod/ /phyogs 'dir dus min rlung dang kha char dang //sad ser than pa sa g.yos shwa 'od thog/dgra jag chom kun gcan gzan 'tshe ba sogs//mi 'dod rkyen ngan thams cad zhi bar mdzod//mi yi na tsha phyugs kyi god kha dang //dus min 'chi ba skeg dang phung sri dang //'thab rtsod 'khrug long byad phur ltas ngan sogs//nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi zhing bzlog par mdzod//ring bo'i tshe dang rlabs chen bsod nams dang //chos nor 'byor ba mnga' thang rigs rgyud sogs//legs tshogs yon tan yar ngo'i zla ba ltar//gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod/ /skye bo thams cad mi dge log spyod spangs//skyabs la dad cing dge ba'i las la gzhol//phan tshun sems ༷༷na ya rabs lugs bzang spyod//rtag

cabade skyid dpal la rol bar mdzod//dregs ldan lha klu mi yi 'byor ba dang //srid pa gsum gyi zas nor longs spyod dang //'khor 'das snod bcud kun gyi phywa g.yang bcas//ma tshang med par dbang du 'du bar mdzod//dkon mchog dbu 'phang smod cing bstan la 'tshe//rang gzhan rig la 'god pa'i bsam sbyor can//mngon spyod yul du gyur pa'i dgra bgegs rnams/ /yal bar ma gtong drag po'i chad pa phob//gzhi lam gyes gsum gar 'gro gar 'dug kyang //nam yang re zhing bltos tshe ma bas bar//nyin gsum bya ra mtshan gsum mel tshe dang //phar 'gro'i skyel ma tshur 'ong bsu ba mdzod//khyed ni srid pa chags pa nas bzung ste//pha mes rigs dang brgyud la 'go ba'i lha//bdag cag rnams kyang khyed gsol khyed mchod na//'dris pa'i khrel gzhung bsten pa'i dam tshig dgongs//rtag tu nam mkha'i mthongs nas lha mig gis//yul 'di'i skye 'gror bya ra ma g.yel bar//nyes pa kun sel legs pa thams cad spel//sdongs grogs 'phrin las lhun gyis 'grub par mdzod//mtshams 'dir g.yang 'bod byed 'dod na gzhan las 'byung ba ltar bya/ de nas yig brgya brjod/ ma rnyed yongs su ma shes dang zhes sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol la/ kyi mkha' las sprin byung mkha' la thim pa bzhin//rig pa'i rtsal gyis bsus pa'i mchod yul kun/ /ngo bo gdod nas skye ba med pa'i klong //rnam pa so so'i gnas su badz+ramuḥ/zhes gshegs sugasol/bsod nams dar rgyas ri rgyal lhun po bzhin//snyan grags chen po nam mkha' bzhin ༵ khyab/ /tshe ring nad med gzhan don

lhun gyis grub//yon tan rgya mtsho mchog gi bkra shis shog/ ces sogs bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// chen po bod kyi yul spu'i byang rgyud kyi/ /sa 'dzin mthon por gnas pa'i gzhi bdag che/ /dgyes bskyed mchod pa'i cho ga 'di sbyar dgos//bstan 'gro'i phan bde dbyar mtsho ltar rgyas shog /ces gzhi bdag 'brog gnas chen po lha'i dge bsnyen gzi brdzid 'phags la gsolamachod bya ba'i cho ga lhamachog dgyes pa'i rol mozhes bya ba 'di gi don gnyer can mang bos ji phyir bskul cing rang gi skyes lhar gsol mchod sogs byed pa la mkho ba'i 'bri 'dun — yod thog nye char dgos pa 'ga' zhig kyang mthong bar brten/ ku swa mi snyam badz+ra yis rab byung bcu gsum pa'i chu mo glang gi lor rang gi skyes yul du bskyod skabs/gzhi bdag gnas pa'i ri bo chen po'i lha zhol spyan gzigs thang zhes grags par mgo brtsams te sbyarayi ge pa ni gu sridage slong ngag dbang bstan 'phel lo/

yul lha'i rgyal po lha'i dge bsnyen chen po'i gsol mchod bsdus pa/༄snyo //hrīḥ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba'i thugs rje gcig bsdus pa//rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma thod phreng rtsal//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs bcas da tshur byon//seng khri pad nyi'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol//khyad par yul lha'i rgyal po mthu rtsal can//lha yi dge bsnyen chen po gzi brjid 'phags//bde skyed yum chen bzhi dang sras mchog dgu//bka' yi sgron po bcu gnyis sde dpon gsum/ /las mkhan btsan brgyad pho nya klu bdud bdun/ /rnam mang 'khor bcas mchod pa'i gnas 'dir byon//'ja' 'od gur khyim dar zab gdan la bzhugs/ /gzhan yang ri klung chu brag thang lam dang //dgas tshal dgon grong phyugs lhas 'phrang sogs la//gnas pa'i lha klu gnyan btsan dmu thel sogs//ma lus mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//oṃ/ phyag rgya sngags kyis byin rlabs bdud ci'i mtsho//ri klung thang skyes me tog sna tshogs dang //dri zhim shing sna bsregs pa'i du ba'i sprin//mun 'joms me lce mkha' la snyeg bzhin 'bar//yid 'ong spos chu'i tshon kyis legs par bran//phye mar la sogs bza' ba phung bor spungs//sil snyan sna tshogs rol mo'i gyer dbyangs dang //cang shes rta dang zhol pho zhol mo dang //ra lug mda' 'phang dar mdung rta dkar sogs/ /phyi nang spyan gzi/lhaX mchod pa'i tshogs rnams 'bul/ /

dgyes pa'i dam rdzas tshogs kyis thugs dam bskang //zhabs bsil sman phud gser skyems dam pas mchod//'gal 'khrul nongs pa gang mchis bzod par gsol/ /mchod do gsol lo dgra lha yongs kyi rje/ /rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i bka' las ma 'da' bar//sangs rgyas bstan srung dkon mchog dbu 'phang bstod//dge 'dun sde dang chos 'khor skyong ba dang //khyad par yul 'di'i skye 'gro thams cad la//byams brtses srung skyob sdongs grogs mdzad du gsol//gzhi la 'khor nor longs spyod rgyas pa dang //tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub par mdzod//gnas skabs kun tu nad yams sad ser dang //rgyugs nad 'khrug rtsod ma lus zhi bar mdzod//char chu dus 'bab lo phyugs rtag —legs shing //mi dang lha mthun 'khrug rtsod zhe khrel med//phan tshun byams ldan bde skyid dar ba dngaka/bsam don thams cad yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ga5tsha7〉〉 cho cig —— nga /'a jisdu ༷ ༷ mo ( ṭāpa dosmo rta/ sdo'o/༷/spyo tsho sa sha gi /rdo ———rdzo tsho 331—— ne

khra rab dge legs rab brtan la gnas ba'i gzhi bdag chen po'i gsol mchod ka li'i phreng ba/༄ //oṃ su sti/ ka ma lar skyes rig 'dzin grub dbang gis//kha ba'i ljongs 'dir bka' bsgos nyer gtad bzhin//ga shed rang snang dag pa'i gzhal yas nas//nga cag mchod pa'i mgron du gshegs su gsol//ca co'i brjod bral dag pa'i rang bzhin la//cha byad bsang dang go mtshon spyan gzigs dang //ja chang 'o zho rgyan ldan gtor ma sogs//nya rgyas 'dzum 'od ngom bzhin bzhes su gsol//ta thā ga ta 'jam dpal snying bo'i bstan//tha spu yangs pa'i khyod du gnas pa kun//da nas bzung ste bskal pa gnas kyi bar//na tshod yar zla bzhin du 'phel bar mdzod//pa wa sangs ltar myur mgyogs cang shes rta//pha rol 'joms pa'i rwa gdeng zhol pho mo//ba dan ltar bkra'i rgyan ldan lug rwa skyes//ma lus g.yang gi ra ba sgo bzhi 'bul//tsa tur 'phrin las 'od stong 'bar ba'i gzis//tsha zer can gyis pad+mo'i tshal ba bzhin//dza ya'i bstan dang de 'dzin bcas pa kun//wa ler g.yeng med brtse ba'i thugs kyis skyongs//zhwa ltar gtsug tu bsten pa'i dgra lha che//za byed 'bar ba'i dpung gi tshogs dang bcas//'a 'ur thog dang btsa' than nad mug sogs//ya nga'i cho 'phrul gdug pa'i dgra la soXs//rā ma ṇa bzhin cho 'phrul sna tshogs

pas//la lung phyogs su nyul ba'i kun jag dgra//sha za'i rigs can mtha' dmag dpung gi tshogs//sa gsum dgra bgegs ming gi lhag mar mdzod//ha ha g.yul las rgyal ba'i bzhad sgra dang //a ti'i rang lugs rgyal ba gnyis pa'i //dri/ ba/// nadu largya dī bgyaXs ci/la /// / pa// // k+to rjor/ //// / /sa bcas//mthu ldan srungag ma khyed la nyer gtad na//chos dang srid kyi dpal 'byor legs pa'i tshogs//gang bsam 'dod rgu lhun gyis 'grub par mdzodaces khra rab dge legs rab brtan la gnas pa'i gzhi bdag chen po'i gsolamachod ka li'i phreng bar bsgrigs pa 'di ni gzhi bdag chen po'i lha zhol dpal lung gi snar thog nas jag rong tsho gzhi'i bun mong gis lha dar bcas bskulangor bris pa'o wa wawa ——— — —————wa —༄byu //stong nyid snying rje dbyer med pa//khams gsum pa yi ngo bo nyid//bskal ba'i me bzhin gzi brjid 'bar//rdo ṭ+wāṃ k+ta shā /sna /du /spya ga/zungs/———wa —wa ——————wa —

phyug ri'i gsol mchod kun bzang dga' bskyed/༄byu / /kyeḥ chos dbyings kun bzang bde chen gzhal yas nas//rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam bstan srung sogs//mchod gtor bsang mchod mgron du gshegs su gsol//bde skyid dpal g.yang spel ba'i byin chen phobs//sa 'dzin rin chen spungs 'dra'i lhun po nas//yul skyong gnas bdag nor 'dzin 'khor dang bcas/ /deng 'dir rtse gcig yid kyis spyan 'dren na/ /grangs med 'khor bcas mchod yul mgron du bzhugs//bsang chen 'bru gsum sngags rgyas byin brlabs pa'i//mthu stobs gzi brjid bskyed pa'i mchod pa'i sprin//mkho dgu'i longs spyod nam mkha'i mtha' klas pa//brtse chen thugs kyi dgyes 'dzum gar gyis rol//khyed gsol khyed bsten sbyin bdag 'khor bcas kyi/ /mi nor phyugs kyi 'gal rkyen khyed kyis sol/ /'jig rten nyer mkho'i phywa g.yang legs tshogs rnams//mi nyams gong nas gong du 'phel ba yi//'phrin las sdongs grogs dus las g.yel med mdzod//'jig rten bde zhing lo legs dang / /'bru rnams 'phel zhing chos 'phel dang / /bde legs sun sum tshogs pa dngan/yid la 'dod pa kun 'grub shog/ces rgyug ri nor 'dzin gyi gsol mchod 'di di/ rab rgyas mchog sprul rin po che blo bzang bshad sgrub chosakyi nyi ma dang /dge slong bskal bzang rgya mtsho sogs kyis dngulasgor kyi kyi

gsum dang lha ngas bcas kyis bskul ba'i ngor/thu'u bkwan smu phreng bdun pa bskal bzang dam chos nyi mas bris shing yin pa ni dka' bcu blo bzang sbyin pa'o/༄ //rgyal kun yab gcig rje btsun mkhyen pa'i gter//snying rje'i rang gzugs 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs//mthu stobs dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag po ste//rigs gsum mgon po'i zhabs la gus phyag 'tshal/rigs gsum mgon po'i gzungs/

bkra shis dpal mtho'i bsangan༄ga // cha 'dzam gling nor 'dzin yangs pa'i byang gi phyogs//mdo smad dpa' ris mdzes byed sa yi rgyan//bkra shis dpal mtho zhes grags lhun po la//gnas bcas dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon che//dpal 'byor nor bu zhi 'dzum dgyes pa'i nyams//dar sngon 'jol ber rin chen 'brog zhwa gsol//g.yas g.yon bgrang phreng nor bu'i gzhong ba bsnams//rgyal po rol ba'i stabs kyis 'gying zhing bzhugs//'khor du lha klu sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs//thams cad bsang gi mgron du spyan drangs na//dga' ba'i gar dang bcas te 'dir byon la//rnal 'byor 'phrin las bsgrub phyir brtan par bzhugs/ /lha mi'i mnol grib sel byed bsang gi rdzas/ /'dod rgu ci yang 'char byed mchod pa'i sprin//dpal 'byor nor bu 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//gzhan yang bza' dang bca' ba mkho rgu'i nor//chas gos rgyan dang phyag mtshan bzhon pa sogs//dngos bshams yid kyis sprul ba 'di bzhes la//bstan 'gro'i legs tshogs rgyas pa'i 'phrin las sgrubs//khyad par 'dir gnas bdag cag 'khor bcas la/ /mi nad phyugs nad dus min 'chi ba dang / /dgra jag chom kun gcan gzan kha smras sogs/ /mi 'dod nyer 'tshe mtha' dag zhi bar mdzod//tshe bsod dpal 'byor mnga' thang rigs rgyud 333

༄wa —/lha dang lha min cod pan gyis//zhabs kyi pad+mo la btud cing //phongs pa kun las sgrol mdzad ma/ /sgrol ma yum la phyag 'tshal lo/ /oṃ tā re tu: re tu re swā hā/bka' gdams lha bzhi'i nang gi sgrol ma'i gzungs/

gnas bdag pad+ma badz+ra'i bsang yig༄༄ //cha dpal dang 'byor ba rab rgyas jag rong gi/gdags srib nor 'dzin skyong ba'i mthu bo che//spyi dang khyad par dmar mtho'i ri brag la//brten pa'i mthu ldan pad+ma badz+ra ni/rnam 'gyur ci yang ston pa'i dpa' gtum gzugs//khros pa'i zhal gdangs 'bar ba'i mche ba gtsigs//phyag g.yas lcags kyu g.yon pas bum pa bzung //za 'og ber dang bse yi khrab rmog dngan/zhabs la sag lham yu ring smug po dang //stag dong gzig thubs 'khor gsum chas kyis sgeg /rmig bzhi rab rno rdo rje sna ldan la//zhon nas nag phyogs sdig can tshar gcod pa'i//dkar phyogs rnal 'byor dpon slob sde bcas rnams//rtag tu g.yel med sdongs grogs bya ra byed//res 'ga' ban btsun zhi dul chos gos 'chang //brtul zhugs 'byams su klas pa'i drang srong che/ /gzhan yang sman btsun sras blon ru 'dren sogs//rang rang zhon pa phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs//sgeg 'gying dpa' dang khro dang rol ba sogs//nyams dang 'gyur ba stong gis bzhugs pa la//rang gi thugs ku'i hūṃ yig 'od zer gyis//reg pa'i mod la mdun gyi nam mkha' ru//yid 'ong mchod rdzas bkra ba'i gur khang du/ /ji srid 'dod kyi bar du bzhugs su gsol/ /chos rgyal mes dbon jing gar rnams kyi dus//bar byung a ti rdi ༷ bstan pa dang //da lta blo bzang rgyal

ba'i bshad sgrub la/ /rab tu gus pa khyed la glo ba 'ga'/khyed la nyer spyod yo byad 'bul ba ni//bde chen phyag rgya chen po'i rol ba las ci yang 'char ba'i 'dod pa'i yon tan sogs/ /bkod legs gtor ma bsang mchod gser skyems dang //gdugs dang rgyal mtshan bla re go mtshon rta//nor lug sha rkyang rkang 'gro 'dab chags bya//rgyan gos longs spyod phyag mtshan bang mdzod zas//'dod dgu'i longs su spyod pa ma lus 'bul//dgyes bzhin bzhes nas yon mchod 'khor bcas kyi//chos srid legs tshogs mthun rkyen thams cad sgrubs/ /dgra jag chom kun me chu rlung sad ser/ /nag mun dus 'gyur mi mthun zhi ba dang //dpal ldan tshang ba dus bzhi dge legs kun//rdzogs ldan dbyar gyi dga' ma'i lang tsho bzhin//dge mtshan gdong lnga ba yis legs drangs nas//phan bde 'od kyi mu khyud che gsal shog /lnga dus rang mtshang lta log lha min grong //dge bcu reg pa'i nyag phran gyis bsnun pas//bcud med /dri dī rngo rdo /la las dkar ba'i phyogs//yid bzang sras po'i dpung tshogs

bkra shis bom sngon gyi bsang mchod/༄ //rang nyid lha'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas bsang rdzas byin gyis brlabs la/ kyiḥ bkra shis bom sngon zhes grags pa'i//sa 'dzin mthon po la gnas pa'i//gzhi bdag lha yi dge bsnyen che//'khor bcas thogs med gnas 'dir gshegs//mdun du char sprin 'khrigs pa'i klong //'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i gur gyi nang / /g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i gdan steng na//lha yi dge bsnyen rdzu 'phul can//sku mdog sngon po 'dzum pa'i nyams//phyag na nor bu'i gzhong ba thogs//na bza' chu dar 'ja' ris gsol//rin chen gser g.yu'i rgyan gyis spras/ /yum mchog klu mo yid 'ong ma//'khor du lha klu du mas bskor//kun kyang dgyes pa'i gar dang bcas//mchod pa'i yul du bzhugs su gsol/ /khyad par mchod pa 'bul ba ni/cha dngas bsil mchod yon mtsho ltar 'khyil//yid 'phrog me tog sna tshogs bzhad//dri zhim spos kyi dud pa 'thul//'od 'bar mar me tshar du dngar//gdung sel sman chab chu rgyun sbreng//zhal zas bza' bca' ri ltar spungs//gdangs snyan rol mo sna tshogs 'khrol//rin chen gser g.yu nor bu'i rgyan//kha dog sna tshogs za 'og gos//yid bzhin nor gyi gzhong ba dang //g.yu 'brug sngon mo rdzu 'phul can//gnam la 'gur dgu sa gzhi la//'dzul dgu ri dwags 'phyo dgu sogs/ /lha klu mi yi longs spyod tshogs/ /sa dang bar snang 339

bkang ste 'bul/ /tsan dan thug pa a gar sogs/ /dri zhim shing sna sman sna dang //rin chen dar zab phye mar rnams//rab 'bar mes bsregs dud pa'i tshogs//be+e ḍū'i chu 'dzin ltar 'khrigs pa'i//'dod yon lnga ldan bsang mchod 'bul//nyams grib mi gtsang dag gyur nas//rmad byung bde bas dgyes gyur cig /lha dang mi yi bza' bca' kun//gcig tu spungs pa'i gtor ma dang //dkar mngar ja chang btung ba'i tshogs//rol mtsho lta bur 'khyil bas mchod//stobs ldan gzhi bdag 'khor bcas kyis/ /mchod gtor mthun rdzas 'di bzhes la//'jam dbyangs sa skya parnyita//'gro mgon bla ma 'phags pa sogs//grub brnyes skyes bu rim byon gyis/ /dam la bzhag pa'i dam tshig dgongs//sangs rgyas bstan pa dar ba dang //'gro ba'i phan bde rgyas par mdzod//khyad par yul phyogs 'di nyid du/ /mi yi na tsha phyugs kyi god//lo nyes 'thab rtsod 'khrug long sogs//mi 'dod nyer 'tshe zhi bar mdzod//tshe ring nad med rigs rgyud 'phel//nor rdzas sgo zog longs spyod rgyas//ci bsam don kun lhun gyis 'grub//bde skyid dga' ston rgyas par mdzod//srid dang zhi ba'i phywa g.yang kun//gnas 'dir 'khyil bas sdod bcud kyi//bkrag mdangs gya nom gzi brjid rgyas//dge mtshan dpal la spyod gyur cig/ri bo bom sngon gyi gzhi bdag gi gsolamachod 'diyang sngags pa tshe ring bsam grubakyis bskul ngor/rnyarma badz+ra yis zhadamar dgon gyi bla brang gong du sbyar ba'o

bom sngon gsol mchod dge legs dpal ster/༄༄ //dge bcu 'dzoms pa'i mdo smad dpa' ris kyi//mdo la ring mo'i rdza rgyud bom sngon zhes//rdza ri mthon mthing gnam la brtsegs 'dra ba'i//rtse mor gnas bcas lha gnyan drag rtsal can//bon paṇa bstan dang yul phyogs skyong ba'i bdag /bkra shis bom sngon sngo bsangs 'brug la zhon//nor gzhung ral gri me 'bar phyag tu bsnams/ /rin chen rgyan dang dar gyi na bza' gsol/ /zhi drag gzugs dang nyams 'gyur ma nges ston//yum mchog klu yi bu mo yid 'ong ma/ /lha klu gnyan btsan 'khor tshogs rgya mtsho bcas/ /yid ltar mgyogs pas bsang gi mgron du byon//sha mar thud rtsam 'o zho ja chang sogs//bza' btung 'bru sna dar gos longs spyod dang / /'dab chags ri dwags gcan gzan nya sram dang / /rta nor ra lug la sogs spyan gzigs rigs/ /thang shug tsan dan a dkar su ru sogs//dri zhim shing lo sman spos dud pa'i srin/ /ting 'dzin sngags dang byin brlabs pa'i/ /dngos bshams yid sprul mchod rdzas sna tshogs pa//lha chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang phyir du gus pas 'bul lo bzhes shing tshim par mdzod/ /oṃ āḥ/ gis bdud rtsir byin brlabs pa'i//nas chang rgun chang rgya ja'i btung ba'i rigs//gser g.yu rin chen bye ma sbyar ba'i skyems//lha chen /khor bcas bde dgas tshim phyir rol//

sdig spong dge sgrub dam tshig nyams pa dang //khas blangs bsang gsur mchod gtor chag pa sogs//rmongs pa'i dbang gis dgongs 'gal ci bgyis pa//mi rtog chos dbyings klong nas dag par mdzod//sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas sogs//bla mas bka' bsgos dam bzhag ma bsnyel bar//bstan pa spyi dang bye brag dge 'dun sde//bod khams spyi dang sgos su yul phyogs 'di'i//mi nor longs spyod thams cad gnyer gtad pas//dus kun g.yel ba med par srung skyob mdzod//sa 'gul chu log me rlung dus 'khrug dang //sad ser btsa' than 'bu srin gnod pa dang / /mi dang phyugs kyi rims nad ngan pa sogs/ /sprin dag rlung gis gtor bzhin zhi bar mdzod//tshe bsod klung rta phyugs kyi 'phel kha sogs//rgyu nor longs spyod dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas//mi g.yang nor g.yang yul khyim bde skyid g.yang //dbang gi 'phrin las lcags kyus 'gugs par mdzod/ /mi dang mi min gnod byed dgra bgegs tshogs//mthu rtsal drag po'i las kyis tshar gcod mdzod/ /mdor na khyed la gsol mchod gser skyems btang //ched dmigs nyer gtad 'phrin las bcol ba yi//gang 'dod ladī kun sgrub cing nyin mtshan kun/ /skad cig 'bral med srung skyob nus ldan ma //sa/ pa 'di ni stobs tshang phun tshogs tshe ring gis rtsom skul zhus pa ltar/dpa' risapa dor zhi gdongadrug snyems blos spyi lo2009lo'i zla b.raba'i sangs rgyas sman bla'i nyin nub byang mi rigs slob grwa chen mo'i rang sha/ /rigs dga' tshal du bris/

bom sngon gyi bsang mchod bsdus pa/rmi //kye/ yulaphyogs 'dir gnas lha chen drag rtsal can/bom sngon gtso 'khor zhi ba'i tshul gyis sgeg/cho 'phrul ma nges dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs/gsolalo mchod do mchog thun dngos grub stsogaces rab dkar zla ba'i par ngor yon bdag dad gus can rnams kyis bsang dud dung skad dang bcas kyis mchod pa'i skabs/sngags 'ching bsod nams tshe ring gis snyan pa'i dbyangs dang bcasatephul pa dge'o gi sa ca chi shā ci ko 〉 mi sna kā 24sti3 ga cirā/snan ru/ mi sha pas //shā— ci ri ༷༷//// — — 3/rdobye sgo kyi 3

lnga ba/ stag lung zhwa dmar phyogs kyi gzhi bdag gi bsang bsngon/'bri gung dgon pa'i mchod gzhi dang bcas pa'i gsol kha/༄ //dge mtshan kun tshang bod yul mdo smad kyi//dbang phyogs yul lha'i gtso bo gzi brjid 'phags//gang de gnas pa'i rdza ri chen po'i sul//drag rgyal khra ras lab rtse la gnas pa'i//lha klu btsan sogs sde brgyad rigs gtogs pa'i//mi min 'byung bo ji snyed mchis pa kun//yid ltar myur ba'i shugs kyis 'dir byon la//dngos bshams yid sprul mchod gtor dam rdzas bzhes/ /'bar ba'i me la bsang rdzas sna tshogs pa//bsregs pa'i dud sprin mkha' lam khyab par dkrigs//ro brgya ldan pa'i gtor ma ri ltar spungs//dkar mngar ja chang gser skyems mtsho ltar bskyil//sna tshogs srog chags phyag mtshan gos dang rgyan//gser dngul rin chen sman dang 'bru sna sogs//mdor na mkho rgu'i longs spyod ci mchis pa//'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod du spel te 'bul//bdag cag ma rig 'khrul pa'i gzhan dbang gis//sa rko rdo slog shing bcad chu gnyan dkrugs//mi gtsang grib phog mar la gtad pa sogs//phog thug byung ba thams cad /zod par mdzod//phyogs 'dir mi nad

phyugs kyi god kha dang //lo nyes 'thab rtsod 'khrug long la sogs pa//mi 'dod kun zhi tshe bsod dpal 'byor sogs//legs tshogs dbyar gyi mtsho bzhin rgyas par mdzod//lus can nad kyi zug rngu drungs 'byin cing //'tsho ba'i srog gi bcud len gyur pa yi//bdud rtsi sman gyi chab rgyun bzang bo 'di'i//kun phan nus pa stobs su smin par mdzod//phan bde'i gzhir gyur bstan pa dar zhing rgyas//bstan 'dzin zhabs brtan dge 'dun chos spyod 'phel/ /bdag cag tshe ring nad med bde zhing skyid//sdod bcud dge mtshan rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//ces pa 'di yang sngags pa pad+ma dbang phyug gis bskul ngor/ sgo dharma badz+ra yis thar ba gling du sbyar ba'o//dge mtshan bcu ldan chos lung zhes grags pa'i/ /'brog ri la gnas gzhi bdag mthu rtsal can//rdo rje dpal ldan sman btsun lha mo bcas//spyan 'dren mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ /dngos bshams yid kyis sprul ba las byung ba'i/ /mchod gtor dam rdzas spyan gzigs sna tshogs kyis//sa dang bar snang nam mkha'i khams bkang ste//gzhi bdag chen po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /khyad par gser zhun 'khyil 'dra'i rab 'bar mer//sna tshogs shing sna dri bzang sman gyi tshogs//bsregs pa'i bsang mchod 'dod yon lnga ldan 'bul//mi gtsang nyes pa'i tshogs kun sangs gyur cig /phyogs 'dir 'khod pa'i dge 'dun 'dus pa'i sde//thugs mthun khrims gtsang bshad sgrub bya ba 'phel//sbyin bdag rnams kyi mi mthun nyer 'tshe zhi//mi phyugs longs spyod da/5 zhing rgyas par mdzod//sdod bcud

kun la bkra shis g.yang chags shing / /chos dang srid kyi legs tshogs dbyar sdurdo wa ṅgi dīkā/na/ gā dī gā dri sdu/ /da phan bde'i dga' ston la//ngoms med spyod ces pa 'di yang 'bri gung dgon pa mchod gzhi dang bcas pa spyi nas bskul ba bzhin/lartsam badz+ra yis dgon 'i nye 'dabasasgar thog tu sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//khro sna tsho ri snang ci nesaḥ kyi ༄byu //chalha gu ru badz+ra sgyu ra su ma ti girti si rgyu //

yul lha kun dga' nor 'dzin gyi gsol mchod/༄ //7shākya'i bstan pa srung la mthu rtsal dang ldan pa'i yul lha kun dga' nor 'dzin mchog/sku mdog dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs ldan pa/sku la yid 'ong khrab gsol dbu nyid la/yid 'ong rmog zhu gsol zhing yid 'ong ba'i/rta mchog dmar ser steng na rab ca'agyings/phyag g.yas mdung rnon dgra bo'i snying la bsnun phyag g.yon dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i bum pa 'dzin mthu rtsal ldan pa'i 'khor dang bcas rnams gdakar gsum mngar gsum la sogs gtor ma dang 'dzam gling gang ba'i bsang gi dud pas mchod/yid 'ong gser skyems ja chang 'o ma'i tshogs/dgyes bzhin bzhes nas bdag cag yon mchod kyi/tshe bsod dpal 'byor mi nor yon mchod rnams/yar ngo'i zla ltar rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/

lha mchog rma rgyal sbom ra'i gsol mchod/༄snyo / /rigs kun khyab bdag dpal ldan kun tu bzang / /rdo rje slob dpon gar mkhan pad+ma 'byung //ris med 'gro la phan bde'i byed po mchog/byang chub bar du snying gi pad mtshor rol//gang de'i bka' nyan srid gsum dregs pa'i gtso//lha gnyan chen po rma rgyal sbom ra la//dgyes byed gsol mchod 'phrin las rim pa dag /khungs ldan mkhas pa'i phyag bzhes bzhin du bri// de yang spyan gzigs rten dang mthun rdzas mchod gtor gser skyems rnams phyag lenaltar bshams/rang nyid ting 'dzinabla ma'i 'khor dam pa dpalachen po sogs yidamagang rung ging rgyal dang ldan pas mchodardzasarnams la dmigasate/oṃ badz+ra yasga skye/lan gsum gyis ma dag pa rnams sbyangs/oṃ swa bha wa shud+dha sarba rnyarmā su bha wa shusgolha haṃ/phyinang gsang ba'i mchod rdzas thams cad midamigs pa stong ba nyid du gyur/stong ba'i ngangalas sne zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod gtor rnams bdud ci'i rgya mtsho'i lha gnyan 'khorabacas kyi dbang bo rnams tshim par byed pa'i nusapa dang ldan pa/gyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas spyan gzigs rnams mdzes shing brjid ldan yid du 'ong ba sa gzhi bar snang gi khyonathams cad yongs su gang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ namamakha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya dang sngags drug phyag drug gis byin gyis brlabs la 'di skadado/bsgyu/ rtse mo rab dkar gangs ri brjid chags pa//shel dkar brtsegs pa'i kyi ཿ

lhun po'i rjes 'gro zhing //sked pa g.yu yi g.ya' chu bsil mas mdzes rtsa bar spang ljongs me tog sman shing tshal//lhung lhung sgra ldan chu bo grangs med 'bab//gangs phran sum brgya drug cus phyogs kun bskor//mthong bas yid la kun dga'i dpal ster ba'i//phyi bltas sa 'dzin dbang bo'i rnam pa la//nang du rin chen sna tshogs las grub pa'i//bang rim dgu dang ldan pa'i pho brang che//gser dang g.yu yi rgya phebs mkha' la bsnyegs//khor lug lcags ri nyis rim lcog dang bcas//kun kyang nor bu'i dra ba dra byed dang //dar zab las grub rgyal mtshan ba dan sogs//sna tshogs bkod pas mdzes pa'i ngo mtshar gyis//rnam par rgyal ba'i khang bzang dag la 'khu//khros pa'i dpa' bo g.yul ngor chas 'dra ba'i//lha srin dregs pa'i tshogs kyi dmag gi dpung //saba'i go dang rno ba'i mtshon thogs pa'i//yongs bskor laṅga'i bdag po'i byin sha 'dar//mdzes brjid rngams pa'i gzhal med khang bzang nas/ /dgra lha'i rgyal po lha gnyan kun gyi gtso//mthu stobs dbang phyug rma chen sbom ra khyed//thogs med rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs//bde ba'i nyams ster dgyes pa bskyed byed pa'i//gsang ba'i yum chen gong sman lha ri dang //dpa' ba'i sras dgu mdzangs ma'i sras mo dgu//thogs pa med par gnas 'dir da tshur byon//'dzum chen sdong khrom dbyi chen rab sde dang //'bri chen ldong dngul lha chen thang lha dang/phyogs bzhi'i gnyan chen sde bzhi 'khor bcas rnams//thogs pa med par gnas 'dir da tshung byon//sum brgya drug cu'i gangs kyi ri

phran nas//mda' mdung 'dzin pa'i dpa' bo'i tshogs rnams dang /'chi med bu mo khengs 'phrog lha sman sogs//ma lus 'khor bcas gnas 'dir da tshur byon//ki bsgyu che'o lha rgyal lo//bsgyu mdun du ting 'dzin gyis sprul gzhal med khang //gser gyi khri sogs sna tshogs gdan steng du//dgra lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas rab bzhugs la//mthun rdzas mchod pa 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol//ro brgya'i dpal dang ldan pa'i zhal zas dang //dri zhim ngad ldan bcung ba mtsho ltar 'khyil//sman spos shing sna'i dud pa sprin ltar gtibs//lha mchog 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul//rnga gshang dung gling rol mo 'brug ltar sgrog /bdud rtsi'i gtor ma ri rab lta bur spungs//gser gyi zhal skyems chu bo'i rgyun ltar zeng //lha mchog 'khor bcas mthun pa'i rdzas su 'bul//khrab rmog mdung thung ral gri dgra sta dang / /mda' dar stag gzig gung gsum bsags pa'i tshogs//cang shes rta dang 'brong g.yag zhol chen lug/lha mchog 'khor bcas dgyes pa'i rten du 'dzugs//za 'og ber chen nor bu shel phreng dang //bdud ci'i bum pa me long rgyal srid bdun//gling bzhi ri rab nyi ma blo ba zung //lha mchog 'khor bcas mchod pa'i rten du 'bul//sa gzhi bar snang yongs gang mchod pa 'di//sngar bcol bsgrub pa'i gtang rag ched du 'bul//da lta srung skyob mdzad pa'i bskul mar 'bul// slad nas 'phrin las bsgrub pa'i rten tu 'bul//dpal ldan lha mchog rma chen sbom ra khyed//rgyal ba kun dngos pad ma 'byung gnas dang //rlaX ston a mi byang chub 'dre bkol gyi//

spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas nyer dgongs la//bstan dang bstan 'dzin dge 'dun sde rnams srungs//nag po dgra dang bgegs kyi dpung tshogs choms//chen po bod kyi rgyal khams mdo smad kyi//mi nor phyugs gsum thams cad bu bzhin skyongs//khyad par bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi//nad gdon bar chad chag che nyam nga bzlog/tshe dpal bsod nams dpal 'byor longs spyod spel//bsam pa'i don kun kun gyis 'grub par mdzod//gi bsgyu che'o lha rgyal lo//bsgyu sku mdog rab dkar khro chags sgeg pa'i nyams//phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel bsnams//g.yon pa shel dkar phreng ba brgya rtsa 'dren//dngos grub char 'bebs khyed la bdag bstod do//dbu la rin chen sbog zhu mdzes par gsol//lhab lhub za 'og ber gyi na bza' can//zhabs gnyis gser gyi khri la 'gying zhing bzhugs/ /dpal ldan dgra lha'i dbang bo khyed la bstod//yid 'phrog sgeg mo mdzes pa'i chas kyis brgyan//g.yas pa 'chi med tshe yi bum pa dang //g.yon pa snang srid gsal ba'i me long 'dzin//gsang ba'i yum chen dgong sman lha rir bstod//lha yi sras dang sras mo bco brgyad dang //gnyan chen sde bzhi lha 'khor sman 'khor gyi//sum brgya drug cur bcas pa'i bka' sdod sogs//pho nya dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bstod//ki bsgyu che'o lha rgyal lo//bab rta mchog gro zhur gser gyi sga sprad pa//g.yu yi gong ched gser srab g.yu mthur bcas//nyi zla'i spu len rin chen rgyan bas par//zhon nas stong gsum myul sdus lha chen po//sku la gser khrab dbu la

bse rmog gsol//g.yas pa mdung ring g.yon pas zhags pa 'dzin//sked la gnam lcags thog mda'i stag dong dang / /mchog dkar sra ba'i gzhu ldan gzig thubs bcings//drag rtsal mthu ldan rma chen sbom ra la//gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//chibs su gser gyi sha ba yu mo bcibs/ / mdzes pa'i rgyan ldan g.yu yi lan tshar 'phyang / /tshe bum me long 'dzin pa'i dgong sman la//gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//stag shar dpa' bo'i chas ldan mtshon cha 'dzin//rlung gi shugs ldan rta mchog la bcibs pa//lha chen thugs kyi sras po mched dgu la//gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//g.yu bya khu byug dung bya khrung khrung bcibs//bum pa me long tshe 'gugs mda' dar bsnams/ /dgra lha'i sras mo lha sman mched dgu la//gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//'dzum chen ldong khrom mkha' lding khyung la bcibs/ /phyag na gnam lcags thog gi mda' gzhu bsnams//dbyi chen rab sde rgya stag ri bkra bcibs//phyag na stag gi lpags pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin//'bri chen ldong dngul gar shog 'brong la bcibs//phyag na gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ral gri 'dzin//gnyan chen thang lhas g.yu 'brug sngon mo bcibs//phyag na mdung ring dar gyi ba dan 'dzin//phyogs bzhi skyong ba'i gnyan chen sde bzhi la//gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//g.yas pas mda' 'dzin g.yon gyis mdung 'dzin cing //rta mchog la zhon sra ba'i go cha gyon//duX khra klad lding stag dmar rol du khrid//

'dab chags gcan gzan ri dwags rjes su 'brangs//rma rigs sum brgya drug cu tshogs rnams dang //sman mo yid 'ong sum brgya drug cu sogs//bka' nyan 'khor dang bcas pa'i tshogs rnams la//gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//lha mchog rma chen sbom ra 'khor bcas rnams//bsten pa'i tshe na lha gnyan rgyang ma ring //bos pa'i tshe na srung ma snyan ma sra//g.yab pa'i tshe na dam can spyan ma rdul//rbad pa'i tshe na dgra lha mthu ma chung //lus dang grib ma bzhin du khyed 'grogs la/ /nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe mdzod//yo srong 'gyel slong chad mthud brjed pa bskul//legs pa brgya sprod nyes pa stong dang bsnol/ /gzhi lam byes gsum kun tu mthun rkyen sgrubs/ /mi nor rigs rgyud zas nor longs spyod spel/ /'khor 'bangs chab srid mnga' thang rgyas par mdzod//mdor na bdag gi chos dang srid kyi don//phun tshogs sde bzhi'i yon tan ma lus pa/ /yar ngo'i zla ba bzhin du rab 'phel nas/ /bkra shis dpal gyis dus kun khyab gyur cig/ki ba che'o lha rgyal lo/zhes gtor mdang chang phud 'bul lo//bkra shis par gyur cig/

rma chen gyi gsol mchod/༄byu //oṃ grub pa'i dbang phyug pad+ma 'byung gnas dang //blo bzang rgyal ba'i dbang bos bka' bsgos shing //bstan pa skyong mdzad lha yi dge bsnyen che//'khor bcas thogs pa med par gshegs su gsol//sprin dkar g.yo 'dra'i rdzu 'phrul rta yi steng //dar mdud mda' gzhu zhags pa 'dzin mdzad cing //dkar gsal dpa' brjid mdzes pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis//'phrin las bsgrub phyir gnas 'dir brtan par bzhugs// kyi grub pa'i gnas mchog dge ldan ri sul du//grub pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun tsong kha pas//grub sde skyong ba'i slad du bka' bsgos shing //grub mchog kun gyi 'phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i//lha mi'i srung ma 'brog skyong chen po dang //lha srin sde brgyad thams cad gnas 'dir gshegs//lhar bcas 'gro ba'i dkar phyogs spel slad du//lha chen 'khor dang bcas pa brtan par bzhugs//phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i sprin 'khrigs shing //gser skyems bdud rtsi'i btung ba rgya mtshor 'khyil//sha khrag gtor ma ri rab ltar spungs te//brag btsan dgra lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas mchod//'bar ba'i me nang bsang rdzas stong phrag dang //dri zhim spos sna bsregs pa'i du ba'i sprin//dbang sngon chu 'dzin mkha' la bsnyegs 'dra bas//dge bsnyen gzhi bdag chen po 'khor bcas bsang / /phyi dang nyer spyod lha

rdzas 'dod yon dang //rin chen bdun dang bkra shis rdzas brgyad sogs//rta mchog la sogs rkang 'gro sna tshogs dang //dar zab 'phan gdugs phyi yi mchod pa 'di/ /gnas bdag chen po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /dgyes bzhin bzhes nas thugs dam bskang gyur cig /sde 'dir bshad sgrub rnam dkar mdzad pa rnams//skyong ba'i las la g.yel ba med par mdzod//nang gi mchod pa bdud ci'i gtor ma dang //gzhan yang sra brtan go cha mtshon rnon sogs//mthun pa'i rdzas kyis nam mkha' gang ba 'di//ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs shing / /gnas bdag chen po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /dgyes bzhin bzhes nas thugs dam bskang gyur cig /sde 'dir bshad sgrub rnam dkar mdzad pa rnams//skyong ba'i las la g.yel ba med par mdzod//rma chen sbom ra 'khor dang bcas pa'i ljags rgyu las skyes pa'i rdo rje rtse gcig pa dkar bo 'od kyi spu gri can gyis gtor ma'i bcud drangs te gsol par gyur// oṃ a ka ro/ lan lnga'am bdun gang rung gis gtoram 'bul/phyi nang gi mchod pas mchod/ rnam 'dren thams cad gzigs pa'i spyan snga ru/ /dang por thugs bskyed sa bcu'i mthar son yang / /'brog gnas tshul bzung rma chen sbom ra zhes/ /chos 'khor skyong mdzad srung ma khyed la bstod/ /dge ldan rnam par rgyal ba'i gling chen po/ /blo gsal mkhas mang nor bus yongs bkang zhing //bshad sgrub 'dod dgu'i longs spyod phun tshogs rnams//dar rgyas srid mtha'i bar du gnas par mdzod/ /lha ༷ bsam dag pa'i tshul gyis brtson pa

pa dbang phyug 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //mkha' la char sprin 'brug sgra char rgyun 'bebs//sa la ljon shing rtsi bcud lo 'dab rgyas//lhun sdug ri bo'i phreng ba tshar du dngar//nags tshal spang ljongs nyams dga' sna tshogs mdzes//rgyun bzang chu klung tshogs rnams phyogs kun 'bab//bkra shis dge mtshan rnam bcu rab rgyas pa'i//rang byung gnas kyi ngo mtshar du mas kyang //byams pa dbang phyug 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //rab yangs snod du 'bru sna'i zan gyi rigs//dkar gsum mngar gsum snying bo lnga phrag lnga/ /sbyar ba'i gtor ma zag med bdud rtsi ru//ting 'dzin sngags brgyas byin gyis brlabs pa dang //bza' bca' btung ba phye mar mngar gsum skyems//ja dkar chang rgod gser skyems la sogs pa//mchod gtor 'dod dgu'i rgya mtsho chen po 'dis/ /byams pa dbang phyug 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //lha klu mi yi mnol grib sel ba'i shing //sna tshogs bsang rdzas bsregs pa'i du ba'i sprin//bsreg gtor bkrus pa'i dri zhim mchod pa ni//'dod dgu'i dngos por kun nas 'char ba dang //gzhan yang dngos bshams yid sprul mchod rdzas kyis//klu gnyan byams pa dbang phyug thugs dam bskang //yul lha gzhi bdag 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //mthu ldan sde brgyad tshogs kyi thugs dam bskang //thugs dam bskangs pas bdag cag 'khor bcas la//'dod don 'phrin las ma lus bsgrub par mdzod// bshags pa ni/ bdag cag bya ba spyod pa mi mkhas pas//dkar dmar thab gzhob la sdogasdu nongs pa'i rigs/khyed rnams

thugs dang 'gal ba ci mchis kun//dmigs med ngang nas bshags kyis bzod par mdzod// ces bya'o//gtor ma la/oṃ badz+ra ma skṛ tas bsangs/su bha was — sbyangs/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las sne las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du cha'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i gtor ma dkar gsum mngar gsum zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen po gyur/ oṃ āḥrgyu/ lan gsumabarjod/ na maḥsarba ta tha ga ta a walo ke te oṃ sa bha ra bha ra hūṃ/lan bdun nam bco lnga/ nyer gcig sogs kyis bsngo/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ bdag gi bsam pa'i zhes pa nas 'byung gyur cig skyukhyi yul gyi lha klu 'byung bo khyed rnams la/zhes pa nas/legs tshogs ma lus lhun gyis grub par mdzod/ces brjod/bstod pa ni/ 7 rgyal kun mkhyen brtse'i mnga' bdag grub pa'i dbang //mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i sku phreng rim byon gyis//dpon slob sde bcas nyer gtad srung ma che/ /klu gnyan byams pa dbang phyug khyed la bstod//sku mdog dkar gsal lha yi cha byad can//rin chen rgyan 'chang dar tshon na bza' bklubs//rat+na'i snod dang shel dkar phreng ba 'dzin/ /mdzes sdug nyams kyis rol pa khyed la bstod/ /yid mthun gnas kyi 'byor ba phun sum tshogs//lha klu dkar phyogs skyong ba'i 'khor gyis bskor//sde brgyad dregs pa'i tshogs rnams bran du bkol//snang srid dregs pa mthu chen khyed la bstod//mngon shes rdzu 'phul mthu stobs thogs pa med//re zhing ltos tshe gang 'dod 'phrin laX sdiX //mchod cing bstod na khas blangs
