yul lha rma rgyal sbom ra'i bsang mchod/༄ //cham ri rab dkar gangs ri'i rtse mo nas/bral gsal 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i gur nang nas yul lha rma rgyal sbom ra lha chen bzhugs sras mchog dam can rma sde rol ba dgu/yum mchog rab mdzes sman btsan lha mo bcu/yang 'khor 'bum bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza/rnam dag mchod pa yid 'ong lha yi rdzas/bsang rdzas rin chen mkho dgu'i 'dod yon 'di/yul lha rma rgyal sbom ra 'khor bcas kyi/bzhes nas bsam pa'i don kun 'grub par mdzod

rma chen bsang bsdus/༄ //ḍūkhus phyogs 'di 'gran zla ma mchis pa'i/sa bcu'i dbang phyug rma chen 'khor dang bcas/sa phyogs 'di ru dad pas spyan 'dren no/sa chen 'od kyis 'geng bzhin gshegs su gsol/rin chen khri dang mdzes pa'i gdan la bzhugs/dngos bshams yid kyi sprul ba'i bsang mchod 'bul/bzhes nas byang chub sgrub pa'i grogs mdzod cig/ci 'dod longs spyod thams cad char ltar phob/sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas pa'i grogs mdzod cig/gnod byed dgra bgegs thal ba'i rdul du rlogs/rnal 'byor bcol ba'i 'phrin las 'grub par mdzod ces pa'ang skyabs mgon zhabs dkar bas sbyar ba'o//

dor zhi gnas bdag stobs ldan dbang phyug gi bsang mchod/༄ //rdo rje 'chang dbang lnga ba chen po yis//dga' ldan gnas lhag ces par lung bstan pa'i//dge ldan nor bu'i gling gi g.yon rgyab kyi/ /spang ri mthon po rtse mo mkha' la bsnyegs//der gnas dgra lha chen po mthu rtsal can//stobs ldan dbang phyug ces par mtshan gsol ba//sku mdog rab dkar lha yi cha byad can//rdzu 'phul thugs ldan rta mchog ngang dkar bcibs/ /lus la gos dkar gser gyi khrab rmog gyon/ /mda' dong ral gri srog len sked labatags/ /g.yas pa'i phyag gis mdung ring mkha' la 'phyar/ /g.yon pas dgos 'dod rin chen gzhong ba bsnams//rgyab car gzhu khams gsum zil gnon khur//'brong 'dzin shags ka 'dom dgu sked la bcings/ /lha bya pho rog nag po klad na lding / /rjes su stag gzig dom dred rol du khrid/ /yum mchog klu mo dung skyong 'brug la bcibs//mdzes sdug nyams chags ral gri nor gzhung thogs//lha klu gnyan btsan sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas/ /bsang dang mchod pa'i mgron du da tshur byon//lha thug tsan dan a dkar dri zhim shing //mkhan pa spos dkar la sogs dri bzang sman//zas sna 'bru sna dar gos bzang legs sogs/ /bsregs pa'i dud sprin sa dang bar snang gang //dkar gsum mngar gsum thud rtsam 'khur ba dang //'bras chang rgun chang rgya ja'i kyi

btung ba dang //'phyor mdzes gos rgyan khrab rmog 'khor gsum dang //mda' mdung ral gri la sogs mtshon cha dang //sgo phyugs gcan gzan la sogs spyan gzigs tshogs//dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul ba ji snyed pa//ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin rlabs can//zag med bde ba skyed phyir 'bul lags na//thugs dam skong zhing 'gal 'khrul ci byung ba/ /thams cad dmigs med dbyings su dag par mdzod//sngon tshe bstan dang de 'dzin dge 'dun sde//chos bzhin sgrub pa'i rgyal blon 'bangs 'khor bcas/ /srung zhing skyong ba'i dam bca' ma bsnyel bar//gang bcol las kun thogs pa med par sgrubs//nad yams 'khrug rtsod 'byung bzhi'i gnod pa sogs/ /na bud rlung gis bdas bzhin zhi bar mdzod//tshe bsod rgyu 'byor dbang thang rlung rta sogs//nag me rlung dang 'phrad bzhin rgyas par mdzod//bkra shis dge mtshan dpal dang g.yang gi tshogs//dbang bsgyur don yod zhags pas drangs par mdzod//gzugs can gzugs med dgra dang gnod pa'i bgegs//'thor rlung drag pos sprin bzhin bcom par mdzod//mdor na dkar phyogs skyong la rdo rje'i gur//nag phyogs 'joms la gnam lcags thog mda' dang //gang bcol re baX 'dod don 'grub pa la/ /dpag bsam shing dang yid bzhin nor bu mas//ra/ zhi gnas bdagabya rog can nam stobs ldanadabang phyug tu grags pa 'di'i gsolamachod rgyas pa zhigaspyi lo 1956lo/ sdudag gi bla ma bka' drin can/rgya tig rdo rje

'chang ngag dbang dkon mchog rgya mtsho mchog dor zhi dgon du phyag phebs skabs ljags rtsom gnang nas bdag gis yi ger btab pa zhig yod kyang dus 'gyur gyis stong dbyingasasu jim zhing dor zhir grags pa'i sa cha de sngon chad bstan pa'i gzugs brnyan tsam yod kyang mi lo lnga bcu'i ring 'dir gzugs brnyan tsam yang nyams nas med pas/gzhi bdaga'adi dag mchod mkhan phar zhog lab tse sogs kyang shul med du song bas gzhi bdag gi —ming tsam yang shes pa'i mi med pas/ gsol mchod kyi dpe cha mi mkho yang / dam pa gong ma'i ring nas dor zhi dgon gnas kyi gnas bdag tu bsten pa zhig yin pas nang chen du lo zla'i dus mchod sogs kyi skabs su dam pa gong ma'i gnas bdag 'di dag kyang ma brjed par bsang dang gtor ma re btang ba'i khrel yod byas na snyam pas re bas/snyi lo —— 2009lo'i zla b.rabar lan kro'u grongakhyer du dor zhi gdong snyems pas bris/

drug pa/ hor nags yangs kyi gzhi bdag gi bsang bsngon/rgya yag dgon dge tshogs gling gi gzhi bdag gsol kha/༄byu //na mo gu ru bh+yaḥskyabs sems sngon du btang / yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas mchod gtor bsang rnamasasngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlabs la bden stobs brjod/ bkra shis dge mtshan phun sum tshogs pa'i gling //rnam grol don gnyer 'du ba'i chos kyi sde'i//gnas gzhir dbang ba'i lha klu gzhi bdag kun//thogs med rdzu 'phrul thugs kyis gshegs su gsol//ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa'i//chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo 'dod yon lnga//bkra shis rtags brgyad rgyal srid rin chen bdun//bza' bca' btung ba'i bye brag sna tshogs dang //rgyan gos gnas mal phyag mtshan bzhon pa'i tshogs//rin chen dar gos 'bru sna sman gyi rigs//mi gtsang nyes kun sel ba'i bsang mchod rnams//'bul lo dgyes pa'i thugs kyis bzhes su gsol//sde 'dir mtha' dbus phyogs mtshams thams cad nas//blo gsal khrims ldan ngur smrig 'dzin rnams dang //dad ldan skye bo dpal 'byor longs spyod bcas//dbyar 363

gyi char sprin bzhin du 'du bar mdzod//bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i zhabs brtan mdzad 'phrin rgyas//dge 'dun sde rnams thugs mthun nang khrims gtsang //mdo sngags bshad sgrub bya ba rab 'phel nas//thub bstan dar rgyas yun ring /jin /snro/ /// /ste/ /khye/ /jordo /ji//khye/gnas par ma da// na bdag rnams sa mthun ra 'a kun// nga tshe bsod rigs rgyud longs spyod rgyas//snod bcud kun la bkra shis g.yang chags pas//bde skyid dpal la rol pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ces rgya yag dgon gsar dge tshogs gling gi gzhi bdag gi gsol kha 'di ni dka'abacu bstan 'dzin dar rgyas sogs mang bos bskul ngor/bu'u bkwan chos kyi nyi mas brisapa'o/

dpa' stag la gsol mchod 'bul tshul lha chen dgyes pa'i mchod sprin rdzogs ldan gsar ba 'gugs pa'i kyo ba/༄rgya/ /dmigs med rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes ni/ /bde chen stong ba'i sgyu ma'i rol gar las/ /gtum drag khro bo'i dbang bo'i skur bzhengs pa/ /bla ma gshin rje gshed kyis dge legs stsol//rnam dag blo gros chu 'dzin las spros pa'i//gsol mchod char sim lha chen mtshor babs pa//'phrin las rnam bzhi'i rlabs phreng 'phel ba la//gang snang dga' ba rgyas phyir 'di na 'god//de yang hor lho ba'i spyi lha thugs khya'i smad kyi yul skyong dpa' stag tu grags pa'i lha gnyan chen por gsol mchod 'bul tshul ni/gtor ma mthong rgyud phyag len ltar la/bye mar zas sna gtsang ma gang 'byor/ja chang zho'o ma sogs btung ba'i rigs gang 'dzoms/chu gnyis nyer spyod 'dod yon lnga/ gzhan yang gos dar sman spos shing sna sogs bsang mas gang 'dzoms mang che sbyar ba'i bsang btang / phyag mtshan gokhrab gcan gzan sros chags spyan gzigs gang dgos rnams dngos samari mor bris pa'am/ma 'byor na yid kyis sprul te/rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje'ajigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyis gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yum dang bcasapa'i skur bzhengs par gyur ces brjod de skad cig dkrung bskyed byed pa'am/yang nayi dam gangayang rung ba'i mngon rtogs rgyas pa btang kyang legs/ rgyuḥrang bzhin bde stong dbyer med ye ༷༷ nyid/ /rnam pa mchod rdzas 'dod

dgu'i rgya mtsho che//byed las mgron rnams ma lus tshim byed cing / /mchod tshogs nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin gyur phyag rgya bcas nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags lan gsum dang ma ma lha'irgyu nas shasta'i bar dang ru ba nas spar+sha/ tshelwasgyu wa/zhes pa nas/ mtho sa ni spra hā zhes sngags drug phyag rgyadrug gi byin gyis brlabs/bdag gi bsam pa'i zhes pa nas 'byung gyur cig ces bden stobs brjod pa dang bcas sogs rjes su 'di ltar rol mo dbyangs dang bcas/cha dge mtshan dpal gyi mngon mtho yul gyi ljongs//dad gtong 'byor ldan grangs med 'dus pa'i gnas//stobs 'byor mnga' thang dga' ston rab 'khyil ba//snyan grags phyogs brgyar g.yo ba'i lha sde yi//rgyab ri ma la ya 'dra'i sa 'dzin la//rab brtan yid 'phrog rin chen pho brang cher//rnam mang 'byor bas legs par gtams pa'i dbus//yul skyong dpa' stag 'khor bcas bzhugs par gyur/ /kyiḥ bde chen kun gsal dbyings su rtag rol kyang //sna tshogs gzugs sku'i sgyu 'phrul 'od zer gyis/ /dngos grub 'dab stong dga' tshal rgyas mdzad pa/ /lha gnyan chen po 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs//gzhan yang gang thugs dgyes bskyed yum sras dang //sprul ba yang sprul stag shar dpa' bo'i tshogs//dbyar gyi char sprin stug po g.yo ba bzhin//dga' ba'i gar dang bcas te gshegs su gsol/ /rang gi mdun du dmar me rlung dkyil dbus/ /gangs ri'i dum bu chad 'dra'i rdzu 'phul rtar//nyer spyod grangs ldan rin chen sga cha dang //dbang bo'i gzhu ltar bkra ba'i rgyan cha'i stengaX/khengs dregs nyams kyis 'gying ba'i

dgra lha ni//shel dkar mdangs 'dzin dngul gyi khrab sog gsol//phyag g.yas mdung dang g.yon pa'i nor gzhong 'dzin//g.yas su gnam lcags mda' mang stag dong dang / /g.yon du mchog dkar gzhu ldan gzig thubs 'chang / /zhabs gnyis sag lham gsol zhing dgyes bzhin bzhugs//rnam mang sprul ba gsang yum sman mo dang //rnam mang phyag gnyan lha 'khor sman 'khor tshogs//rnam mang klu bdud btsan gyi dmag dpung bcas//rnam mang cho 'phul dang bcas bzhugs par gyur// de nas gsol mchod sogs rim par 'bul ba ni/ rgyu/bde stong zung 'jug rnam rol las byung ba'i//mchod rdzas spyan gzigs sna tshogs 'bul ba ni//dwangs bsil mchod yon dbyibs legs me tog bzhad//dri zhim dud sprin mun sel mar me'i phreng //bde ster dri chab ro brgya'i zhal zas spungs//gdangs snyan rol mo tshim byed 'dod yon lnga//bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad dang rin chen bdun//rno ngar mdung ring yid bzhin nor bu'i gzhong //'od 'bar khrab rmog sna tshogs rgyan cha dang //srab 'jam 'jol ber 'bob zhu sag lham dang //rta nor ra lug ma lha ba glang khyu/ /'phyo dgu 'phur dgu 'dzul dgu'i srog chags rigs//rnam mang bza' bca' ja chang btung ba sogs//dngos bshams yid sprul dam rdzas spyan gzigs 'dis//lha chen 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang gyur nas//nyams chag ma lus byang zhing dag gyur cig /ma rig dbang gis bya spyod 'dor len nor//ma lus mkhyen pa'i khyed thugs 'gal bgyis rnams/ /sdu /lus 'gyod pa'i sems kyis bdag

zhi'i dpal 'byor snying bo ma lus pa//'bul lo bzhes nas dgyes pas thugs dam bskang //rin chen ri rab gling bzhi rol mtsho bdun//dgos 'dod kun 'byung dpag bsam sngon pa'i shing //'dod 'jo'i ba dang gter bum ma rmos 'bru//phyi dang dkor mdzod gsang ba'i rten rdzas sogs//dngos bshams yid sprul mchod pa sna tshogs 'dis//srid zhi'i mgron dang dkar phyogs skyong ba yi//drang srong 'khor bcas thugs dam bskangs gyur nas//nyams chag sel zhing 'dod don lhun grub mdzod//gtor ma phul te 'phrin las bcol ba ni 'di ltar/6rin chen gzi 'od 'bar ba'i snod mchog tsa/sman lnga 'bru lnga snying bo lnga la sogs//nas dkar gtsang ma'i zan dang sbyar ba yi//ro brgya ldan pa'ibadud rtsi'i gtor ma'i tshogs//chos kyi dbyings dang mchog gsum bden pa'i mthu//ting 'dzin gzungs dang rig sngags mos pa'i stobs//phyi dang rten 'byung tshogs pa'i chos nyid kyis//'dod dgu nam mkha' mdzod du 'char ba 'di//rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam mchog gsum dang //mkha' 'gro chos skyong rgya mtsho'i tshogs la 'bul//srid zhi'i 'jigs skyob mchog thun dngos grub stsol//sa lam grogs mdzod las bzhi'i 'phrin las sgrubs//rten gnas lha klu gzhi bdag tshogs la 'bul//bya bar ko long ma sdom gnas po mdzod//khyad par drang srong kurma bzang skyong che//bka' blon sha sgrol btsun stong sde 'khor la//lhun po brtsegs pa'i dbyibs ldan rgyan mdzes sogs//gtor tshogs 'di dag 'bul lo legs bzhes nas//mtsho skyes rdo bsdo /sha chen kurma pa//spyan ras gzigs

dbang dkon mchog yar 'phel gyis//rdo rje'i gtsug gtad bdud ci lce la bzhag /snying la bran pa'i tha tshig dran dgongs la//phyogs 'dir chos srid legs tshogs 'dod don kun//'bad med lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//yul 'di bde skyid 'dod don 'grub pa'i gzhi//gzhi dang rtsa ba rnam dkar dge ba'i las//las mthun bsam sbyor chos dang mthun pa'i dpal/ /dpal 'byor mnga' thang dar ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//yul 'di'i bde skyid gang la rag las pa//mi shigs rdo rje khams su rtag brtan cing //'phrin las grags pa kun phan gzegs ma yis//lcags ri dkar bo'i khyon kun 'gongs par mdzod//ma bu grogs kyi 'byung khams 'phrod pa yis//smra brjod bden tshig bsam pa mkhas pa'i blo/ /bya ba gegs med 'dod don kun sgrub la/ /dbang thang rlung rta dgung ltar yangs par mdzod//khyad par nad rims dgra jag chom kun dang //gcan gzan gnod 'tshe thog ser btsan than sogs/ /phyi nang rkyen ngan bar chad chu 'dzin sogs//'phrin las kun khyab dbyings su zhi bar mdzod/ /mi phyugs longs spyod chos srid 'dod don kun//bsam pa tsam gyis don la mi bslu ba'i//yid bzhin nor dang bum bzang 'dod 'jo ltar/ /legs tshogs mtsho ltar rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//bye brag bkra shis dge mtshan 'khyil ba'i mtsho/ /don mthun bshes gnyen nor bu'i yongs su gang //'chad nyan rlabs phreng mkha' la g.yo ba la//gtong ba'i spu char dbab pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//yul 'di/ /9 /la bsam ngan sbyor tsub las//byung

khyad par chos kyi rgyal bo tsong kha pa'i//ring lugs srid mtha'i bar du rgyas par mdzod//'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par bsil ljongs su//nad rims lo nyes mu ge 'thab rtsod dang / /mtha' dmag mtha' 'dre'i gnod pa rab zhi nas//rdzogs ldan dga' ston mgron du bsu bar mdzod//yang sgos bdag cag rgyu sbyor 'khor bcas la//gnod cing 'tsho ba'i nad gdon kha smras dang //'thab rtsod god kha mtshang ngan byur chags sogs//mi mthun rkyen ngan thams cad zhi bar mdzod//tshe bsod stobs 'byor snyan grags nor phyug rgyas//srid zhi'i dpal 'byor ma lus 'du ba dang //bsam ngan sbyor rtsub 'chang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams//gang 'tsham drag po'i chad pas tshar chod cig /lha khyed gdugs bzhin bkur ro gdung ba skyobs// rgyal mtshan bzhin du 'phyar ro gzi byin bskyed//lha yi rnga bzhin bskul lo snyan pa sgrogs//yid bzhin rnor ltar bsten no dgos 'dod stsol//bdag cag gzhi byes gang du lha khyed dang //lus dang grib ma bzhin du nyer 'grogs te//nyin gyi bya ra mtshan gyi mel tshe dang //phar 'gro'i skyel ma tshur 'ong bsu ba mdzod//yo srong 'gyel slong chad mthud brjed la bskul/ /nyes tshogs dang bsnol legs pa kun dang spyod//bsod nams mtsho bskyil snyan pa'i dar dkar phyor//grags pa'i dung bus bde skyid gtam bzang sgrogs/khyed kyi 'phrin las lam gsum babs pa'i rgyun//rnal 'byor rgyu sbyor 'dod don zhing sa ru//legs drangs phan bde'i lo 'bras dga' ston la//'gro kun ci daXr spyod pa'i 'phrin las mdzod//ces

'phrin las bcol/ yig brgya bzlas la/ bzod gsol bya rten yod na brtan bzhugs/med na gshegs gsol bya'o//zhes dad gtong 'byor bas phyug pa'i lha sne hor lho ba'i spyi lha dpa' stag tu grags pa'i lha gnyan chen por gsol mchod 'bul tshul lha chen dgyes pa'i mchod srin rdzogs ldan gsar ba 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ tshad ldan mkhas pa'i sngon gyi yig cha med pa dang / sgrub pa'i brtul zhugasa'adzinapa mdo ba'i khri sman tshang nas yig 'dzinayod kyang khong gis rig gnas ma sbyangasapa'i grub chen gyi gsung yig zhu dag dgos gsungs par brten/ sngags 'chang bsam grub tshe ring nas 'di ltar du dgos zhes bskul ma mdzad pa'i ngo ma bzlog par/ khyab bdag 'khor lo'i mgon po byams pa thub bstan rgya mtsho dpal bzang bo'i zhabasardulaspyi bos yun ring bsten cing gsung gi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i snyoms las pa kirti rnyarma sra nyis 'bru mang bo'am thi yin zhes pa sa pho stag gi lo rgyal bla'i dkar phyogs dga' ba dang bor don ldan chos 'phel gling gi tham ka bla brang sde bzhi'i dpal 'khyil nas bris pa dge legs 'phel//

dpa' stag bsang mchod bsam dgu lhun grub ma/༄7 //raṃ ye ṇa ā:rdu lan gsum/ gi rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam zhi khros lha/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs/ /mkha' la char ltar 'bab pa bzhin du byon// rang rang 'os pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol//dngos bshams yid kyis sprul ba'i gtor ma dang //ja phud chang phud gser skyems la sogs pa//raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gyis zag med byin brlabs nas//mchod do bsngos so mnyes shing tshim par mdzod//mdor na rgyal ba'i bstan dang bstan 'dzin la/ /gnod cing 'tshe ba'i dgra bgegs ci mchis pa//rdul du brlag pa'i 'phrin las gnyan po mdzod//kyiḥ rin chen sa 'dzin lhun po'i pho brang nas//chu 'dzin g.yo 'dra'i rta dkar 'gying ba'i stengan/rin chen lnga las grub pa'i sga srab kyis/ /brgyan pa'i steng na lha dbang dpa' stag ni/ /sku mdog dkar la dmar bo'i mdangs chags pa//gar dgu'i nyams ldan dngul gyi khrab rmog gyon//nor bu'i rgyan spros dar sna'i gri mdung btsugs//g.yas pa'i mdung dar dkar bo mkha' la phyar/ /g.yon pa'i nor gzhong gser gyi srab mda' 'dzin//'khor gsum sked 'chang dgra lha'i chos ldan pa//zhal nas ha ha dregs pa'i skad sgra can//snang zhing srid pa'i lha 'dre g.yo zhing 'dar//dbang med bran du 'khol ba'i mthu ldan che//yab yum sras dang blon po 'bangs bcas rnams//thogs med rdzu 'phul thugs kyis gnas 'dir gshegs//zag med bde gter yid 'phrog mchod pa'i rdzas//bza' sdu/'a btung ba ja chang gtor ma'i

tshogs//ri ltar spungs la mtsho bzhin 'khyil ba 'di//rig 'dzin sngags kyi byin gyis brlabs pa dang //myur mgyogs rta mchog shwa rkyang ri dwags tshogs//nor bu khra can khrab rmog za 'og ber//dgra 'jom mtshon chas zhi drag mtha' yas rnams//dgra lha'i rgyal po dpa' stag mnyes phyir 'bul//dgyes bzhin bzhes nas bla ma'i bka' bzhin du//bstan dang 'gro ba'i phan bde tshul bzhin spel//sngags 'chang bdag gis tshe bsod dpal 'byor dang //kha rje dbang thang snyan grags rlung rta bskyed//pha rol bsam ngan sbyor rtsub kha smras dang //'thab rtsod 'khrug long mi 'dod rkyen ngan bzlog/bdag cag gzhi byes gang du 'gro sdod dang //las dang bya ba gang byas bsam bzhin sgrubs//khyad par rgya dang hor gyi yul spu 'di'i//dregs ldan rgyal blon thams cad dbang du bsdus//zas nor dpal 'byor thams cad g.yang du khug /ci bsam ci 'dod thams cad yid bzhin sgrubs// mdor na chos ldan bya ba gang byas kyang //lha khyed yid la dran nas bskul byung na///bas su babs sdu'i 'gal rkyen kun zhi zhing //'dod pa'i // /// nānasta rdo pa shāX sna /cho/ ༷༷/ma dgu kun grub ma 'di 'dra zhig hor lho ba'i bsam 'grub tshe ringanas bkra shis lha rdzas bcas dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/mdo trī dzā tram̐ // hā/dro sdu/ zlozlo /zlo la li ta'i ming can gyis lang jus mkhar du bka' 'gyur

shug bkra'i yul lha rnams mnyes par byed pa'i bsang mchod mu tig phreng ba/༄༄ / /na mo ma ki la ṭa sgo ṣi ya/ /'jam mgon rgyal ba'i mkhyen brtse'i shel rdul spo//'jam dkar thor cog khro chen gshin rje'i gshed//'jam dbyangs bla ma'i zhabs sen rkang drug pa//'jam mnyen snying gi pad+mo rtag rol mdzod/ /khungs ldan nya lcibs khog pa nas bton pa'i//dam ldan yul lha dgyes bskyed mu tig phreng //brgyad ldan dam pa'i dar la legs brgyus pa'i//dad ldan rnam sad gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan spel// del yul lha rnams mnyes par byed pa'i bsang mchod 'bul bar 'dodapa'i gang zag gis/bsang ngas gtsang ma mchod gtor sogs mthong brgyud ltar kya rnam du byas nas/sla chos su ma song bar bshams nas/de nas skyabs sems sngon du song la/yi dam gang rung sngon du sgoms la/ma sbo tis bsangs/subha was sbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du zhes pa nas las byung ba'i bla ma yi dam chos skyong srung ma yul lha gzhi bdag dam can rgya mtsho mnyes par byed pa'i bsang rdzas mchod gtor bsam gyis mi khyab pa kun tu bzang bo'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung bo rgya mtsho bkod pa rab 'byams shing kun khyab par gyur cig sarba bid nas khaṃ/ oṃ su bha wa nas 'byung gyur cig de ltar ni/ dis brlabs la/mgron spyan 'dren ni/rdu/

bde stong dbyer med lha lam yangs pa nas//bla ma yi dam mchog gsum chos srung dang //gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro dam can tshogs//sa gsum dkar phyogs skyong ba'i 'byung bo rnams/ /sgo gsum gus pas spyan 'dren gnas 'dir gshegs//khyad par bshad sgrub sde 'di'i mdun gyi ri//rin chen dpal 'bar la gnas dge bsnyen ni//mi g.yo rdo rje sku mdog dmar nag la//nyid byed 'bum gyis 'khyud 'dra'i gzi brjid can//dar dkar ba dan gyis mdzes lcags kyu g.yas//dar dmar 'phur lding rol pa'i sna thag g.yon//dar sngon sha 'gag dmar smug ral gu can//gser g.yu mu tig rgyan gyis rnam par mdzes/'brong g.yag kham pa ru ring rgyan ldan bcibs//ri bo dpal 'bar lha ri dpal 'dzin dang //brag dkar rta phur bkra shis mthong smon dang //g.yon ri dge legs dpal mtho'i gnas kyi bdag/sha yu 'phar sbyang zhon ldan blon po sogs//shug bkra'i yul lha gzhi bdag ma lus pa//thogs med 'dir byon mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs//mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ skye dag byed chu bzhi lha chab dal gyis 'bab//chu skyes thang skyes me tog sna tshogs bkra//dri bzang sman spos bsang dud lha lam khyab//rtsi bcud 'bru mar sgron me mun pa sel//bsang zhim byugs pa'i dri yis stong gsum 'gengs//ro brgya lha mi'i bza' bca' lhun po'i spungs//sna tshogs rol mo'i bye brag mchod pa 'bul//dkar gsum mngar gsum gtor ma rgyan can 'di//rnam pa phun tshogs 'dod yon lnga ldan zhing //ngo bo zag med bdud rtsi'i rgya maX ni//bla ma mchog gsum yi dam bstan

srung dang //yul lha gnas kyi bdag pos dgyes par rol/ bye brag tu mchod pa 'bul ba ni/rgyu/ kun tu bzang bo'i mchod sprin la 'gran pa'i//kun nas gus pas lha bsang rgya mtsho 'di//kun nas brtse ldan srid zhi'i mgron rnams la//kun dga' bde chen stong ba'i srid zhu bgyi/cha gser mdog yal 'dab ldan pa'i stag pas bsang / /g.yu mdog yal 'dab ldan pa'i shug pas bsang //dung mdog yal 'dab ldan pa'i mkhan pas bsang //mchong mdog yal 'dab ldan pa'i ba lus bsang //tsan dan dza ti ga bur a ka ru//dri zhim sna tshogs bzang drug sman sna stong //thang skyes chu skyes me tog sna tshogs dang //bdud rtsi'i rgyan gyis ljon pa'i shing gis bsang //dkar gsum mngar gsum zas phud 'bru sna'i rigs//gos dar za 'og gser dngul nor bu'i tshogs//dngos bshams yid sprul sngags rgyas byin brlabs nas//rang rang 'chad dgu'i dngos por gyur pas bsang /kyiḥ bka' drin gsum ldan rtsa rgyud bla ma bsang / /skyabs gsum kun 'dus yi dam lha tshogs bsang / /gnas gsum dpa' bo mkha' 'gro ma lus bsangan/mchog gsum bstan pa'i srung ma thams cad bsang // 6 yul phyogs 'di rnams skyong ba'i gzhi bdag bsangan/mdun ri rin chen dpal 'bar gzhi bdag bsang //rdza dmar lha ri dpal 'dzin gzhi bdag bsang //rta gul bkra shis mthong smon gzhi bdag bsang //g.yon ri dge legs spo mtho'i gzhi bdag bsang //dben gnas ri bo dpal 'bar gzhi bdag bsang / /bkra shi /sa lung yul lha gzhi bdag bsang //

gangs dkar chos lung yul lha gzhi bdag bsangan/nor bu dbang 'phel nor bu dpal 'bar dang /phyug mtsho sngon mo g.yu mtsho me long ma//shug bkra g.yur ldem shug chu gaṅgār 'gran/ /g.ya' chu brag chu'i klu gnyan sa bdag bsang / /nyid srib ri dang dgas tshal lding ka dang //lam chen bzhi mdo chu klung ljon pa'i shing //rang byung bcos ma'i me dang rlung la sogs//so sor dbang ba'i phyogs 'di'i gzhi bdag bsang /gzhan bsang gsolasogs bya/bstod pa ni/ rgyuḥrin chen dpal 'bar lhun po'i ba gam la//rin chen las grub gzhal yas khang gi dbus//rin chen rgyan ldan lha g.yag kham zhol stengan/rin chen rgyan ldan mi g.yo rdo rjer bstod//zhal gcig phyag gnyis pad+ma ra ga'i mdog/sgeg 'dzum nyams ldan za 'og na bza' can//g.yas pa'i rdo rje lcags kyus khams gsum 'gugs//g.yon pa'i btsan zhags dgra sde 'ching la bstod//dge legs spo mtho la gnas dge bsnyen ni//dbang sngon mdog can phyag gnyis phur bu bsnams//lha rdzas dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis mdzes//sha ba dkar bo zhon ldan khyed la sprul//ri bo dpal 'bar la gnas gzhi bdag che//g.yas kyi sbrul zhags dam nyams dgra la 'debs//g.yon gyi spu gyis dgra bgegs srog rtsa gcod//sku mdog dmar bo 'phar ba bcibs der bstod//lha ri dpal 'dzin la gnas dge bsnyen ni/ /sku mdog dkar ser phyag g.yas rtse gsum phyar/ /g.yon pa rin chen bum pas dgos 'dod stsol//spyang sngon steng na 'gying ba khyed la 'dud//bkra shis mthong smon // bdag sku mdog dkar//g.yas pas

nor dbyug g.yon pas nor gzhong 'dzin//lha rdzas dar dang rin chen rgyan gyis spras//yu mo zhon pa can khyed bstod par bgyis//srid zhi'i mgron rnams mchod cing bstod pas mthus/ /srid pa'i mtsho las sgrol ba'i mgon skyabs dang //srid dang zhi ba'i dbyings su ma gzim par//srid zhi'i legs tshogs 'phel ba'i 'phrin las mdzod nyams grib bshags pa ni//ཿmi shis rmongs blos dam sdom nyams pa dang //ma tshangs rdzas sbags thab gzhob dme bshan grib//me btang sa brkos shing bcad log spyod rnams//mu med mkhyen spyan ldan pa'i tshogs la bshags/ 'phrin las bcol ba ni/rgyuḥ bla ma mchog gsum yul lha gzhi bdag gis//bdag sogs mi nor chos srid dkar cha'i zla//dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel nad rims gdon 'gal rkyen//nyes tshogs kun gzhil snang dgra'i dpung tshogs choms/ phywa g.yang 'gugs pa ni/cha rwa rkyang 'phel g.yang thunes ldan rta mdzo'i g.yang //rgya stag rtsal g.yang 'brug sgra snyan pa'i g.yang //g.yang dkar lug g.yang 'dod 'jo ba yi g.yang //mtshon cha rno g.yang go cha btsan pa'i g.yang //ro brgya'i zas g.yang 'jam mnyen gos kyi g.yang //bde skyid dpal g.yang rigs rgyud bu tsha'i g.yang //srid dang zhi ba'i phywa g.yang ma lus pa//dga' ba'i gar dang bcas te gnas 'dir stsol/rgyu blo rmongs dbang —gis mchod rdzas ma tshang sbags//glo bur 'gal 'khrul nongs tshogs ci bgyis rnams/ /blo gros mchog ldan spyan sngar mthol zhing bshags//blo mchog tshangs pa'i dngos grub ma lus stsol//gshegs sdugasolab ni/ skyeḥ dga' ba'i 'dzum

ston srid zhi'i mgron rnams kyis//dga' mgur rol pa'i rang gnas chos dbyings su/ /dga' skyed mthun pa'i bsang mchod bzhes nas slar/ /dga' mgur rol pa'i rang gnas chos dbyings su//dga' ba'i gar gyis bzhud la mgon skyabs mdzod/rgyu/mi g.yel thugs rje'i bskul ba'i khyung sngon skyes//mi shes mun pa'i mal nas rab bslangs ste//mi dman dge bcu'i nyi ma khams gsum gyis//mi mthun smag rum sel ba'i bkra gis shog/sa bdag dge bsnyen dgyes pa'i dpal yon gyis//sa 'dir nad 'khrug mu ge zhi ba dang //sa la lo tog 'bru drug smin pa sogs//sa steng phan bdes khyab pa'i bkra shis shog /ces shug bkra'i yul lha gzhi bdag rnams la mnyes par byed pa'i bsang mchod mu tig phreng ba gzhon nu'i mgul rgyan 'di ni/ dge skuladaka' bcu 'dzin pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis nan tan tu bskul ba'i ngo ma bzlog par/mkhas grub mang bos mdzad pa'i bsang yig la gzhi byas nas/sku mdog phyag mtshan dogs gcod dgos pa nas/ chos skyong chen po'i mig mthong bstsal ba'i lus khog la gzigs snang ltar/spar chos skyong las brtag zhu gul te/ rtsom par bka'i gnang ba thob 'phral gro rgyal ba'i sras po'am blon po'i rang lugs 'dzinapa shākya'i dgeslong ngag gi dbang jig shes rab bzang bo dbyangs can rol // / / 'jam dpal dgyes pa'isras/ sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni dge tshul shes rab bstan

chu rul kha lung ba'i gzhi bdag gnyan chen sde bzhi la bsang mchod 'bul tshul/༄ //dngos grub kun 'byung bla ma dang //dbyer med badz+ra lha ra war//btud nas gnyan chen sde bzhi yi//mnyes byed bsang mchod khyer bde spel/ /hriḥṣ+ṭiḥs bsang / swā bhā was spyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las bsang rdzas rnams rang rang gi ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bla ma yi dam gnyan chen sde bzhi 'khor dang bcas pa rnams mnyes par byed pa'i dam rdzas spyan gzigs zhes pa nas/ 'byor zhing rgyas par gyur cig nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya lan gsum dang nyer spyod 'dod yon sngasngags drug phyag rgya drug bden pa'i stobs sogs brjod gzhi kun bzang bde stong sgyu ma'i rnam rol las//byung ba'i bla ma yi dam rgyal sras dang //nyan rang dpa' bo mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs/ /'dir gshegs bsang gi mchod pa'i mgron du byon/ /swo/ngo mtshar 'ja' 'od 'khrigs pa'i gur khang nas//gnyan chen sde bzhi yum sras dregs pa'i tshogs//mthu ldan dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha klu rnams//ma lus thogs med gshegs shing brtan par bzhugs// swo/ dri ldan shing gi snying bo kun bsdus shing //bzang drug sman gyi nus pas bcud du spel//'dzad med nam mkha' mdzod du byin rlabs 'di//༷༷ byed rgyal po'i ye shes mer bsregs

pas/ /zag med ye shes bdud rtsi'i bsang mchod 'dis/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam lha tshogs bsang //rgyal sras rig 'dzin dpa' po mkha' 'gro bsang / /dam can phyogs skyong zhing skyong ma lus bsang //khyad par 'dzum chen ldom khrom 'khor bcas bsang / /dbyi chen rab sde dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs bsang / /'bri chen ldong dngul mthu ldan 'khor bcas bsang /gnyan chen thang lha las byed 'khor bcas bsangan /lha btsun sman mo bka' yi rtags 'chang ba'i/ /dregs ldan srid pa'i dmag tshogs ma lus bsang // srid gsum 'byung bo sde brgyad ma lus bsang //kun gyis bsang mchod dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /rnal 'byor 'dod pa'i don rnams yid bzhin sgrubs/ gser skyems 'bul bar sgro na 'bru gsumalan gsumagyis byinagyis rlobs/rgyu/ dngos grub char 'bebs drin can bla ma dang //yi dam dpa' bo mkha' 'gro nor lha dang //mthu ldan dam can srung ma'i tshogs rnams la//'bul lo 'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod//khyad par 'dzum chen ldom khrom 'khor bcas dang //dbyi chen rab sde 'bri chen ldong dngul dang //srid pa'i lha chen gnyan chen thang lha la/ /'bul li 'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod/ /lha klu sman mo dregs pa'i 'khor tshogs dang //phyi nang gsang ba'i sde brgyad ma lus dang //phyogs 'dir gnas pa'i lha klu gzhi bdag la//'bul lo 'phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod//ces gser skyems 'bul/ skabs 'dir gzhi bdag gtor ma gtong / bstod pa ni/ swo/'dzum chen sdom khrom nam mkha' sdiX la bcibs/ /phyag na gnam lcags

'bar ba'i mda' gzhu bsnams//dbyi chen rab sde nags kyi rdo rjer bcibs//phyag na stag gi pags pa 'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin//'bri chen ldong dngul 'brong chen dkar la bcibs//phyag na gnam lcags 'bar ba'i ral gri 'dzin/ /gnyan chen thang lha g.yu 'brug sngon mo bcibs//phyag na mdung ring dar gyi ba dan 'dzin//phyogs bzhi skyong ba'i gnyan chen sde bzhi dang //yid 'phrog sman mo sras mchog mthu bo che//dregs pa'i lha srin sde brgyad tshogs rnams dang //bka' nyan las byed 'khor tshogs rnams la bstod//khyed rnams mchod cing bstod pa'i dge ba'i mthus//bdag sogs rnams kyi mi 'dod nyer 'tshe zhi//bsam pa'i don rnams yid bzhin 'grub pa dang //rtag tu srung skyob g.yel /spyan /dīkā /gas mdzod// ki swo che'o lha rgyal lo/bsngo smon shis brjod kyis mtha' ༄cu//dpal chen dri med nam mkha'i mdangs dang ldan//dus mtha'i risprin ltar rdu sgra 'brug stong che//'bar ba'i rdo rjes bgegs kyi klad pa 'gems//phyag na rdo rje bsnams la phyag 'tshal lo/phyag rdor 'byung bo 'dul byed kyi gzungs/

rnam rgyal gsol kha/༄byu //oṃ/ chos dbyings bde ba chen po'i pho brang nas//rtsa brgyud bla ma mchog gsum srung ma bcas//yul 'dir gnas pa'i yul lha gzhi bdag sogs//srid zhi'i mgron rnams ma lus gnas 'dir byon//phun sum tshogs 'dus phyogs kyi 'khor lo'i dbus//rnam rgyal lhun po'i spo la rab brten pa'i//'od 'bar rin chen pho brang dam pa nas//lha yi dge bsnyen chen po mthu rtsal can//rnam par rgyal dang rgyal bzang 'od zer can//g.yas ri rab mdzes rgyud du gnas pa yi//lha yi dge bsnyen bstan pa'i blo gros dang //g.yon ri 'byor ldan rgyud du gnas pa yi//dpal chen rmugs 'dzin la sogs dgra lha'i tshogs//sras blon btsun mo 'bum 'khor bcas pa yi//ma lus 'dir byon dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs//myur mgyogs 'gros bzang rta mchog tshogs rnams dang / /yid 'ong zhol pho zhol mo ra dang lug /'dab chags gcan gzan ri dwags go mtshon sogs//phyi nang gsang ba'i gcan gzan rten rdzas kyis/ /dgra lha'i rgyal po 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //nyams chag nongs pa'i tshogs kun bshags par bgyi//brtse bas bzod cing byams pas skyong bar mdzod//zas phud rin chen 'bru sna spos kyi shing //gtsang sbyar bsregs pa'i bsang mchod dam pa 'dis//srid zhi'i mgron rnams thugs dam 3 3

bskangagyaracig nyamasagribamalasadagacingatshangasaparashog khyedarnamasar ge ririg / mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus//dus kyi 'khrug pa mu ge yams la sogs//mi mthun rkyen rnams mtha' dag zhi ba dang //tshe dang bsod nams rigs rgyud dpal 'byor sogs//'phel zhing rgyas pa'i 'phrin las rtag tu mdzod//mi rnams 'phel zhing dbang phyug phun sum tshogs//bstan la dad cing dkon mchog mchod la brtson//phan tshun byams ldan ya rabs spyod bzang bo//phyogs 'dir rtag blugang ba'i bkra shis shog/ces pa 'di yang rgya yag mkhanapo tshul khrims 'phelargyas rgya mtshos bskul ngor shākya'i dge stong snyebyams pa thub bstan rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/she

bdun pa/ sum mdo dang 'bru gu'i bsang brngon/dge bsnyen seng mtho'i bsang mchod bsdus pa byin rlabs sprin phunganasku //cha'adzam bu gling gi dbus dkyil nas//shar phyogs gangs ri rtse rgyal la//dgung la nyi zla skar gsum shar//bar na lho sprin phyug mo 'khrigs//sa la rtsi sman 'bru drug 'khrungs//phyogs la bkra shis rdzas brgyad bkram//'ja' 'od 'khyil ba'i gur khang nas//rin po che 4khri steng na//yulalha'i rgyal po dge bsnyen ni//sku mdog dkar gsal dung 'od 'bar//sku la dar zab sna tshogs gsog/'ja' tshon 'od kyi zhwa gos brgyan//dbu la dar dkar prog zhu gsog/nyi zla 'od kyis 'phu yang btsugs//stag ral g.yas la gzig shubs g.yon//chibs su rag dkar stag la bcibs//rol du ngang ba zhir bo khrid/ /phyag g.yas sba lcag dkar bo bsnams//g.yon pas sbrul gyi srab skyogs bsgyur//gang 'dod gnas su byon pa'i tshe//sngon tshe bskal ba'i dang bo la//slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas dang //dus gsum mkhyen pa'i nam bas//dam la btags pa'i dam tshig can//mtshan ni dge bsnyen chen po btags//sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung ma yin//ser chags yongs kyi sruX 5ma yin//rnal 'byor bdag gi dgra lha

yin/ /shar phyogs rin chen brtsegs pa'i khri//bka' rgyud bla ma 'byon pa'i gnas/ /bdud rtsi rgyun chad med par 'bab/ /rnal 'byor sku tshe ring ba'i rtags//lho phyogs glang ri glang snying ni//rin chen gter spungs tshul du gnas//zas kyi g.yang dang 'bru yi bcud/ /dngos grub char ba 'bab pa'i rtags/ /nub phyogs rta rdzong phyug po ri//tshong dpon mgron gyis bskor ba'i ri//mi nor zas gsum 'phel ba'i g.yang //dgos 'dod re ba skong ba'i rtags//byang phyogs dge bsnyen rdo rje'i ri//gser gyi mchod rten tshul du gnas//sangs rgyas bstan pa'i srung ma yin//bstan dgra ma lus 'dul ba'i rtags//bsang dang mchod pa rgya chen 'di//dge bsnyen chen po 'khor bcas bsangan/byang gi sman btsun phyug mo bsang //sman phran 'khor dang bcas pa bsang //lho phyogs seng sman dkar mo bsang //seng sman 'khor dang bcas pa bsang //dge bsnyen khyed kyi 'khor tshogs ni//sras ni lha rtse klu rtse bsang //phyi blon bdun brgya nyi shu bsang //nang blon sum brgya drug cu bsang //yul 'khor rgyal blon bcu gsum bsang //bom ser chu mgo dkar dris bsang //klu'i chu rgya mtsho mthon po bsang //ha lis mildog mthon po bsang //shar phyogs lcags rdzong g.yang chen bsang / /lho phyogs lcags rdzong g.yang mkhar bsang //nub phyogs tsong kha'i mtsho sngon bsang //byang phyogs kho shun phyug mo bsang //tsong kha'i nyin srib la gnas pa'i//sa bdag klu gnyan thams cad bsang //yul gyi yul lha gnyan po bsang //byang gi mgron g.yang bcu /sdum bsang //gtan gyi pho lha gnyan po

bsang //ka drod yul lha gnyan po bsangan/bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bsang //ye shes mgon po bstan srung bsang //chos skyong srung ma gzhi bdag bsang //sa bdag rgyal po the se bsang //sa bdag blon po gtsang kun bsang //sa bdag dmag mi gung rgyal bsang //sa bdag phyo ma phyi long bsang //sa bdag hal khyi ho bad bsang //sa bdag zin phung nag po bsang //sa bdag gza' rgod khra tsha bsang / /sa bdag 'phar ba gong rgyug bsang / /sa bdag pho phyi blon chen bsang //sa bdag gnam khyi spun bdun bsang //sa bdag lam lha mgron yag bsangan/sa bdag phug lha ge thung bsang //sa bdag sgo lha rtag yag bsang //sa bdag thab lha yod mo bsang / /sa bdag klu gnyan 'khor bcas bsang / /bsang mchod phul pa'i yon tan gyis//rnal 'byor bdag cag 'khor bcas la//'phan po mi yi dngos grub stsol//rdzu 'phul rta yi dngos grub stsol//bsod nams nor gyi dngos grub stsol//'bru zan gter gyi dngos grub stsol//g.yang dkar lug gi dngos grub stsol//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol//ces pa 'di'i dge bsnyen seng mtho'i bsang mchod bsdus pa byin rlabs srin gung zhes bya ba snang srid zil gnon saskya pa rje btsun dam rol pa'irdo rjes so/

bal lon gsolakha bsdus pa/ra //cha phun tshogs stobs dang mthu rtsal legs ldan zhing //bal lon dge bsnyen zhes su nyer grags pa//sprul ba yang sprul 'khor tshogs ma lus —rnams//bdag gi spyan 'dren 'dir gshegs gdan la bzhugs//sna tshogs bza' bca' btung ba'i bye brag kun//ri ltar spungs shing mtsho ltar bskyil ba dang //'dod yon lnga dang nyer spyod rol mo'i tshogs//'bul lo dgyes bzhin bzhes la 'dod don sgrubs//gzhan yang go mtshon g.yag lug srog chags dang //rgyal srid bdun dang bkra shis rtags rdzas sogs//lha klu mi yi dpal 'byor tshogs rnams kun//dngos su bshams dang yid kyis sprul te 'burme//tsan dan dkar dmar stag pa shug pa dang //ba lu su lu bzang bo drug la — sogs/ /bsregs pa'i bsang dud lha yi lam 'geng ba'i//'bul lo dgyes bzhin bzhes la 'dod don sgrubs/khyed la 'phrin las ched du bcol ba ni//rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi//mi mthun rkyen ngan bar chad bzlog pa dang //mthun rkyen yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel bar mdzod//ba won dge bsnyen zhes pa la gsolamachod zhig dgos zhes lcang skya'i phyag mdzod yeshes bstan 'dzin gyis bskul ba labarten nas shākya'i btsun pa bsod nams ming can gyis g.yar phralatsam du sbyar ba'o//

phyug mo'i gsol mchod/༄ //rgyu rgyal kun 'dus zhal pad+ma 'byung gnas dang //grub pa'i byang chub chos rje kurma pa//'gro ba'i 'dren mchog rgyal sras sprul ba'i sku//rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams kyi//bka' dang dam la gnas pa'i dam tshig can//bkra shis dge mtshan ldan pa'i yul gyi ljongs//rta rdzong rgyug po'i ri la gnas bcas pa'i//gnas bdag 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//mdun gyi nam mkhar 'ja' tshon gur khyim dbus//yid 'ong rin chen mdzes pa'i gdan khri la//dgyes pa'i 'dzum chags brtan par bzhugs su gsol//chu gnyis nyer spyod 'dod yon rin chen bdun//bkra shis rdzas brgyad sna tshogs spyan gzigs dang //dkar gsum mngar gsum bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs/ /sman rag gtor ma phyi nang mchod sprin bcas/ /'dod yon lnga ldan bsang mchod dud sprin 'khrigs//sngags dang ting 'dzin phyag rgyas byin brlabs pas//gnas bdag chen po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul//dgyes pa'i bsang mchod dam pa 'di bzhes la/ /phyogs 'dir 'khod pa'i bdag cag yon mchod rnams/ /brtse ba chen po'i g.yel ba med par mdzod/ /mi nor phyugs gsum thams cad bu bzhin skyongs//mi yi na tsha phyugs kyi god kha sel//gcan gzan gnod 'tshe ma lus zhi bar mdzod//char chu dus su 'bab cing lo kyi

tog la//sad ser btsa' than zhing gi nyer 'tshe zhi//rtsi bcud lo tog tshogs rnams 'phel bar mdzod//gzhi lam byes gsum nyin mtshan thams cad du//'gal rkyen kun sel mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs//mdor na bdag sogs rnams kyi chos mthun gyi//'dod pa'i don rnams yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ /lta ba bzang dang ldan pa'i sa phyogs 'dir//lta ngan log chos nam yang mi 'byung bar//lta ba rnam dag chos kyi snying bo mchog/lta ba'i yang rtse — rdzogs pa chen po yis//bshad sgrub bstan pa dar zhing rgyas pa dang /bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs par mdzod/ces pa 'di'ang pad+ma 'phrin las 'gyur med rdo rjes gsungs so/tsho tsho tsho sna rme ma rmetsho rimasti tshoX༄khe //sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing //dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad//cirang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul /'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin//

phyug mo'i gsol kha bde skyid kun 'byungan༄'i //kye/ sman ri phyug mo rin chen gter mdzod nas//mo btsun chen mo 'jo sgeg zla ba bzhin//rin chen sbog zhu dar bzang na bza' bklubs//sil khrol rgyan dang g.yu gyur rna tshar 'phyang //lnga skyes dung dkar me lung phyag na bsnams//re 'ga' gter gnas re 'ga' sha ba bcibs//sman mo na chung —stong gi 'khor dang bcas//bsang mgron mchod pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//lha sman phyug mo phyogs 'di'i mtshams skyong ba'i//bsod dri'i spun gsum khya mtho skya mtho sogs//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde brgyad mthu chen — kun//'dir byon rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs//chu gtsang me tog 'o zho ja chang phud//'khur ba sha thud shing rtog bza' bca'i rigs//gos dar rin chen srog chags spyan gzigs tshogs//yul lha 'khor bcas dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul//dri zhim bsang rdzas ye shes mer bsregs pa'i//dud pa'i sprin phung mgron gyi dbang bo ltar//bde ster zag pa med pa'i longs spyod —kyis//sa skyong mkha' 'gro bde ldan phyug mo bsang //bsod dri la gnas ma seng klu btsan bsang //khya mthor gnas pa'i klu rje dbang sngon bsang //skya mthor gnas pa'i btsan rje g.yu ngog bsang //gzhan yang ri lung thang snang mtsho chu la//gzhug mar gnas pa'i sde brgyad ma lus bsang //nyams grib kun gtsang 39

dgyes pa'i 'dzum klong nas//rma g.yang mnga' thang phyugs kyi dngos grub stsol//spyan ras gzigs dbang pad 'byung kurma pa'i//ji ltar bka' bsgos dam bcas dran mdzod la//rnal 'byor bdag gi ji ltar bcol ba'i don//thogs pa med par lhun gyis grub par mdzod//mongs pa bdag 'dra bya spyod mimakhas pa'i//khyed cag thugs dang 'gal ba ci bgyis pa//nongs 'gyod drag po'i sgo nas bshags bgyid na//bzod par bzhes la bdag tshang dngos grub rtsol//bdag cag yon mchod lha r+shagros mthun gyi//srung bya ldan pa'i ri dwags nags tshal la//ci dgar spyod pa'i dmu srin dgra sde kun//nad than thog ser la — —sogs tshar gcod mdzod/khyed rnams gus pa'i yid kyis mchod pa dang //ji mi snyam pa'i gnod spyod rtsom mkhan gnyis//mthong gsal spyan gyis ma nor shan phye la//ngan la chad pa bzang la phan 'dogs mdzod//khyad par khyed la gus ldan bdag cag gi/mi la na tsha phyugs la god kha sogs//mi 'dod nyer 'tshe ming yang migags par//tshe bsod rigs rgyud rlung rta dar bar mdzod//phyogs 'dir sad ser kha ba rwa 'od dang //thog glog gcan spyang za kha zug la sogs//rkyen ngan ri mtshon dgra yi phyogs bsnyil zhingan/bde skyid ba dan srid rtser bsgreng bar mdzod/ces pa 'di ni kho shun phyug mo sogs kyi gsol kha bde skyid kun 'byung zhes bya ba 'di ni bstan pa'i sbyin bdag rgya tig bsam 'grub tshe ring sogs kyis bskulangor hor sprulang ming can bsam gtan don 'grub kyis bris sdu'o //

klu mo dung skyong ma'i gsolas/khong //skyoḥ rgyal ba'i yum gcig gter bdag nor rgyun ma//'jig rten skyong phyir klu rgyal dung skyong gi /klu mo dkar phyogs khas blangs dung skyong ma/ /dregs pa'i klu mo 'khor bcas gnas 'dir byon//sha phud chang phud zas sna me tog spos//dri zhim sman sna bsang rdzas dar tshon 'bru//rin chen sdod du dgos 'dod mar me sogs//klu mo dung skyong 'khor bcas rnams la 'bul//legs par bzhes nas phyi dang gnod pa'i dgra//skad cig tshar gcod mngon pa'i rtags mtshan ston//mdor na mi nor lo tog dang bcas pa'i//nyer 'tshe ma lus myur du bzlog par mdzod//rgyal sras don yod chos rgyal bka' bzhin du//dam ldan 'jig rten klu mo mthu rtsal can//deng 'dir khyed mchod rnams la srung skyob la//dgyes nas sdongs grogs mdzod cig dngos grub stsol//ces pa 'di ni rgyal sras don yod chos rgyal gyi bka' bzhin du rgyal yum klu ma'i gsol mchod mdzad nas chos dbang bstan pa rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o///sa phyogs 'dir gnas dkar dag lha 'dre'i tshogs//chos dang zang zing sbyin pa'i tshim byas la//byams pa'i sems kyis gnas mgron dam tshig srungs//dam chos spel ba'i sdongs grogs mdzad du gsol/ /yul 'di'i gzhi bdag gnyan po 'khor bcas kyi//gtsang ma phud kyi bsang mchod 'di bzhes la//rnal 'byor dpon slob bsam don 3 3

'grub pa dang //gsang chen bstan pa rgyas pa'i grogs mdzod cig / ༈ gser skyems ni/raṃ yo khaṃ/oṃ ā rgyu/gser skyems zag pa med pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ snye/sku gsum brgyud gsum bla ma dang //yi dam zhi khro lha tshogs dang //skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum po dang //mkha' 'gro nor lha chos skyong sogs//mchod yul gong ma thams cad la//mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo//gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la//bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol//lha yi dbang bo brgya byin dang //klu yi rgyal po dga' bo dang //lha min dbang bo thags bzang ris// mi'am ci ljon rta mgo dang //gnod sbyin gang ba bzang bo dang //mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba dang //chos skyong ma hā ka la dang //dri za zur bud lnga la sogs//phyi yi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la/ /mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ / gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol//yab gcig bdud rje dag po dang //btsan rgyal yam shud dmar bo dang //yul lha phywa sangs klu sras dang //srog bdag rgyal po snying 'byin dang //chos skyong gnod sbyin dmar bo dang //lha mo 'jigs pa'i klog 'byin dang //dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa dang //dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng sogs//nang gi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la//mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo//gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la//bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol//bdud po kha thun ram dang //gshin rje gshed po dmar bo dang //klu bdud nā ga rā dzā dang //ga// sbyin bshan pa gri thogs dang //ma mo

srin po khram 'debs dang //btsan rgod yam shud srog len dang /bdud po ri lde 'gong yag dang //srog bdag dung gi thor tshugs sogs//gsang ba'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la//mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo//gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la//bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol//gza' mchog rgyal po rā hu la//skar mchog khram shing kha 'thor dang //bdud mchog ma nu yasna dang //btsan mchog gri btsan mthu bo dang //ma mchog ce spyang dung 'dzin dang //klu mchog klu rgyal dung skyong dang /mgon mchog nag po ste dkar dang //rgyal mchog li byin ha ra sogs//mchog gi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo//gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la//bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol//dpung g.yas dgra lha sprul ba dang //dpung g.yon ma mor sprul ba dang //chu so bdud du sprul ba dang //mgo bo srin por sprul ba dang //mjug ma dmu ru sprul ba dang //lag g.yas gshin rjer sprul ba dang /lag g.yon klu btsan sprul ba dang //mig dang snying dang mche ba gsum//gza' bdud nyid du sprul ba sogs//sprul ba'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la//mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul lo/ /gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la/ /bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol//sa bdag hal khyi nag po dang //klu bdud sgo ra nag po dang //sa yi lha mo brtan ma dang //phyogs skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi dang //mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga dang /yul 'di'i gzhi bdag thams cad dang //pho lha dgra lha srog lha dang //mo 3/ mo sman la sogs pa'i//snang srid sde

brgyad 'khor bcas la//mchod pa dam pa 'di 'bul go/gser skyems gtsang ma 'di bzhes la//bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol//sa ā rgyu/rig 'dzin rtsa brgyud bla ma dam pa dang //bde gshegs kun 'dus zhi khro rab 'byams lha//khyad par ye shes mkha' 'gro'i lha tshogs la//gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor sdongs grogs mdzod//ma mgon lcam dral tshe ring mched lnga dang //drag po'i sde dpon sum cu yab yum sras//bka' nyan bran g.yog mngag gzhug bcas pa rnams//gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor sdongs grogs mdzod//sngags 'chang bdag gi rigs kyi srung ma dngan/sa phyogs 'di yi yul gzhi gnas kyi bdag/lo bla zhag dus tshes la dbang ba'i lha//gser skyems 'di bzhes rnal 'byor sdongs grogs mdzod//mchog gsumango bo dpalamagon bla ma dang //rgyud sde rgya mtsho gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs//ma mgon gza' rdor tshe ring mched lnga la//chod gsol bstod do bsamadon lhun 'grub mdzod/ga sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar ba dang sems can la bde snyeskyid 'byung ba dang rnala'abyor bdag cag sgrub pa po'i zhi ba'i las dnganargyas pa'i las dang / dbang gi las dang / drag po'i las dang /las rab 'byams gang brtsams pa thams cad thogs pa med cing myur ba nyid du 'grub pa'i sdongs grogs mdzad du gsol/khyad par du yang bdag cag dpon slob bsrung bya mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa'i nad gdon 'gal rkyen bar chad chag che nyam nga lo skeg bla gshed la sogs 3༷'i mi 'dod pa'i nye bar 'tshe ba mi

mthun pa'i phyogs ngan pa thams cad zhi zhing bzlog pa'i 'phrin las mdzad du gsol/mdor na mtho ris kyi yon tan bdun dang ldan zhing sde bzhi'i dpal phun sum tshogs pa la rang dbang bsgyur nas rtag tu dge ba bcu'i chos yang dag pa la spyod nas thar ba dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang la dbugs 'byin pa'i 'phrin las dam pa rgya chen po yongs su 'grub par mdzad du gsol// bsang gi rjes chog gi dang po smon lam btab pa ni/ rgyuḥ bla ma rnams la bsang mchod phul pas mthus//rang bzhin gdod ma'i gnas lugs rtogs par shog /yi dam rnams la bsang mchod sul pas mthus//dngos grub rnam gnyis myur du 'thob par shog/mkha' 'gro rnams la bsang mchod bul pas mthus//'phrin las rnam bzhi rtsol med 'grub par shog/chos skyong rnams la bsang mchod phul pas mthus//byang chub las la bar chad med par shog/dam can rnams la bsang mchod bul pas mthus//bstan dgra dam nyams myur du sgrol bar shog /yon tan mgron la bsang mchod phul pas mthus//bstan pa bsrungs shing sdongs grogs byed par shog/gzhi bdag mgron la bsang mchod phul pas mthus//bdag cag dpon slob 'khon 'gras med par shog/snying rje'i mgron la bsang mchod gul pas mthus//sdug bsngal kun bral sangs — rgyas 'thob par shog/lan chags mgron la bsang mchod phul pas mthus//tshe rabs grangs med lan chags dbyung bar shog/bsang mchod bul pa'i mthu stobs byin rlabs kyis//tshogs gnyi/ /ra rdzogs don gnyis lhun grub shog/

dge'o/ bzod par gsolab ni/rgyuḥ ma rig gti mug rmongs pa'i dbang gyur nas//bsang la bos pa'i srid zhi'i mgron rigs kyi//sku gsung thugs dang yon tan 'phrin las kyi//'gal 'khrul ci bgyis bshags so bzod par gsol/ces dang ye ge brgya bas lhag chad kha bskang kye/ bsang dang zhi ba'i mgron la spyan drangs pa'i//srid las 'das dang srid par gnas pa kun// dgyes dgu'i dpal la rol te gnas su bzhud/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog srid zhi'i mgron//sku gsum lhun grub rgyal ba'i zhing du gshegs//yon tan mgron rnams sprul sku'i zhing du gshegs//snying rje'i mgron rnams rigs drug gnas su gshegs//bskyed pa'i lha sku skye med klong du gshegs//khyab gdal bum sku'i sbubs su gshegs su gsol//oṃ badz+ra muḥ sarba lo ka gatshukhyezhes brjod/rdzogs rim gyi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go/bsngo ba ni/ 'dis mtshon bdag gzhan dus gsum rnam dkar dges//las nyon dbang gis 'khor ba'i mkha' khyab 'gro//'jigs rung srid pa'i chu bo las brgal te//sku gsum lhun gyis grub pa'i rgyu ru bsngo// smon lam ni/ rgyal ba zhabs brtan bstan pa dar zhing rgyas//skye dgu bde zhing nad mug mtshon 'khrug zhi//thams cad gsang chen theg pa'i chos la spyod/ /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin rdo rje 'chang 'grub shog/ shis brjod ni/ rgyuḥphan bde dpal gyur byin rlabs thugs rje'i gter//dge ldan brgyud pa'i bla ma'i bkra shis shog/gang 'dul zhi khro'i gar gyis srid gsuma'adul//lha rigs rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i bkra shis sho/tsho/'phrin las thogs med grub gnyis

'dod dgu'i sprin//sku gsum mkha' 'gro yongs kyi bkra shis shog /mi bzad gtum chen rngams pa'i bdud dpung 'joms//mthu ldan dam can srung ma'i /byi /sdu // ba// r+sha rdzu // tu phun tshogs phan bde dpyid//bde dga' rgya ces brjod bsang ras dang sha chang la sogs tshogs kyi dga' stonarol/rdo rje'i glu dang shin saskyid pa'i bro brdungs pa sogs bya'o 2 ༄7//rigs drug gi rnal 'byor ma//bar chad srung ba'i las mdzod ri cig /'aXthen las rnam bzhi thogs med pas//dbang bsgyur khyed la phyag /'tshal la/ go cha'i dpa' mo drug gi gzungs/

yul skyong zho lung mthon po'i bsang gsol yul lha dga' ba'i bzhad sgra/༄༄ //kye/mdo smad byang phyogs 'dzin ma'i yul gyi rgyan//rin chen rdul mang brtsegs pa'i ri bo la//gnas bcas dkar phyogs skyong ba'i sde dpon che//rgyal chen zho lung 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs//mdun du rta mchog rin chen rgyan mdzes pa//gling bzhi yud kyis bskor ba'i shugs ldan steng /yul lha'i rgyal po dpa' bo'i rnam 'gyur can//dar dkar thod 'ching za 'og ber chen gsol//phyag g.yas mdung ring nam mkha'i dbyings su bsgrengs//g.yon pas 'dod rgu'i nor gyi bum bzang bsnams//lha sman sras blon sprul 'khor rgya mtsho'i dbus//dgyes 'dzum dga' ba'i nyams kyis bzhugs su gsol//'jam bu'i gser sbyang 'khyil 'dra'i me dang du//sna tshogs mthun rdzas bsregs pa'i du ba'i tshogs//'dod rgu'i cir yang 'char ba'i mchod pa'i sprin//rab 'byams zhing kun 'gengs pa'i bsang gis mchod//rin chen snod du 'bru sna zan gyi rigs//dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis bsgrubs gtor ma dang //'bras chang rgun chang ja dkar sman phud sogs//bdud rtsi'i zegs ma thor ba'i skyems kyis brngan//sngon dus slob dpon sangs rgyas gnyis pa yi//bka' rtags rdo rje'i ri mos dbang baXr zhingan/sa snying kurma mkhas grub du ma

yi//bstan 'gro'i phan bde spel ba'i g.yar dam skyongs//pad dkar 'chang dngos bsod nams rgya mtsho'i sde//rgyal ba'i sras po blo bzang bstan 'dzin dang //ho ru ka dpal mchog grub nyi ma yi//sku phreng brgyud par bcas pa'i tha tshig dgongs//'dzam gling spyi dang khyad par mdo smad ljongs//dga' ba brgyad ldan bshad sgrub dar rgyas gling //yon mchod sde dang bcas pa thams cad kyi//chos srid legs tshogs yar ngo'i bla bzhin spel/ /bdag cag gzhi lam byes gsum gang du yang / /nam yang re zhig stos tshe ma bsru bar/ /mdo li shing rta lam du bder drangs shing //dga' skyid glu dbyangs phyogs mthar bsgrag par shog /yul la bkra shis dus bzhi gnas lugs legs//mi la nad med sems mthun bde dga' rgyas//phyugs la dgra god gcan gzan nyer 'tshe zhi//rnam kun legs tshogs rgyas pa'i bkra shis stsol/ces pa 'di yang phran tsam snga phyi dkor der thogs skabs yul skyong 'di nyid kyis dga' ba'i mtshan ma mngadu byung bas nye bar bskul te dam pa'i bka' 'bangs gu gyur kyang rmongs pa'i yang bran du spyod pa'i ma cig mngag dbang 'phrin las kyis zho lung mthon po'i lha zholagyi sman ljongs nyams su dga' ba zhig nas bris pa'o/

gnas bdag nor bu g.yul rgyal gyi bsang mchod lha yi rnga sgra/༄ //hūṃ hrīḥ/sngon dus g.yung drung bon gyi lha gcig pu//rgyal ba'i dbang bo pad+ma tā ra yis//yul phyogs 'di yi gnas kyi srung mar bskos//dkar phyogs dge ba'i rgyal mtshan srid rtser bsgrengs//rdo rje mgor bzhag lce la bdud rtsi byin//dam bca' tha tshig rdo rje'i bro bor te//rang rang srog gi snying bo phul nas kyang //ji ltar zhal bzhes dam bca' dran mdzod la//sgrub po rnal 'byor bdag la rjes dgongs shig da dang mthun pa'i dam rdzas chen po ni//roḥlas skyes pa'i 'bar ba'i me nang du//shug pa 'om bu ba lu spen ma dang //nya sprid mkhan po stag pa la sogs pa//bdud ci'i shing lnga rin chen rnam pa lnga//dar zab sna tshogs za 'og rigs byed dang //phye mar bsregs pa'i du ba'i sprin gyi tshogs//rab dkar chu 'dzin dkar bo'i dbyibs lta bu//yid 'ong lha lam yangs pa'i zhing kun khyab//rin chen gter gyi bum pa bzang bo dang /dri zhim sman gyis gtams pa'i rin chen sgom//rta dang dre'u ba lang ma he dang //mdzo g.yag 'bri dang 'brong bu tse ra lug /shwa rkyang la sogs rkang bzhi'i tshogs rnams dang / /stag gzig dom dred 'phar spyang gcan gzan rigs//rma bya shang shang ne tso rgod dang bzhad//mthiXji ril ngur ba la sogs 'dab chags

tshogs//chu srin rgyal po dung sogs chu gnas rigs//rdo rje'i lha mo rgyal srid rin chen bdun//bkra shis rdzas rtags nye ba'i rin chen bdun//go khrab gri dang rmog ral mda' gzhu mdung //zhwa lham gos dang pho thang mo thang sogs//mdor na dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul ba yis//mi zad nam mkha'i mdzod kyi 'khor lo 'di//phul pa'i bdag cag rig 'dzin sgrub pa bos//ma shes bag med spyod pa cing ba yis//khyad par sa gnyan bskos dang chu gnyan dkrugs//rdo gnyan bslogs dang shing gnyan bcad pa sogs//gnas bdag chen po yab yum sras 'khor dang / /blon po ru 'dren 'khor tshogs dpung dang bcas//gzhan yang klu gnyan sa bdag la sogs pa//'gram 'khrugs thugs dang 'gal ba'i las gyur rnams//mi 'bab mi sped snying nas bshags lags na//sgrib med tshangs pa mchog gi dngos spub stsol//de ltar bsang mchod bul pa'i byin rlabs kyis/ /yul 'dir nad mug mtshon 'khrug zhi ba dang / /'jigs pa chen po brgyad dang bcu drug sogs//rnam pa kun caming yang med par mdzod//bdag cag tshe bsod dpal 'byor rgyas pa dang //dbang thang rlung rta snyan grags phyogs bcur sgrogs//zas nor longs spyod yid la gang 'dod pa//mi zad nam mkha' mdzod bzhin 'phel ba dang //'dus pa'i tshogs rnams dbyar gyi mtsho ltar rgyas//bshad sgrub bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa dang //mi nor zas gsum dbang du 'du bar mdzod//khyad par bdag la bsam ngan sbyor rtsub mkhan//snga daX lag brdar phyi dgra yid la sems//da

dgra sod du btsugs pa'i dgra bo rnams//lo zla zhag dang za mar ma bzhag la///// :zhu /// rjes /15 ཿdza /rdo :she ///mtha bas ma na da drag sa ra da ga / nga nas bzang byang chub ri pa ri pa ma thob bar//lha mchog khyed kyis sdongs grogs ma g.yel cig/ces nor bu g.yul rgyal gyi bsang mchod 'di ni lcags mo bya lor 'du khang gsar blornying dang dung 'khor bzhengs skabs ched du dmigs te/zla tshes bzang bor thub bstan chos kyi rdo rjes bris pa dge legs su gyur cig/————— — ————— —————ba — — — —

brag dkar gshegs gtor/༄byu //rang gi thugs ku'i hūṃ las 'od zer 'phros pas rnga yab lang ku'i grong khyer 'phags yul rdo rje gdan/gnas chen tsi ri te se/ rwa sgreng dpal gyi dang khrod/nyang stong bkra shis lhun po/chos 'khor rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang mdo khams byang rgyud brag dkar rdo rje'i pho brang la sogs pa gar bzhugs kyi gnas nas zhing skyong lha yi dge bsnyen chen po gsang yum sras blon sprul ba yang sprul dregs pa sde brgyad kyi tshogs dang bcas pa skad cig spyan drangs/kye/'gyur med rang bzhin dag pa'i chos dbyings las//ci yang 'char ba sgyu ma'i cho 'phrul gyis//snang srid dregs pa'i sde dpon sku shar ba//rgyal ba'i bstan srung chen po 'dir gshegs shig /lang ku'i grong khyer 'phags yul tsa ri tra//rwa sgreng nyang stong chos 'khor rgyal sogs nas//khyad par brag dkar rdo rje pho brang nas//lha yi dge bsnyen chen po gshegs su gsol//gsang yum sras blon sprul ba yang sprul sogs//sa dang bar snang gang ba'i 'khor tshogs bcas//'brug gi sgra ldan dbyar gyi char sprin bzhin//'ur 'ur chems choms badz+ras ma dzaḥ/mdun du ting 'dzin gyis sprul khang bzang dbus//gser dngul dar zab khri stan bzhon pa sogs//rang rang ji ltar 'os pa'i gdan khri la//rnal 'byor 'phrin las bsgrub phyir brtan par bzhugs//ting 'dzin sngags rgyas byin 03

rlabs mthun pa'i rdzas/ /phyi dang nyer spyod spyan gzigs mchod pa'i spyin/ /bsang sna'i du sprin ja chang bdud rtsi'i skyems//ma lus 'khor tshogs dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul//khyad par stong gsum khyon ltar yangs pa'i snod//lha mo'i zhal zas gtor tshogs kyis gtams pa// oṃ āḥ/ gis bdud cir byin brlabs pas/ dge bsnyen chen po 'khor bcas zhal du 'bul/ / zhing skyong dgra lha'i rgyal po lha'i dge bsnyen chen po 'khor dang bcas pa'i rdo rje 'od zer gyi spu gyis gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ cham hā de wa u ba si ka sa ba ri wa ra i dam pa lita kha kha khā gyi khā gyi/ lan gsum brjod/ a ka ro lan gsum/oṃ ma hā de wa u ba si ka sa ba ri wa ra ma nas shasnya bar mchod/ oṃ ma hā de wa mu ba si ka sa ba ri wa ra oṃ lha'irgyu/ yid 'phrog spang ljongs brag dkar thor gtsug can//bya dang ri dwags sman shing skyed tshal dbus//rin chen las grub khang bzang yid 'ong nang / sprin dkar g.yo 'dra'i rta mchog rgyan ldan steng //rdzu 'phrul dpal brjid kyis 'gying bstan srung che//lha yi dge bsnyen chen por phyag 'tshal lo//yid 'ong mchod sprin tshogs kun ma lus 'bul//bdag sogs dgon gnas gnyer du gtad lags pas//pha rol rbad 'dre gnod byed tshogs zhi nas//bshad sgrub legs tshogs gong du 'phel bar mdzod// gzhi bdag gtor ma bsngo/rdu rdo rje 'chang dngos dpal ldan mar me mdzad//spyan ras gzigs dbang rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas zhabs//blo bzang rgyal ba gnyis pa yab sras kyi//bka' ༷nga dam la gnas pa'i dam tshig can//

rgyal bstan spyi dang bka' gdams bshad sgrub kyi//khrims ldan skyong ba nam yang mi g.yel ba'i//snang srid yongs la dbang bsgyur mthu stobs can//lha yi dge bsnyen chen po 'khor dang bcas//lung rigs nga ros phas rgol zil gnon pa'i//lnga rig smra ba'i seng ge 'khor dang bcas//drag sngags bden tshig nus pa mthar son pa'i//rig 'dzin lha yi drang srong 'khor dang bcas//las bzhi'i 'phrin las glog gi rjes 'gro ba'i//tshangs chen dung gi zur phud 'khor dang bcas//dgra lha'i snying khrag hub kyis 'dren mdzad pa'i//btsan rgod gzi 'od 'bar ba 'khor dang bcas//na sel sman gyi myu gu rgyas mdzad pa'i//klu tsha tshe yi rig 'dzin 'khor dang bcas//gang bsam 'dod dgu'i nor gyi char 'bebs pa'i/ /gnod rgyun gter bdag chen po 'khor dang bcas//mi nor phyugs gsum yul khams kun skyong ba'i//gzhi bdag rdo rje dpal ldan 'khor dang bcas//thugs kyi dgyes bskyed gsang ba'i yum sras tshogs//lha klu sman btsan 'bum sde'i 'khor dang bcas//bka' nyan gtso bo dmu srin tshar gcod pa'i//phyi dang gsang ba'i blon tshogs 'khor dang bcas//ru 'dren sde bzhi sprul ba yang sprul sogs//sde brgyad dregs pa'i dmag dpung 'khor dang bcas//dgra bo'i rje gcod bya khyi ce spyang sogs//za byed mche ldan dmag tshogs 'khor dang bcas//phu mdo nyin srib kun la dbang bsgyur ba'i//yul lha'i gzhi bdag gnyen po 'khor dang bcas/ /'dir gshegs rgyan gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/sha khrag dmaX gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes shig/dza de

ba'i zhal zas 'di bzhes shig/dza gad dpa' bo'i sman phud 'di bzhes shig/dri zhim bsang gi mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /bye mar zas sna'i mchod pa 'di bzhes shig/dkar gsum 'o ma'i rgya mtsho 'di bzhes shig/bcud ldan rgya ja'i btung ba 'di bzhes shig /khrag chang bdud rtsis mchod pa 'di bzhes shig /gtsang ma phud kyi gser skyems 'di bzhes shig/sngar bcol legs pa'i gtang rag gnyen po bzhes//da bcol legs pa'i gsol 'debs rten du bzhes//'khor srung rkyen bzlog nad gdon bar chad zhi//tshe dang bsod nams chos 'byor bde skyid spel//rtogs ldan skye rgu mtha' dag dbang du bsdus//zas nor longs spyod 'dod rgu char du phob//gnod byed dgra dang bgegs kyi g.yul ngo bzlog/phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//dpon slob rnams kyi༅morabastanapa'i dpal gyur〉〉〉tshangs dbang lha dngasamomo/cham hā de tsho.u ba si ka sa ba ri wa ra ma nas shasnya bar mchod/ oṃ ma hā de nas oṃ lha'irgyu/ mnga' gsolani/oṃ snying rje'i lha mchog sprul ba'i zlos gar dang //mthun pa'i smon las zhing 'dir yongs grub pa'i//mthu ldan stobs chen lha yi dge bsnyen khyed//snang srid dregs pa'i gtso bor mnga' gsol lo//thub bstan yang snying 'jam mgon tsong kha pa'i/ rang lugs khrims gtsang bshad dang sgrub pa'i srog/spel la nyin mtshan g.yel med bya ra mkhan//dge ldan bstan pa'i srung ma mnga' gsol lo//bstan la 'khu zhing 'tshe ba'i bsam stor can//ma rungs dgra sde'i snying khraX hub gcig gis//'dren la dpa'

bo'i gtum drag khros pa'i gar//dgra bgegs gshed ma'i gtso bo mnga' gsol lo//mi mthun tshang tshing kun 'joms dus mtha'i me//ci 'dod re skong bum bzang dpag bsam shing //nyer 'tshe'i gdung sel sman gyi mchog nyid de//rnal 'byor dgra lha chen po mnga' gsol lo//deng nas bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas//lha khyed gdugs bzhin bkur ro gdung ba skyobs//rgyal mtshan bzhin du 'phyar ro ci phyin bskyed//lha yi rnga bzhin bskul lo snyan po sgrogs//rtag tu dgon gnas dge 'dun gtsug lag khang //bdag cag yon mchod skyong la ma g.yel bar/ /rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las ngo so mthun pa yi/ /mchod cing mnga' gsol don dang ldan par mdzod/ shis brjod ni/cha'achi med dpal ster rab dkar bdud ci'i chus/ /dbang bskur thig phreng ji bzhin lan tshar g.yo//tshe mthar phyin pa'i yul lha rnams kyi mthus//phyogs 'dir tshe ring nad med bkra shis shog /stag shar dpa' bo'i dgra la 'cha' ba'i zhal//dmar nag nyi zla'i snang mig g.yo ba can//gnas skyong dgra lha gzhon nu'i gzi byin gyis//nag phyogs g.yul las rgyal ba'i bkra shis shog/mu tig 'khri shing yang dag rgyu ba bzhin//yid 'ong 'jo sgeg lang tsho kun dga' dpyid//lha klu na chung sman mo'i tshogs kyi mthus//ljongs 'dir bde skyid 'dzoms pa'i bkra shis shog/gser gyi rgya phibs 'bar ba'i khang bzang sogs//rang snang gzhal yas bkod pa sna tshogs pa'i//dge mtshan des kyang sa gzhi bcud ldan zhing //rtsi shing lo 'bras smin pa'i bkra shis // /dbyar skyes sgra ldan lha yi char chen

bzhin//shis brjod dbyangs dang 'brel ba'i bstod tshig 'di/khyed thugs 'o mardo skye dgur 'phyur ba las/ /longs chos rlabs phreng phyogs brgya g.yo bar masad/ce/sa brjod cing me tog gi char dbabapar bya'o/ snyoms las pa dbyangs ldan snyom pa'i blo gros kyis bkod pa'o/ri ༄ //chos dbyings rang bzhin in+d+ra rmi la'i mdog/zhal gcig /ga /ciganyis sa gnon mnyam bzhag mdzad//lha yi gos dang rin chen rgyan mang mdzes//bcon ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal lo/mi 'khrugs pa'i gzungs/

dge bsnyen brag dkar gyi bsang brngon bkra shis 'khyil ba/sku'i //dge bsnyen brag dkar gyi bsang brngon la/gzhi ma gtsang ma'i steng du dkar gsum gyi mchod pa/ gtso gtor lori rab khang bzang rgya sgribs tog gi mdzes pa gcigagayas su zong chung gcigagayon du bshos bu sprul 'khyud can gcigaphye bu gcig teng lo gciga'abrang rgyas gcigamadun du skum gtor gnyis/dkar gtor gcigadabang bo rnam lnga/g.yag lug ra gsum/bshos bu sum cu so bdun bya'o/glang seng khyung 'brug bya khra khu byug lcog chung 'jol mo/gnam la 'gur dgu/sa la 'dzuladagu byung na rab/dkar gsum/mngar gsum/chu sna/sman sna/ja chang gser skyemasamachod pa/'bru sna/bye mar/ji tog sna tshogs/ zhal zas/ tshogs mchod bya'o/ri rab gling phran nyi bla dang bcas pa/phyi lcags ri mu khyud byung na rab/rgyal srid sna bdun bkra shis rtags brgyad/yan lag brgyad ldan/lha'i dpal 'byor ji snyed pa bshams la/nang mchod ja phud sogs 'bul/rang nyid skad cig gis dpal rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa yum dang bcas pa'i skur bzhengs par gyur/oṃlha'itsā gis byin gyis brlabs la/ griḥ/lhun 'grub chos dbyings bde chen klong yangs nas//ṭhā/chos sku snang mtha' longs sku spyan ras gzigs//sprul sku pad 'byung mtsho skyes rdo rje dang //de bam ka ra blo bzang grags pa'i dpal//rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gro'i tshogs dang bcas//thogs med thugs rje dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs//mdun

gyi nam mkhar 'dab ma stong ldan pa'i//seng khri pad+ma nyi ma'i gdan steng dbus//rang rang dgyes 'dzum gdan la bzhugs gsol 'debs/ /oṃ lha'iṭ+wāṃ/phyi yi mchod pas bar snang sa gzhi khyab//nang mchod zag med ye shes bdud rtsi lnga//gsang ba sabasam brjod 'das 'bul phyir bzhes//dgyes mgur bzhes la mchog thun dngos grub stsol//'gro kun don du so sor skur bstan pa//gang la gang 'dul de la der ston mdzad//pad 'byung a ti sha dang blo bzang — grags//sna tshogs sprul ba'i gar mdzad de la 'dud//mkha' 'gro bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs//gter srung yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad rnams//khyed kyi bka' dang dam tshig la gnas pa'i//'phrin las rnam bzhi lhun gyis grub pa la//bka' dang dam tshig skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i//chos sgra chen po dar zhing rgyas pa dang //'jig rten kun tu dge mtshan bkra shis rgyas//mchoshe thun dngos grub ma lus bstsal du gsol//oṃ badz+ra maskṛta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na sum̐ phaṭa/oṃ su bha wa shu ཿsarbarnyarmaḥswa bhā wa bi shu rgyuḥstong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las sne las byung ba'i rin po che'i sdod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ sa zhu ba las byung ba'i mchod pa dang gtor ma ye shes kyi rang bzhin can dwangs shing thogs pa med pa mgron rnams kyis longs spyod pa tsam gyis sdug bsngal thams cad zhi zhing zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen po rgyud la bskyed pa'i nus mthu dang ldan par gyur//oṃ āḥrgyu/ lan gsum/oṃ sarba bir gur gur su ra su ra/ā warta ya ā warta ya ho/badz+ra sbra ḍi na khaṃ/cham āḥ /oṃ 5bye sa /6

bus āḥ//oṃ sna be+e ā rgyu/oṃ a lo ge āḥ//chagarnyelha'irgyu/oṃ na wibye lha'irgyu/oṃ shasta lha'ihūṃ/ oṃ rū ba lha'it+t+waṃ/oṃ shasta lha'irdu/oṃ garnyelha'irgyu/char sa lha'irgyu/asbar+sha 74/oṃ su bha wa shud dhe rtarmaḥte badz+ra sid rnyi hūṃ/na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta : bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥsarba tad khaṃ ud ga te sga ra na gyi me ga ga na khaṃ swā sa oṃ lha ta lhu phaṭa/oṃ ā ka ro mu khaṃ sarba rnyarmaḥṇi/ at+ya nuṅga na na tad/ namaḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ke te/ oṃ saṃ bha ra sa bha ra hūṃ/ oṃ ru ru spru ru dz+wa la tiṣ+ṭha sid bha lo tsa ni sarba arba sna ni swā hā/bdag gi bsam pa'i stobs dang ni//de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin stobs dang //chos kyi dbyings kyi stobs rnams kyis//don rnams gang dag bsam pa kun//de dag thams cad ci rigs par//thogs pa med par 'byung gyur cig/kye/ljongs 'dir skyong ba'i yul lha'i tshul 'dzin pa//la pa'i sa ming brag dkar zhes gsol ba/ /gcig tsam nges sprul ba sna tshogs ston/ /ston mdzad dge bsnyen chen po gnas 'dir gshegs//la phye de se rtsa ra'i gnas la sogs//rig 'dzin dgra lha chos 'khor srung ma mdzad//dge slong cha lugs chos gos rnam gsum 'chang //zhing skyong 'khor bcas gnas 'dir spyan 'dren gshegs//dbus phyogs rgya gar yul gyi dgra lha zhes//ma ru tse dang li yul gnas srung mdzad//bsre khrab bse rmog nyi zla'i 'od ltar 'bar//rta dmar bcibs shing gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//gnas bdag dge bsnyen brag dkar chen po dang //gsang yum sras dang blon pa'i tshogs dang bcas//las mkhan btsan rgod klu bdus the'u rang tshogs//ma lus gang ba'i

tshogs rnams gnas 'dir byon//khyad par mdo smad snang gi sde dpon che//lha mchog rma chen sbom ra mtshan gsol ba//gsang ba'i yum chen gong sman lha ri dang //lha yi sras dang sras mo bco brgyad sogs//gnyan chen sde bzhi sum brgya drug cu'i tshogs//thogs pa med par gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//khyad par yul phyogs 'di dang mdo smad kyi//lha klu gzhi bdag gnyan po'i tshogs rnams dang //ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kun//ma thogs bsang mchod mgron tsaspyan 'dren gyis//rang rang dgyes pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol//pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ/kyi/khyed rnams dgyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni//shing sna tsan dan dkar dmar a ka ru//'bru sna rin chen lnga dang dar sna'i —tshogs//sman sna spos dkar phye mar 'o skon dang //bsregs pa'i du sprin nam mkha' kun khyab 'di//dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyis bzhes su gsol//snyen pa'i dbyangs dang ka lang rol mo'i sgra//sna tshogs skad kyi chos dbyings dung dkar klu//mgrin bzang yid kyi dbang ba'i me tog dang //dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol//khrag gi ma dbang ba'i me tog dang /sha chen tshil chen zhun chen mar me sbar//sha rus zhal zas rkang gling rol mo'i sgra//mi lpags gcan gzan g.yang gzhi bla re bre//rgyu ma'i dra ba glo snying yan lag spungs/ /dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol//grub gtor khang bzang rgya thabs tog gis mdzes//rtsa brgyad yan lag stong sbyar amṛta//dgra bgegs snying khrag rak+ta mtsho ltar bskyil//dbang bo rnam lnga'i me tog rgyan ldan

'di//dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol//khrab rmog go mtshon rdo rje'i mtshon cha'i rigs//ral gri dgra sta lcags stsa gri gug dang //mda' gzhu sa mda' rdo rje tho ba dang //zhags pa mdung dmar dgra bgegs snying la snun//dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol//g.yag rog rta mchog bya khyi lce spyang dang //glang seng stag 'brug bya khra dom dred dang //gnam la 'phur dgu sa la 'dzul dgu dang //ma tshang med pa'i spyan gzigs yid sprul ba'i//dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol//dkar gsum mngar gsum chu sna'i sman phud dang //ja chang phud dang gser skyems phye mar dang //me tog sman dang zhal zas tshogs mchod pa//'brang rgyas ting lo g.yag lug ra gsum 'di//dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol//dar mtshon rin chen sna lnga gos nor spungs//ri rab gling bzhi gling phran nyi zlas brgyan//lcags ri mu khyud rgyal srid rin chen bdun//yan lag brgyad ldan rdzing bu yid bzhin nor//lha mi'i dpal 'byor longs spyod ji snyed pa//dngos bshams yid sprul mchod thin rgya mtsho 'di//dgyes pa bskyed phyir 'bul gyi bzhes su gsol// skabs 'dir gzhi bdag gtor ma bsngo/kye/zhi ba'i nyams ldan yul lha dkar bo ni//zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas g.yon mda' gzhu bsnams//sku la khrab rmog zhabs la sag lham gsol//stag dong g.yas la gzig thubs sked la bcings rta dkar sga srab gong chen can la bcibs//sprul ba ma nges ston la mchod par bgyi//mi dkar rta dkar g.yag dkar /ga ra dkar//ba glang mdzo 'bri rnga

mong bong bu dngan /stag gzig dom dred 'phar spyang gcan gzan rigs/ /'brong dang rwa ba rkyang drel gtsod la sogs//rna ba rgo ba la sogs ri dwags rigs//sna tshogs bshams shing yid kyis sprul nas 'bul//bya rgod khyung sogs 'dab chags mkha' la sding //chu bya ngang ba khrung khrung rang sgra sgrog /khu byug 'jol mo snang po'i skad snyan sogs//sgra dbyangs snyan pa'i gsung dbyangs di ri ri//shing sna bsregs pa'i du sprin nam mkha' khyab//dung skad snyan pa'i skad kyis khyed la 'bod//dbyar dus glog 'brug char sprin 'thib cing byon/khyed la mnyes pa'i mchod pa 'bul ba ni//shing tog rigs dang phye mar spos sna dang / /rin chen sna lnga 'bru sna dar sna'i rigs//dkar gsum mngar gsum 'bras chang rgun chang dang //ja chang gser skyems sman phud bdud ji dang //yan lag brgyad ldan chu sna'i chab bran pas//ro brgya zag med bdud rtsir bsgyur nas 'bul//bsang ngo mchod do lha rnams dgyes par mdzod//dgyes mgur spyod la bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod// kye/ gnas 'dir dbang ba'i lha srid sde brgyad dang //yul 'di skyong ba'i srung ma ma lus pa//mdo smad a mdo yul phyogs skyong ba yi//gnas bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag ri mtsho brag/lam 'phrang dgas tshal chu klung ljongs dang yul//jing bu gdengs ka yul phyogs thams cad kyi//lha klu gzhi bdag 'byung bo ma lus pa//gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/kyi/sngon tshe rgyal ba rnams kyi bka'//bar du slob dpon pad+ma yis//lha 'dre dam la /tags nas su//bsang dang gsol

mchod mang du mdzad//rgyal blon thugs dgongs rdzogs nas su//bsam yas chos 'khor lha 'dres brtsigs//rgyal po'i dgongs pa rdzogs par mdzad//bod 'bangs bde skyid nyi ma shar//bsam pa'i don rnams thams cad 'grub//nad 'khrug gnod pa zhi phyir du//de ring bsang mchod mchod pa 'bul//lha yi dbu 'phang yar la bstod//'dre ngan byad phur dgra la bsgyur//ki ki swo swo lha rgyal lo/kye/bsang ngo rtsa brgyud bla ma bsangan/yi dam lha tshogs thams cad bsang //byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bsang / /chos skyong srung ma thams cad bsang / /yul lha gzhi bdag thams cad bsang / /gzhan yang stong gsum 'dzam gling yul//srung zhing skyong ba'i gnas bdag bsang //ming dang mtshan ni ma thon pa'i//bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro bsang //lha srung dam can rgya mtsho bsangan/drang srong nor lha yul lha bsang /lam lha dang lha gnyan po bsang ma lha bu rtse gnyen po bsang //thab la gnas pa'i thab lha bsangan/mkhar la gnas pa'i rtse lha bsang //sgo lha rta g.yag gnyis po bsang //spang dang mtsho la gnas pa bsang //rang la 'go ba'i lha srung bsang //pha mes brgyud kyi srung ma bsang //lhan cig skyes pa'i lha rnams bsangan/grogs lha gnyan po thams cad bsang //tshe bsod longs spyod rgyas par mdzod/ /gsol lo mchod do lha rgyal lo/ /kye/gzhan yang dus gsum pha ma dang / /khams gsum rigs drug thams cad bsang //lan chags glo bur mgron rigs bsang //yi dwags bgegs rigs thams cad bsang //glo bur snying rje'i /gron rnams bsang /lhag ma'i mgron

rigs thams cad bsang //rgyal pham med par 'di bsngos pas//yid kyi re ba rdzogs par shog/mchod sbyin bsang mchod 'di bsngos pas//lha srin sde brgyad thams cad la//gsol mchod nam mkha'i mdzod gyur nas//gang la ci 'dod 'thob par shog /ki swo swo che'o lha rgyal lo//skabs 'dir rang rang mos pa'i yul lha la bsang mchod thon/bstod pa ni/chos nyid zhi ba'i ngang las ma g.yeng kyang //ma rungs 'dul phyir sprul ba sna tshogs ston//drag po'i skur ston bse khrab bse rmog gyon//nyi zla'i 'od ltar 'bar ba khyed la bstod//sku mdog dmar smug gzi 'od 'bar ba las//bdud rta rlung dmar zhon cing stong gsum skor//zhags pas dgra bo'i ske bcings mdung dmar bcas//srog rtsa gcod cing dgra snying zhal du gsol//dam can bshan pa khyed la bdag bstod do//dge slong cha lugs chos gos rnam gsum 'chang //gser theb gyon cing kha ḍam lhuje bzed 'chang / /dgra bcom chos kyis brgyan pa khyed la bstod/ /sku mdog dkar bo shel ltar dwangs pa la/ /lhab lhub dar gyi 'jol ber sku la gsol/ /rin chen rgyan mdzes chibs rta ngang dkar bcibs//zhi ba'i nyams ldan rgyas mdzad khyed la bstod//phyag g.yas phreng ba g.yon pa'i nor gzhong bsnams//dgyes pa'i gsang yum mdzes pa'i lcam sring dang //bka' sgron sprul ba gang sprul bran g.yog bcas//ma lus 'khor dang bcas pa bdag bstod do//sku mdog rab dkar khro chags sgeg pa dang / /phyag g.yas yid bzhin nor bu bsam 'phel bsnams//g.yon pa shel kyi/kar phreng ba brgya rtsa 'dren//dngos

grub char 'bebs chen po khyed la bstod//gsang ba'i yum chen gong sman lha ri dang //lha yi sras dang sras mo dgu dang bcas//gnyan chen sde bzhi lha sman 'khor dang bcas//sum brgya drug cu'i sde dpon bka' sdod bcas//thang lha yum bzhi bka' sdod tshogs la bstod//kye/ lha khyed rtag tu gsol zhing mchod pa'i mthus//dgon gnas dge 'dun sde dang gtsug lag khang //bdag cag rgyu 'byor sde dang bcas pa la//legs pa brgya sprod nyes pa stong dang bsnor//nad gdon chag chen 'jigs pa kun las skyob//bsam pa'i don 'grub mi nor rigs rgyud 'phel//rgyab kyi brten pa mdun gyi 'khar ba mdzod//phar 'gro'i skyel ma tshur 'ong bsu ma mdzod//mun pa'i sgron me lam 'phrang grol 'don mdzod//rtag tu gsol zhing mchod cing bskul pa'i mthus//kun las rnam par rtag sargyal bar shog/ces yi gebargya bas lhag chad skongs/ma snyed yongs su ma shes dang //gang yang nus pa ma mchis pas//'dir ni bya ba gang bgyis pa/ /de kun khyed kyis bzod mdzad rigs//khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzod//rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol//bsang mgron rang gnas su gshegs kyang / /gtan nas gshegs pa ma yin par/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol//badz+ra mu/ bsang mgron 'khor dang bcas pa rnams//rang rang gnas su gshegs par gyur//sarba lo ka gats+tsha/yid bzhin nor bu mdzad med gter bum ltar//dpag bsam shing ltar 'dod pa'i re ba skongs//bral med stsol mdzad bla ma yi dam lha//mkhaX 'gro chos skyong rnams kyi bkra shis

zhog /rang rang srung zhing skyong ba'i sde brgyad lha/ /yul lha dngos grub char 'bebs lha klu dang / /mi nor bsam 'phel rigs rgyud nor rnams spel/ /mnga' thang chab srid rgyas pa'i bkra shis shog/nyid yang bkra shis mtshan yang bkra shis shog /nyid mtshan rtag tu bral med bkra shis 'byung //bgegs med bsod nams rgyas shing tshe 'phel zhing / /'phel rgyas g.yung drung ltar bstan bkra shis shog /e ma 'di 'dra lha rnams mnyes par byed pas bsang mchod gaṅga'i rgyun 'dra yid du 'ong ba/ ro brgyas tshim pa'i 'dod yon mang bshams pas/ lha rnams dgyes dgur rol la spyod par gyis 'di 'dra'i skal bzang yun du e ma mtshar/zhes bsang mchod bkra shis 'khyilab zhes bya ba 'di ni/zhing skyong zhabs drung dang don gnyer can 'ga' zhig gis yul lha brag dkar dang gnas bdag lcam sring smin thang lha dang mdo smad kyi yul lha rnams yod pa'irang rang gi 'dod mos ltar/ shākya'i dge slong ngag dbang chos grags rgya mtshos sbyar ba'o/

lha yi dge bsnyen chen po'i bskang gso pad+mo rgyas pa'i nyin byed/༄7//yid mthunagyisaganasasu dngos bshams yid sprul phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa sna tshogs pa 'dus byas la/ rang nyid yi dam gang rung ba'i bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas/mchod gtor spyi ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/riḥ ཿbsang /su lha was sbyangs/stong ba'i ngang las mdunadu mu tig gi 'od ltar 'tsher ba'i dkar brag gi ri bo rtsemo tshangs pa'i 'jig rten tubasnyegs shingartsa ba spang gdong yid du thong ba nags tshal du mas brgyan pa/ri dwags dang spyang bya sna tshogasasgra skad snyan po sgrog cing lang ling du ba rngams zilaldan pa'i dbus su khang brtsegs shel dkar g.yu gser gsum sogs las grub pa'i rgyan gyis pas pa'i nangadu gangs ri chags pa'i dum bu ltar dkar ba'i rta mchog srin gyi shugs can rin po che'i sga srabasogs rgyan gyis sprasapa'i steng du shel dkar gyi mdung ring gser gyi so rnon dang ldan pa de las 'od zer 'phros don gnyis byas/tshul 'dusayongs su gyur pa lasalha'i dge bsnyen chen po skumadog chu shelagyi ri bo 'dra ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/phyag g.yas shel gyi mdung ring gser gyi sornon can lha gos kyi lhab lhub dang ldan pa 'dzin cing /phyag g.yon yid bzhin gyi nor bu 'dzin pa/shin tu 'dzum zhing ka shi rka'i la thod dang lha gos kyi na bza' phu bung can gsol ba rol zhing 'gying ba/de'i g.yas g.yon rnams dang mtha' skor du btsun mosras blon dmag 'bangs sogs kyis bskor cing longs spyod bsam gyis mi khyab dang bcas/gtso 'khor thamasacad kyi spyi bor oṃ/mgrin par lha / thugs kur rgyu gi 2

'od zer gyis rangabazhin gyi gnas nas lha'i dgebasnyen chen po 'khor dang bcas spyan drangs/rol mo dbyangs dang bcas/ rdu/ lhun grub bde chen chos sku pho brang nas//dus gsum rgyal ba'i bstan srung mthu rtsal can//dkar phyogs skyong mdzad srung ma yongs kyi gtso/ /lha yi dge bsnyen chen po gnas 'dir gshegs/ /lha gcig dpal ldan mar me mdzad dpal dang / /khyad par 'brom ston rgyal po'i 'byung gnas kyi/ /bstan dang bstan 'dzin skyong bar zhal bzhes pa'i/ /g.yar dam ma g.yel gnas 'dir da tshur byon/ /rgyal kun snying rje'i rang gzugs pad dkar 'chang / /dus mthar rgyal bstan skyong ba'i srung ma cher/ /ston mdzad lha yi dge bsnyen spyan 'dren no//dam tshig ldan pa'i gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol//oṃ ma hā de wa mu ba su ka sa ba ri a dar+ṣa ya dza dzaḥdza skye bo hoḥ dam tshig pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ rdu/mdun du ting 'dzin gyis sprul 'ja' yas dbus//pad nyi rdzu 'phrul shugs ldan rta mchog steng //dgyel med bzhugs nas dam ldan rnal 'byor kun//nyin mtshan dus drug srung skyob ma g.yel zhig /pad+ma ka ma la ye s+t+waṃ//oṃ mahā de wa u ba si ka sa ba ri wa ra ma nas shas bar mchod/ /oṃ mahā de wa mu ba si ka sa ba ri wa ra oṃ āḥzhe/ /rab dkar 'od zer 'bum phrag 'phro ba'i mthus/ma rungs nag phyogs mtha' dag zil gnon cing //grub pa bo la dngos grub mchog stsol pa'i//lha yi dge bsnyen chen por gus pas bstod//bshas bzlas ni/rang gi thugs ku'i las 'od zer 'phros pas rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs spyan drang sdu/yigabargya gang mang bzlas/rgyu lnga brgya'i
