gtsug rgyan jo bo yab sras dang //khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa//sku bzhi bdag nyid dkyil 'khor 'khor lo'i mgon//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i tshogs rnams dgongs su gsol//dngos grub 'byung gnas rdo rje dam tshig las//bag med dbang gi 'gal bgyis mthol lo bshags//spyan ras gzugs dbang thugs rje'i zlos gar mkhan//lha yi dge bsnyen 'khor bcas bdag la dgongs//lha khyed rgyal kun thugs rje'i gter chen du//yid ches dad pas snying nas ma bgrus bshegs//phyi nang gsang ba'i rten rdzas ma tshang ba//gtang rag dus su ma mthong mthol lo bshags//mdor na rang bzhin dag pa'i sems kyi dbyings//glo bur nyer ba'i sprin gyis rgud pa las//rmi lam bzhin du 'khrul pas nongs pa rnams//spros bral chos dbyings ngang du bzod par mdzod//bskangs rdzas byin gyis brlabs la/ཿཿ gang shar bde ba chen po'i rol ba las//mthun pa'i dam rdzas phyi dang mchod pas tshogs//lha lam 'dzin pa'i khyon kun yongs bkang ste//lha chen 'khor dang bcas pa mchod par bgyi//zhi rgyas dbang drag nyer spyod mtha' klas pa/ /dbang lnga'i yul du dga' bskyed 'dod yon lnga//shel dkar mdangs dang gser gyi so ldan dang //sgrub pas dngos grub stsol pa'i nor gzhong 'dis/ /lha yi dge bsnyen chen po'i thugs dam bskang //gsang yum sras blon 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //thugs dam gnyan po dbang du skong gyur nas//'gal rkyen kun sel mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs//nor bu'i sga srab mdzes ༷/ cang shes rta//'bri g.yag zhol ldan

ra lug ri dwags tshogs//stag gzig gcan gzan dung khra pho mo dang //shel ltar 'tsher ba'i nor skyong dpag med 'dis//lha yi dge bsnyen chen po'i thugs dam bskang //gsang yum sras blon 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang / /thugs dam gnyan po dbang du skong gyur nas//'gal rkyen kun sel mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs//sra brtan rdo rje go khrab mdzes shing brjid//rno ngar dgra dpung 'joms pa'i mtshon cha 'bar//ri rab gling bzhi nyi zla rgyal srid bdun//mdor na lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs 'dis//lha yi dge bsnyen chen po'i thugs dam bskang //gsang yum sras blon 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //thugs dam gnyan po dbang du skong gyur nas//'gal rkyen kun sel mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs//stong gsum ltar yangs rin chen snod rnams su/ /lhun por spungs ba'i bdud rtsi'i gtor ma dang //khrag chang btung ba gser skyems rgya mtsho 'khyil//phyi nang rten sogs ma tshang med pa 'dis//lha yi dge bsnyen chen po thugs dam bskang //gsang yum sras blon 'khor bcas thugs dam bskang //thugs dam gnyan po dbang du bskangs gyur nas//'gal rkyen kun sel mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs//rgyal kun mkhyen dang brtse ba'i cha shas tshogs//gcig bsdus 'phags mchog spyan ras gzigs dbang nyid//rgyal bstan skyong mdzad lha yi dge bsnyen cher//yid ches mos pa'i bla med rten mchog 'dis//lha yi dge bsnyen chen po'i thugs dam bskang //gsang yum sras blon 'khor bcas thugs dam bsdang // thugs dam gnyan po dbang du

bskang gyur nas//'gal rkyen kun sel mthun rkyen ma lus sgrubs//bskul ba bya ba ni/ /rdu bla ma yi dam srung mamo sgrub pa'i dus la bab/ lan gsum/ rgyu dkar phyogs skyong la mthu ldan srung ma'i tshogs//ma g.yel rnal 'byor bdag la tshul gson dang //bdag cag bla med byang chub sgrub pa la//snga dgra ras pa lag la dngos su bkar//phyi dgra yid la bsam zhing sbyor ba brtson/ /da lta dngos su bsam sbyor du ma yis/ /gnod par byed pa'i gdug can dgra bo 'di//lo dang zla bar 'jog pa'i long med pas//da lta nyid du srung ma rnams kyis sgrol//gnam gyi 'ju thag sa yi rten bur phyungs//bla srog tshe gsum spar gyis thob la drongs//sha khrag rus pa ma lus srog bcud gtor//snying khrag dron mo zhal du hub kyis drongs/ /mdun rgyud tshun chad gtan nas brlag par mdzod//nyes can 'di dag yal bar bor gyur na//dngos brgyud bla ma rnams kyi bka' yang bcag /rang gi khas blangs dam bca' ris su bor//mthu ldan srung mar grags kyang ming du zad//de bas dam rdzas mchod pa 'di bzhes la//mthu stobs nus pa rdzu 'phrul dpung bskyed de//khams gsum srog la rngams pa'i rnam 'gyur gyis//drag shul mi zad cho 'phrul sna tshogs pas//gnod byed ma lus rgyal ba'i las mdzod cig / snyi bzlog bya/ ba ba ni/ oṃ mahā de wa u ba si ka sid rnyi dzaḥ zhesaci mang bzlas/yig brgya brjod/de nas gtor ma byin gyis brlabs la/lha yi dge bsnyen chen po'i ljags 'od zer gyi sbru gus gtor ma'i bcud thams cad drangs te gsol bar gyur/ oṃ mahā spya wa sku ba si ka sa ba ri wa ra i dam pa

long ta kha kha khā gyi khā gyi/ lan gsum mam bdun brjod/ma ka ro lan gsum gyi 'khor rnams la 'bul/oṃ mahā de wa mu ba si ka sa ba ri wa ra ma nas shasnya bar mchod/oṃ mahā de wa u ba si ka sa ba ri wa ra oṃ āḥrgyu/ nang mchod 'bul/ yid 'ong mchod sprin tshogs kun ma lus 'bul//bdag sogs dgon gnas gnyer du gtad lags pas//pha rol rbad 'dre gnod byed tshogs zhi nas//bshad sgrub legs tshogs gong du 'phel bar mdzod//ces gtor rdzongs bya/dkar gtor bsngo/bstod pa ni/ snying rje'i cha shas yongs rdzogs pad dkar 'chang //snyigs dus nag phyogs bdud sde'i gnyan po ru//mthu stobs dpa' yas lha yi dge bsnyen cher//ston mdzad dgra lha'i rgyal po khyed la bstod//gang sku ke la sha yi sa 'dzin la//nyi gzhon 'bum gyis 'khyud 'dra gzi brjid 'bar//'od 'bar nor bu'i rgyan dang lha yi gos//rab dkar dar gyi cod pan 'dzin la bstod//g.yas pa'i phyag na rab mnabs mdung rnon gyi//nag phyogs bdud rigs ma lus gzhom pa dang //phyag g.yon nor bu gang ba'i gzhong ba yis//sgrub la ci 'dod dngos grub stsol la bstod//gzhan yang dbang drag rgyas mdzad sprul ba dang //gsang yum blon po 'jigs rung ru 'dren bcas//laṅga'i bdag po g.yul ngo chas 'dra ba'i/ /'khor tshogs dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs la bstod/ /rdo rje 'chang dbang jo bo yab sras sogs//dngos rgyud bla ma lha yi spyan snga ru//zhal bzhes dam tshig gnyan po nyer dgongs nas//rgyal bstan spyi dang blo bzang rgyal ba'i bstan//bshad dang sgrub paX phyogs brgyad rab 'phel zhing //de

'dzin dam pa rnams kyi sku tshe srungs//'jig rten ma lus rtag cabade ba dang //dgra bgegs nag po'i rigs rnams brlag par mdzod//khyad par dga' ldan chos 'khor gling 'di yi//dge 'dun rnams kyi thugs mthun khrims gtsang zhing / /mthun rkyen sgrub pa'i bod 'brog sde rigs rnams/ /mi nyams dbyar mtsho lta bu rgyas par mdzod/ /mdor na rnal 'byor dpon slob 'khor bcas kyi//bshad sgrub longs spyod tshe dang bsod nams sogs//legs tshogs ma lus dbyar gyi chu gter bzhin//spel la byang chub bar du grogs mdzod cig/bzod gsol brtan bzhugs shis brjod sogs ltar bya'o//dge slong blo bzang dpal ldan yeshes kyis mdzad pas be+e ra jo bo chen po'i gtor chog dang bang mchen po'i lung gi zhwa ser bstan pa'i gsal byed/rwa smreng blo bzang ye shes bstan pa rab rgyas kyis phyi dkar jo bo chen po'i bskang gso sogs las 'don chos skor — phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs pa lags so/brag dkar pho brang du bzhugs//

brgyad pa/ gser skyems/rgyal po sku lnga'i gser skyems/༄༄ //griḥ/badz+rakro rnya ha ya gri wa pad+man+ta kṛta rgyu phaṭa/ oṃ su bhā wa shud rnya sarba rnya rma su bhā wa shud rnyosdo hre/ stong ba nyid du gyur/ stong ba'i ngang las yo las rlung dkyil gzhu dbyibs ba dan mtshan//de steng raṃ las me dkyil gru gsum pa//raṃ gyis mtshan steng rka las mi mgo yi//snyed pu gsum steng ma las thod pa'i nang //rlu waṃ māṃ r+pā ṭ+wāṃ las seng ge dang //glang bo rta dang rma bya mi sha'i steng / /oṃ rgyu swā hā steng thabs shes kyi//nyi zla sbyar la dbyangs gsal gyis mtshan pa//dbus su rdo rje'i rtser a lte bar rgyu//yar ra oṃ sum̐ swā me hā lda dang //mar rwa mū waṃ rmā r+pā ṭ+wāṃ gyis mtshan//thugs ku'i rdu las 'od 'phro rlung gis me/1sbar te rdzas 'khol rgyal ba sras bcas mchod//rgyal kun rigs lngar gyur pa'i byang chub sems//babs pa'i a dang 'bru bcu hūṃ dbyangs gsal//rim gyis gcig la gcig phog thim pa yis//nyi zlar bcas pa 'od zhu rdzas la thim//sman rag gtor gsum zag med bdud rtsir gyur//oṃ āḥ/ sarba pañtsa mtha ta rgyu hrīḥṭha//oṃ lha'irgyu ma hā rak+ta dz+wa la ma la hūṃ hrīḥṭha//oṃ lha'irgyu ma sne ba lo ta te dzo ba lo ta ba la pa te ku h+ya sa ma yo hūṃ hrīḥk+ṣa1//bho rnyi tsi sta gha na lhu ya gu tsa hoḥ//rgyu

gser skyems gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa 'di//dbus phyogs thugs kyi rgyal po sprul ba yum//blon po 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa//gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//rgyuḥ gser skyems gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa 'di//shar phyogs sku yi rgyal po sprul ba yum//blon po 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa//gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//rgyuḥ gser skyems gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa 'di//lho phyogs yon tan rgyal po sprul ba yum//blon po 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa//gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod///ci gser skyems gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa 'di//nub phyogs gsung gi rgyal po sprul ba yum/ /blon po 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa/ /gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ rgyuḥ gser skyems gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa 'di//byang phyogs 'phrin las rgyal po sprul ba yum//blon po 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa//gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//gser skyems gtsang ma phud kyi mchod pa 'di//rdo rje dregs ldan nor sbyin dzi'u dmar//ru 'dren sde bzhi sprul ba yang sprul la//gsol 'o mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod//sa gsum 'gro ba'i 'dod 'jo dbang gi rgyal//dpal ldan gsang ba 'dus pa'i dge 'dun sde//skyong mdzad dam can skyes bu chen po la//gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/bshags pa bya ba ni/ rgyuḥ kun tu bzang bo rig 'dzin pad+ma 'byung //rtsa brgyud bla ma rta mgrin dbang gi lha/ /sprul ba'i chos rgyal chen po 'khor bcasdu rnams//rnal 'byor bdag la deng

'dir dgongs su gsol//bdag cag ma rig sgrib pa'i dbang gyur te//dngos grub rtsa ba'i bla mar smod pa dang //yi dam lha la spang len bgyis pa dang / /gsang ba sngags kyi dam tshig nyams pa bshags//khyad par sprul ba'i rgyal po 'khor bcas la//bsnyen sgrub mchod gtor bskang ba chag pa dang //gtang rag le lo'i dbang gyur dus las yol//mchod rdzas mi gtsang pags sogs mthol lo bshags//gdug can dgra dang zas gtam 'dres pa dang //'phrin las rnam bzhi'i bya ba nye ba bor/ /'gro la brtse ba'i snying rje btang ba sogs//theg chen tshul dang 'gal rnams mthol lo bshags//chos kun gdod nas stong ba'i rang bzhin la//kun rdzob 'khrul ngor bgyis pa'i nyes pa rnams//gsal stong 'dzin pa med pa rig pa'i gshis//spros bral chos dbyings ngang du dag par mdzod dam can gyi 'phrin las bcol ba di/ rgyuḥskyes bu dam can chen po thig le rtsal//seng ge rwa skyes ma nges bzhon pa can//sum brgya drug cu'i sprul ba grangs med pa//ma thogs rings pa'i tshul gyis da tshur byon//dam nyams dgra bgegs bsgral ba las byung ba'i//sha rus zas mchog dam rdzas rgyan ldan che//sman skyems rak+ta'i mchod pa 'bul byed na//dgyes par rol la bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ ཿ bstan srung pe har rgyal po sku lnga dang //dam can rdo rje legs pa 'khor bcas rnams//mtsho skyes rdo rje'i spyan sngar zhal bzhes bzhin//thub pa'i bstan pa spyi dang khyad par du//bshad sgrub 'byung gnas ngo mtshar sprul ba'i zhing //sku 'bum byam/ sdu gling gi dga' tshal du//chos spyod bya

dregs pa sde brgyad la gser skyems gtong ba'i cho ga bdud rtsi'i rlabs phreng /༄༄ //na mo gu ru ha ya sgri wa ba ya/ 'dir dregs pa sne brgyad la gser skyems gtong ba'i tshul ni/de yang gser skyems kyi ngas la phyag len mi 'dra ba sna tshogs 'dug kyang 'dir 'khyer bde ba'i dbang du byas na/mgron gyi lde tshan gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i phud char gyi nangadu/chang phud la/gser sogs rinapo che dang /sman sna/'bru sna rnams rdog po'am bye ma btab pa bshams/rang nyid rta mgrin sogs yi dam gyi nga rgyal dang ldan pas byin rlabs nang mchod ltar bya ba'am/ yang na ma sbo tas bsangs/su bhā wasasbyangs/ stong ba'i ngang las oṃ sa zhu ba las byung ba'i gser skyems 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang rmen zhing mgron so so'i mos pa dang mthun pa'i mkho dgu'i longs spyod zad mi shes pa 'byung ba nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin du gyur par bsam la/ oṃ lha'isnye lan gsum dang/nam mkha' mdzod kyisngags lan gsum bden stobs dang bcas pa brjod/ rgyuḥ bde chen lhun grub gzhal yas nas/ /rtsa brgyud bla ma dkon mchog gsum/ /dpa' bo mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs//gser skyems mgyon du gshegs su gsol//gar bzhugs so so'i gnas rnams nas//snang srid dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs//rang rang 'khor g.yog dang bcas pa//gser skyems mgron du gshegs su gsol//mdun du pad ma nyi zla dang //khri stan /spyan pa la sogs pa//ji ltar 'os pa'i

gdan khri la//mchod pa'i yul du bzhugs su gsol/gser skyems dang po lag tu thogs la/ rgyu/ rtsa ba'i bla ma bka' drin can/ /brgyud pa'i bla ma byin rlabs can//yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro'i tshogs//sangs rgyas byang sems nyan rang dang //dpa' bo mkha' 'gro srung ma'i tshogs/ /skyabs yul dam pa thams cad la/ /gser skyems mchod pa 'di 'bul lo//bzhes nas mchog thun dngos grub stsol/ ces brjod la gser skyems de sa gtsang sar gshegs pa'am gsog snod gzhan zhig tu drugs/sdetshan phyi ma rnams la'ang de bzhin du byas la/ rgyu/ lha yi dbang bo brgya byin dang //lha min dbang bo thag bzang dang / mi'am ci ljon rta mgo dang / /gnod sbyin gang ba bzang bo dang /mkha' lding gser mig 'khyil ba dngan /chos skyong ma hā kā la dang //srin po laṅka mgrin bcu dngan/dri za zur phud lnga ba sogs//phyi yi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la//gser skyems mchod pa 'di 'bul lo// bzhes nas 'gal rkyen bar chad sol//bdag gi yid la gang bsam don// lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/tshig rkang phyi ma bzhi bo 'di sdetshan 'og ma thams cad la sbyar te/ snye/ yab gcig bdud rje nag po dang //btsan rgyal yam thud dmar bo dang //yul lha phywa sang klu sras dang //srog bdag rgyal po snying 'byin dang //chos skyong gnod sbyin dmar bo dang //lha mo 'jigs pa'i glog 'byin dang //dge bsnyen rdo rje legs pa dang //dkar mo nyi zla'i thod phreng sogs//dang gi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la//gser skyems mchod pa 'di 'bul lo//bzhes nas 'gal rkyen bar chad /sdu//bdag gi yid la gang bsam don//

lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /rgyuḥ bdud po kha thun rak+ṣa dngan/gshin je gshed po dmar bo dang //klu bdud nā ga rā dza dang //gnod sbyin bshan pa gri thogs dang /ma mo srid pa khram 'debs dang //btsan po yam shud srog len dang //bdud po re lde 'gong yag dang //srog bdag dung gi thor — tshugs sogs//gsang ba'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la//gser skyems mchod pa 'di 'bul lo//bzhes nas 'gal rkyen bar chad sol//bdag gi yid la gang bsam don//lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzodaka ཿ gza' mchog rgyal po rā hu la//dkar mchog khram shing kha 'thor dang //bdud mchog ma nu yak+ṣa dang //btsan mchog gyi btsan 'thum po dang //ma mchog lce spyang dung 'dzin dang //klu mchog klu rgyal dung skyong dang //mgon mchog nag po lte gar dang //rgyal mchog li byin ha ra sogs//mchog gi sde brgyad 'khor bcas la//gzer skyems mchod pa 'di 'bul lo//bzhes nas 'gal rkyen bar chad sol//bdag gi yid la gang bsam don//lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ / rgyuḥdapung g.yas dgra lhar sprul ba dang //dpung g.yon ma mor sprul ba dang //mchu so bdud du sprul ba dang //mgo bo srin por sprul ba dang //mjug ma dmu ru — sprul ba dang //lag g.yas gshin rjer sprul pa dang //lag g.yon klu btsan sprul ba dang //mig dang snying dang mtshan ma gsum//gza' bdud nyid du sprul ba sogs//sprul ba'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la//gser skyems mchod pa 'di 'bul lo/ /bzhes nas 'gal rkyen /ra chad sol/ /bdag gi yid la gang

bsam don/ /lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod// rgyu/ sa bdag hal khyi dag po dang //klu bdud go ra dag po dang //sa yi lha mo bstan ma dang //phyogs skyong rgyal chen sde bzhi dang //mgon po bdun cu rtsa lnga dang / /yul 'di'i gzhi bdag thams cad dang / /pho lha dgra lha srog lha dang //mo lha mo sman la sogs pa//snang srid sde brgyad thams cad la//gser skyems mchod pa 'di 'bul lo//bzhes nas 'gal rkyen bar chad sol/ /bdag gi yid la gang bsam don/ /lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ de ltar mchod pas mgron rnams tshim zhing dgyes nas rang gi yid kyis gang bcol ba'i las rnams thogs pa med par sgrub par bsam/ de nas/ chu las chu bur rdol ba bzhin//rig pa'i rtsal gyis bos pa'i mgron/ /ngo bo skye med chos kyi dbyings/ /rnam pa rang rang gnas su gshegs//'bad dang rtsol ba mi dgos par/zhes sogs bya'o/ phud phor gcig las med na/ snod che ba zhig tu bshams pa byin rlabs tshar rjes/mgron tshan re re bzhin phud phor gcig po der blugs nas 'bul ba sogs bgyis kyang chog go rgyud sde rnams su sde brgyad kyi rnam bzhag gzhan gsungs pa'ang yod mod/ 'dir ni gnub chen sangs rgyas ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i sde brgyad mchod thabs sgra sor bzhag tu bris pa yin no/zhes dregs pa sde brgyad la gser skyems gtong ba'i cho ga bdud ci'i rlabs phreng zhesabya ba 'di ni bsod namasastobasakyis mngon par mtho ba dur bed wang phun tshogs bsam 'grub kyis rin chen gnyis pa'i skyes dang bsdus 'phrin yig gi lam nas bskulapa'ingor

ku sna 47snyam badz+ra gyis phra du bris pa'i yege pa ni gu dzingag dbang bstan 'phelalo/ /'di'i lag len ni/snod gtsang ma'i nang du gtor ma ri rab bang rim bzhi ba'i dbyibs can gyi steng du dkon mchog la kum gtor dkar bo gsum/ bang rim dang po la phyi'i lde brgyad/gnyis pa lanang gi gsum pa la gsang ba'i/bzhi ba la mchog gi ri rab rtsa bar sprul ba'i lde brgyad dang bcas par bshos chung brgyad re/ mtha' skor du gtsang ris kyi dpal mgon/ yul lha gzhi bdag dang bcas pa la bshos tham grangs ma nges pa'i ci mnganade dag gi bar mtshams rnams su ril bu/ mtheb kyu/ ting lo/chang bu sogs dang /dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ sha khrag sna tshogs/ sman dang me tog ji bcud shing tog sna tshogs/'bru sna rin po che/gos sna/dar sna/ zas sna rnamasagang 'dzom r+shar+sham 'dres par tshom bur spungs/gzhan yang gser skyems/ja phud/ chang phud/ nyer spyod kyi mchod pa dang bcas pa bshams/ yi dam gyi rnal 'byor dang rdzas rnamasasngags drug phyag rgya yis byin gyis brla sa tshul rnams bsang chog bkra shis dbyangs snyan ltar bya/de nas mgron rnams nam mkha' la grin brdol ba bzhin du/stong ba'i dbyings las skad cig gis 'ur gyis bzhings te nam mkha' bar snang sa gzhi thams cad khyab par bzhugs par bsam la/dngos gzhi'i bsngo tshig gzhung ltar dang mjugatu 'dod gso dmigs bsal sbyar dgos yod na ye ge zur du yod pa ltar sbyar bas 'bus/ gtor ma sogs med par gser skyems 'ba' zhig gtong ba yin na/ gud phor du gser skyems blugasapa lagatu thogs te 'bru gsum gyis brlabs la/ mgron tshan re re rdzogs mtshams su 'thor ba re bya/ bsang rgyang ba gtong na/bsangamachod dam pa 'di 'bul lo/dgyes pa chen pos legs bzhes nas/bdag gi 'dod don bsgrub tu gsol/ zhesal mi badz+ra yis mas 5/

dgra lha'i dbang bo lha gnyan dpa' stag la gser skyems 'bul tshul lha dgyes mchod sprin/༄'i //no mo gu ru bh+ya/gser skyems bshams te/skyabs sems mdor bsdus byas la/chos dbyings ngang las rang nyid lha gsal ba'i/mdun du sne las rin chen snod steyangs por/oṃ āḥ las 'dod yon lnga ldan gyis/ /gser skyems nam mkha' mdzod kyi rang bzhin du gyur/ lha lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/rgyuḥ rang bzhin bde ba chen po'i chos sku la//rnam pa du mar chags pa'i zlos gar gyis//srid dang zhi ba'i phan bde ma lus pa'i//gzhi rten bse la char ba 'bebs byed pa'i//bla ma yi dam bgrang yas dkyil 'khor lha//dpa' bo mkha' 'gro bka' sdod srung ma'i tshogs//dgra lha'i dbang bo la sogs bos pa'i mgron//ma lus spyan drangs mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs//ka ma la ye ste/ nu rtsa brgyad stong sgyur zag med mchod pa'i sprin//'dod yon lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i gser skyems 'di//rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam rgyud sde bzhi//zhi khro rab 'byams rgyal ba sras bcas dang //gnas gsum mkha' 'gro bstan srung rgya mtsho bcas//bsru med skyabs kyi tshogs rnams mnyes phyir 'bul//mchog dang thun mong dngos grub char chen gyis//'dod don lhun gyis 'grub pa'i 'phrin las mdzod/ rgyu rtsa brgyad stong sgyur zag med mchod pa'i sprin//༷dod yon lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i gser

skyems 'di//rnam 'byor dgra lha gnyan po dpa' rtags che//gsang ba'i yum gcig rdo rje dpal 'bar ma//sras mchog bka' blon phyag brnyan la sogs pa'i//snang srid dregs pa'i sde brgyad 'khor bcas la//gsol lo mchod do rnam bzhi'i 'phrin las kyis//rnal 'byor bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par mdzod/ / rgyuḥ rtsa brgyad stong sgyur zag med mchod pa'i sprin/ /'dod yon lnga ldan bdud rtsi'i gser skyems 'di//bdag gi cho rigs rgyud pa la 'go zhingan/mgon dang grogs mdzad mthu ldan tshogs rnams dang //lo zla zhag dus gzhi byes lam gyi lha//phyogs skyong sde brgyad yul lha gzhi bdag sogs//mgron du 'os pa ji snyed mchis rnams la//'bul zhing bsngo'o rtag tu sdongs grogs mdzod//rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dam tshig bdud rtsi'i ro//rgyun du myang ba'i mthu ldan khyed rnams kyis//sngon gyi khas blangs dam bca' dran mdzod la//nyin mtshan g.yel med bdag gi grogs mdzod cig/gzhi lam byes gsum 'gro 'dug gang du yang //legs pa brgya spyod nyes pa stong dang bsnol//lam 'phrang g.yang sa chu las sgrol don dang //dgra jag chom rkun nyer 'tshe kun las srung//'gal rkyen kun zhi chos srid mtsho ltar rgyas//che rgu kun 'dus snyan grags phyogs bcur khyab//bshad dang sgrub pa'i bya ba rab 'phel nas/ /dge mtshan 'bum phrag bkra ba'i 'phrin las mdzod/ /mchod yul ye shes pa rnams rang la thim/ /'jig rten lha tshogs dgyes bzhin rang gnas su/ /gshegs shing slar yang bdag gis 'bod pa'i tshe//ma thogs // la thogs med 'phrin las mdzod/ /

ces dgra lha'i dbang bo lha gnyan dpa' stag la gser skyems 'bul tshul dgra lha /snye :re /khyo /sgo lha /de :rdo ཿཿ sna /to /snyed sa pa ma da na sa bya ba / gas rus sun sum gas nga dad ga nga 'a ra 'i /mi dze 'iho lha 'i// po /thurib khur sa ma sa pa ra ba da na ba bsam 'grub nga nas yang yang bsku pa'i ngor/ btsun pa byams pa bub bstan rgya mtshos ra ba'o// ཿ 5tsho

'ju lag mthon po bcu gsum dang gnas bdag byams pa dbang phyug gi gser skyems/༄snyo //kyeḥ rang snang phun tshogs gnas rnams nas//mthu stobs rdzu 'phul dpag med pa//gzhi bdag mthon po bcu gsum sogs//dkar phyogs skyong ba'i tshogs rnams dang //dgon gnas dge 'dun mchog gsum rten//dkor zas yo byad srung skyob pa'i//klu gnyan byams pa dbang phyug che//'khor bcas 'dir byon gdan la bzhugs//'bru bcud rin chen sbyar ba yi//lha yi bdud rtsi ma sbo ta//'chi med btung ba'i rgyun bzang 'dis//dkar phyogs skyong ba khyed rnams mchod//mes lha gangs dkar la sogs pa'i// mthon po bcu gsum 'khor bcas la//gser skyems mchod pa 'di 'bul lo//'dod don gang bsam 'grub par mdzod//klu gnyan byams pa dbang phyug che//yul 'di'i dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams//gser skyems mchod pa 'di 'bul lo//'dod don gang bsam 'grub par mdzod/ /lam sang chu mig dgon sgrub gnas//gtsug lag khang skyong thams cad la//gser skyems mchod pa 'di 'bul lo//'dod don gang bsam 'grub par mdzod//mdor na dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams//gser skyems mchod pa 'di bzhes shing //bdag cag 'khor dang thams cad la//'dod don kun gyiX 'grub par mdzod//

skyukhu ka drod tsheri gzi 'bar gnas kyi bdag/'ju lag klung 'gram skyong ba gnyan gyi rje mthon po bcu gsum yul lha gzhi bdag kun/gsol lo mchod do bcol ba'i 'phrin las mdzod ces pa 'di ni btsun pa sngo kho ngag dbang legs bshad nyi mas ka drod gnas bstod skabs gsungs pa'o rta wagu'irngu ci mo

tshangs pa'i gser skyems dngos grub 'gugs pa'i lcags kyu/༄༄ //6 rin chen 'od 'bar 'chi med lha yi bcud//stong gsum khyon ltar yangs pa'i snod gang ba/ /zag med bde ba ster byed gser skyems 'dis//'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po'i lha tshogs mchod//srid gsum srog bdag dung gi thor tshugs can/ /mi bzad shel gyis bstan dgra'i srog rtsa gcod/ /nyi zer zhags pa'i bdud kyi bla 'gug pa/ /lha chen tshangs pa rab 'bar bcud 'dir rol//btsan rgod dregs pa'i sde dpon bse khrab can//mi bzad bang chen lha btsan bdud dmag 'gyed//rta mchog la bcibs bstan pa'i bya ra ba//bdud ci'i gser skyems rgya mtsho 'di bzhes shig /sprul ba rnam drug ging brgyad dmag dpon gsum//ru 'dren sde bzhi dregs pa sde brgyad tshogs//kun kyang gser skyems rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la//rnal 'byor bcol ba'i las kun thogs med sgrubs/ /lha yi rgyal po 'khor dang bcas pa yi mchod gtor dam rdzas rgya mtsho 'di bzhes la//gnam lcags lce dang glog 'khyug ser ba dang / /me dang sa g.yo kun po'i tshogs rnams khog /dgon gnas dge 'dun sde dang bcas pa yi//'gal rkyen mi mthun nyer 'tshe kun zhi nas//chos 'byor bde dgas dus kun 'tsho ba sogs/ /phun tshogs dpal g.yang rgyas pa'i 'phrin las mdzod// cesatshangs pa'i gser skyems dngos grub 'gug pa'i lcagasakyu zhesabya ba 'dini sngo'ongag dbang legs baspyad nyims brtsams/

dgu ba/ g.yang 'bod/sgrol ma'i g.yang 'bod/d+ku//mchog gsum ngo bo rtsa brgyud bla ma dang //yi dam rje btsun sgrol ma'i byin rlabs mthus//bdag gi yid la ji ltar bsam pa'i don//bgegs med myur du 'grub par mdzad du gsol//bla ma lha mchog 'phags pa'i thugs bskyed dang //nor lha gter bdag rnams kyi byin mthu yis//rnam 'dren zas gtsang sras po chos kyi g.yang //'dus las dge bcu'i khrims gtsang dar gyur cig/phyogs 'dus kun tu dge legs sgo 'byed pa'i//bkra shis rdzas brgyad rgyal srid sna bdun g.yang //sprin bzhin 'du zhing rtsi shing ltar rgyas nas//chos mthun 'tsho ba ngoms med spyod par shog /'o ma'i rgyun 'dzin gnag phyugs g.yang dkar lug /cang shes rta bo srog chags grangs med kyis//phywa g.yang sprin bzhin 'thib nas rab yangs pa'i//ra ba phyugs kyis 'gengs pa'i dpal stsol cig/gser dngul zangs lcags la sogs rin chen rigs//nas 'bras gro sogs 'bru rigs dpag med kyis//phywa g.yang dpal 'byor legs tshogs ji snyed kun//ma bsdus 'du bzhin bang mdzod gang gyur cig /srab 'jam gos bzang zas rigs sna tshog/ dang //rno ngar mtshon cha sra brtan go

༄ //mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas mchog dam pa na//mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i mthu stobs can//sgrub pa po la ma g.yel bu bzhin gzigs//gnas gsum mkha' 'gro tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo/ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma'i gzungs/

gang ser ma/sku'i //gang la ser sna rnam chags pa//rnam 'joms dri ma med mdzad cing //thugs zhi gnod pa mi mnga' des/khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur//'dren pa gang zhig 'gro ba rnams//thar ba'i lam du 'gro mdzad cing //chos rnams thams cad ston pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /ston pa 'gro ba rnams kyi rten//sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir//gang zhig bde bar mnga' mdzad des//khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur//skyob pa gang zhig byams pa yi//thugs kyis 'gro ba 'di dag kun//bu gcig bzhin du rtag bskyangs des//khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur/ /gang zhig 'khor bar 'gro ba yi//sems can kun gyi rten gyur cing //gling dang dpung gnyen gyur pa des//khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur//gang zhig chos rnams mngon sum gyur//gtsang zhing bslu ba mi mnga' ba//gsung gtsang gtsang mar mdzad pa des//khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur//dpa' bo chen po gang skyes pas//phun sum tshogs don 'byor gyur cing / /don grub chos kyang grub pa des/ khyed la bde legs mdzad par gyur//gang zhig skyes pas sa rnams ni/ /nags tshal bcas pa rab g.yos shing / /sems can thams cad rab dga' des/ /khyed la bde legs mdza/ par gyur//byang chub snying bor
zhu //klu yi rgyal bo sog ma med/kā/ngas rgyas stong gi 'phrin las pa//gzhon nu gtum po sgrul mgo can//sngags bdag sku la phyag 'tshal lo/klu rgyal sog ma tshekyi gzungs bzhugs so/

mjug byanganade yang bod gangs can gyi yul gru/mdo smad sa yi thig le/dpa' ris nor dkar gyi pha yul 'di chab dpal rig gsum dbyar gyi mtsho mo rgyas par ltar gong nas gong du 'phel ba'i skal bzang gi dus 'dir nged rang skyong rdzong bod kyi skad yig bya ba'i gzhung las khang gis rang rigs kyi srol rgyun rig gnas nyams pa sor chud dang ma nyams gong 'phel du gtong ched dpa' ris yul khongs su gtogs pa'i la lung kun la song nas gna' dpe dang / ngag rgyud/bsang brjod/ glu/ gab tshig gtam dpe sogs 'tshol cid dang tshags sgrig byas yod/ de las bsang brjon ni brjod bya'i don gyi thad nas dpa' ris sa cha'i chos lugs cho ga dang /yul srol goms 'dris/yul khams lo rgyus sogs dpyad par bya ba'i gzhir gyur yod par ma zad/ rjod byed tshig gi cha nas sngon byon skyes chen dam pa rnams kyi rtsom rtsal khyad 'phags can mngon par mtshon thub pa zhig yin pas/ nga tshos de dag bor brlagatu mi gtong bar rjes rabs pa'i 'dren byed kyi lam du bsham thub na srol rgyun rig gnas 'dzin skyong spel gsum byed par e phan snyam nas par du bsgrigs pa yin/ deb 'di'i ma yig 'tshol sdud dang / tshags sgrig zhu dag kha skong sogs las rim re re'i khrod rgan dang grogs po mi zhung ba zhis

gis lhag bsam zol bral gyis rogs ram byas pa dper na/ a lags dor zhi tshang gis bya ba 'di'i thog mtha' bar gsum kun la thugs khur gnang bas mi tshad/ dad ldan mang tshogs kyi re 'dun ltar bsang yig gsar du sbyar cing / gzhung lugs kyis phyug pa'i gleng gzhi mdzad pa ni deb 'di'i rgyan du gyur yod pa dang / a lags tsha kho tshul khrims rgya mtsho tshang dang / dpa' ris rdzong gi srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa'am mchod rten thang gi a khu blo bzang brtson 'grus/ a khu legs bshad nyi ma/ stag lung dgon gyi a khu phun tshogs rgya mtsho bcas kyis rtsom khungs 'tshol sdud dang nang don kha gsab byed par rogs ram mang bo gnang yod/ de min/ dpa' ris rdzong gi dbu 'dren rnam pa dang / gangs rgyan na chung tshags par〉 gyi rtsom sgrig pa tshos kyang thugs khur dang rgyab skyor gnang bas deb 'di gzhi nas kun gyi spyan lam du 'bul thub song 'dir khong rnam par bka' drin zhu ba'i lhag bsam gyi ze'u 'bru yang yang 'bul gyin yod do//
